=== FILE: App.xaml.cs ===

﻿using Victory.Services;
using Victory.Views;
using System.Windows;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows.Threading;
// using MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf;

namespace Victory
{
    public partial class App : Application
    {
        private bool _isClosing = false; // Флаг для предотвращения повторного вызова
        private bool _isShowingUiExceptionNotification = false;
        private DateTime _lastUiExceptionNotificationUtc = DateTime.MinValue;

        public App()
        {
            DispatcherUnhandledException += App_DispatcherUnhandledException;
            AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException += CurrentDomain_UnhandledException;
            System.Threading.Tasks.TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException += TaskScheduler_UnobservedTaskException;

            // ВАЖНО: Обработчик ProcessExit для очистки сессии при принудительном завершении (taskkill)
            AppDomain.CurrentDomain.ProcessExit += CurrentDomain_ProcessExit;
        }

        private void App_DispatcherUnhandledException(object sender, DispatcherUnhandledExceptionEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.LogError("[App] DispatcherUnhandledException", e.Exception);
            }
            catch { }

            if (IsFatalException(e.Exception))
            {
                e.Handled = false;
                TryShowUiExceptionNotification(e.Exception, isFatal: true);
                return;
            }

            e.Handled = true;
            TryShowUiExceptionNotification(e.Exception, isFatal: false);
        }

        private void CurrentDomain_UnhandledException(object? sender, UnhandledExceptionEventArgs e)
        {
            var ex = e.ExceptionObject as Exception;
            try
            {
                if (ex != null)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[App] AppDomain.UnhandledException (IsTerminating={e.IsTerminating})", ex);
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[App] AppDomain.UnhandledException (non-Exception, IsTerminating={e.IsTerminating}): {e.ExceptionObject}");
                }
            }
            catch { }

            if (e.IsTerminating && ex != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    Current?.Dispatcher?.BeginInvoke(new Action(() => TryShowUiExceptionNotification(ex, isFatal: true)));
                }
                catch { }
            }
        }

        private void TaskScheduler_UnobservedTaskException(object? sender, System.Threading.Tasks.UnobservedTaskExceptionEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.LogError("[App] TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException", e.Exception);
            }
            catch { }

            e.SetObserved();
        }

        private static bool IsFatalException(Exception ex)
        {
            return ex is OutOfMemoryException
                or StackOverflowException
                or AccessViolationException
                or AppDomainUnloadedException
                or BadImageFormatException
                or CannotUnloadAppDomainException;
        }

        private void TryShowUiExceptionNotification(Exception ex, bool isFatal)
        {
            try
            {
                var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
                if (_isShowingUiExceptionNotification)
                {
                    return;
                }

                if (!isFatal && (now - _lastUiExceptionNotificationUtc) < TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2))
                {
                    return;
                }

                _isShowingUiExceptionNotification = true;
                _lastUiExceptionNotificationUtc = now;

                var userMessage = isFatal
                    ? "Критическая ошибка интерфейса. Приложение будет закрыто."
                    : $"Ошибка интерфейса: {ex.Message}";

                try
                {
                    new NotificationWindow(userMessage, "error").Show();
                }
                catch
                {
                    MessageBox.Show(
                        userMessage,
                        "Ошибка",
                        MessageBoxButton.OK,
                        isFatal ? MessageBoxImage.Stop : MessageBoxImage.Warning);
                }
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                _isShowingUiExceptionNotification = false;
            }
        }

        private void CurrentDomain_ProcessExit(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (_isClosing)
                return;

            try
            {
                _isClosing = true;
                Logger.Log("[App] ProcessExit triggered (taskkill/crash) - cleaning up session");
                
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser != null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[ProcessExit] Ending session for user: {currentUser.Username}");
                    
                    try
                    {
                        // Завершаем сессию быстро (максимум 1.5 сек)
                        var auth = new SupabaseAuthService();
                        var endSessionTask = auth.EndUserSession(currentUser.Username);
                        endSessionTask.Wait(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1500));
                        Logger.Log("[ProcessExit] Session cleanup completed or timed out after 1.5s");
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("[ProcessExit] Failed to end session", ex);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                try { Logger.LogError("[App] Error in ProcessExit handler", ex); } catch { }
            }
        }

        protected override void OnStartup(StartupEventArgs e)
        {
            base.OnStartup(e);

            // Используем Singleton NavigationService
            var navigationService = NavigationService.Instance;

            // Глобальный логгер для Binding ошибок и Trace
            try
            {
                Trace.AutoFlush = true;
                var logPath = System.IO.Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "debug.log");
                var listener = new TextWriterTraceListener(logPath);
                // Общие трассировки
                if (!Trace.Listeners.Contains(listener)) Trace.Listeners.Add(listener);
                // Ошибки привязок WPF
                PresentationTraceSources.DataBindingSource.Switch.Level = SourceLevels.Error;
                PresentationTraceSources.DataBindingSource.Listeners.Add(listener);
            }
            catch { }

            // Apply persisted theme and language before any window is shown
            try
            {
                var settingsPath = System.IO.Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "settings.json");
                if (System.IO.File.Exists(settingsPath))
                {
                    var json = System.IO.File.ReadAllText(settingsPath);
                    var settings = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ViewModels.SettingsData>(json);
                    if (settings != null)
                    {
                        // Theme
                        // Switch MaterialDesign base theme by replacing resource dictionary
                        var dicts = Application.Current.Resources.MergedDictionaries;
                        // remove existing MD light/dark dicts
                        for (int i = dicts.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                        {
                            var src = dicts[i].Source?.OriginalString ?? string.Empty;
                            if (src.Contains("MaterialDesignTheme.Dark.xaml") || src.Contains("MaterialDesignTheme.Light.xaml"))
                                dicts.RemoveAt(i);
                        }
                        var themeUri = new Uri(settings.DarkTheme
                            ? "pack://application:,,,/MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf;component/Themes/MaterialDesignTheme.Dark.xaml"
                            : "pack://application:,,,/MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf;component/Themes/MaterialDesignTheme.Light.xaml");
                        dicts.Add(new ResourceDictionary { Source = themeUri });

                        // Language (use default Russian)
                        string code = "ru-RU";
                        try
                        {
                            var langUri = new Uri($"pack://application:,,,/Victory;component/Resources/Strings.{code}.xaml", UriKind.Absolute);
                            dicts.Add(new ResourceDictionary { Source = langUri });
                        }
                        catch { }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch { }

            // Регистрируем страницы
            navigationService.RegisterPage("Loading", typeof(LoadingView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("Login", typeof(LoginView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("Main", typeof(MainView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("Editor", typeof(EditorView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("QuizEdit", typeof(QuizEditView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("Player", typeof(PlayerView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("Quiz", typeof(QuizPage));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("Settings", typeof(SettingsView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("Profile", typeof(ProfileView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("MultiplayerMenu", typeof(KahootMenuView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("Friends", typeof(FriendsView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("CreateMultiplayerRoom", typeof(CreateMultiplayerRoomView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("GameRooms", typeof(GameRoomsView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("RoomHost", typeof(RoomHostView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("RoomJoin", typeof(RoomJoinView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("RoomGame", typeof(RoomGameView));
            navigationService.RegisterPage("AiChat", typeof(AiChatView));

            // Создаем главное окно
            var mainWindow = new MainWindow();

            // Подписываемся на событие закрытия окна
            mainWindow.Closing += MainWindow_Closing;
            mainWindow.StateChanged += (s, ev) =>
            {
                // Переприменяем макет при изменении состояния окна, чтобы избежать чёрной половины
                try { mainWindow.InvalidateVisual(); mainWindow.UpdateLayout(); } catch { }
            };

            // Настраиваем Frame для навигации
            navigationService.Configure(mainWindow.mainFrame);

            // Переходим на стартовую страницу
            navigationService.NavigateTo("Loading"); // Начинаем с экрана загрузки

            // Показываем ТОЛЬКО одно окно
            mainWindow.Show();

            // Стартуем сервис бейджей (уведомления на кнопках)
            try 
            { 
                SocialBadgeService.Start();
                // Убрали дублирующее уведомление - теперь все инвайты обрабатываются через SocialNotificationService
            } 
            catch { }

            try
            {
                OfflineMonitorService.Start();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[App] Failed to start offline monitor", ex);
            }
        }

        private void MainWindow_Closing(object? sender, System.ComponentModel.CancelEventArgs e)
        {
            // Предотвращаем повторный вызов
            if (_isClosing)
            {
                return;
            }

            _isClosing = true;
            
            // Закрываем все открытые диалоговые окна перед закрытием приложения
            try
            {
                var openWindows = Application.Current.Windows.OfType<Window>().ToList();
                foreach (var window in openWindows)
                {
                    // Пропускаем главное окно
                    if (window is MainWindow)
                        continue;
                    
                    // Закрываем все остальные окна (диалоги)
                    try
                    {
                        // Пытаемся установить DialogResult только если окно было показано как диалог
                        // DialogResult можно установить только для окон, показанных через ShowDialog()
                        // Безопасно пытаемся установить DialogResult, игнорируя ошибки
                        if (window.DialogResult == null)
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                // Проверяем, есть ли у окна Owner (признак модального диалога)
                                if (window.Owner != null)
                                {
                                    window.DialogResult = false;
                                }
                            }
                            catch
                            {
                                // Игнорируем ошибку - окно не было показано как диалог
                                // Просто закрываем его без установки DialogResult
                            }
                        }
                        
                        window.Close();
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[App] Error closing dialog window: {window.GetType().Name}", ex);
                        // Не пытаемся снова установить DialogResult, так как это может вызвать ту же ошибку
                        try
                        {
                            window.Close();
                        }
                        catch { }
                    }
                }
                
                // Скрываем overlay, если он был показан
                if (sender is MainWindow mainWindow)
                {
                    mainWindow.HideOverlay();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[App] Error closing dialog windows", ex);
            }
            
            try
            {
                var cleanupTask = System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(async () =>
                {
                    try
                    {
                        Logger.Log("[App] Cleanup started");

                        var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                        if (currentUser != null)
                        {
                            // Очистка комнаты (если есть)
                            var currentRoom = RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;
                            if (currentRoom != null)
                            {
                                var gameService = new SupabaseMultiplayerService();

                                try
                                {
                                    if (string.Equals(currentRoom.HostUsername, currentUser.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                    {
                                        await gameService.DeleteRoom(currentRoom.Id);
                                        Logger.Log($"[App] Room {currentRoom.Id} deleted");
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        await gameService.LeaveRoom(currentRoom.Id, currentUser.Username);
                                        Logger.Log($"[App] Left room {currentRoom.Id}");
                                    }
                                }
                                catch (Exception ex)
                                {
                                    Logger.LogError("[App] Room cleanup error", ex);
                                }
                            }

                            // Завершение сессии
                            try
                            {
                                var auth = new SupabaseAuthService();
                                var ended = await auth.EndUserSession(currentUser.Username);
                                if (ended)
                                {
                                    Logger.Log($"[App] Session ended for {currentUser.Username}");
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    Logger.Log("[App] Session end returned false");
                                }
                            }
                            catch (Exception ex)
                            {
                                Logger.LogError("[App] End session error", ex);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("[App] Cleanup task error", ex);
                    }
                });

                if (!cleanupTask.Wait(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3)))
                {
                    Logger.Log("[App] Cleanup timed out after 3s, force closing");
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.Log("[App] Cleanup completed successfully");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[App] Cleanup wait failed", ex);
            }

            try
            {
                OfflineMonitorService.Stop();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[App] Failed to stop offline monitor", ex);
            }
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: CLOUDFLARE_GEMINI_WORKER.js ===

// Cloudflare Worker для проксирования Google Gemini API
// Вставь этот код в твой Worker: https://dash.cloudflare.com/

addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  event.respondWith(handleRequest(event.request))
})

async function handleRequest(request) {
  // Разрешаем CORS
  if (request.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
      }
    })
  }

  try {
    // Извлекаем API ключ из URL (query parameter)
    const url = new URL(request.url)
    const apiKey = url.searchParams.get('key')
    
    if (!apiKey) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
        error: {
          message: 'API key is required',
          code: 400
        }
      }), {
        status: 400,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
        }
      })
    }

    // Перенаправляем запрос на Gemini API
    // ОРИГИНАЛЬНАЯ модель которая работала!
    const geminiUrl = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`
    
    const response = await fetch(geminiUrl, {
      method: request.method,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      },
      body: request.body
    })

    const responseBody = await response.text()
    
    return new Response(responseBody, {
      status: response.status,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
      }
    })
  } catch (error) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
      error: {
        message: error.message,
        type: 'proxy_error',
        code: 500
      }
    }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
      }
    })
  }
}

=== FILE: Converters/GradientConverter.cs ===

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace Victory.Converters
{
    public class GradientConverter : IMultiValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (values == null || values.Length < 2)
                return new LinearGradientBrush(Colors.Gray, Colors.DarkGray, 135);

            var startColor = values[0]?.ToString() ?? "#667eea";
            var endColor = values[1]?.ToString() ?? "#764ba2";
            var isUnlocked = values.Length > 2 && values[2] is bool unlocked && unlocked;

            try
            {
                var startObj = ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(startColor);
                var endObj = ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(endColor);
                var start = startObj is Color startColorObj ? startColorObj : Colors.Gray;
                var end = endObj is Color endColorObj ? endColorObj : Colors.DarkGray;

                if (!isUnlocked)
                {
                    // Для заблокированных - серый градиент
                    start = Colors.LightGray;
                    end = Colors.Gray;
                }

                return new LinearGradientBrush(start, end, new System.Windows.Point(0, 0), new System.Windows.Point(1, 1));
            }
            catch
            {
                return new LinearGradientBrush(Colors.Gray, Colors.DarkGray, 135);
            }
        }

        public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }

    public class RarityColorConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is not Models.AchievementRarity rarity)
                return Colors.Gray;

            return rarity switch
            {
                Models.AchievementRarity.Common => Colors.Gray,
                Models.AchievementRarity.Rare => Color.FromRgb(59, 130, 246), // Blue
                Models.AchievementRarity.Epic => Color.FromRgb(147, 51, 234), // Purple
                Models.AchievementRarity.Legendary => Color.FromRgb(250, 204, 21), // Gold
                _ => Colors.Gray
            };
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }

    public class RarityBorderConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is not Models.AchievementRarity rarity)
                return 1.0;

            return rarity switch
            {
                Models.AchievementRarity.Common => 1.0,
                Models.AchievementRarity.Rare => 2.0,
                Models.AchievementRarity.Epic => 3.0,
                Models.AchievementRarity.Legendary => 4.0,
                _ => 1.0
            };
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows.Data;
using MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf;

namespace Victory.Converters
{
    public class IconConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return PackIconKind.Star;

            var iconName = value.ToString();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(iconName))
                return PackIconKind.Star;

            try
            {
                if (Enum.TryParse<PackIconKind>(iconName, true, out var iconKind))
                {
                    return iconKind;
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                // Игнорируем ошибки
            }

            return PackIconKind.Star;
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows.Data;

namespace Victory.Converters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Конвертер для преобразования int в string и обратно
    /// </summary>
    public class IntToStringConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is int intValue)
            {
                return intValue.ToString();
            }
            return string.Empty;
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is string stringValue && int.TryParse(stringValue, out int result))
            {
                return result;
            }
            return 0;
        }
    }

        {
            if (values.Length == 2 && 
                values[0] is double percentage && 
                values[1] is double containerWidth &&
                containerWidth > 0)

=== FILE: Converters/ProgressConverter.cs ===

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows.Data;

namespace Victory.Converters
{
    public class ProgressConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, System.Globalization.CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value == null || parameter == null)
                return 0.0;

            try
            {
                var current = System.Convert.ToDouble(value);
                var required = System.Convert.ToDouble(parameter);
                
                if (required == 0)
                    return 0.0;
                
                var percentage = (current / required) * 100;
                return Math.Min(percentage, 100.0);
            }
            catch
            {
                return 0.0;
            }
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, System.Globalization.CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }

    public class ProgressWidthConverter : IMultiValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (values == null || values.Length < 3 || values[0] == null || values[1] == null || values[2] == null)
                return 0.0;

            try
            {
                var current = System.Convert.ToDouble(values[0]);
                var required = System.Convert.ToDouble(values[1]);
                var parentWidth = System.Convert.ToDouble(values[2]);
                
                if (required == 0 || parentWidth == 0)
                    return 0.0;
                
                var percentage = Math.Min((current / required) * 100, 100.0);
                return (parentWidth * percentage) / 100.0;
            }
            catch
            {
                return 0.0;
            }
        }

        public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }

    public class RarityTextConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is not Models.AchievementRarity rarity)
                return "";

            return rarity switch
            {
                Models.AchievementRarity.Common => "Обычное",
                Models.AchievementRarity.Rare => "Редкое",
                Models.AchievementRarity.Epic => "Эпическое",
                Models.AchievementRarity.Legendary => "Легендарное",
                _ => ""
            };
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }

    public class BoolToVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is bool boolValue)
            {
                return boolValue ? System.Windows.Visibility.Visible : System.Windows.Visibility.Collapsed;
            }
            return System.Windows.Visibility.Collapsed;
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is System.Windows.Visibility visibility)
            {
                return visibility == System.Windows.Visibility.Visible;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows.Data;

namespace Victory.Converters
{
    public class ProgressToWidthConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            // Этот конвертер будет вычислять процент, а реальную ширину установим через code-behind
            // Для XAML используем процент как коэффициент
            if (value == null || parameter == null)
                return 0.0;

            try
            {
                var current = System.Convert.ToDouble(value);
                var required = System.Convert.ToDouble(parameter);
                
                if (required == 0)
                    return 0.0;
                
                var percentage = Math.Min((current / required) * 100, 100.0);
                // Возвращаем процент, который будет использован для вычисления ширины
                return percentage;
            }
            catch
            {
                return 0.0;
            }
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Converters/StringToColorConverter.cs ===

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace Victory.Converters
{
    public class StringToColorConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return Colors.Gray;

            try
            {
                var colorString = value.ToString();
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(colorString))
                    return Colors.Gray;

                // Убираем # если есть
                if (colorString.StartsWith("#"))
                {
                    var color = ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(colorString);
                    return color is Color c ? c : Colors.Gray;
                }

                // Пробуем добавить # если его нет
                if (colorString.Length == 6)
                {
                    var color = ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#" + colorString);
                    return color is Color c ? c : Colors.Gray;
                }

                var convertedColor = ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(colorString);
                return convertedColor is Color c2 ? c2 : Colors.Gray;
            }
            catch
            {
                return Colors.Gray;
            }
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Data/AppDbContext.cs ===

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.IO;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Data
{
    public class AppDbContext : DbContext
    {
        public DbSet<User> Users { get; set; }

        protected override void OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
        {
            var baseDir = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.CommonApplicationData); // %ProgramData%
            var appDir = Path.Combine(baseDir, "Victory");
            if (!Directory.Exists(appDir))
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(appDir);
            }
            var dbPath = Path.Combine(appDir, "app.db");
            optionsBuilder.UseSqlite($"Data Source={dbPath}");
        }

        protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
        {
            modelBuilder.Entity<User>()
                .HasIndex(u => u.Username)
                .IsUnique();

            modelBuilder.Entity<User>()
                .Property(u => u.AvatarPath)
                .HasDefaultValue("");
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: MainWindow.xaml.cs ===

﻿using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Input;

namespace Victory
{
    public partial class MainWindow : Window
    {
        public MainWindow()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            // Устанавливаем иконку программно
            try
            {
                var iconUri = new System.Uri("pack://application:,,,/Decals/Victory.ico", System.UriKind.Absolute);
                Icon = System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapFrame.Create(iconUri);
            }
            catch
            {
                // Если не удалось загрузить иконку, игнорируем ошибку
            }
            MouseLeftButtonDown += MainWindow_MouseLeftButtonDown;
        }

        private void MainWindow_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.ButtonState == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
            {
                DragMove();
            }
        }

        private void Minimize_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => WindowState = WindowState.Minimized;

        private void MaximizeRestore_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            WindowState = WindowState == WindowState.Maximized ? WindowState.Normal : WindowState.Maximized;
        }

        private void Close_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => Close();

        public Frame MainFR => mainFrame;

        // Методы для управления overlay
        public void ShowOverlay()
        {
            ModalOverlay.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        }

        public void HideOverlay()
        {
            ModalOverlay.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        }
    }
}



=== FILE: Models/Achievement.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace Victory.Models
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Модель достижения (бейджа)
    /// </summary>
    public class Achievement
    {
        public string Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Icon { get; set; } = string.Empty; // MaterialDesign icon kind или emoji
        public AchievementType Type { get; set; }
        public AchievementRarity Rarity { get; set; }
        public int RequiredValue { get; set; } // Требуемое значение для получения
        public int CurrentValue { get; set; } // Текущее значение пользователя
        public bool IsUnlocked { get; set; } = false;
        public DateTime? UnlockedAt { get; set; }
        public string Category { get; set; } = string.Empty; // "quizzes", "games", "social", "streaks"
        public string GradientStart { get; set; } = "#667eea";
        public string GradientEnd { get; set; } = "#764ba2";
    }

    public enum AchievementType
    {
        Counter,      // Простой счётчик (пройди 10 викторин)
        Streak,       // Серия (5 дней подряд)
        Perfect,      // Идеальный результат (100% правильных)
        Social,       // Социальные (добавь 5 друзей)
        Creator,      // Создание контента (создай 10 викторин)
        Special       // Специальные достижения
    }

    public enum AchievementRarity
    {
        Common,       // Обычные (серый)
        Rare,         // Редкие (синий)
        Epic,         // Эпические (фиолетовый)
        Legendary     // Легендарные (золотой)
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Коллекция достижений пользователя
    /// </summary>
    public class AchievementCollection
    {
        public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public List<Achievement> Achievements { get; set; } = new List<Achievement>();
        public DateTime LastUpdated { get; set; } = DateTime.Now;
        
        public int TotalAchievements => Achievements.Count;
        public int UnlockedAchievements => Achievements.Count(a => a.IsUnlocked);
        public double CompletionPercentage => TotalAchievements > 0 ? (double)UnlockedAchievements / TotalAchievements * 100 : 0;
    }
}

=== FILE: Models/GameModels.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace Victory.Models
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Модели для мультиплеерных игр через Supabase
    /// </summary>

    /// <summary>
    /// Игровая комната
    /// </summary>
    public class GameRoom
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string RoomCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string RoomName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string HostUsername { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string GameType { get; set; } = "quiz";
        public GameRoomStatus Status { get; set; } = GameRoomStatus.Waiting;
        public int MaxPlayers { get; set; } = 10;
        public int CurrentPlayers { get; set; } = 1;
        public string? QuizId { get; set; }
        public Dictionary<string, object>? Settings { get; set; }
        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
        public DateTime? StartedAt { get; set; }
        public DateTime? FinishedAt { get; set; }

        // Связанные данные
        public List<GameRoomPlayer>? Players { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Игрок в комнате
    /// </summary>
    public class GameRoomPlayer
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public int RoomId { get; set; }
        public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string DisplayName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string? AvatarPath { get; set; }
        public DateTime JoinedAt { get; set; }
        public bool IsReady { get; set; }
        public int Score { get; set; }
        public int? Position { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Игровая сессия
    /// </summary>
    public class GameSession
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public int RoomId { get; set; }
        public int QuestionIndex { get; set; }
        public Question? CurrentQuestion { get; set; }
        public DateTime? QuestionStartTime { get; set; }
        public Dictionary<string, int>? Answers { get; set; } // username -> answer_index
        public Dictionary<string, GamePlayerResult>? Results { get; set; } // username -> result
        public GameSessionStatus Status { get; set; } = GameSessionStatus.Waiting;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Результат игрока
    /// </summary>
    public class GamePlayerResult
    {
        public bool IsCorrect { get; set; }
        public int TimeMs { get; set; }
        public int Points { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Статус игровой комнаты
    /// </summary>
    public enum GameRoomStatus
    {
        Waiting,
        Starting,
        InProgress,
        Finished
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Статус игровой сессии
    /// </summary>
    public enum GameSessionStatus
    {
        Waiting,
        Active,
        Completed
    }
}



=== FILE: Models/GameSettings.cs ===

namespace Victory.Models
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Centralized constants for game room settings
    /// </summary>
    public static class GameSettings
    {
        // Setting Keys
        public const string TimerMode = "timer_mode";
        public const string GlobalTimerSeconds = "global_timer_seconds";
        public const string PerQuestionTimerSeconds = "per_question_timer_seconds";
        public const string WaitForAll = "wait_for_all";
        public const string ShuffleQuestions = "shuffle_questions";
        public const string HostParticipation = "host_participation";
        public const string RejoinAllowed = "rejoin_allowed";

        // Timer Mode Values
        public const string TimerModeNone = "none";
        public const string TimerModeGlobal = "global";
        public const string TimerModePerQuestion = "per_question";

        // Default Values
        public const int DefaultGlobalTimerSeconds = 60;
        public const int DefaultPerQuestionTimerSeconds = 30;
        public const bool DefaultWaitForAll = false;
        public const bool DefaultShuffleQuestions = true;
        public const bool DefaultHostParticipation = false;
        public const bool DefaultRejoinAllowed = true;
        public const string DefaultTimerMode = TimerModePerQuestion;

        // Validation Bounds
        public const int MinTimerSeconds = 5;
        public const int MaxTimerSeconds = 300;
        public const int MaxGlobalTimerSeconds = 3600; // 1 hour

        /// <summary>
        /// Validates timer value is within acceptable bounds
        /// </summary>
        public static int ValidateTimerSeconds(int value, bool isGlobal = false)
        {
            int max = isGlobal ? MaxGlobalTimerSeconds : MaxTimerSeconds;
            if (value < MinTimerSeconds) return MinTimerSeconds;
            if (value > max) return max;
            return value;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Validates timer mode is a recognized value
        /// </summary>
        public static string ValidateTimerMode(string mode)
        {
            if (mode == TimerModeNone || mode == TimerModeGlobal || mode == TimerModePerQuestion)
                return mode;
            return DefaultTimerMode;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace Victory.Models
{
    public class Quiz
    {
        public string Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public DateTime CreatedDate { get; set; } = DateTime.Now;
        public DateTime ModifiedDate { get; set; } = DateTime.Now;
        public List<Question> Questions { get; set; } = new List<Question>();
        public string Author { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int TimeLimit { get; set; } = 30; // seconds per question
        public string AuthorUsername { get; set; } = string.Empty; // Для AI-викторин
        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.Now; // Для AI-викторин
        public bool IsSelected { get; set; } = false; // Для UI выбора викторины
    }

    public class Question
    {
        public string Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        public string Text { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string QuestionType { get; set; } = "closed";
        public List<string> Options { get; set; } = new List<string>();
        public List<string> OptionMediaPaths { get; set; } = new List<string>();
        public int CorrectAnswerIndex { get; set; } = 0;
        public string OpenAnswer { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string ImagePath { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Explanation { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int OrderIndex { get; set; } = 0; // Порядок вопроса в викторине

        [JsonIgnore]
        public bool IsOpenQuestion => string.Equals(QuestionType, "open", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        
        // Для AI-викторин с множественными ответами
        public List<Answer>? Answers { get; set; }
    }
    
    public class Answer
    {
        public string Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        public string Text { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public bool IsCorrect { get; set; } = false;
        public string DisplayPrefix { get; set; } = "";
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Victory.Models
{
    public class User
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }                                 // Server ID (primary key)
        public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;        // required
        public string PasswordHash { get; set; } = string.Empty;    // required (for local storage if needed)
        public string DisplayName { get; set; } = string.Empty;     // required
        public string? AvatarPath { get; set; }                      // optional
        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
        public DateTime? LastLogin { get; set; }
        public int QuizzesCreated { get; set; }
        public int QuizzesPassed { get; set; }
        public string? JwtToken { get; set; }                        // JWT token for API access

        // Constructor for creating from server data
        public User(int serverId, string username, string displayName, string? avatarPath = null, string? jwtToken = null)
        {
            Id = serverId;
            Username = username;
            DisplayName = displayName;
            AvatarPath = avatarPath ?? string.Empty;
            JwtToken = jwtToken;
        }

        // Default constructor
        public User() { }
    }
}

# План рефакторинга проекта Victory

## 1. СТИЛЕВЫЕ ПРОБЛЕМЫ

### 1.1 Закомментированный код
- **App.xaml.cs:6** - Закомментированный `using MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf;`
  - **Решение**: Удалить, если не используется, или раскомментировать при необходимости

### 1.2 Пустые catch-блоки без логирования
- **Найдено 49+ мест** с `catch { }` без обработки ошибок
- **Критичные места**:
  - `App.xaml.cs:19, 21, 26, 31, 70, 93, 127, 131, 160, 178, 243`
  - `Views/RoomGameView.xaml.cs` - множественные пустые catch
  - `Services/SupabaseMultiplayerService.cs` - несколько пустых catch
- **Решение**: Добавить логирование через `Logger.LogError()` или хотя бы `Logger.Log()`

### 1.3 Хардкод API ключей в исходном коде
- **Services/GeminiConfig.cs:8** - API ключ OpenRouter в коде
- **Services/AiConfig.cs:39** - OpenAI API ключ в коде
- **Проблема**: Ключи видны в скомпилированном .exe, небезопасно
- **Решение**: Вынести в конфигурационные файлы или переменные окружения

### 1.4 Избыточные комментарии в коде
- **Views/AiChatView.xaml.cs** - комментарии типа "СУПЕР-ИНТЕЛЛЕКТУАЛЬНАЯ СИСТЕМА", "РЕВОЛЮЦИОННЫЙ AI"
- **Решение**: Заменить на профессиональные технические комментарии

### 1.5 Неиспользуемые using-директивы
- Проверить все файлы на неиспользуемые импорты (можно через IDE)

### 1.6 Непоследовательное именование

## 3. ДУБЛИРОВАНИЕ КОДА

### 3.1 Дублирование логики применения темы
**Места дублирования:**
- `App.xaml.cs:105-118` - логика применения темы при старте
- `ViewModels/SettingsViewModel.cs:233-254` - метод `ApplyTheme()`

**Проблема**: Одинаковая логика удаления и добавления ResourceDictionary для темы MaterialDesign

**Решение**: 
- Вынести в отдельный сервис `ThemeService` или статический метод
- Использовать единую точку применения темы

### 3.2 Дублирование логики сохранения/загрузки настроек
**Места дублирования:**
- `ViewModels/SettingsViewModel.cs:86-119` - `LoadSettings()`
- `ViewModels/SettingsViewModel.cs:121-146` - `SaveSettings()`
- `Services/UserSettingsService.cs:28-53` - `GetCurrentSettings()`
- `Services/UserSettingsService.cs:55-79` - `SaveSettings()`

**Проблема**: 
- Два разных формата настроек (`SettingsData` и `UserSettings`)
- Дублирование логики чтения/записи JSON
- Синхронизация между `SettingsViewModel` и `UserSettingsService`

**Решение**:
- Унифицировать модель настроек
- Использовать единый сервис для работы с настройками
- Убрать дублирование через делегирование

### 3.3 Дублирование конфигураций AI
**Места дублирования:**
- `Services/AiConfig.cs` - конфигурация для OpenAI
- `Services/GeminiConfig.cs` - конфигурация для Gemini/OpenRouter

**Проблема**: Два разных класса для похожих целей, возможна путаница

**Решение**: 
- Объединить в единый `AiServiceConfig` с поддержкой разных провайдеров
- Или четко разделить ответственность и документировать

### 3.4 Дублирование сервисов настроек
**Места дублирования:**
- `Services/UserSettingsService.cs` - локальные настройки
- `Services/SupabaseUserSettingsService.cs` - настройки в Supabase

**Проблема**: Два сервиса для одной цели, сложная синхронизация

**Решение**: 
- Использовать паттерн Repository с единым интерфейсом
- SupabaseUserSettingsService должен быть оберткой над UserSettingsService

### 3.5 Дублирование логики локализации
**Проблема**: 
- `Services/LocalizationService.cs:20-23` - метод `SetLanguage()` пустой с комментарием "только русский язык"
- `App.xaml.cs:120-127` - логика загрузки языковых ресурсов
- `ViewModels/SettingsViewModel.cs.backup` - старая логика выбора языка

**Решение**: 
- Если локализация не используется, удалить неиспользуемый код
- Если планируется, реализовать полноценно

=== FILE: Server/Controllers/AdminController.cs ===

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Victory.Server.Data;
using Victory.Server.Models;

namespace Victory.Server.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    public class AdminController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly ServerDbContext _context;

        public AdminController(ServerDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        [HttpGet("users")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<object>>> GetUsers()
        {
            var users = await _context.Users
                .Select(u => new
                {
                    u.Id,
                    u.Username,
                    u.DisplayName,
                    u.AvatarPath,
                    CreatedAt = u.CreatedAt
                })
                .ToListAsync();

            return Ok(users);
        }

        [HttpGet("users/count")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<int>> GetUserCount()
        {
            var count = await _context.Users.CountAsync();
            return Ok(count);
        }

        [HttpDelete("users/{id}")]
        public async Task<ActionResult> DeleteUser(int id)
        {
            var user = await _context.Users.FindAsync(id);
            if (user == null)
            {
                return NotFound();
            }

            _context.Users.Remove(user);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            return NoContent();
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: Server/Controllers/AuthController.cs ===

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Security.Claims;
using Victory.Server.Models;
using Victory.Server.Services;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Server.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/auth")]
    public class AuthController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly AuthService _authService;

        public AuthController(AuthService authService)
        {
            _authService = authService;
        }

        [HttpPost("register")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<AuthResponse>> Register([FromBody] RegisterRequest request)
        {
            Logger.Log($"[AuthController] Register called with username: {request.Username}");
            var response = await _authService.Register(request);
            Logger.Log($"[AuthController] Register response: Success={response.Success}, Message={response.Message}");
            if (!response.Success)
            {
                return BadRequest(response);
            }
            return Ok(response);
        }

        [HttpPost("login")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<AuthResponse>> Login([FromBody] LoginRequest request)
        {
            Logger.Log($"[AuthController] Login called with username: {request.Username}");
            var response = await _authService.Login(request);
            Logger.Log($"[AuthController] Login response: Success={response.Success}, Message={response.Message}");
            if (!response.Success)
            {
                return Unauthorized(response);
            }
            return Ok(response);
        }

        [HttpGet("profile")]
        [Authorize] // Require authentication
        public async Task<ActionResult<UserDto>> GetProfile()
        {
            try
            {
                var userIdClaim = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
                if (userIdClaim == null || !int.TryParse(userIdClaim.Value, out var userId))
                {
                    return Unauthorized();
                }

                Logger.Log($"[AuthController] Getting profile for user ID: {userId}");
                var user = await _authService.GetUserById(userId);

                if (user == null)
                {
                    return NotFound();
                }

                var userDto = new UserDto
                {
                    Id = user.Id,
                    Username = user.Username,
                    DisplayName = user.DisplayName,
                    AvatarPath = user.AvatarPath
                };

                return Ok(userDto);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AuthController] Error getting profile: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return StatusCode(500);
            }
        }

        [HttpPut("profile")]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<ActionResult<bool>> UpdateProfile([FromBody] UpdateProfileRequest request)
        {
            try
            {
                var userIdClaim = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
                if (userIdClaim == null || !int.TryParse(userIdClaim.Value, out var userId))
                {
                    return Unauthorized();
                }

                Logger.Log($"[AuthController] Updating profile for user ID: {userId}");
                var success = await _authService.UpdateUserProfile(userId, request.DisplayName, request.AvatarPath);

                if (success)
                {
                    return Ok(true);
                }
                else
                {
                    return BadRequest(false);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AuthController] Error updating profile: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return StatusCode(500);
            }
        }

        [HttpPost("change-password")]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<ActionResult<bool>> ChangePassword([FromBody] ChangePasswordRequest request)
        {
            try
            {
                var userIdClaim = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
                if (userIdClaim == null || !int.TryParse(userIdClaim.Value, out var userId))
                {
                    return Unauthorized();
                }

                Logger.Log($"[AuthController] Changing password for user ID: {userId}");
                var success = await _authService.ChangeUserPassword(userId, request.CurrentPassword, request.NewPassword);

                if (success)
                {
                    return Ok(true);
                }
                else
                {
                    return BadRequest(false);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AuthController] Error changing password: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return StatusCode(500);
            }
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: Server/Data/ServerDbContext.cs ===

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Victory.Server.Models;

namespace Victory.Server.Data
{
    public class ServerDbContext : DbContext
    {
        public DbSet<ServerUser> Users { get; set; }

        public ServerDbContext(DbContextOptions<ServerDbContext> options) : base(options)
        {
        }

        protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
        {
            modelBuilder.Entity<ServerUser>(entity =>
            {
                entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
                entity.HasIndex(e => e.Username).IsUnique();
                entity.Property(e => e.Username).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(50);
                entity.Property(e => e.DisplayName).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(100);
                entity.Property(e => e.PasswordHash).IsRequired();
            });
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: Server/EmbeddedServerHost.cs ===

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Server.Data;
using Victory.Server.Services;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Server
{
    public static class EmbeddedServerHost
    {
        private static WebApplication? _app;
        private static UdpDiscoveryService? _udpService;
        private static bool _isRunning = false;

        public static async Task<bool> StartAsync()
        {
            if (_isRunning)
            {
                return true;
            }

            try
            {
                Logger.Log("Starting embedded SignalR + REST API server...");

                var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(new string[0]);
                builder.WebHost.ConfigureKestrel(options =>
                {
                    options.ListenAnyIP(5000);
                    options.Limits.MaxRequestBodySize = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB
                    options.Limits.KeepAliveTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2);
                    options.Limits.RequestHeadersTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1);
                });

                // Configure database
                var dbPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "ServerData", "users.db");
                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(dbPath)!);
                
                builder.Services.AddDbContext<ServerDbContext>(options =>
                    options.UseSqlite($"Data Source={dbPath}"));

                // Add services
                Logger.Log("Registering services...");
                builder.Services.AddScoped<AuthService>();
                Logger.Log("AuthService registered");

                builder.Services.AddControllers();
                Logger.Log("Controllers service registered");
                builder.Services.AddSignalR(options =>
                {
                    options.EnableDetailedErrors = true;
                    options.MaximumReceiveMessageSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB
                    options.StreamBufferCapacity = 10;
                    options.ClientTimeoutInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
                    options.HandshakeTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15);
                    options.KeepAliveInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15);
                });
                
                builder.Services.AddCors(options =>
                {
                    options.AddPolicy("AllowAll", policy =>
                    {
                        policy.AllowAnyOrigin()
                              .AllowAnyMethod()
                              .AllowAnyHeader();
                    });
                });

                _app = builder.Build();

                // Ensure database is created and log registered services
                using (var scope = _app.Services.CreateScope())
                {
                    var serviceProvider = scope.ServiceProvider;

                    // Log registered controller types
                    var controllerTypes = serviceProvider.GetServices(typeof(ControllerBase));
                    Logger.Log($"Registered controller types: {controllerTypes.Count()}");

                    var dbContext = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<ServerDbContext>();
                    Logger.Log("Creating database...");
                    await dbContext.Database.EnsureCreatedAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"Database created successfully. Connection string: {dbContext.Database.GetConnectionString()}");
                }

                _app.UseCors("AllowAll");

                // Add request logging middleware
                _app.Use(async (context, next) =>
                {
                    Logger.Log($"HTTP Request: {context.Request.Method} {context.Request.Path}");
                    await next();
                    Logger.Log($"HTTP Response: {context.Response.StatusCode}");
                });

                _app.UseRouting();

                Logger.Log("Mapping endpoints...");
                _app.UseEndpoints(endpoints =>
                {
                    Logger.Log("Adding controller routes...");
                    endpoints.MapControllers();
                    Logger.Log("Controllers mapped in UseEndpoints");

                    Logger.Log("Adding SignalR hub...");
                    endpoints.MapHub<GameHub>("/gamehub");
                    Logger.Log("SignalR hub mapped");

                    Logger.Log("Adding root endpoint...");
                    endpoints.MapGet("/", () => "Victory Quiz Server - REST API + SignalR");
                    Logger.Log("Root endpoint mapped");

                    Logger.Log("Adding test endpoint...");
                    endpoints.MapGet("/test", () => "Test endpoint working");
                    Logger.Log("Test endpoint mapped");
                });
                Logger.Log("All endpoints mapped successfully");

                // Start web app in background
                _ = _app.RunAsync();

                // Wait for server to be ready
                await Task.Delay(1000);
                
                // Test server health with retries
                using var httpClient = new System.Net.Http.HttpClient();
                httpClient.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
                
                for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"Health check attempt {i + 1}/5...");
                        var response = await httpClient.GetAsync("http://localhost:5000/");
                        if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                        {
                            Logger.Log("Server health check passed");
                            
                            // Test API endpoints
                            try
                            {
                                var testResponse = await httpClient.GetAsync("http://localhost:5000/test");
                                if (testResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                                {
                                    Logger.Log("Test endpoint working");
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    Logger.Log($"Test endpoint failed: {testResponse.StatusCode}");
                                }
                            }
                            catch (Exception ex)
                            {
                                Logger.Log($"Test endpoint error: {ex.Message}");
                            }
                            
                            break;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            Logger.Log($"Server responded with {response.StatusCode}, retrying...");
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"Health check attempt {i + 1} failed: {ex.Message}");
                        if (i == 4) // Last attempt
                        {
                            Logger.LogError("All health check attempts failed", ex);
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (i < 4) await Task.Delay(1000); // Wait 1 second between attempts
                }

                // Start UDP discovery
                _udpService = new UdpDiscoveryService();
                _udpService.Start();

                _isRunning = true;
                Logger.Log("Embedded server started on http://0.0.0.0:5000 (REST API + SignalR)");
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to start embedded server", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public static async Task StopAsync()
        {
            if (!_isRunning)
            {
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                Logger.Log("Stopping embedded server...");
                _udpService?.Stop();
                if (_app != null)
                {
                    await _app.StopAsync();
                    await _app.DisposeAsync();
                }
                _isRunning = false;
                Logger.Log("Embedded server stopped");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Error stopping embedded server", ex);
            }
        }
    }
}



=== FILE: Server/GameHub.cs ===

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR;
using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Victory.Server
{
    public class GameHub : Hub
    {
        private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, NetworkRoom> _rooms = new();
        private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, string> _userRooms = new();

        public override async Task OnDisconnectedAsync(Exception? exception)
        {
            if (_userRooms.TryRemove(Context.ConnectionId, out var roomCode))
            {
                if (_rooms.TryGetValue(roomCode, out var room))
                {
                    var player = room.Players.FirstOrDefault(p => p.ConnectionId == Context.ConnectionId);
                    if (player != null)
                    {
                        room.Players.Remove(player);
                        await Clients.Group(roomCode).SendAsync("PlayerLeft", player.Name, room.Players.Count);
                    }

                    if (room.HostConnectionId == Context.ConnectionId)
                    {
                        await Clients.Group(roomCode).SendAsync("HostDisconnected");
                        _rooms.TryRemove(roomCode, out _);
                    }
                }
            }
            await base.OnDisconnectedAsync(exception);
        }

        public async Task Ping()
        {
            // Simple ping method for connection testing
            await Clients.Caller.SendAsync("Pong");
        }

        public async Task CreateRoom(string roomCode, string hostName, string quizData)
        {
            string newRoomCode;
            Random random = new Random();
            do
            {
                newRoomCode = random.Next(100000, 999999).ToString();
            } while (_rooms.ContainsKey(newRoomCode));

            var room = new NetworkRoom
            {
                Code = newRoomCode,
                HostName = hostName,
                HostConnectionId = Context.ConnectionId,
                QuizData = quizData,
                Players = new List<NetworkPlayer>(),
                IsActive = true,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.Now
            };

            _rooms[newRoomCode] = room;
            _userRooms[Context.ConnectionId] = newRoomCode;

            var hostPlayer = new NetworkPlayer
            {
                Name = hostName,
                Score = 0,
                ConnectionId = Context.ConnectionId,
                JoinedAt = DateTime.Now
            };
            room.Players.Add(hostPlayer);

            await Groups.AddToGroupAsync(Context.ConnectionId, newRoomCode);
            await Clients.Caller.SendAsync("RoomCreated", newRoomCode);
            await Clients.Group(newRoomCode).SendAsync("PlayerJoined", hostPlayer.Name, room.Players.Count);
        }

        public async Task JoinRoom(string roomCode, string playerName)
        {
            if (!_rooms.TryGetValue(roomCode, out var room))
            {
                await Clients.Caller.SendAsync("JoinFailed", "Room not found");
                return;
            }

            if (room.Players.Any(p => p.Name.Equals(playerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            {
                await Clients.Caller.SendAsync("JoinFailed", "Player name already taken");
                return;
            }

            var player = new NetworkPlayer
            {
                Name = playerName,
                Score = 0,
                ConnectionId = Context.ConnectionId,
                JoinedAt = DateTime.Now
            };

            room.Players.Add(player);
            _userRooms[Context.ConnectionId] = roomCode;

            await Groups.AddToGroupAsync(Context.ConnectionId, roomCode);
            await Clients.Caller.SendAsync("JoinSuccess", roomCode);
            await Clients.Group(roomCode).SendAsync("PlayerJoined", playerName, room.Players.Count);
        }

        public async Task StartGame(string roomCode)
        {
            if (_rooms.TryGetValue(roomCode, out var room) && room.HostConnectionId == Context.ConnectionId)
            {
                room.IsStarted = true;
                room.StartedAt = DateTime.Now;
                await Clients.Group(roomCode).SendAsync("GameStarted");
            }
        }

        public async Task NextQuestion(string roomCode, int questionIndex)
        {
            if (_rooms.TryGetValue(roomCode, out var room) && room.HostConnectionId == Context.ConnectionId)
            {
                await Clients.Group(roomCode).SendAsync("NextQuestion", questionIndex);
            }
        }

        public async Task SendAnswer(string roomCode, string playerName, int answerIndex, bool isCorrect)
        {
            if (_rooms.TryGetValue(roomCode, out var room))
            {
                var player = room.Players.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Name == playerName);
                if (player != null)
                {
                    if (isCorrect)
                    {
                        player.Score += 10;
                    }
                    await Clients.Group(roomCode).SendAsync("AnswerReceived", playerName, answerIndex, isCorrect, player.Score);
                }
            }
        }

        public async Task ShowResults(string roomCode)
        {
            if (_rooms.TryGetValue(roomCode, out var room) && room.HostConnectionId == Context.ConnectionId)
            {
                var leaderboard = room.Players.OrderByDescending(p => p.Score).ToList();
                await Clients.Group(roomCode).SendAsync("ShowResults", leaderboard);
            }
        }

        public async Task EndGame(string roomCode)
        {
            if (_rooms.TryGetValue(roomCode, out var room) && room.HostConnectionId == Context.ConnectionId)
            {
                room.IsActive = false;
                room.EndedAt = DateTime.Now;
                await Clients.Group(roomCode).SendAsync("GameEnded");
                _rooms.TryRemove(roomCode, out _);
                foreach (var player in room.Players)
                {
                    _userRooms.TryRemove(player.ConnectionId, out _);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public class NetworkRoom
    {
        public string Code { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string HostName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string HostConnectionId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string QuizData { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public List<NetworkPlayer> Players { get; set; } = new List<NetworkPlayer>();
        public bool IsActive { get; set; }
        public bool IsStarted { get; set; }
        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
        public DateTime? StartedAt { get; set; }
        public DateTime? EndedAt { get; set; }
    }

    public class NetworkPlayer
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int Score { get; set; }
        public string ConnectionId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public DateTime JoinedAt { get; set; }
    }
}

namespace Victory.Server.Models
