=== FILE: Server/Services/AuthService.cs ===

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System;
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Server.Data;
using Victory.Server.Models;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Server.Services
{
    public class AuthService
    {
        private readonly ServerDbContext _dbContext;
        private const string JWT_SECRET = "VictoryQuizApp_SuperSecretKey_2024_MustBe32CharsMinimum!";
        private const int TOKEN_EXPIRY_HOURS = 24;

        public AuthService(ServerDbContext dbContext)
        {
            _dbContext = dbContext;
        }

        public async Task<AuthResponse> Register(RegisterRequest request)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Register attempt for username: {request.Username}");

                // Check if username exists
                var existingUser = await _dbContext.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Username == request.Username);
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Existing user check: {existingUser != null}");

                if (existingUser != null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Username already exists: {request.Username}");
                    return new AuthResponse
                    {
                        Success = false,
                        Message = "Имя пользователя уже занято"
                    };
                }

                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Creating new user: {request.Username}");
                // Create user
                var user = new ServerUser
                {
                    Username = request.Username,
                    DisplayName = request.DisplayName,
                    PasswordHash = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(request.Password),
                    CreatedAt = DateTime.Now
                };

                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Adding user to database");
                _dbContext.Users.Add(user);
                await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] User saved with ID: {user.Id}");

                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Generating JWT token for new user: {user.Username}");
                var token = GenerateJwtToken(user);

                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Registration successful for user: {user.Username}");
                return new AuthResponse
                {
                    Success = true,
                    Token = token,
                    User = new UserDto
                    {
                        Id = user.Id,
                        Username = user.Username,
                        DisplayName = user.DisplayName,
                        AvatarPath = user.AvatarPath
                    }
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AuthService] Registration error for user {request.Username}: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return new AuthResponse
                {
                    Success = false,
                    Message = $"Ошибка регистрации: {ex.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<AuthResponse> Login(LoginRequest request)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Login attempt for username: {request.Username}");

                var user = await _dbContext.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Username == request.Username);
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] User found: {user != null}");

                if (user == null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[AuthService] User not found: {request.Username}");
                    return new AuthResponse
                    {
                        Success = false,
                        Message = "Неверное имя пользователя или пароль"
                    };
                }

                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Verifying password for user: {user.Username}");
                var passwordValid = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.Verify(request.Password, user.PasswordHash);
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Password valid: {passwordValid}");

                if (!passwordValid)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Invalid password for user: {request.Username}");
                    return new AuthResponse
                    {
                        Success = false,
                        Message = "Неверное имя пользователя или пароль"
                    };
                }

                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Updating last login for user: {user.Username}");
                user.LastLogin = DateTime.Now;
                await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Last login updated successfully");

                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Generating JWT token for user: {user.Username}");
                var token = GenerateJwtToken(user);

                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Login successful for user: {user.Username}");
                return new AuthResponse
                {
                    Success = true,
                    Token = token,
                    User = new UserDto
                    {
                        Id = user.Id,
                        Username = user.Username,
                        DisplayName = user.DisplayName,
                        AvatarPath = user.AvatarPath
                    }
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AuthService] Login error for user {request.Username}: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return new AuthResponse
                {
                    Success = false,
                    Message = $"Ошибка входа: {ex.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        private string GenerateJwtToken(ServerUser user)
        {
            var tokenHandler = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler();
            var key = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(JWT_SECRET);

            var tokenDescriptor = new SecurityTokenDescriptor
            {
                Subject = new ClaimsIdentity(new[]
                {
                    new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, user.Id.ToString()),
                    new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, user.Username),
                    new Claim("DisplayName", user.DisplayName)
                }),
                Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(TOKEN_EXPIRY_HOURS),
                SigningCredentials = new SigningCredentials(
                    new SymmetricSecurityKey(key),
                    SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256Signature)
            };

            var token = tokenHandler.CreateToken(tokenDescriptor);
            return tokenHandler.WriteToken(token);
        }

        public async Task<ServerUser?> GetUserById(int userId)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Getting user by ID: {userId}");
                var user = await _dbContext.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == userId);
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] User found: {user != null}");
                return user;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AuthService] Error getting user by ID {userId}: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> UpdateUserProfile(int userId, string displayName, string? avatarPath = null)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Updating profile for user ID: {userId}");

                var user = await _dbContext.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == userId);
                if (user == null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[AuthService] User not found: {userId}");
                    return false;
                }

                user.DisplayName = displayName;
                if (avatarPath != null)
                {
                    user.AvatarPath = avatarPath;
                }

                await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Profile updated successfully for user: {user.Username}");
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AuthService] Error updating profile for user {userId}: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> ChangeUserPassword(int userId, string currentPassword, string newPassword)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Changing password for user ID: {userId}");

                var user = await _dbContext.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == userId);
                if (user == null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[AuthService] User not found: {userId}");
                    return false;
                }

                // Verify current password
                var passwordValid = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.Verify(currentPassword, user.PasswordHash);
                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Current password valid: {passwordValid}");

                if (!passwordValid)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Invalid current password for user: {user.Username}");
                    return false;
                }

                // Update password
                user.PasswordHash = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(newPassword);
                await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();

                Logger.Log($"[AuthService] Password changed successfully for user: {user.Username}");
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AuthService] Error changing password for user {userId}: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public ClaimsPrincipal? ValidateToken(string token)
        {
            var tokenHandler = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler();
            var key = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(JWT_SECRET);

            try
            {
                var principal = tokenHandler.ValidateToken(token, new TokenValidationParameters
                {
                    ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
                    IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(key),
                    ValidateIssuer = false,
                    ValidateAudience = false,
                    ClockSkew = TimeSpan.Zero
                }, out SecurityToken validatedToken);

                return principal;
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: Server/UdpDiscoveryService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Server
{
    public class UdpDiscoveryService
    {
        private const int DiscoveryPort = 51000;
        private const string DiscoveryRequest = "VICTORY_DISCOVER";
        private const string DiscoveryResponsePrefix = "VICTORY_SERVER";

        private UdpClient? _udpClient;
        private CancellationTokenSource? _cts;
        private Task? _listenerTask;

        public void Start()
        {
            try
            {
                _cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
                _udpClient = new UdpClient(new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Any, DiscoveryPort));
                _listenerTask = ListenAsync(_cts.Token);
                Logger.Log("UDP Discovery service started on port 51000");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to start UDP discovery", ex);
            }
        }

        public void Stop()
        {
            try
            {
                _cts?.Cancel();
                _udpClient?.Close();
                _listenerTask?.Wait(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
                Logger.Log("UDP Discovery service stopped");
            }
            catch
            {
                // Ignore cleanup errors
            }
        }

        private async Task ListenAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            while (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested && _udpClient != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    var result = await _udpClient.ReceiveAsync(cancellationToken);
                    var message = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(result.Buffer);
                    if (message.StartsWith(DiscoveryRequest, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        var response = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes($"{DiscoveryResponsePrefix} 5000");
                        await _udpClient.SendAsync(response, response.Length, result.RemoteEndPoint);
                    }
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                {
                    break;
                }
                catch
                {
                    // Continue listening
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            {

                    Directory.CreateDirectory(_achievementsDirectory);

                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(_perfectStreaksDirectory);

        /// <summary>
        /// Получает достижения пользователя
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<AchievementCollection> GetUserAchievements(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                var userAchievementsFile = Path.Combine(_achievementsDirectory, $"{username}.json");
                var allAchievements = GetAllAchievements();
                var userAchievements = new List<Achievement>();

                // Загружаем сохранённые достижения пользователя
                if (File.Exists(userAchievementsFile))
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var json = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(userAchievementsFile);
                        var savedData = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, UserAchievementData>>(json);
                        
                        if (savedData != null)
                        {
                            // Объединяем шаблоны достижений с сохранёнными данными
                            foreach (var achievement in allAchievements)
                            {
                                if (savedData.TryGetValue(achievement.Id, out var saved))
                                {
                                    achievement.CurrentValue = saved.CurrentValue;
                                    achievement.IsUnlocked = saved.IsUnlocked;
                                    achievement.UnlockedAt = saved.UnlockedAt;
                                }
                                userAchievements.Add(achievement);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error loading user achievements: {ex.Message}", ex);
                    }
                }

                // Если файла нет или он пустой, создаём новый список
                if (userAchievements.Count == 0)
                {
                    userAchievements = allAchievements.Select(a => new Achievement
                    {
                        Id = a.Id,
                        Title = a.Title,
                        Description = a.Description,
                        Icon = a.Icon,
                        Type = a.Type,
                        Rarity = a.Rarity,
                        RequiredValue = a.RequiredValue,
                        CurrentValue = 0,
                        IsUnlocked = false,
                        UnlockedAt = null,
                        Category = a.Category,
                        GradientStart = a.GradientStart,
                        GradientEnd = a.GradientEnd
                    }).ToList();
                }

                return new AchievementCollection
                {
                    Username = username,
                    Achievements = userAchievements,
                    LastUpdated = DateTime.Now
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error getting user achievements: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return new AchievementCollection
                {
                    Username = username,
                    Achievements = GetAllAchievements(),
                    LastUpdated = DateTime.Now
                };
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Проверяет и обновляет достижения на основе статистики
        /// </summary>
        public async Task CheckAndUpdateAchievements(string username, UserStats stats)
        {
            try
            {
                var achievements = await GetUserAchievements(username);
                bool hasChanges = false;
                var newlyUnlocked = new List<Achievement>();

                foreach (var achievement in achievements.Achievements)
                {
                    int newValue = 0;

                    // Определяем текущее значение в зависимости от типа достижения
                    switch (achievement.Id)
                    {
                        case "quiz_1":
                        case "quiz_10":
                        case "quiz_50":
                        case "quiz_100":
                            newValue = stats.QuizzesPassed;
                            break;
                        case "perfect_1":
                        case "perfect_5":
                            newValue = stats.PerfectQuizzes;
                            break;
                        case "perfect_streak_3":
                            newValue = stats.CurrentPerfectStreak;
                            break;
                        case "creator_1":
                        case "creator_10":
                            newValue = stats.QuizzesCreated;
                            break;
                        case "ai_creator_5":
                            newValue = stats.AiQuizzesCreated;
                            break;
                        case "social_5":
                            newValue = stats.FriendsCount;
                            break;
                        case "multiplayer_10":
                            newValue = stats.MultiplayerGamesPlayed;
                            break;
                        case "multiplayer_win_5":
                            newValue = stats.MultiplayerGamesWon;
                            break;
                    }

                    // Обновляем значение
                    if (achievement.CurrentValue != newValue)
                    {
                        achievement.CurrentValue = newValue;
                        hasChanges = true;
                    }

                    // Проверяем, нужно ли разблокировать
                    if (!achievement.IsUnlocked && newValue >= achievement.RequiredValue)
                    {
                        achievement.IsUnlocked = true;
                        achievement.UnlockedAt = DateTime.Now;
                        hasChanges = true;
                        newlyUnlocked.Add(achievement);
                    }
                }

                // Сохраняем изменения
                if (hasChanges)
                {
                    await SaveUserAchievements(username, achievements);
                    
                    // Показываем уведомления о новых достижениях
                    foreach (var achievement in newlyUnlocked)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            ShowAchievementNotification(achievement);
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error showing notification: {ex.Message}", ex);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error checking achievements: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Записывает идеальную викторину
        /// </summary>
        public async Task RecordPerfectQuiz(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                var streakData = await LoadPerfectStreakData(username);
                var today = DateTime.Now.Date;
                
                // Если последняя идеальная викторина была сегодня, увеличиваем счётчик
                if (streakData.LastPerfectDate == today)
                {
                    streakData.CurrentStreak++;
                }
                // Если последняя была вчера, продолжаем серию
                else if (streakData.LastPerfectDate == today.AddDays(-1))
                {
                    streakData.CurrentStreak++;
                }
                // Иначе начинаем новую серию
                else
                {
                    streakData.CurrentStreak = 1;
                }
                
                streakData.LastPerfectDate = today;
                streakData.TotalPerfectQuizzes++;
                
                await SavePerfectStreakData(username, streakData);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error recording perfect quiz: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Сбрасывает серию идеальных викторин
        /// </summary>
        public async Task ResetPerfectStreak(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                var streakData = await LoadPerfectStreakData(username);
                streakData.CurrentStreak = 0;
                await SavePerfectStreakData(username, streakData);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error resetting streak: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получает текущую серию идеальных викторин
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<int> GetPerfectStreak(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                var streakData = await LoadPerfectStreakData(username);
                var today = DateTime.Now.Date;
                
                // Если последняя идеальная викторина была не сегодня и не вчера, сбрасываем серию
                if (streakData.LastPerfectDate.HasValue && 
                    streakData.LastPerfectDate.Value != today && 
                    streakData.LastPerfectDate.Value != today.AddDays(-1))
                {
                    streakData.CurrentStreak = 0;
                    await SavePerfectStreakData(username, streakData);
                }
                
                return streakData.CurrentStreak;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error getting streak: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return 0;
            }
        }

                return streakData.TotalPerfectQuizzes;

            {

        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Сохраняет достижения пользователя
        /// </summary>
        private async Task SaveUserAchievements(string username, AchievementCollection collection)
        {
            try
            {
                var userAchievementsFile = Path.Combine(_achievementsDirectory, $"{username}.json");
                var data = new Dictionary<string, UserAchievementData>();
                
                foreach (var achievement in collection.Achievements)
                {
                    data[achievement.Id] = new UserAchievementData
                    {
                        CurrentValue = achievement.CurrentValue,
                        IsUnlocked = achievement.IsUnlocked,
                        UnlockedAt = achievement.UnlockedAt
                    };
                }
                
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(data, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });
                await File.WriteAllTextAsync(userAchievementsFile, json);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error saving achievements: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Загружает данные о серии идеальных викторин
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<PerfectStreakData> LoadPerfectStreakData(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                var streakFile = Path.Combine(_perfectStreaksDirectory, $"{username}.json");
                if (File.Exists(streakFile))
                {
                    var json = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(streakFile);
                    return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PerfectStreakData>(json) ?? new PerfectStreakData();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error loading streak data: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
            return new PerfectStreakData();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Сохраняет данные о серии идеальных викторин
        /// </summary>
        private async Task SavePerfectStreakData(string username, PerfectStreakData data)
        {
            try
            {
                var streakFile = Path.Combine(_perfectStreaksDirectory, $"{username}.json");
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(data, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });
                await File.WriteAllTextAsync(streakFile, json);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error saving streak data: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Показывает уведомление о разблокированном достижении
        /// </summary>
        private void ShowAchievementNotification(Achievement achievement)
        {
            try
            {
                var app = System.Windows.Application.Current;
                if (app != null && app.Dispatcher != null)
                {
                    app.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            var notification = new Views.AchievementNotificationWindow(achievement);
                            notification.Show();
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error creating notification window: {ex.Message}", ex);
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AchievementService] Error showing notification: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Данные достижения пользователя для сохранения
        /// </summary>
        private class UserAchievementData
        {
            public int CurrentValue { get; set; }
            public bool IsUnlocked { get; set; }
            public DateTime? UnlockedAt { get; set; }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Данные о серии идеальных викторин
        /// </summary>
        private class PerfectStreakData
        {
            public int CurrentStreak { get; set; }
            public int TotalPerfectQuizzes { get; set; }
            public DateTime? LastPerfectDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime? LastGameDate { get; set; }
        }
    }
}

        private const string EMBEDDED_API_KEY = "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"; // <-- ВАШ КЛЮЧ УСТАНОВЛЕН!

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userKey))
                {
                    Logger.Log("[AiConfig] Using user-provided API key");
                    return userKey;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)

                Logger.LogError("[AiConfig] Error reading user settings", ex);
            }

            // Затем используем встроенный ключ (если есть)
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(EMBEDDED_API_KEY))

                Logger.Log("[AiConfig] Using embedded API key");

=== FILE: Services/AiQuizGeneratorService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Сервис для генерации викторин с помощью AI (OpenAI GPT)
    /// </summary>
    public class AiQuizGeneratorService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
        // Используем твой личный Cloudflare Worker прокси (работает без VPN!)
        private const string OPENAI_API_URL = "https://shrill-feather-d2a6.denislabyncev935.workers.dev/";

        public AiQuizGeneratorService()
        {
            _httpClient = new HttpClient();
            _httpClient.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60);
            
            // Автоматически настраиваем API ключ
            InitializeApiKey();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Инициализация API ключа из конфигурации
        /// </summary>
        private void InitializeApiKey()
        {
            var apiKey = AiConfig.GetApiKey();
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(apiKey))
            {
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Clear();
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", $"Bearer {apiKey}");
                Logger.Log("[AiQuizGenerator] API key initialized automatically (using proxy server)");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Установить API ключ OpenAI (для ручной настройки)
        /// </summary>
        public void SetApiKey(string apiKey)
        {
            _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Clear();
            _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", $"Bearer {apiKey}");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Проверить, доступен ли AI-сервис
        /// </summary>
        public bool IsAvailable()
        {
            return AiConfig.IsAvailable();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Генерация викторины на основе темы и параметров
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<Quiz?> GenerateQuizAsync(string topic, int questionCount = 10, string difficulty = "medium", string language = "ru")
        {
            try
            {
                if (!IsAvailable())
                {
                    Logger.LogError("AI API key is not set");
                    return null;
                }

                // Валидация темы на предмет неподходящего контента
                if (!IsTopicAppropriate(topic))
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[AiQuizGenerator] WARNING: Inappropriate topic rejected: '{topic}'");
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Тема должна быть связана с образованием. Пожалуйста, укажите тему для викторины (например: история, математика, программирование).");
                }

                Logger.Log($"[AiQuizGenerator] Generating quiz: topic='{topic}', questions={questionCount}, difficulty={difficulty}");

                // Формируем промпт для AI
                var prompt = BuildQuizPrompt(topic, questionCount, difficulty, language);

                // Отправляем запрос к OpenAI
                var response = await SendOpenAiRequestAsync(prompt);

                if (response == null)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[AiQuizGenerator] Failed to get response from AI");
                    return null;
                }

                // Парсим ответ и создаём викторину
                var quiz = ParseQuizFromResponse(response, topic);

                Logger.Log($"[AiQuizGenerator] Quiz generated successfully: {quiz?.Questions?.Count ?? 0} questions");
                return quiz;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AiQuizGenerator] Error generating quiz: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Улучшить существующий вопрос с помощью AI
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<Question?> ImproveQuestionAsync(Question question, string improvementHint = "")
        {
            try
            {
                if (!IsAvailable())
                {
                    Logger.LogError("AI API key is not set");
                    return null;
                }

                var prompt = $@"Улучши следующий вопрос викторины. {improvementHint}

Текущий вопрос: {question.Text}
Ответы:
{string.Join("\n", question.Answers.Select((a, i) => $"{i + 1}. {a.Text} (правильный: {a.IsCorrect})"))}

Верни улучшенную версию в формате JSON:
{{
  ""text"": ""улучшенный текст вопроса"",
  ""answers"": [
    {{""text"": ""ответ 1"", ""isCorrect"": true}},
    {{""text"": ""ответ 2"", ""isCorrect"": false}},
    {{""text"": ""ответ 3"", ""isCorrect"": false}},
    {{""text"": ""ответ 4"", ""isCorrect"": false}}
  ]
}}";

                var response = await SendOpenAiRequestAsync(prompt);
                if (response == null) return null;

                return ParseQuestionFromJson(response);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AiQuizGenerator] Error improving question: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Проверка, подходит ли тема для образовательной викторины
        /// </summary>
        private bool IsTopicAppropriate(string topic)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(topic))
                return false;

            topic = topic.ToLowerInvariant().Trim();

            // Список неподходящих ключевых слов
            var inappropriateKeywords = new[]
            {
                "оскорбл", "матер", "порно", "секс", "наркотик", "терроризм", 
                "суицид", "насилие", "убийство", "расизм", "фашизм",
                "хакерство", "взлом", "вирус", "малваре"
            };

            // Проверка на неподходящий контент
            if (inappropriateKeywords.Any(keyword => topic.Contains(keyword)))
            {
                Logger.Log($"[AiQuizGenerator] WARNING: Topic contains inappropriate keywords: '{topic}'");
                return false;
            }

            // Список нецелевых запросов (не образовательные)
            var offTopicPatterns = new[]
            {
                "кто такой", "кто это", "что такое аллах", "что такое бог",
                "помоги мне", "расскажи мне", "напиши мне", "сделай мне",
                "привет", "здравствуй", "как дела"
            };

            // Если запрос больше похож на вопрос/просьбу, а не на тему викторины
            if (offTopicPatterns.Any(pattern => topic.StartsWith(pattern) || topic.Contains(pattern)))
            {
                Logger.Log($"[AiQuizGenerator] WARNING: Topic looks like a question/request, not a quiz topic: '{topic}'");
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Построить промпт для генерации викторины
        /// </summary>
        private string BuildQuizPrompt(string topic, int questionCount, string difficulty, string language)
        {
            var difficultyText = difficulty switch
            {
                "easy" => "лёгкий (базовые концепции)",
                "hard" => "сложный (продвинутые темы)",
                _ => "средний"
            };

            return $@"Создай викторину на тему ""{topic}"" на русском языке.

Параметры:
- Количество вопросов: {questionCount}
- Сложность: {difficultyText}
- Язык: русский

Требования:
1. Каждый вопрос должен быть интересным и проверять понимание темы
2. У каждого вопроса должно быть 4 варианта ответа
3. Только один ответ должен быть правильным
4. Неправильные ответы должны быть правдоподобными
5. Вопросы должны быть разнообразными (не повторять формулировки)

Верни результат СТРОГО в формате JSON (без дополнительного текста):
{{
  ""title"": ""Название викторины"",
  ""description"": ""Краткое описание"",
  ""questions"": [
    {{
      ""text"": ""Текст вопроса?"",
      ""answers"": [
        {{""text"": ""Вариант ответа 1"", ""isCorrect"": true}},
        {{""text"": ""Вариант ответа 2"", ""isCorrect"": false}},
        {{""text"": ""Вариант ответа 3"", ""isCorrect"": false}},
        {{""text"": ""Вариант ответа 4"", ""isCorrect"": false}}
      ]
    }}
  ]
}}";
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Отправить запрос к OpenAI API
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<string?> SendOpenAiRequestAsync(string prompt)
        {
            try
            {
                var systemPrompt = @"Ты специализированный помощник для создания ТОЛЬКО образовательных викторин.

ВАЖНЫЕ ПРАВИЛА:
1. Ты создаёшь викторины ТОЛЬКО на образовательные темы (наука, история, программирование, искусство и т.д.)
2. Если пользователь спрашивает что-то не связанное с созданием викторин - вежливо откажись
3. Если тема неподходящая (оскорбления, насилие, политика) - откажись
4. ВСЕГДА отвечай в формате JSON без дополнительного текста
5. Создавай качественные, интересные и образовательные вопросы

Ты НЕ отвечаешь на общие вопросы типа 'кто такой...', 'что такое...', 'помоги мне...'.
Твоя ЕДИНСТВЕННАЯ задача - создавать викторины на образовательные темы.";

                var requestBody = new
                {
                    model = "gpt-4o-mini", // Стандартный формат для OpenAI
                    messages = new[]
                    {
                        new { role = "system", content = systemPrompt },
                        new { role = "user", content = prompt }
                    },
                    temperature = 0.7,
                    max_tokens = 4000
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(requestBody);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                Logger.Log($"[AiQuizGenerator] Sending request to OpenAI...");
                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync(OPENAI_API_URL, content);

                if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[AiQuizGenerator] OpenAI API error: {response.StatusCode} - {errorContent}");
                    return null;
                }

                var responseJson = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                var responseObj = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<OpenAiResponse>(responseJson);

                return responseObj?.Choices?.FirstOrDefault()?.Message?.Content;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AiQuizGenerator] Error sending request to OpenAI: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Парсинг викторины из ответа AI
        /// </summary>
        private Quiz? ParseQuizFromResponse(string responseText, string fallbackTopic)
        {
            try
            {
                // Убираем возможные markdown блоки ```json ... ```
                responseText = responseText.Trim();
                if (responseText.StartsWith("```json"))
                {
                    responseText = responseText.Substring(7);
                }
                if (responseText.StartsWith("```"))
                {
                    responseText = responseText.Substring(3);
                }
                if (responseText.EndsWith("```"))
                {
                    responseText = responseText.Substring(0, responseText.Length - 3);
                }
                responseText = responseText.Trim();

                var options = new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                };

                var aiQuiz = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AiQuizResponse>(responseText, options);

                if (aiQuiz == null || aiQuiz.Questions == null || aiQuiz.Questions.Count == 0)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[AiQuizGenerator] Failed to parse quiz from AI response");
                    return null;
                }

                // Конвертируем в наш формат Quiz
                var quiz = new Quiz
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                    Title = aiQuiz.Title ?? $"Викторина: {fallbackTopic}",
                    Description = aiQuiz.Description ?? $"Викторина на тему {fallbackTopic}",
                    Questions = new List<Question>(),
                    CreatedAt = DateTime.Now
                };

                foreach (var aiQuestion in aiQuiz.Questions)
                {
                    var question = new Question
                    {
                        Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                        Text = aiQuestion.Text ?? "",
                        Answers = new List<Answer>()
                    };

                    if (aiQuestion.Answers != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var aiAnswer in aiQuestion.Answers)
                        {
                            question.Answers.Add(new Answer
                            {
                                Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                                Text = aiAnswer.Text ?? "",
                                IsCorrect = aiAnswer.IsCorrect
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    // Проверяем, что есть хотя бы один правильный ответ
                    if (question.Answers.Any(a => a.IsCorrect))
                    {
                        quiz.Questions.Add(question);
                    }
                }

                return quiz;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AiQuizGenerator] Error parsing quiz: {ex.Message}", ex);
                Logger.Log($"[AiQuizGenerator] Response text: {responseText}");
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Парсинг одного вопроса из JSON
        /// </summary>
        private Question? ParseQuestionFromJson(string json)
        {
            try
            {
                json = json.Trim();
                if (json.StartsWith("```json")) json = json.Substring(7);
                if (json.StartsWith("```")) json = json.Substring(3);
                if (json.EndsWith("```")) json = json.Substring(0, json.Length - 3);
                json = json.Trim();

                var options = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
                var aiQuestion = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AiQuestionResponse>(json, options);

                if (aiQuestion == null) return null;

                var question = new Question
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                    Text = aiQuestion.Text ?? "",
                    Answers = new List<Answer>()
                };

                if (aiQuestion.Answers != null)
                {
                    foreach (var aiAnswer in aiQuestion.Answers)
                    {
                        question.Answers.Add(new Answer
                        {
                            Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                            Text = aiAnswer.Text ?? "",
                            IsCorrect = aiAnswer.IsCorrect
                        });
                    }
                }

                return question;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[AiQuizGenerator] Error parsing question: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        #region Response Models

        private class OpenAiResponse
        {
            [JsonPropertyName("choices")]
            public List<OpenAiChoice>? Choices { get; set; }
        }

        private class OpenAiChoice
        {
            [JsonPropertyName("message")]
            public OpenAiMessage? Message { get; set; }
        }

        private class OpenAiMessage
        {
            [JsonPropertyName("content")]
            public string? Content { get; set; }
        }

        private class AiQuizResponse
        {
            [JsonPropertyName("title")]
            public string? Title { get; set; }

            [JsonPropertyName("description")]
            public string? Description { get; set; }

            [JsonPropertyName("questions")]
            public List<AiQuestionResponse>? Questions { get; set; }
        }

        private class AiQuestionResponse
        {
            [JsonPropertyName("text")]
            public string? Text { get; set; }

            [JsonPropertyName("answers")]
            public List<AiAnswerResponse>? Answers { get; set; }
        }

        private class AiAnswerResponse
        {
            [JsonPropertyName("text")]
            public string? Text { get; set; }

            [JsonPropertyName("isCorrect")]
            public bool IsCorrect { get; set; }
        }

        #endregion
    }
}



=== FILE: Services/ApiService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Models;
using Victory.Server.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public class ApiService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
        private string? _jwtToken;
        private static string _baseUrl = "http://localhost:5000/";

        public ApiService()
        {
            _httpClient = new HttpClient { BaseAddress = new Uri(_baseUrl) };
        }

        public static void SetServerUrl(string url)
        {
            _baseUrl = url.EndsWith("/") ? url : url + "/";
            Logger.Log($"Server URL set to: {_baseUrl}");
        }

        public static string GetServerUrl()
        {
            return _baseUrl;
        }

        public void SetJwtToken(string token)
        {
            _jwtToken = token;

            // Clear existing authorization header
            _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = null;

            // Set new token if provided
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
            {
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization =
                    new System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", _jwtToken);
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> LogoutFromSupabase()
        {
            try
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_jwtToken))
                    return true; // Already logged out

                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync($"{_baseUrl}auth/v1/logout", null);

                // Clear token regardless of response
                SetJwtToken(string.Empty);

                return response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error during Supabase logout: {ex.Message}", ex);
                // Clear token even if logout fails
                SetJwtToken(string.Empty);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<AuthResponse?> RegisterUser(string username, string password, string displayName = null)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"Attempting to register user: {username}");

                var request = new RegisterRequest
                {
                    Username = username,
                    Password = password,
                    DisplayName = displayName ?? username
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(request);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                Logger.Log($"Sending POST request to: {_httpClient.BaseAddress}api/auth/register");
                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync("api/auth/register", content);

                Logger.Log($"Response status: {response.StatusCode}");

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var responseJson = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"Registration response: {responseJson}");

                    var authResponse = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AuthResponse>(responseJson, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
                    });

                    return authResponse;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"Registration failed: {response.StatusCode} - {errorContent}");
                    return null;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to register user", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        public async Task<AuthResponse?> LoginUser(string username, string password)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"Attempting to login user: {username}");
                
                var request = new LoginRequest
                {
                    Username = username,
                    Password = password
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(request);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                Logger.Log($"Sending POST request to: {_httpClient.BaseAddress}api/auth/login");
                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync("api/auth/login", content);
                
                Logger.Log($"Response status: {response.StatusCode}");
                
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var responseJson = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"Login response: {responseJson}");
                    
                    var authResponse = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AuthResponse>(responseJson, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
                    });
                    
                    if (authResponse?.Success == true && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(authResponse.Token))
                    {
                        SetJwtToken(authResponse.Token);
                        Logger.Log("Login successful, JWT token set");
                        return authResponse;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"Login failed: {response.StatusCode} - {errorContent}");
                }
                
                return null;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to login user", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        public async Task<UserDto?> GetProfile()
        {
            try
            {
                var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync("api/auth/profile");

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"Profile response: {json}");

                    var userDto = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<UserDto>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
                    });

                    return userDto;
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"Failed to get profile: {response.StatusCode}");
                }

                return null;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to get profile", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> UpdateProfile(string displayName, string? avatarPath = null)
        {

            {

                {
                    PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
                });

                Logger.Log($"Request body: {json}");

                var response = await _httpClient.PutAsync("api/auth/profile", content);

                Logger.Log($"Update profile response status: {response.StatusCode}");

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log("Profile updated successfully");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"Failed to update profile: {response.StatusCode} - {errorContent}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to update profile", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> ChangePassword(string currentPassword, string newPassword)
        {
            try
            {
                var request = new { CurrentPassword = currentPassword, NewPassword = newPassword };
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(request, new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
                });
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                Logger.Log($"Sending POST request to: {_httpClient.BaseAddress}api/auth/change-password");
                Logger.Log($"Request body: {json}");

                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync("api/auth/change-password", content);

                Logger.Log($"Change password response status: {response.StatusCode}");

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log("Password changed successfully");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"Failed to change password: {response.StatusCode} - {errorContent}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to change password", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

using System;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Исключение, выбрасываемое при попытке присоединиться к комнате, из которой игрок забанен
    /// </summary>
    public class BannedFromRoomException : Exception
    {
        public int RoomId { get; }
        public string RoomCode { get; }
        public string Username { get; }

        public BannedFromRoomException(int roomId, string roomCode, string username)
            : base($"Игрок {username} забанен в комнате {roomCode}")
        {
            RoomId = roomId;
            RoomCode = roomCode;
            Username = username;
        }
    }

=== FILE: Services/DiscoveryService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public static class DiscoveryService
    {
        private const int DiscoveryPort = 51000;
        private const string DiscoveryRequest = "VICTORY_DISCOVER";
        private const string DiscoveryResponsePrefix = "VICTORY_SERVER"; // e.g. "VICTORY_SERVER 5000"

        public static async Task<string?> DiscoverServerHubUrlAsync(int timeoutMs = 1500)
        {
            try
            {
                using var udp = new UdpClient();
                udp.EnableBroadcast = true;

                var requestBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(DiscoveryRequest);

                // Broadcast discovery request
                await udp.SendAsync(requestBytes, requestBytes.Length, new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Broadcast, DiscoveryPort));

                using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(timeoutMs);
                var receiveTask = udp.ReceiveAsync();
                var completed = await Task.WhenAny(receiveTask, Task.Delay(timeoutMs, cts.Token));

                if (completed == receiveTask)
                {
                    var result = receiveTask.Result;
                    var response = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(result.Buffer);
                    if (response.StartsWith(DiscoveryResponsePrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        // Format: "VICTORY_SERVER <port>"
                        var parts = response.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                        var port = parts.Length >= 2 ? parts[1] : "5000";
                        var ip = result.RemoteEndPoint.Address.ToString();
                        return $"http://{ip}:{port}/gamehub";
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Server discovery failed", ex);
            }

            return null;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// </summary>
    public class GeminiAssistantService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
        private const string GOOGLE_GEMINI_URL = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:generateContent";
        private string? _apiKey;
        private string _endpoint = GOOGLE_GEMINI_URL;
        private readonly bool _useOpenRouter;
        private readonly string _openRouterBaseUrl;
        private readonly string _openRouterModel;
        private readonly string? _openRouterApiKey;
        private readonly List<ConversationMessage> _conversationHistory = new List<ConversationMessage>();
        private string _systemPrompt = string.Empty;

        public GeminiAssistantService()
        {
            _httpClient = new HttpClient();
            _httpClient.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60);
            InitializeApiKey();
            InitializeEndpoint();

            _useOpenRouter = GeminiConfig.UseOpenRouterForAssistant;
            if (_useOpenRouter)
            {
                _openRouterBaseUrl = GeminiConfig.GetOpenRouterBaseUrl();
                _openRouterModel = GeminiConfig.GetOpenRouterAssistantModel();
                _openRouterApiKey = GeminiConfig.GetOpenRouterApiKey();
                Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] Using OpenRouter model: {_openRouterModel}");
            }
            else
            {
                _openRouterBaseUrl = string.Empty;
                _openRouterModel = string.Empty;
                _openRouterApiKey = null;
            }

            InitializeSystemContext();
        }

        private void InitializeApiKey()
        {
            _apiKey = GeminiConfig.GetApiKey();
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_apiKey))
            {
                Logger.Log("[GeminiAssistant] Initialized with Function Calling support!");
            }
        }

        private void InitializeEndpoint()
        {
            var workerUrl = GeminiConfig.GetWorkerUrl();
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(workerUrl))
            {
                _endpoint = workerUrl.TrimEnd('/');
                Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] Using Cloudflare worker endpoint: {_endpoint}");
            }
            else
            {
                _endpoint = GOOGLE_GEMINI_URL;
                Logger.Log("[GeminiAssistant] Cloudflare worker URL not configured, using direct Google endpoint");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Инициализация системного контекста - рассказываем Gemini о приложении
        /// </summary>
        private void InitializeSystemContext()
        {
            _systemPrompt = @"Ты — AI-ассистент для приложения викторин 'Victory'.

**КРИТИЧЕСКИ ВАЖНО:**
ВСЕГДА вызывай функции для выполнения действий! НЕ отвечай текстом если есть подходящая функция!

**ТВОИ ФУНКЦИИ:**
1. create_quiz - создать новую викторину
2. list_quizzes - показать список викторин
3. select_quiz - выбрать викторину
4. edit_quiz - редактировать викторину
5. delete_quiz - удалить викторину (одну или все!)
6. search_quizzes - найти викторины

**ПРАВИЛА ВЫЗОВА ФУНКЦИЙ:**

🔴 УДАЛЕНИЕ (delete_quiz):
- 'удали все викторины' → delete_quiz(delete_all=true)
- 'убери всё' → delete_quiz(delete_all=true)
- 'стереть все' → delete_quiz(delete_all=true)
- 'очисти всё' → delete_quiz(delete_all=true)
- 'удали викторину ООП' → delete_quiz(quiz_name='ООП')

🟢 СОЗДАНИЕ (create_quiz):
- 'создай викторину про Python' → create_quiz(topic='Python', question_count=10)
- 'сделай тест на 15 вопросов по физике' → create_quiz(topic='физика', question_count=15)

🔵 ПРОСМОТР (list_quizzes):
- 'покажи мои викторины' → list_quizzes()
- 'что у меня есть' → list_quizzes()
- 'список викторин' → list_quizzes()

🟡 ВЫБОР (select_quiz):
- 'выбери викторину ООП' → select_quiz(quiz_name='ООП')
- 'открой викторину Python' → select_quiz(quiz_name='Python')

🟠 РЕДАКТИРОВАНИЕ (edit_quiz):
- 'добавь 5 вопросов' → edit_quiz(action='add_questions', value='5')
- 'сделай сложнее' → edit_quiz(action='change_difficulty', value='hard')

**ВАЖНО:**
1. НЕ спрашивай подтверждения - ВЫЗЫВАЙ функцию СРАЗУ
2. Если пользователь говорит 'удали все' - это delete_quiz(delete_all=true), а НЕ текстовый ответ!
3. Понимай естественную речь: 'убери всё' = 'удали все викторины' = delete_quiz(delete_all=true)
4. ВСЕГДА предпочитай вызов функции тексту

Ты - ИСПОЛНИТЕЛЬ, а не консультант. ДЕЙСТВУЙ!";

            _conversationHistory.Add(new ConversationMessage
            {
                Role = "user",
                Content = _systemPrompt
            });
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Обработать сообщение пользователя (Gemini сам решит что делать!)
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<AssistantResponse> ProcessMessageAsync(
            string userMessage, 
            List<Quiz> userQuizzes,
            Quiz? selectedQuiz = null)
        {
            Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] Processing: '{userMessage}'");

            // Добавляем сообщение пользователя в историю
            _conversationHistory.Add(new ConversationMessage
            {
                Role = "user",
                Content = userMessage
            });

            if (_useOpenRouter)
            {
                return await SendOpenRouterRequestAsync(userQuizzes, selectedQuiz);
            }

            try
            {
                return await SendRequestWithFunctions(userQuizzes, selectedQuiz);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GeminiAssistant] Error processing message", ex);
                return new AssistantResponse
                {
                    Message = "😔 Произошла ошибка при обработке запроса.",
                    FunctionCall = null
                };
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Отправить запрос в Gemini с определением функций
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<AssistantResponse> SendRequestWithFunctions(
            List<Quiz> userQuizzes,
            Quiz? selectedQuiz)
        {
            var functions = DefineFunctions();
            var context = BuildContextInfo(userQuizzes, selectedQuiz);

            var requestBody = new
            {
                contents = _conversationHistory.Select(m => new
                {
                    role = m.Role,
                    parts = new[] { new { text = m.Content } }
                }).ToArray(),
                tools = new[]
                {
                    new
                    {
                        function_declarations = functions
                    }
                },
                systemInstruction = new
                {
                    parts = new[] { new { text = context } }
                }
            };

            var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(requestBody, new JsonSerializerOptions
            {
                WriteIndented = false,
                DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull
            });

            var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
            
            // Добавляем API key в URL (обязательно для Cloudflare Worker и прямого вызова)
            var separator = _endpoint.Contains('?') ? '&' : '?';
            var urlWithKey = $"{_endpoint}{separator}key={_apiKey}";
            Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] Sending request to: {urlWithKey.Replace(_apiKey, "***KEY***")}");
            
            var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync(urlWithKey, content);
            var responseText = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[GeminiAssistant] Gemini API error: {response.StatusCode} - {responseText}");
                return new AssistantResponse
                {
                    Message = "😔 Не удалось связаться с AI. Попробуйте позже.",
                    FunctionCall = null
                };
            }

            Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] Response: {responseText.Substring(0, Math.Min(200, responseText.Length))}...");

            return ParseResponse(responseText);
        }

        private async Task<AssistantResponse> SendOpenRouterRequestAsync(
            List<Quiz> userQuizzes,
            Quiz? selectedQuiz)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_openRouterApiKey))
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GeminiAssistant] OpenRouter API key not configured");
                return new AssistantResponse
                {
                    Message = "⚠️ OpenRouter API ключ не настроен. Добавьте его в GeminiConfig.",
                    FunctionCall = null
                };
            }

            try
            {
                var messages = BuildOpenRouterMessages();
                messages.Add(new
                {
                    role = "system",
                    content = BuildContextInfo(userQuizzes, selectedQuiz)
                });

                var requestBody = new
                {
                    model = _openRouterModel,
                    messages,
                    tools = BuildOpenRouterTools(),
                    tool_choice = "auto",
                    temperature = 0.7,
                    top_p = 0.9
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(requestBody, new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull
                });

                using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, $"{_openRouterBaseUrl}/chat/completions");
                request.Headers.Add("Authorization", $"Bearer {_openRouterApiKey}");
                request.Headers.Add("HTTP-Referer", "https://victory-app");
                request.Headers.Add("X-Title", "Victory Assistant");
                request.Content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                Logger.Log("[GeminiAssistant] Sending request to OpenRouter...");
                var response = await _httpClient.SendAsync(request);
                var responseText = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

                if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[GeminiAssistant] OpenRouter API error: {response.StatusCode} - {responseText}");
                    return new AssistantResponse
                    {
                        Message = "⚠️ OpenRouter временно недоступен. Попробуйте позже.",
                        FunctionCall = null
                    };
                }

                return ParseOpenRouterResponse(responseText);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GeminiAssistant] Error sending request to OpenRouter", ex);
                return new AssistantResponse
                {
                    Message = "⚠️ Ошибка при обращении к OpenRouter. Попробуйте позже.",
                    FunctionCall = null
                };
            }
        }

        private List<object> BuildOpenRouterMessages()
        {
            var messages = new List<object>();

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_systemPrompt))
            {
                messages.Add(new { role = "system", content = _systemPrompt });
            }

            foreach (var message in _conversationHistory)
            {
                if (IsSystemPromptMessage(message))
                    continue;

                var role = string.Equals(message.Role, "user", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                    ? "user"
                    : "assistant";

                messages.Add(new { role, content = message.Content });
            }

            return messages;
        }

        private AssistantResponse ParseOpenRouterResponse(string responseText)
        {
            try
            {
                using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(responseText);
                var root = doc.RootElement;

                if (!root.TryGetProperty("choices", out var choices) || choices.GetArrayLength() == 0)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[GeminiAssistant] OpenRouter response has no choices");
                    return new AssistantResponse
                    {
                        Message = "🤔 AI не прислал ответ. Попробуйте снова.",
                        FunctionCall = null
                    };
                }

                var message = choices[0].GetProperty("message");

                if (message.TryGetProperty("tool_calls", out var toolCalls) && toolCalls.GetArrayLength() > 0)
                {
                    var function = toolCalls[0].GetProperty("function");
                    var functionName = function.GetProperty("name").GetString() ?? string.Empty;
                    var argumentsJson = function.TryGetProperty("arguments", out var argsElementRaw)
                        ? argsElementRaw.GetString() ?? "{}"
                        : "{}";

                    JsonElement argsElement;
                    try
                    {
                        argsElement = JsonDocument.Parse(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(argumentsJson) ? "{}" : argumentsJson).RootElement;
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("[GeminiAssistant] Failed to parse OpenRouter function arguments", ex);
                        argsElement = JsonDocument.Parse("{}").RootElement;
                    }

                    var parsedArgs = ParseArguments(argsElement);

                    _conversationHistory.Add(new ConversationMessage
                    {
                        Role = "model",
                        Content = $"[FunctionCall] {functionName} {argumentsJson}"
                    });

                    return new AssistantResponse
                    {
                        Message = $"🤖 Выполняю: {functionName}",
                        FunctionCall = new FunctionCall
                        {
                            Name = functionName,
                            Arguments = parsedArgs
                        }
                    };
                }

                var contentText = message.TryGetProperty("content", out var contentElement)
                    ? ExtractOpenRouterContent(contentElement)
                    : message.GetProperty("content").GetString() ?? string.Empty;

                contentText = contentText.Trim();

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(contentText))
                {
                    _conversationHistory.Add(new ConversationMessage
                    {
                        Role = "model",
                        Content = contentText
                    });

                    return new AssistantResponse
                    {
                        Message = contentText,
                        FunctionCall = null
                    };
                }

                Logger.Log("[GeminiAssistant] OpenRouter response content empty");
                return new AssistantResponse
                {
                    Message = "🤔 Не удалось получить ответ от AI. Попробуйте снова.",
                    FunctionCall = null
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GeminiAssistant] Error parsing OpenRouter response", ex);
                return new AssistantResponse
                {
                    Message = "❌ Ошибка при обработке ответа OpenRouter.",
                    FunctionCall = null
                };
            }
        }

        private static string ExtractOpenRouterContent(JsonElement contentElement)
        {
            switch (contentElement.ValueKind)
            {
                case JsonValueKind.String:
                    return contentElement.GetString() ?? string.Empty;
                case JsonValueKind.Array:
                    var builder = new StringBuilder();
                    foreach (var part in contentElement.EnumerateArray())
                    {
                        if (part.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
                        {
                            builder.Append(part.GetString() ?? "");
                        }
                        else if (part.TryGetProperty("text", out var textProp))
                        {
                            builder.Append(textProp.GetString() ?? "");
                        }
                    }
                    return builder.ToString();
                default:
                    return contentElement.ToString();
            }
        }

        private bool IsSystemPromptMessage(ConversationMessage message)
        {
            return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_systemPrompt)
                   && string.Equals(message.Role, "user", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                   && string.Equals(message.Content, _systemPrompt, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }
