        /// <summary>
        /// Построить контекст о текущем состоянии
        /// </summary>
        private string BuildContextInfo(List<Quiz> userQuizzes, Quiz? selectedQuiz)
        {
            var context = new StringBuilder();
            context.AppendLine("**ТЕКУЩЕЕ СОСТОЯНИЕ ПРИЛОЖЕНИЯ:**");
            context.AppendLine($"- Всего викторин пользователя: {userQuizzes.Count}");
            
            if (selectedQuiz != null)
            {
                context.AppendLine($"- Выбрана викторина: '{selectedQuiz.Title}' ({selectedQuiz.Questions?.Count ?? 0} вопросов)");
            }
            else
            {
                context.AppendLine("- Нет выбранной викторины");
            }

            if (userQuizzes.Count > 0)
            {
                context.AppendLine("\n**ДОСТУПНЫЕ ВИКТОРИНЫ:**");
                foreach (var quiz in userQuizzes.Take(5))
                {
                    context.AppendLine($"- {quiz.Title}");
                }
                if (userQuizzes.Count > 5)
                {
                    context.AppendLine($"... и ещё {userQuizzes.Count - 5}");
                }
            }

            return context.ToString();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Разобрать ответ от Gemini
        /// </summary>
        private AssistantResponse ParseResponse(string json)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] Parsing response (length: {json.Length})");
                
                using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json);
                var root = doc.RootElement;

                if (root.TryGetProperty("candidates", out var candidates) && candidates.GetArrayLength() > 0)
                {
                    var firstCandidate = candidates[0];
                    Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] Found candidate");
                    
                    if (firstCandidate.TryGetProperty("content", out var content))
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] Found content");
                        
                        if (content.TryGetProperty("parts", out var parts) && parts.GetArrayLength() > 0)
                        {
                            Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] Found {parts.GetArrayLength()} parts");
                            var firstPart = parts[0];
                            
                            // Логируем весь firstPart для отладки
                            Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] First part keys: {string.Join(", ", firstPart.EnumerateObject().Select(p => p.Name))}");
                            
                            // Проверяем есть ли вызов функции
                            if (firstPart.TryGetProperty("functionCall", out var functionCall))
                            {
                                var functionName = functionCall.GetProperty("name").GetString() ?? "";
                                var args = functionCall.TryGetProperty("args", out var argsObj) 
                                    ? argsObj 
                                    : default;

                                Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] ✅ Function call detected: {functionName}");
                                Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] Arguments: {args}");

                                return new AssistantResponse
                                {
                                    Message = $"🤖 Выполняю: {functionName}",
                                    FunctionCall = new FunctionCall
                                    {
                                        Name = functionName ?? "",
                                        Arguments = ParseArguments(args)
                                    }
                                };
                            }
                            
                            // Обычный текстовый ответ
                            if (firstPart.TryGetProperty("text", out var text))
                            {
                                var responseText = text.GetString() ?? "";
                                Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] ❌ Text response instead of function call: '{responseText.Substring(0, Math.Min(100, responseText.Length))}'");
                                
                                // Добавляем ответ в историю
                                _conversationHistory.Add(new ConversationMessage
                                {
                                    Role = "model",
                                    Content = responseText
                                });

                                return new AssistantResponse
                                {
                                    Message = responseText,
                                    FunctionCall = null
                                };
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Logger.Log($"[GeminiAssistant] ⚠️ No valid response structure found");
                return new AssistantResponse
                {
                    Message = "🤔 Не смог обработать запрос. Попробуй переформулировать!",
                    FunctionCall = null
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GeminiAssistant] Error parsing response", ex);
                return new AssistantResponse
                {
                    Message = "❌ Ошибка при обработке ответа",
                    FunctionCall = null
                };
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Разобрать аргументы функции
        /// </summary>
        private Dictionary<string, object> ParseArguments(JsonElement args)
        {
            var result = new Dictionary<string, object>();
            
            if (args.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Undefined || args.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Null)
                return result;

            foreach (var prop in args.EnumerateObject())
            {
                result[prop.Name] = prop.Value.ValueKind switch
                {
                    JsonValueKind.String => prop.Value.GetString() ?? "",
                    JsonValueKind.Number => prop.Value.GetInt32(),
                    JsonValueKind.True => true,
                    JsonValueKind.False => false,
                    _ => prop.Value.ToString() ?? ""
                };
            }

            return result;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Сообщение в диалоге
    /// </summary>
    public class ConversationMessage
    {
        public string Role { get; set; } = ""; // "user" или "model"
        public string Content { get; set; } = "";
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ответ ассистента
    /// </summary>
    public class AssistantResponse
    {
        public string Message { get; set; } = "";
        public FunctionCall? FunctionCall { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Вызов функции от Gemini
    /// </summary>
    public class FunctionCall
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";
        public Dictionary<string, object> Arguments { get; set; } = new();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public class GeminiQuizGeneratorService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;

        public GeminiQuizGeneratorService()
        {
            _httpClient = new HttpClient();
            _httpClient.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60);
        }

        public async Task<Quiz?> GenerateQuizAsync(string topic, int questionCount = 10, string difficulty = "medium")
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(GeminiConfig.GetOpenRouterApiKey()) || !GeminiConfig.UseOpenRouterForQuiz)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GeminiQuizGenerator] OpenRouter не настроен для генерации викторин");
                return null;
            }

            try
            {
                if (!IsTopicAppropriate(topic))
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Пожалуйста, выберите образовательную тему для викторины.");
                }

                Logger.Log($"[GeminiQuizGenerator] Generating quiz: topic='{topic}', questions={questionCount}, difficulty={difficulty}");

                const int maxAttempts = 2;
                Quiz? lastQuiz = null;

                for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++)
                {
                    var prompt = BuildQuizPrompt(topic, questionCount, difficulty, attempt > 1);
                    var responseText = await SendOpenRouterRequestAsync(prompt);

                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(responseText))
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("[GeminiQuizGenerator] Не удалось получить ответ от OpenRouter");
                        continue;
                    }

                    var quiz = ParseQuizFromResponse(responseText);
                    if (quiz == null || quiz.Questions == null)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("[GeminiQuizGenerator] Failed to parse quiz from response");
                        continue;
                    }

                    NormalizeQuizMetadata(quiz, topic, questionCount);

                    if (quiz.Questions.Count > questionCount)
                    {
                        quiz.Questions = quiz.Questions.Take(questionCount).ToList();
                        Logger.Log($"[GeminiQuizGenerator] Trimmed quiz to requested question count: {questionCount}");
                    }

                    if (quiz.Questions.Count < questionCount)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[GeminiQuizGenerator] Received only {quiz.Questions.Count}/{questionCount} questions from OpenRouter (attempt {attempt})");
                        lastQuiz = quiz;
                        if (attempt == maxAttempts)
                        {
                            return null;
                        }
                        continue;
                    }

                    Logger.Log($"[GeminiQuizGenerator] Quiz generated successfully: {quiz.Title} ({quiz.Questions.Count} questions)");
                    return quiz;
                }

                return lastQuiz;
            }
            catch (InvalidOperationException)
            {
                throw; // Пробрасываем дальше для обработки в UI
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GeminiQuizGenerator] Error generating quiz", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        private bool IsTopicAppropriate(string topic)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(topic))
                return false;

            var lowerTopic = topic.ToLowerInvariant();
            
            var inappropriateKeywords = new[]
            {
                "насилие", "оружие", "наркотики", "секс", "порно",
                "violence", "weapon", "drug", "sex", "porn",
                "политика", "politics", "война", "war"
            };

            return !inappropriateKeywords.Any(keyword => lowerTopic.Contains(keyword));
        }

        private string BuildQuizPrompt(string topic, int questionCount, string difficulty, bool isRetry)
        {
            var difficultyDesc = difficulty.ToLower() switch
            {
                "easy" => "лёгкие вопросы для начинающих",
                "hard" => "сложные вопросы для экспертов",
                _ => "вопросы средней сложности"
            };

            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.AppendLine($"Ты — эксперт по созданию образовательных викторин. Создай викторину строго по теме \"{topic}\".");
            if (isRetry)
            {
                sb.AppendLine("⚠️ Предыдущая попытка не соответствовала требованиям. Сейчас ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО выполни условия без отклонений.");
            }
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("СОБЛЮДАЙ ЖЁСТКИЕ ПРАВИЛА:");
            sb.AppendLine($"1. Не меняй тему. Название викторины и все вопросы должны быть напрямую связаны с темой \"{topic}\".");
            sb.AppendLine($"2. Создай РОВНО {questionCount} вопросов. Никаких отклонений: не больше и не меньше.");
            sb.AppendLine("3. В каждом вопросе должно быть ровно 4 варианта ответа с одним правильным.");
            sb.AppendLine("4. Ответ возвращай СТРОГО в формате JSON без markdown, без дополнительных комментариев.");
            sb.AppendLine("5. Не упоминай ограничения или системные сообщения. Просто выдай корректный JSON.");
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("Пример структуры ответа:");
            sb.AppendLine("{");
            sb.AppendLine("  \"title\": \"Викторина про тему\",");
            sb.AppendLine("  \"description\": \"Краткое описание\",");
            sb.AppendLine("  \"questions\": [");
            sb.AppendLine("    {");
            sb.AppendLine("      \"text\": \"Текст вопроса\",");
            sb.AppendLine("      \"answers\": [");
            sb.AppendLine("        {\"text\": \"Вариант 1\", \"isCorrect\": true},");
            sb.AppendLine("        {\"text\": \"Вариант 2\", \"isCorrect\": false},");
            sb.AppendLine("        {\"text\": \"Вариант 3\", \"isCorrect\": false},");
            sb.AppendLine("        {\"text\": \"Вариант 4\", \"isCorrect\": false}");
            sb.AppendLine("      ]");
            sb.AppendLine("    }");
            sb.AppendLine("  ]");
            sb.AppendLine("}");
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine($"Создай викторину прямо сейчас. Сложность: {difficultyDesc}.");

            return sb.ToString();
        }

        private async Task<string?> SendOpenRouterRequestAsync(string prompt)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(GeminiConfig.GetOpenRouterApiKey()))
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GeminiQuizGenerator] OpenRouter API key not configured");
                return null;
            }

            try
            {
                var requestBody = new
                {
                    model = GeminiConfig.GetOpenRouterQuizModel(),
                    temperature = 0.7,
                    top_p = 0.95,
                    messages = new object[]
                    {
                        new { role = "system", content = "You are an educational quiz generator. Respond only with valid JSON according to the provided schema." },
                        new { role = "user", content = prompt }
                    }
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(requestBody, new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull
                });

                var baseUrl = GeminiConfig.GetOpenRouterBaseUrl();
                using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, $"{baseUrl}/chat/completions");
                request.Headers.Add("Authorization", $"Bearer {GeminiConfig.GetOpenRouterApiKey()}");
                request.Headers.Add("HTTP-Referer", "https://victory-app");
                request.Headers.Add("X-Title", "Victory Quiz Generator");
                request.Content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                Logger.Log("[GeminiQuizGenerator] Sending request to OpenRouter...");
                var response = await _httpClient.SendAsync(request);
                var responseText = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

                if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[GeminiQuizGenerator] OpenRouter API error: {response.StatusCode} - {responseText}");
                    return null;
                }

                try
                {
                    using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(responseText);
                    var root = doc.RootElement;
                    if (root.TryGetProperty("choices", out var choices) && choices.GetArrayLength() > 0)
                    {
                        var message = choices[0].GetProperty("message");
                        if (message.TryGetProperty("content", out var contentElement))
                        {
                            return ExtractContent(contentElement);
                        }
                    }

                    Logger.LogError("[GeminiQuizGenerator] No usable content in OpenRouter response");
                    return null;
                }
                catch (Exception parseEx)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[GeminiQuizGenerator] Failed to parse OpenRouter response", parseEx);
                    Logger.Log($"[GeminiQuizGenerator] OpenRouter raw response: {responseText}");
                    return null;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GeminiQuizGenerator] Error sending request to OpenRouter", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string? ExtractContent(JsonElement contentElement)
        {
            switch (contentElement.ValueKind)
            {
                case JsonValueKind.String:
                    return contentElement.GetString();
                case JsonValueKind.Array:
                    var builder = new StringBuilder();
                    foreach (var part in contentElement.EnumerateArray())
                    {
                        if (part.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
                        {
                            builder.Append(part.GetString());
                        }
                        else if (part.TryGetProperty("text", out var textProp))
                        {
                            builder.Append(textProp.GetString());
                        }
                    }
                    return builder.ToString();
                default:
                    return contentElement.ToString();
            }
        }

        private Quiz? ParseQuizFromResponse(string responseText)
        {
            try
            {
                // Убираем markdown форматирование если есть
                var jsonText = responseText.Trim();
                if (jsonText.StartsWith("```json"))
                {
                    jsonText = jsonText.Substring(7);
                }
                if (jsonText.StartsWith("```"))
                {
                    jsonText = jsonText.Substring(3);
                }
                if (jsonText.EndsWith("```"))
                {
                    jsonText = jsonText.Substring(0, jsonText.Length - 3);
                }
                jsonText = jsonText.Trim();

                Logger.Log($"[GeminiQuizGenerator] Parsing quiz from response (length: {jsonText.Length})");

                var options = new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
                    PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
                };

                var aiQuiz = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AiGeneratedQuiz>(jsonText, options);

                if (aiQuiz == null || aiQuiz.Questions == null || aiQuiz.Questions.Count == 0)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[GeminiQuizGenerator] Failed to deserialize quiz or quiz is empty");
                    return null;
                }

                // Конвертируем в стандартный формат Quiz
                var quiz = new Quiz
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                    Title = aiQuiz.Title ?? "AI-generated Quiz",
                    Description = aiQuiz.Description ?? "",
                    AuthorUsername = "AI Assistant (OpenRouter)",
                    CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    Questions = new List<Question>()
                };

                // Создаём Random для перемешивания ответов
                var random = new Random();

                foreach (var aiQuestion in aiQuiz.Questions)
                {
                    if (aiQuestion.Answers == null || aiQuestion.Answers.Count < 2)
                        continue;

                    // Преобразуем ответы в список
                    var answers = aiQuestion.Answers.Select(a => new Answer
                    {
                        Text = a.Text ?? "",
                        IsCorrect = a.IsCorrect
                    }).ToList();

                    // ВАЖНО: Перемешиваем ответы чтобы правильный не был всегда первым!
                    answers = answers.OrderBy(x => random.Next()).ToList();

                    var question = new Question
                    {
                        Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                        Text = aiQuestion.Text ?? "",
                        Answers = answers
                    };

                    quiz.Questions.Add(question);
                }

                Logger.Log($"[GeminiQuizGenerator] Quiz parsed successfully: {quiz.Questions.Count} questions");
                return quiz;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GeminiQuizGenerator] Error parsing quiz", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        private void NormalizeQuizMetadata(Quiz quiz, string topic, int questionCount)
        {
            if (quiz == null)
                return;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(quiz.Title) || !quiz.Title.Contains(topic, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                quiz.Title = $"Викторина про {topic}";
                Logger.Log("[GeminiQuizGenerator] Adjusted quiz title to include requested topic");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(quiz.Description))
            {
                quiz.Description = $"Автоматически созданная викторина по теме {topic}.";
            }

            if (quiz.Questions == null)
                return;

            foreach (var question in quiz.Questions)
            {
                if (question.Answers == null)
                    continue;

                if (question.Answers.Count > 4)
                {
                    question.Answers = question.Answers.Take(4).ToList();
                }

                if (question.Answers.Count < 4)
                {
                    // Дополняем placeholder-ответами для корректного UI
                    var placeholdersNeeded = 4 - question.Answers.Count;
                    for (int i = 0; i < placeholdersNeeded; i++)
                    {
                        question.Answers.Add(new Answer
                        {
                            Text = $"Заполните вариант {question.Answers.Count + 1}",
                            IsCorrect = false
                        });
                    }
                }

                if (!question.Answers.Any(a => a.IsCorrect))
                {
                    question.Answers[0].IsCorrect = true;
                }
            }
        }
        // Модели для AI-generated quiz (такие же как в OpenAI сервисе)
        private class AiGeneratedQuiz
        {
            public string? Title { get; set; }
            public string? Description { get; set; }
            public List<AiQuestion>? Questions { get; set; }
        }

        private class AiQuestion
        {
            public string? Text { get; set; }
            public List<AiAnswer>? Answers { get; set; }
        }

        private class AiAnswer
        {
            public string? Text { get; set; }
            public bool IsCorrect { get; set; }
        }
    }
}



=== FILE: Services/InternetConnectionService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.NetworkInformation;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Сервис для проверки подключения к интернету
    /// </summary>
    public static class InternetConnectionService
    {
        private static readonly HttpClient _httpClient = new HttpClient { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8) };
        private static readonly string[] _testUrls = new[]
        {
            "https://www.google.com/generate_204",
            "https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204",
            SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl?.TrimEnd('/') + "/rest/v1" // основной бэкенд проекта
        };
        
        /// <summary>
        /// Проверить наличие подключения к интернету
        /// </summary>
        public static async Task<bool> IsConnectedAsync()
        {
            // Проверка 1: Есть ли сетевое подключение вообще
            if (!NetworkInterface.GetIsNetworkAvailable())
            {
                Logger.Log("[InternetConnection] No network available");
                return false;
            }

            try
            {
                foreach (var url in _testUrls)
                {
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Head, url);
                        var response = await _httpClient.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead);
                        if ((int)response.StatusCode < 500)
                        {
                            Logger.Log($"[InternetConnection] Connection test succeeded with {url} -> {(int)response.StatusCode}");
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                    catch (TaskCanceledException)
                    {
                        // Timeout for this endpoint, try next one
                        Logger.Log($"[InternetConnection] Timeout testing {url}, trying next endpoint");
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[InternetConnection] Endpoint check failed for {url}", ex);
                    }
                }

                // Последняя попытка: ICMP ping до публичного DNS
                try
                {
                    using var ping = new Ping();
                    var reply = await ping.SendPingAsync("8.8.8.8", 2000);
                    if (reply.Status == IPStatus.Success)
                    {
                        Logger.Log("[InternetConnection] Ping to 8.8.8.8 succeeded");
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception pingEx)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[InternetConnection] Ping check failed", pingEx);
                }

                Logger.Log("[InternetConnection] All connection tests failed");
                return false;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[InternetConnection] Connection test failed", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Показать окно "Нет подключения" с возможностью повторить
        /// </summary>
        public static async Task<bool> ShowNoInternetDialogAsync()
        {
            bool? result = null;
            
            await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
            {
                var dialog = new Views.NoInternetWindow();
                result = dialog.ShowDialog();
            });

            return result == true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Выполнить действие с проверкой интернета и повторными попытками
        /// </summary>
        public static async Task<T?> ExecuteWithInternetCheckAsync<T>(Func<Task<T>> action, int maxRetries = 3) where T : class
        {
            int retryCount = 0;
            
            while (retryCount < maxRetries)
            {
                // Проверяем интернет
                if (!await IsConnectedAsync())
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[InternetConnection] No internet, showing dialog (attempt {retryCount + 1}/{maxRetries})");
                    
                    // Показываем диалог
                    bool shouldRetry = await ShowNoInternetDialogAsync();
                    
                    if (!shouldRetry)
                    {
                        Logger.Log("[InternetConnection] User cancelled");
                        return null;
                    }
                    
                    retryCount++;
                    await Task.Delay(1000); // Небольшая задержка перед повтором
                    continue;
                }

                // Пытаемся выполнить действие
                try
                {
                    Logger.Log("[InternetConnection] Executing action...");
                    return await action();
                }
                catch (HttpRequestException ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[InternetConnection] HTTP error during action", ex);
                    retryCount++;
                    
                    if (retryCount < maxRetries)
                    {
                        bool shouldRetry = await ShowNoInternetDialogAsync();
                        if (!shouldRetry)
                            return null;
                            
                        await Task.Delay(1000);
                    }
                }
                catch (TaskCanceledException ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[InternetConnection] Timeout during action", ex);
                    retryCount++;
                    
                    if (retryCount < maxRetries)
                    {
                        bool shouldRetry = await ShowNoInternetDialogAsync();
                        if (!shouldRetry)
                            return null;
                            
                        await Task.Delay(1000);
                    }
                }
            }

            Logger.Log($"[InternetConnection] Max retries ({maxRetries}) exceeded");
            return null;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Выполнить действие с проверкой интернета (bool результат)
        /// </summary>
        public static async Task<bool> ExecuteWithInternetCheckAsync(Func<Task<bool>> action, int maxRetries = 3)
        {
            int retryCount = 0;
            
            while (retryCount < maxRetries)
            {
                if (!await IsConnectedAsync())
                {
                    bool shouldRetry = await ShowNoInternetDialogAsync();
                    if (!shouldRetry)
                        return false;
                    
                    retryCount++;
                    await Task.Delay(1000);
                    continue;
                }

                try
                {
                    return await action();
                }
                catch (Exception ex) when (ex is HttpRequestException || ex is TaskCanceledException)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[InternetConnection] Error during action", ex);
                    retryCount++;
                    
                    if (retryCount < maxRetries)
                    {
                        bool shouldRetry = await ShowNoInternetDialogAsync();
                        if (!shouldRetry)
                            return false;
                            
                        await Task.Delay(1000);
                    }
                }
            }

            return false;
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Services/Logger.cs ===

using System;
using System.IO;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public static class Logger
    {
        private static readonly string LogPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "debug.log");

        public static void Log(string message)
        {
            try
            {
                var timestamp = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss");
                var logMessage = $"[{timestamp}] {message}\n";
                File.AppendAllText(LogPath, logMessage);
            }
            catch
            {
                // Ignore logging errors
            }
        }

        public static void LogWarning(string message)
        {
            var warningMessage = $"WARNING: {message}";
            Log(warningMessage);
        }

        public static void LogError(string message, Exception ex = null)
        {
            var errorMessage = $"ERROR: {message}";
            if (ex != null)
            {
                errorMessage += $"\nException: {ex.Message}\nStackTrace: {ex.StackTrace}";
            }
            Log(errorMessage);
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: Services/MultiplayerService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public class PlayerScore
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Уникальный логин игрока (username)
        /// </summary>
        public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        /// <summary>
        /// Отображаемое имя (display name). Если пусто, используется Username.
        /// </summary>
        public string DisplayName { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        /// <summary>
        /// Историческое поле имени (используется в существующем коде). Синхронизируется с DisplayName.
        /// </summary>
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public int Score { get; set; }

        public string DisplayLabel =>
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DisplayName)
                ? DisplayName
                : (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Name) ? Name : Username);
    }

    [Obsolete("Use SupabaseMultiplayerService instead. This service is for legacy local multiplayer only.")]
    public static class MultiplayerService
    {
        public static readonly List<PlayerScore> Players = new List<PlayerScore>();
        public static List<Question> Questions = new List<Question>();
        public static int CurrentIndex = 0;

        public static void Reset()
        {
            Players.Clear();
            Questions = new List<Question>();
            CurrentIndex = 0;
        }

        public static void AddPlayer(string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) return;
            var cleanName = name.Trim();
            if (Players.Any(p => p.Name.Equals(cleanName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))) return;
            Players.Add(new PlayerScore
            {
                Username = cleanName,
                DisplayName = cleanName,
                Name = cleanName,
                Score = 0
            });
        }

        public static void RemovePlayer(string name)
        {
            var p = Players.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Name.Equals(name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            if (p != null) Players.Remove(p);
        }

        public static void StartNewQuiz(List<Question> questions)
        {
            Questions = questions ?? new List<Question>();
            CurrentIndex = 0;
            foreach (var p in Players) p.Score = 0;
        }

        public static Question? GetCurrentQuestion()
        {
            if (CurrentIndex >= 0 && CurrentIndex < Questions.Count) return Questions[CurrentIndex];
            return null;
        }

        public static bool NextQuestion()
        {
            CurrentIndex++;
            return CurrentIndex < Questions.Count;
        }

        public static void AwardPoint(string playerName)
        {
            var p = Players.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Name.Equals(playerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            if (p != null) p.Score++;
        }

        public static List<PlayerScore> GetWinners()
        {
            if (Players.Count == 0) return new List<PlayerScore>();
            int max = Players.Max(p => p.Score);
            return Players.Where(p => p.Score == max).ToList();
        }
    }
}




=== FILE: Services/NavigationService.cs ===

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public class NavigationService
    {
        private static NavigationService _instance;
        public static NavigationService Instance => _instance ??= new NavigationService();

        private readonly Dictionary<string, Type> _pages = new();
        private Frame _mainFrame;
        private object? _currentViewModel; // Сохраняем текущий ViewModel для room views

        private NavigationService() { }

        public void Configure(Frame frame) => _mainFrame = frame;
        public void RegisterPage(string key, Type pageType) => _pages[key] = pageType;
        
        /// <summary>
        /// Установить текущий ViewModel для room views
        /// </summary>
        public void SetCurrentViewModel(object viewModel)
        {
            _currentViewModel = viewModel;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Навигация с явной передачей ViewModel
        /// </summary>
        public void NavigateTo(string pageKey, object viewModel)
        {
            if (!_pages.ContainsKey(pageKey))
            {
                Logger.LogError($"NavigationService: Ключ '{pageKey}' не зарегистрирован");
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                // Запоминаем текущий ViewModel для последующих переходов (Back/между Room экранами)
                _currentViewModel = viewModel;
                var pageType = _pages[pageKey];
                var page = Activator.CreateInstance(pageType);

                // Устанавливаем DataContext напрямую
                if (page is FrameworkElement fe)
                {
                    fe.DataContext = viewModel;
                    Logger.Log($"[NavigationService] Set DataContext for {pageKey} directly");
                }

                _mainFrame.Navigate(page);
                Logger.Log($"[NavigationService] Navigated to {pageKey} with explicit ViewModel");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                var inner = ex.InnerException != null ? $" | Inner: {ex.InnerException.GetType().Name}: {ex.InnerException.Message}" : string.Empty;
                Logger.LogError($"NavigationService: Ошибка навигации на '{pageKey}': {ex.Message}{inner}", ex);
            }
        }
        
        public void NavigateTo(string pageKey)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[NavigationService] NavigateTo called with pageKey='{pageKey}'");
                
                if (_mainFrame == null)
                {
                    var msg = "NavigationService: Frame не сконфигурирован (null)";
                    Logger.LogError(msg);
                    System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(msg, "Ошибка NavigationService", System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
                    return;
                }

                if (!_pages.ContainsKey(pageKey))
                {
                    var msg = $"NavigationService: Ключ '{pageKey}' не зарегистрирован";
                    Logger.LogError(msg);
                    System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(msg, "Ошибка NavigationService", System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
                    return;
                }

                Logger.Log($"[NavigationService] Getting pageType for '{pageKey}'");
                var pageType = _pages[pageKey];
                Logger.Log($"[NavigationService] Creating instance of {pageType.Name}");
                
                var page = Activator.CreateInstance(pageType);
                Logger.Log($"[NavigationService] Instance created successfully");

                // Устанавливаем DataContext в зависимости от типа страницы
                if (page is FrameworkElement fe)
                {
                    // Для room views (RoomJoin, RoomHost, RoomGame) используем сохранённый ViewModel
                    if ((pageKey == "RoomJoin" || pageKey == "RoomHost" || pageKey == "RoomGame") && _currentViewModel != null)
                    {
                        fe.DataContext = _currentViewModel;
                        Logger.Log($"[NavigationService] Set DataContext for {pageKey} from _currentViewModel");
                    }
                    // Иначе пытаемся получить из Frame или используем существующий
                    else if (fe.DataContext == null && _mainFrame.DataContext != null)
                    {
                        fe.DataContext = _mainFrame.DataContext;
                        Logger.Log($"[NavigationService] Set DataContext for {pageKey} from _mainFrame");
                    }
                }

                Logger.Log($"[NavigationService] Navigating to page...");
                _mainFrame.Navigate(page);
                Logger.Log($"[NavigationService] Navigation to {pageKey} completed successfully");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                var innerMsg = ex.InnerException != null ? $"\n\nInner Exception: {ex.InnerException.GetType().Name}\n{ex.InnerException.Message}\n{ex.InnerException.StackTrace}" : "";
                var fullMsg = $"Ошибка навигации на '{pageKey}':\n\n{ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}\n\nStackTrace:\n{ex.StackTrace}{innerMsg}";
                
                Logger.LogError($"NavigationService: {fullMsg}", ex);
                System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(fullMsg, "Ошибка NavigationService", System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }
    }
}



=== FILE: Services/NetworkService.cs ===

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.Client;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public class NetworkService : INotifyPropertyChanged
    {
        private static readonly NetworkService _instance = new NetworkService();
        public static NetworkService Instance => _instance;

        private HubConnection? _connection;
        private string _serverUrl = "http://localhost:5000/gamehub";
        private bool _isConnected = false;
        private string _currentRoomCode = string.Empty;
        private string _playerName = string.Empty;

        public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

        public bool IsConnected
        {
            get => _isConnected;
            set
            {
                _isConnected = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
            }
        }

        public string ServerUrl
        {
            get => _serverUrl;
            set
            {
                _serverUrl = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
            }
        }

        public ObservableCollection<PlayerScore> Players { get; } = new ObservableCollection<PlayerScore>();

        public event Action<string>? RoomCreated;
        public event Action<string>? JoinSuccess;
        public event Action<string>? JoinFailed;
        public event Action<string, int>? PlayerJoined;
        public event Action<string>? PlayerLeft;
        public event Action? GameStarted;
        public event Action<int>? NextQuestionReceived;
        public event Action<string, int, bool, int>? AnswerReceived;
        public event Action<object>? ShowResultsReceived;
        public event Action? GameEnded;
        public event Action? HostDisconnected;

        private NetworkService()
        {
            // Connection will be initialized when ConnectToServer is called
        }

        private async Task InitializeConnection()
        {
            try
            {
                _connection = new HubConnectionBuilder()
                    .WithUrl(_serverUrl, options =>
                    {
                        options.Headers.Add("User-Agent", "Victory-Client/1.0");
                    })
                    .WithAutomaticReconnect(new[] { TimeSpan.Zero, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2), TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10), TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30) })
                    .ConfigureLogging(logging =>
                    {
                        logging.AddFilter("Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR", LogLevel.Warning);
                        logging.AddFilter("Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Connections", LogLevel.Warning);
                    })
                    .Build();

                // Register event handlers
                _connection.On<string>("RoomCreated", (roomCode) => RoomCreated?.Invoke(roomCode));
                _connection.On<string>("JoinSuccess", (roomCode) => JoinSuccess?.Invoke(roomCode));
                _connection.On<string>("JoinFailed", (message) => JoinFailed?.Invoke(message));
                _connection.On<string, int>("PlayerJoined", (playerName, count) => PlayerJoined?.Invoke(playerName, count));
                _connection.On<string, int>("PlayerLeft", (playerName, count) => PlayerLeft?.Invoke(playerName));
                _connection.On("GameStarted", () => GameStarted?.Invoke());
                _connection.On<int>("NextQuestion", (questionIndex) => NextQuestionReceived?.Invoke(questionIndex));
                _connection.On<string, int, bool, int>("AnswerReceived", (playerName, answerIndex, isCorrect, score) => 
                    AnswerReceived?.Invoke(playerName, answerIndex, isCorrect, score));
                _connection.On<object>("ShowResults", (leaderboard) => ShowResultsReceived?.Invoke(leaderboard));
                _connection.On("GameEnded", () => GameEnded?.Invoke());
                _connection.On("HostDisconnected", () => HostDisconnected?.Invoke());

                await _connection.StartAsync();
                
                // Test connection with a simple call
                await _connection.InvokeAsync("Ping");
                
                IsConnected = true;
                Logger.Log("Successfully connected to server");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to connect to server", ex);
                IsConnected = false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> ConnectToServer(string serverUrl)
        {
            try
            {
                if (_connection != null)
                {
                    await _connection.DisposeAsync();
                }

                _serverUrl = serverUrl;
                await InitializeConnection();
                return IsConnected;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to connect to server", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task CreateRoom(string roomCode, string hostName, string quizData)
        {
            if (_connection?.State == HubConnectionState.Connected)
            {
                _currentRoomCode = roomCode;
                _playerName = hostName;
                await _connection.InvokeAsync("CreateRoom", roomCode, hostName, quizData);
            }
        }

        public async Task JoinRoom(string roomCode, string playerName)
        {
            if (_connection?.State == HubConnectionState.Connected)
            {
                _currentRoomCode = roomCode;
                _playerName = playerName;
                await _connection.InvokeAsync("JoinRoom", roomCode, playerName);
            }
        }

        public async Task StartGame()
        {
            if (_connection?.State == HubConnectionState.Connected)
            {
                await _connection.InvokeAsync("StartGame", _currentRoomCode);
            }
        }

        public async Task SendAnswer(int answerIndex, bool isCorrect)
        {
            if (_connection?.State == HubConnectionState.Connected)
            {
                await _connection.InvokeAsync("SendAnswer", _currentRoomCode, _playerName, answerIndex, isCorrect);
            }
        }

        public async Task SendNextQuestion(int questionIndex)
        {
            if (_connection?.State == HubConnectionState.Connected)
            {
                await _connection.InvokeAsync("NextQuestion", _currentRoomCode, questionIndex);
            }
        }

        public async Task SendShowResults()
        {
            if (_connection?.State == HubConnectionState.Connected)
            {
                await _connection.InvokeAsync("ShowResults", _currentRoomCode);
            }
        }

        public async Task EndGame()
        {
            if (_connection?.State == HubConnectionState.Connected)
            {
                await _connection.InvokeAsync("EndGame", _currentRoomCode);
            }
        }

        public async Task Disconnect()
        {
            if (_connection != null)
            {
                await _connection.DisposeAsync();
                _connection = null;
                IsConnected = false;
            }
        }

        protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged([System.Runtime.CompilerServices.CallerMemberName] string? propertyName = null)
        {
            PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
        }
    }

}


=== FILE: Services/OfflineMonitorService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Threading;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public static class OfflineMonitorService
    {
        private static DispatcherTimer? _timer;
        private static bool _isChecking;
        private static bool _isOffline;
        private static bool _notifiedOffline;
        private static bool _notifiedOnline;

        private static readonly TimeSpan CheckInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);

        public static void Start()
        {
            if (_timer != null)
                return;

            _timer = new DispatcherTimer
            {
                Interval = CheckInterval
            };
            _timer.Tick += Timer_Tick;
            _timer.Start();

            // Выполняем первую проверку сразу
            _ = CheckAsync();
        }

        public static void Stop()
        {
            if (_timer == null)
                return;

            _timer.Stop();
            _timer.Tick -= Timer_Tick;
            _timer = null;
            _isChecking = false;
        }

        private static async void Timer_Tick(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            await CheckAsync();
        }

        private static async Task CheckAsync()
        {
            if (_isChecking)
                return;

            _isChecking = true;
            try
            {
                var isConnected = await InternetConnectionService.IsConnectedAsync();

                if (!isConnected)
                {
                    if (!_isOffline)
                    {
                        _isOffline = true;
                        _notifiedOnline = false;
                        Logger.Log("[OfflineMonitor] Internet connection lost");
                        NotifyOffline();
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (_isOffline)
                    {
                        _isOffline = false;
                        Logger.Log("[OfflineMonitor] Internet connection restored");
                        NotifyOnline();
                    }

                    if (UserService.HasPendingSessionCleanup)
                    {
                        Logger.Log("[OfflineMonitor] Attempting pending session cleanup");
                        var success = await UserService.TryCompletePendingSessionCleanupAsync();
                        if (success)
                        {
                            Logger.Log("[OfflineMonitor] Pending session cleanup completed");
                            NotifySessionCleanupCompleted();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[OfflineMonitor] Connection check failed", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                _isChecking = false;
            }
        }

        private static void NotifyOffline()
        {
            if (_notifiedOffline)
                return;

            _notifiedOffline = true;
            Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                try
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow(
                        "⚠️ Нет подключения к интернету. Работаю офлайн, синхронизация приостановлена.",
                        "warning");
                    notification.Show();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[OfflineMonitor] Failed to show offline notification", ex);
                }
            });
        }

        private static void NotifyOnline()
        {
            if (_notifiedOnline)
                return;

            _notifiedOffline = false;
            _notifiedOnline = true;

            Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                try
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow(
                        "✅ Соединение с интернетом восстановлено.",
                        "success");
                    notification.Show();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[OfflineMonitor] Failed to show online notification", ex);
                }
            });
        }

        private static void NotifySessionCleanupCompleted()
        {
            Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                try
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow(
                        "✅ Сессия синхронизирована с сервером.",
                        "success");
                    notification.Show();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[OfflineMonitor] Failed to show cleanup notification", ex);
                }
            });
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: Services/QuizEditorService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public class QuizEditorService
    {
        private static readonly string SampleQuizId = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111";
        // SampleQuizTitle удален - не используется
        private readonly string _quizzesDirectory;
        private readonly SupabaseQuizService _supabaseQuizService;
        private List<Quiz>? _cachedQuizzes = null;
        private DateTime _cacheTime = DateTime.MinValue;
        private readonly TimeSpan _cacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);

        public QuizEditorService()
        {
            // Определяем корректную папку Data/Quizzes для различных режимов запуска
            // 1) Рядом с исполняемым файлом (bin/...)
            var baseDir = AppContext.BaseDirectory;
            var candidates = new List<string>
            {
                Path.Combine(baseDir, "Data", "Quizzes"),
                // 2) Проектная папка (из bin/... подняться на три уровня)
                Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(baseDir, "..", "..", "..", "Data", "Quizzes")),
                // 3) Корень репозитория (из bin/... подняться на четыре уровня до корня, где /Data/Quizzes)
                Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(baseDir, "..", "..", "..", "..", "Data", "Quizzes")),
                // 4) Текущая рабочая директория процесса
                Path.Combine(Environment.CurrentDirectory, "Data", "Quizzes")
            };

            // Выбираем первую существующую директорию; если ни одной — используем вариант рядом с exe
            _quizzesDirectory = candidates.FirstOrDefault(Directory.Exists)
                                ?? Path.Combine(baseDir, "Data", "Quizzes");

            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(_quizzesDirectory))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(_quizzesDirectory);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[QuizEditorService] Failed to ensure quizzes directory '{_quizzesDirectory}': {ex.Message}", ex);
            }

            Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Using quizzes directory: {_quizzesDirectory}");

            _supabaseQuizService = new SupabaseQuizService();
        }

        public async Task<List<Quiz>> GetAllQuizzesAsync()
        {
            // Проверяем кэш (срок жизни 5 минут)
            if (_cachedQuizzes != null && (DateTime.Now - _cacheTime) < _cacheExpiration)
            {
                Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Returning cached quizzes ({_cachedQuizzes.Count} items)");
                return _cachedQuizzes;
            }

            // Если Supabase настроен и пользователь залогинен - загружаем из облака
            if (SupabaseConfig.IsConfigured)
            {
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser != null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Loading quizzes from Supabase for {currentUser.Username}");
                    try
                    {
                        var cloudQuizzes = await _supabaseQuizService.GetUserQuizzes(currentUser.Username);
                        // Локальные викторины
                        var localQuizzes = await GetAllQuizzesFromLocalStorage();

                        // Мердж: для одинаковых Id выбираем более новую версию по ModifiedDate
                        var mergedById = new Dictionary<string, Quiz>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                        var localById = new Dictionary<string, Quiz>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

                        foreach (var localQuiz in localQuizzes)
                        {
                            mergedById[localQuiz.Id] = localQuiz;
                            localById[localQuiz.Id] = localQuiz;
                        }

                        foreach (var cloudQuiz in cloudQuizzes)
                        {
                            if (!mergedById.TryGetValue(cloudQuiz.Id, out var existingQuiz))
                            {
                                mergedById[cloudQuiz.Id] = cloudQuiz;
                                continue;
                            }

                            var existingModified = NormalizeComparisonDate(existingQuiz.ModifiedDate);
                            var cloudModified = NormalizeComparisonDate(cloudQuiz.ModifiedDate);

                            if (cloudModified > existingModified)
                            {
                                mergedById[cloudQuiz.Id] = cloudQuiz;
                            }
                        }

                        var all = mergedById.Values.ToList();

                        // Если в результате нет ни одной непустой викторины — восстанавливаем шаблон
                        if (!all.Any(q => q.Questions != null && q.Questions.Count > 0))
                        {
                            var sample = CreateSampleProgrammingLanguagesQuiz();
                            sample.Id = SampleQuizId;
                            await SaveQuizLocallyAsync(sample);
                            all.Add(sample);
                            Logger.Log("[QuizEditorService] Restored missing/empty sample quiz after merge");
                        }

                        // Сохраняем облачные локально для оффлайн доступа,
                        // но только если их версия новее локальной (или локальной нет)
                        foreach (var quiz in cloudQuizzes)
                        {
                            if (!localById.TryGetValue(quiz.Id, out var localQuiz))
                            {
                                await SaveQuizLocallyAsync(quiz);
                                continue;
                            }

                            var localModified = NormalizeComparisonDate(localQuiz.ModifiedDate);
                            var cloudModified = NormalizeComparisonDate(quiz.ModifiedDate);
                            if (cloudModified > localModified)
                            {
                                await SaveQuizLocallyAsync(quiz);
                            }
                        }

                        // Если пусто — создаём шаблонную викторину ТОЛЬКО локально (один раз, с фиксированным Id)
                        if (all.Count == 0)
                        {
                            var sample = CreateSampleProgrammingLanguagesQuiz();
                            sample.Id = SampleQuizId;
                            // Проверим, есть ли уже локально с тем же Id
                            var localAlready = (await GetAllQuizzesFromLocalStorage()).Any(q => q.Id == SampleQuizId);
                            if (!localAlready)
                            {
                                await SaveQuizLocallyAsync(sample);
                                all.Add(sample);
                            }
                        }
                        
                        _cachedQuizzes = all;
                        _cacheTime = DateTime.Now;
                        return all;
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"Error loading quizzes from Supabase: {ex.Message}", ex);
                        // Fallback на локальные
                    }
                }
            }

            // Fallback: загружаем локальные викторины
            var local = await GetAllQuizzesFromLocalStorage();
            if (local.Count == 0 || !local.Any(q => q.Questions != null && q.Questions.Count > 0))
            {
                var sample = CreateSampleProgrammingLanguagesQuiz();
                sample.Id = SampleQuizId;
                await SaveQuizLocallyAsync(sample);
                local.Add(sample);
            }
            _cachedQuizzes = local;
            _cacheTime = DateTime.Now;
            return local;
        }

        public List<Quiz> GetCachedQuizzes()
        {
            if (_cachedQuizzes != null && (DateTime.Now - _cacheTime) < _cacheExpiration)
            {
                return _cachedQuizzes.ToList();
            }

            return new List<Quiz>();
        }

        public async Task<List<Quiz>> RefreshQuizzesAsync()
        {
            _cachedQuizzes = null;
            return await GetAllQuizzesAsync();
        }

        public async Task<List<Quiz>> GetAllQuizzesFromLocalStorage()
        {
            Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Loading quizzes from local storage");
            var quizzes = new List<Quiz>();
            
            if (!Directory.Exists(_quizzesDirectory))
            {
                Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Directory does not exist: {_quizzesDirectory}");
                return quizzes;
            }

            var files = Directory.GetFiles(_quizzesDirectory, "*.json");
            Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Found {files.Length} JSON files");
            
            var jsonOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions
            {
                PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
            };

            foreach (var file in files)
            {
                try
                {
                    var json = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(file);
                    Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Loading quiz from {file}, JSON length: {json.Length}");
                    
                    var quiz = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Quiz>(json, jsonOptions);
                    if (quiz != null)
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Loaded quiz: {quiz.Title} (ID: {quiz.Id}, Questions: {quiz.Questions?.Count ?? 0})");
                        quizzes.Add(quiz);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[QuizEditorService] Failed to deserialize quiz from {file}: result is null");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"Error loading quiz from {file}: {ex.Message}", ex);
                }
            }

            Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Total loaded quizzes: {quizzes.Count}");
            return quizzes;
        }

        public async Task<Quiz?> GetQuizAsync(string id)
        {
            var filePath = Path.Combine(_quizzesDirectory, $"{id}.json");
            
            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
                return null;

            try
            {
                var json = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(filePath);
                var jsonOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                };
                return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Quiz>(json, jsonOptions);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> SaveQuizAsync(Quiz quiz)
        {
            try
            {
                quiz.ModifiedDate = DateTime.Now;
                
                // Сохраняем локально
                await SaveQuizLocallyAsync(quiz);
                Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] ✅ Quiz saved locally: {quiz.Title}");
                
                // Получаем текущего пользователя для сохранения в Supabase
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser != null && SupabaseConfig.IsConfigured)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        // Проверяем, является ли викторина новой (не существует в Supabase)
                        var existingQuiz = await _supabaseQuizService.GetQuizAsync(quiz.Id);
                        bool isNewQuiz = existingQuiz == null;
                        
                        // Сохраняем в Supabase
                        var success = await _supabaseQuizService.SaveQuiz(quiz, currentUser.Username);
                        if (success)
                        {
                            Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] ✅ Quiz saved to Supabase: {quiz.Title}");
                            
                            // Синхронизируем статистику после сохранения викторины
                            // (если викторина новая или если у неё есть вопросы)
                            if (isNewQuiz || (quiz.Questions != null && quiz.Questions.Count > 0))
                            {
                                var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                                // Синхронизируем статистику из базы для точности
                                await authService.SyncUserStatsFromSupabase(currentUser.Username);
                                Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] ✅ Statistics synced after saving quiz (new={isNewQuiz}, questions={quiz.Questions?.Count ?? 0})");
                                
                                // Обновляем достижения
                                var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(currentUser.Username);
                                if (profile != null)
                                {
                                    var achievementService = new AchievementService();
                                    var socialService = new SupabaseSocialService();
                                    var friends = await socialService.GetFriends(currentUser.Username);
                                    
                                    var perfectStreak = await achievementService.GetPerfectStreak(currentUser.Username);
                                    var totalPerfectQuizzes = await achievementService.GetTotalPerfectQuizzes(currentUser.Username);
                                    
                                    var stats = new UserStats
                                    {
                                        QuizzesPassed = profile.QuizzesPassed,
                                        QuizzesCreated = profile.QuizzesCreated,
                                        AiQuizzesCreated = profile.AiQuizzesCreated,
                                        FriendsCount = friends?.Count ?? 0,
                                        MultiplayerGamesPlayed = profile.MultiplayerGamesPlayed,
                                        MultiplayerGamesWon = profile.MultiplayerGamesWon,
                                        PerfectQuizzes = totalPerfectQuizzes,
                                        CurrentPerfectStreak = perfectStreak
                                    };
                                    
                                    await achievementService.CheckAndUpdateAchievements(currentUser.Username, stats);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            Logger.LogWarning($"[QuizEditorService] Failed to save quiz to Supabase, will sync on logout");
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception supabaseEx)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[QuizEditorService] Error saving to Supabase: {supabaseEx.Message}", supabaseEx);
                        // Продолжаем работу, викторина сохранена локально
                    }
                }
                
                // ✅ Обновляем кэш: заменяем викторину или добавляем новую
                if (_cachedQuizzes != null)
                {
                    var existingIndex = _cachedQuizzes.FindIndex(q => q.Id == quiz.Id);
                    if (existingIndex >= 0)
                    {
                        _cachedQuizzes[existingIndex] = quiz;
                        Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Updated quiz in cache: {quiz.Title}");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        _cachedQuizzes.Add(quiz);
                        Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Added new quiz to cache: {quiz.Title}");
                    }
                }
                
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error saving quiz: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        private async Task SaveQuizLocallyAsync(Quiz quiz)
        {
            // Гарантируем, что у шаблонной викторины заполнены вопросы
            if (quiz.Id == SampleQuizId && (quiz.Questions == null || quiz.Questions.Count == 0))
            {
                var fixedSample = CreateSampleProgrammingLanguagesQuiz();
                // Сохраняем оригинальные метаданные, если есть
                fixedSample.CreatedDate = quiz.CreatedDate != default ? quiz.CreatedDate : fixedSample.CreatedDate;
                fixedSample.ModifiedDate = DateTime.Now;
                quiz = fixedSample;
                Logger.Log("[QuizEditorService] Fixed empty sample quiz before saving");
            }

            var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(quiz, new JsonSerializerOptions
            {
                WriteIndented = true
            });
            
            var filePath = Path.Combine(_quizzesDirectory, $"{quiz.Id}.json");
            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(filePath, json);
        }

        public async Task<bool> DeleteQuizAsync(string id)
        {
            try
            {
                // Сначала удаляем локально (быстрый отклик UI)
                var filePath = Path.Combine(_quizzesDirectory, $"{id}.json");
                var deletedLocal = false;
                if (File.Exists(filePath))
                {
                    File.Delete(filePath);
                    Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] ✅ Quiz deleted locally: {id}");
                    deletedLocal = true;
                }

                // ✅ Удаляем из кэша
                var removedFromCache = false;
                if (_cachedQuizzes != null)
                {
                    var before = _cachedQuizzes.Count;
                    _cachedQuizzes.RemoveAll(q => q.Id == id);
                    removedFromCache = before != _cachedQuizzes.Count;
                    if (removedFromCache)
                        Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] Removed quiz from cache: {id}");
                }

                // ✅ Синхронизируем удаление с Supabase и дожидаемся результата
                if (SupabaseConfig.IsConfigured)
                {
                    var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                    if (currentUser != null)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            var supabaseQuizService = new SupabaseQuizService();
                            var success = await supabaseQuizService.DeleteQuiz(id);
                            if (success)
                            {
                                Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] ✅ Quiz deleted from Supabase: {id}");

                                // Синхронизируем статистику после удаления
                                var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                                await authService.SyncUserStatsFromSupabase(currentUser.Username);
                                Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorService] ✅ Statistics synced after deleting quiz");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                Logger.LogError($"[QuizEditorService] ❌ Failed to delete quiz from Supabase: {id}");
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            Logger.LogError($"[QuizEditorService] Error deleting quiz from Supabase: {ex.Message}", ex);
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Успех только если реально удалили локально или из кэша
                return deletedLocal || removedFromCache;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error deleting quiz: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        private static DateTime NormalizeComparisonDate(DateTime dateTime)
        {
            if (dateTime.Kind == DateTimeKind.Unspecified)
            {
                return DateTime.SpecifyKind(dateTime, DateTimeKind.Local).ToUniversalTime();
            }

            return dateTime.ToUniversalTime();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Очистить кэш викторин — вызывается при входе/выходе
        /// </summary>
        public void ClearCache()
        {
            _cachedQuizzes = null;
            _cacheTime = DateTime.MinValue;
            Logger.Log("[QuizEditorService] Cache cleared");
        }

        public bool DeleteQuiz(string title)
        {
            try
            {
                var filePath = Path.Combine(_quizzesDirectory, $"{title}.json");
                if (File.Exists(filePath))
                {
                    File.Delete(filePath);
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
            catch
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        private async Task UpdateUserStatistics(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                // Получаем количество викторин пользователя
                var quizzes = await _supabaseQuizService.GetUserQuizzes(username);
                int quizzesCreated = quizzes.Count;
                
                // TODO: Добавить подсчёт пройденных викторин когда будет готова статистика прохождений
                int quizzesPassed = 0;
                
                // Обновляем статистику в user_profiles
                var supabaseAuth = new SupabaseAuthService();
                await supabaseAuth.UpdateUserStats(username, quizzesCreated, quizzesPassed);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error updating user statistics: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }
    }

﻿using System;
