=== FILE: Services/QuizUsageTrackingService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Сервис для отслеживания частоты использования викторин
    /// </summary>
    public class QuizUsageTrackingService
    {
        private static readonly string UsageFilePath = Path.Combine(
            Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData),
            "Victory",
            "quiz_usage.json"
        );

        private Dictionary<string, QuizUsageInfo> _usageData;

        public QuizUsageTrackingService()
        {
            _usageData = LoadUsageData();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Увеличить счётчик использования викторины
        /// </summary>
        public void RecordQuizUsage(string quizId, string quizTitle)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(quizId) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(quizTitle))
                return;

            var key = quizId ?? quizTitle;
            
            if (!_usageData.ContainsKey(key))
            {
                _usageData[key] = new QuizUsageInfo
                {
                    QuizId = quizId,
                    QuizTitle = quizTitle,
                    TimesUsed = 0,
                    LastUsed = DateTime.MinValue
                };
            }

            _usageData[key].TimesUsed++;
            _usageData[key].LastUsed = DateTime.Now;
            _usageData[key].QuizId = quizId ?? _usageData[key].QuizId;
            _usageData[key].QuizTitle = quizTitle ?? _usageData[key].QuizTitle;

            SaveUsageData();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получить количество использований викторины
        /// </summary>
        public int GetUsageCount(string quizId, string quizTitle)
        {
            var key = quizId ?? quizTitle;
            return _usageData.TryGetValue(key, out var info) ? info.TimesUsed : 0;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получить последнее время использования викторины
        /// </summary>
        public DateTime GetLastUsed(string quizId, string quizTitle)
        {
            var key = quizId ?? quizTitle;
            return _usageData.TryGetValue(key, out var info) ? info.LastUsed : DateTime.MinValue;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Отсортировать викторины: сначала часто используемые, затем недавно использованные, затем недавно созданные
        /// </summary>
        public List<Quiz> SortQuizzesByUsage(List<Quiz> quizzes)
        {
            return quizzes.OrderByDescending(q =>
            {
                var usageCount = GetUsageCount(q.Id, q.Title);
                var lastUsed = GetLastUsed(q.Id, q.Title);
                var createdDate = q.CreatedDate > q.CreatedAt ? q.CreatedDate : q.CreatedAt;

                // Приоритет: сначала часто используемые, затем недавно использованные, затем недавно созданные
                if (usageCount > 0)
                {
                    // Комбинация частоты использования (больший вес) и последнего использования
                    // Используем обратное значение времени для сортировки: чем новее использование, тем больше значение
                    var lastUsedScore = lastUsed != DateTime.MinValue 
                        ? (int)(DateTime.Now - lastUsed).TotalSeconds 
                        : int.MaxValue; // Если никогда не использовалась, но usageCount > 0 (не должно быть, но на всякий случай)
                    
                    // Больший вес для частоты использования, меньший для времени последнего использования
                    return (usageCount * 1000000) - lastUsedScore;
                }
                else
                {
                    // Если не использовалась - сортируем по дате создания (чем новее, тем выше)
                    var createdScore = (int)(DateTime.Now - createdDate).TotalSeconds;
                    // Делаем отрицательным, чтобы недавно созданные были выше
                    return -createdScore;
                }
            }).ToList();
        }

        private Dictionary<string, QuizUsageInfo> LoadUsageData()
        {
            try
            {
                if (File.Exists(UsageFilePath))
                {
                    var json = File.ReadAllText(UsageFilePath);
                    var data = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, QuizUsageInfo>>(json);
                    return data ?? new Dictionary<string, QuizUsageInfo>();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Error loading quiz usage data", ex);
            }

            return new Dictionary<string, QuizUsageInfo>();
        }

        private void SaveUsageData()
        {
            try
            {
                var directory = Path.GetDirectoryName(UsageFilePath);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory) && !Directory.Exists(directory))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
                }

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(_usageData, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });
                File.WriteAllText(UsageFilePath, json);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Error saving quiz usage data", ex);
            }
        }

        private class QuizUsageInfo
        {
            public string QuizId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
            public string QuizTitle { get; set; } = string.Empty;
            public int TimesUsed { get; set; }
            public DateTime LastUsed { get; set; }
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Services/RoomService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public class RoomService
    {
        private static readonly RoomService _instance = new RoomService();
        public static RoomService Instance => _instance;

        private readonly Dictionary<string, Room> _rooms = new Dictionary<string, Room>();
        private readonly Random _random = new Random();

        private RoomService() { }

        public string CreateRoom(string hostName, Quiz selectedQuiz)
        {
            string roomCode = GenerateRoomCode();
            var room = new Room
            {
                Code = roomCode,
                HostName = hostName,
                Quiz = selectedQuiz,
                Players = new List<PlayerScore>(),
                IsActive = true,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.Now
            };

            var hostLabel = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(hostName) ? "Хост" : hostName.Trim();
            room.Players.Add(new PlayerScore
            {
                Username = hostLabel,
                DisplayName = hostLabel,
                Name = hostLabel,
                Score = 0
            });
            
            _rooms[roomCode] = room;
            return roomCode;
        }

        public bool JoinRoom(string roomCode, string playerName)
        {
            if (!_rooms.ContainsKey(roomCode)) return false;
            
            var room = _rooms[roomCode];
            if (!room.IsActive) return false;
            
            // Check if player already exists
            if (room.Players.Any(p => p.Name.Equals(playerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                return false;

            var label = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(playerName) ? "Игрок" : playerName.Trim();
            var player = new PlayerScore
            {
                Username = label,
                DisplayName = label,
                Name = label,
                Score = 0
            };
            
            room.Players.Add(player);
            return true;
        }

        public Room? GetRoom(string roomCode)
        {
            return _rooms.ContainsKey(roomCode) ? _rooms[roomCode] : null;
        }

        public void StartRoom(string roomCode)
        {
            if (_rooms.ContainsKey(roomCode))
            {
                _rooms[roomCode].IsStarted = true;
                _rooms[roomCode].StartedAt = DateTime.Now;
            }
        }

        public void EndRoom(string roomCode)
        {
            if (_rooms.ContainsKey(roomCode))
            {
                _rooms[roomCode].IsActive = false;
                _rooms[roomCode].EndedAt = DateTime.Now;
            }
        }

        public void AwardPoints(string roomCode, string playerName, int points)
        {
            if (_rooms.ContainsKey(roomCode))
            {
                var player = _rooms[roomCode].Players.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Name == playerName);
                if (player != null)
                {
                    player.Score += points;
                }
            }
        }

        public void RemovePlayer(string roomCode, string playerName)
        {
            if (_rooms.ContainsKey(roomCode))
            {
                var player = _rooms[roomCode].Players.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Name == playerName);
                if (player != null)
                {
                    _rooms[roomCode].Players.Remove(player);
                }
            }
        }

        public void CleanupOldRooms()
        {
            var cutoff = DateTime.Now.AddHours(-2);
            var toRemove = _rooms.Where(kvp => kvp.Value.CreatedAt < cutoff).Select(kvp => kvp.Key).ToList();
            foreach (var key in toRemove)
            {
                _rooms.Remove(key);
            }
        }

        private string GenerateRoomCode()
        {
            string code;
            do
            {
                code = _random.Next(100000, 999999).ToString();
            } while (_rooms.ContainsKey(code));
            return code;
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: Services/ServerConfigService.cs ===

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public class ServerConfig
    {
        public string ServerUrl { get; set; } = "http://localhost:5000";
        public bool AutoDiscoverServer { get; set; } = true;
        public bool UseEmbeddedServer { get; set; } = false;
        public bool RequireNetworkServer { get; set; } = true;
    }

    public static class ServerConfigService
    {
        private static readonly string ConfigFilePath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "server-config.json");
        private static ServerConfig? _config;

        public static ServerConfig LoadConfig()
        {
            try
            {
                if (File.Exists(ConfigFilePath))
                {
                    var json = File.ReadAllText(ConfigFilePath);
                    _config = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ServerConfig>(json);
                    Logger.Log($"Loaded server config from {ConfigFilePath}");
                    Logger.Log($"Server URL: {_config?.ServerUrl}");
                    Logger.Log($"Use Embedded Server: {_config?.UseEmbeddedServer}");
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.Log("Config file not found, using default configuration");
                    _config = new ServerConfig();
                    SaveConfig(_config);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Failed to load config: {ex.Message}", ex);
                _config = new ServerConfig();
            }

            return _config!;
        }

        public static void SaveConfig(ServerConfig config)
        {
            try
            {
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(config, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });
                File.WriteAllText(ConfigFilePath, json);
                _config = config;
                Logger.Log($"Config saved to {ConfigFilePath}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Failed to save config: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        public static ServerConfig GetConfig()
        {
            return _config ?? LoadConfig();
        }
    }
}



=== FILE: Services/ServerDiscoveryService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.NetworkInformation;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public static class ServerDiscoveryService
    {
        private const int DISCOVERY_PORT = 5001; // Отдельный порт для обнаружения
        private const int DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT = 3000; // 3 секунды

        public static async Task<string?> DiscoverServerAsync()
        {
            Logger.Log("Starting automatic server discovery...");

            try
            {
                // Получаем локальную сеть
                var localNetwork = GetLocalNetwork();
                if (localNetwork == null)
                {
                    Logger.Log("Could not determine local network");
                    return null;
                }

                Logger.Log($"Scanning network: {localNetwork}");

                // Сканируем сеть на предмет сервера
                var serverUrl = await ScanNetworkForServer(localNetwork);
                
                if (serverUrl != null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"Server found at: {serverUrl}");
                    return serverUrl;
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.Log("No server found in network");
                    return null;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Error during server discovery", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string? GetLocalNetwork()
        {
            try
            {
                var host = Dns.GetHostEntry(Dns.GetHostName());
                foreach (var ip in host.AddressList)
                {
                    if (ip.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork)
                    {
                        var ipString = ip.ToString();
                        if (ipString.StartsWith("192.168.") || ipString.StartsWith("10.") || ipString.StartsWith("172."))
                        {
                            // Получаем сеть (первые 3 октета)
                            var parts = ipString.Split('.');
                            if (parts.Length >= 3)
                            {
                                return $"{parts[0]}.{parts[1]}.{parts[2]}";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Error getting local network", ex);
            }
            return null;
        }

        private static async Task<string?> ScanNetworkForServer(string network)
        {
            var tasks = new List<Task<string?>>();

            // Сканируем IP адреса в сети (1-254)
            for (int i = 1; i <= 254; i++)
            {
                var ip = $"{network}.{i}";
                tasks.Add(CheckServerAtAddress(ip));
            }

            // Ждем результаты с таймаутом
            var completedTask = await Task.WhenAny(tasks);
            var result = await completedTask;

            if (result != null)
            {
                return result;
            }

            // Если ничего не найдено, ждем остальные задачи
            var allTasks = await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
            return allTasks.FirstOrDefault(r => r != null);
        }

        private static async Task<string?> CheckServerAtAddress(string ip)
        {
            try
            {
                using var client = new TcpClient();
                var connectTask = client.ConnectAsync(ip, 5000);
                var timeoutTask = Task.Delay(DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT);

                var completedTask = await Task.WhenAny(connectTask, timeoutTask);
                
                if (completedTask == connectTask && client.Connected)
                {
                    client.Close();
                    
                    // Дополнительная проверка - HTTP запрос
                    var serverUrl = $"http://{ip}:5000";
                    if (await TestServerHealth(serverUrl))
                    {
                        return serverUrl;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                // Игнорируем ошибки подключения
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static async Task<bool> TestServerHealth(string serverUrl)
        {
            try
            {
                using var httpClient = new System.Net.Http.HttpClient();
                httpClient.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);
                
                var response = await httpClient.GetAsync($"{serverUrl}/health");
                return response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }
            catch
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: Services/ServerManager.cs ===

using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public static class ServerManager
    {
        private static Process? _serverProcess;
        private static readonly object _lock = new object();
        private static bool _starting = false;

        public static bool IsRunning => _serverProcess != null && !_serverProcess.HasExited;

        public static async Task<bool> EnsureStartedAsync(string serverUrl = "http://localhost:5000")
        {
            if (IsRunning) return true;

            lock (_lock)
            {
                if (_starting) return true;
                _starting = true;
            }

            try
            {
                var baseDir = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;
                // Prefer packaged binaries in output
                var packagedDir = Path.Combine(baseDir, "VictoryServer", "publish");
                string? exePath = Path.Combine(packagedDir, "VictoryServer.exe");
                string? dllPath = Path.Combine(packagedDir, "VictoryServer.dll");

                ProcessStartInfo startInfo;
                if (File.Exists(exePath))
                {
                    startInfo = new ProcessStartInfo
                    {
                        FileName = exePath,
                        Arguments = "",
                        WorkingDirectory = packagedDir,
                        UseShellExecute = false,
                        CreateNoWindow = true,
                        RedirectStandardOutput = true,
                        RedirectStandardError = true
                    };
                }
                else if (File.Exists(dllPath))
                {
                    startInfo = new ProcessStartInfo
                    {
                        FileName = "dotnet",
                        Arguments = $"\"{dllPath}\"",
                        WorkingDirectory = packagedDir,
                        UseShellExecute = false,
                        CreateNoWindow = true,
                        RedirectStandardOutput = true,
                        RedirectStandardError = true
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    // Fallback to running from sources (requires SDK)
                    var serverSrcDir = Path.Combine(baseDir, "VictoryServer");
                    if (!Directory.Exists(serverSrcDir))
                    {
                        // Try one level up for dev
                        serverSrcDir = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(baseDir, "..", "VictoryServer"));
                    }
                    if (!Directory.Exists(serverSrcDir))
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("VictoryServer binaries/sources not found.");
                        return false;
                    }

                    startInfo = new ProcessStartInfo
                    {
                        FileName = "dotnet",
                        Arguments = "run --urls " + serverUrl,
                        WorkingDirectory = serverSrcDir,
                        UseShellExecute = false,
                        CreateNoWindow = true,
                        RedirectStandardOutput = true,
                        RedirectStandardError = true
                    };
                }

                _serverProcess = new Process { StartInfo = startInfo, EnableRaisingEvents = true };
                _serverProcess.OutputDataReceived += (_, e) => { if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(e.Data)) Logger.Log("[Server] " + e.Data); };
                _serverProcess.ErrorDataReceived += (_, e) => { if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(e.Data)) Logger.LogError("[Server] " + e.Data); };
                _serverProcess.Start();
                _serverProcess.BeginOutputReadLine();
                _serverProcess.BeginErrorReadLine();

                // Wait until server responds
                var http = new HttpClient();
                var timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15);
                var start = DateTime.UtcNow;
                while ((DateTime.UtcNow - start) < timeout)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var resp = await http.GetAsync(serverUrl);
                        if (resp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                        {
                            Logger.Log("Server is up at " + serverUrl);
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                    catch { }
                    await Task.Delay(500);
                }

                Logger.LogError("Server did not start within timeout");
                return false;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to start server", ex);
                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                lock (_lock) { _starting = false; }
            }
        }

        public static void Stop()
        {
            try
            {
                if (_serverProcess != null && !_serverProcess.HasExited)
                {
                    _serverProcess.Kill(true);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to stop server", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                _serverProcess = null;
            }
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: Services/SocialBadgeService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Windows.Threading;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public static class SocialBadgeService
    {
        public static int PendingFriendRequestsCount { get; private set; }
        public static int IncomingRoomInvitesCount { get; private set; }
        public static event Action<int,int>? Updated;

        private static DispatcherTimer? _timer;

        public static void Start()
        {
            if (_timer != null) return;
            _timer = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2) };
            _timer.Tick += async (s, e) => await PollAsync();
            _timer.Start();
        }

        private static async System.Threading.Tasks.Task PollAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null)
                {
                    SetCounts(0, 0);
                    return;
                }
                var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
                var pending = await social.GetPendingFriendRequests(current.Username);
                var invites = await social.GetIncomingRoomInvites(current.Username);
                SetCounts(pending.Count, invites.Count);
            }
            catch { }
        }

        private static void SetCounts(int friends, int invites)
        {
            if (friends == PendingFriendRequestsCount && invites == IncomingRoomInvitesCount) return;
            PendingFriendRequestsCount = friends;
            IncomingRoomInvitesCount = invites;
            try { Updated?.Invoke(PendingFriendRequestsCount, IncomingRoomInvitesCount); } catch { }
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: Services/SocialNotificationService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Threading;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Глобальный сервис для отслеживания социальных уведомлений (заявки в друзья, приглашения в комнаты)
    /// Работает независимо от того, в какой части приложения находится пользователь
    /// </summary>
    public class SocialNotificationService
    {
        private static SocialNotificationService? _instance;
        public static SocialNotificationService Instance => _instance ??= new SocialNotificationService();

        private DispatcherTimer? _pollTimer;
        private readonly SupabaseSocialService _socialService = new SupabaseSocialService();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _notifiedKeys = new HashSet<string>();
        private readonly Queue<NotificationData> _notificationQueue = new Queue<NotificationData>();
        private bool _isShowingNotification = false;
        private int _currentNotificationTopOffset = 50; // Начальная позиция сверху
        private const int NOTIFICATION_SPACING = 70; // Расстояние между уведомлениями

        public int PendingFriendRequestsCount { get; private set; } = 0;
        public event EventHandler? PendingFriendRequestsChanged;

        private SocialNotificationService()
        {
            Logger.Log("[SocialNotificationService] Initialized");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Запускает поллинг социальных событий
        /// </summary>
        public async void Start()
        {
            if (_pollTimer != null)
            {
                Logger.Log("[SocialNotificationService] Already started");
                return;
            }

            Logger.Log("[SocialNotificationService] Starting social polling");

            // Инициализируем уже существующие уведомления как "показанные"
            await InitializeNotifiedKeysAsync();

            _pollTimer = new DispatcherTimer
            {
                Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5) // Опрашиваем каждые 5 секунд
            };
            _pollTimer.Tick += async (s, e) => await PollSocialAsync();
            _pollTimer.Start();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Останавливает поллинг
        /// </summary>
        public void Stop()
        {
            _pollTimer?.Stop();
            _pollTimer = null;
            _notifiedKeys.Clear();
            _notificationQueue.Clear();
            PendingFriendRequestsCount = 0;
            Logger.Log("[SocialNotificationService] Stopped");
        }

        private async Task InitializeNotifiedKeysAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null) return;

                // Помечаем все существующие accepted friend requests
                var accepted = await _socialService.GetAcceptedFriendRequests(current.Username);
                foreach (var fr in accepted)
                {
                    _notifiedKeys.Add($"friend_request_accepted:{fr.Id}");
                }

                // Помечаем все существующие accepted room invites
                var acceptedInv = await _socialService.GetAcceptedRoomInvites(current.Username);
                foreach (var inv in acceptedInv)
                {
                    _notifiedKeys.Add($"room_invite_accepted:{inv.Id}");
                }

                // Помечаем все существующие входящие приглашения как "уже показанные"
                var incoming = await _socialService.GetIncomingRoomInvites(current.Username);
                foreach (var inv in incoming)
                {
                    _notifiedKeys.Add($"room_invite_sent:{inv.Id}");
                }

                // Считаем pending заявки в друзья (НЕ помечаем как показанные, просто считаем)
                var pending = await _socialService.GetPendingFriendRequests(current.Username);
                PendingFriendRequestsCount = pending.Count;
                PendingFriendRequestsChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);

                Logger.Log($"[SocialNotificationService] Initialized with {_notifiedKeys.Count} already shown notifications, {PendingFriendRequestsCount} pending requests");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SocialNotificationService] InitializeNotifiedKeysAsync error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        private async Task PollSocialAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null) return;

                // 1. Новые входящие заявки в друзья (pending)
                var pending = await _socialService.GetPendingFriendRequests(current.Username);
                PendingFriendRequestsCount = pending.Count;
                PendingFriendRequestsChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);

                foreach (var fr in pending)
                {
                    var key = $"friend_request_pending:{fr.Id}";
                    if (_notifiedKeys.Add(key))
                    {
                        EnqueueNotification($"Новая заявка в друзья от {fr.From_Username}", "info");
                    }
                }

                // 2. Принятые заявки в друзья
                var accepted = await _socialService.GetAcceptedFriendRequests(current.Username);
                foreach (var fr in accepted)
                {
                    // Пропускаем аномальные записи
                    if (string.Equals(fr.To_Username, current.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        continue;

                    var key = $"friend_request_accepted:{fr.Id}";
                    if (_notifiedKeys.Add(key))
                    {
                        EnqueueNotification($"{fr.To_Username} принял(а) вашу заявку в друзья", "success");
                        
                        // Уменьшаем счётчик pending (если это была наша заявка)
                        if (PendingFriendRequestsCount > 0)
                        {
                            PendingFriendRequestsCount--;
                            PendingFriendRequestsChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
                        }
                    }
                }

                // 3. Приглашения в комнату (входящие)
                var incoming = await _socialService.GetIncomingRoomInvites(current.Username);
                foreach (var inv in incoming)
                {
                    var key = $"room_invite_sent:{inv.Id}";
                    if (_notifiedKeys.Add(key))
                    {
                        // Проверяем настройки уведомлений
                        if (UserSettingsService.Instance.GetCurrentSettings().NotificationsEnabled)
                        {
                            // Показываем только интерактивное окно (без дополнительного инфо-тоста)
                            System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                            {
                                var wnd = new Views.RoomInviteNotificationWindow(inv.Id, inv.Room_Id, inv.From_Username);
                                wnd.Show();
                            });
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            Logger.Log($"[SocialNotificationService] Room invite notification skipped (notifications disabled)");
                        }
                    }
                }

                // 4. Принятые приглашения в комнату
                var acceptedInv = await _socialService.GetAcceptedRoomInvites(current.Username);
                foreach (var inv in acceptedInv)
                {
                    // Не показываем если адресат - текущий пользователь
                    if (string.Equals(inv.To_Username, current.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        continue;

                    var key = $"room_invite_accepted:{inv.Id}";
                    if (_notifiedKeys.Add(key))
                    {
                        EnqueueNotification($"{inv.To_Username} принял(а) приглашение в комнату", "success");
                    }
                }

                // Показываем следующее уведомление из очереди
                ProcessNotificationQueue();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SocialNotificationService] PollSocialAsync error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        private void EnqueueNotification(string message, string type, bool isRoomInvite = false, int inviteId = 0, int roomId = 0)
        {
            _notificationQueue.Enqueue(new NotificationData
            {
                Message = message,
                Type = type,
                IsRoomInvite = isRoomInvite,
                InviteId = inviteId,
                RoomId = roomId
            });

            Logger.Log($"[SocialNotificationService] Enqueued notification: {message}");
        }

        private void ProcessNotificationQueue()
        {
            if (_isShowingNotification || _notificationQueue.Count == 0)
                return;

            // Проверяем настройки уведомлений
            if (!UserSettingsService.Instance.GetCurrentSettings().NotificationsEnabled)
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SocialNotificationService] Notification queue cleared (notifications disabled)");
                _notificationQueue.Clear();
                return;
            }

            _isShowingNotification = true;
            var data = _notificationQueue.Dequeue();

            System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                try
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow(data.Message, data.Type);
                    
                    // Позиционируем уведомления с отступом друг от друга
                    notification.Loaded += (s, e) =>
                    {
                        notification.Top = _currentNotificationTopOffset;
                        _currentNotificationTopOffset += NOTIFICATION_SPACING;
                    };

                    notification.Closed += (s, e) =>
                    {
                        // Когда уведомление закрывается, сбрасываем флаг и показываем следующее
                        _isShowingNotification = false;
                        _currentNotificationTopOffset = Math.Max(50, _currentNotificationTopOffset - NOTIFICATION_SPACING);
                        
                        // Показываем следующее из очереди
                        ProcessNotificationQueue();
                    };

                    notification.Show();
                    Logger.Log($"[SocialNotificationService] Showed notification: {data.Message}");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SocialNotificationService] Error showing notification: {ex.Message}", ex);
                    _isShowingNotification = false;
                }
            });
        }

        private class NotificationData
        {
            public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
            public string Type { get; set; } = "info";
            public bool IsRoomInvite { get; set; }
            public int InviteId { get; set; }
            public int RoomId { get; set; }
        }
    }
}



=== FILE: Services/SoundService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public class SoundService
    {
        private static SoundService? _instance;
        public static SoundService Instance => _instance ??= new SoundService();

        private bool _soundEnabled = true;
        private string? _tempSoundPath;

        public bool SoundEnabled
        {
            get => _soundEnabled;
            set => _soundEnabled = value;
        }

        private SoundService()
        {
            try
            {
                // Read persisted settings
                var settingsPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "settings.json");
                if (File.Exists(settingsPath))
                {
                    var json = File.ReadAllText(settingsPath);
                    var obj = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Victory.ViewModels.SettingsData>(json);
                    _soundEnabled = obj?.SoundEnabled ?? true;
                }
            }
            catch { _soundEnabled = true; }
        }

        private string GetSoundPath()
        {
            // First try to get from embedded resource
            if (_tempSoundPath == null)
            {
                try
                {
                    var assembly = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
                    var resourceName = "Victory.sounds.click.mp3";
                    
                    using (var stream = assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(resourceName))
                    {
                        if (stream != null)
                        {
                            var tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "Victory");
                            Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);
                            _tempSoundPath = Path.Combine(tempDir, "click.mp3");
                            
                            using (var fileStream = new FileStream(_tempSoundPath, FileMode.Create))
                            {
                                stream.CopyTo(fileStream);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch { }
            }

            // Fallback to file system
            if (_tempSoundPath == null || !File.Exists(_tempSoundPath))
            {
                var soundPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "sounds", "click.mp3");
                if (File.Exists(soundPath))
                {
                    return soundPath;
                }
            }

            return _tempSoundPath ?? string.Empty;
        }

        public void PlayClickSound()
        {
            if (!_soundEnabled) return;
            
            try
            {
                var soundPath = GetSoundPath();
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(soundPath) && File.Exists(soundPath))
                {
                    var player = new MediaPlayer();
                    player.Open(new Uri(soundPath, UriKind.Absolute));
                    player.Volume = 0.5;
                    player.MediaEnded += (s, e) => player.Close();
                    player.Play();
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                // Ignore sound errors
            }
        }

        public void PlaySuccessSound()
        {
            PlayClickSound();
        }

        public void PlayErrorSound()
        {
            PlayClickSound();
        }

        public void PlayNotificationSound()
        {
            PlayClickSound();
        }

        public void PlayQuizStartSound()
        {
            PlayClickSound();
        }

        public void PlayQuizCompleteSound()
        {
            PlayClickSound();
        }


    }
}


=== FILE: Services/SupabaseAuthService.cs ===

using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Server.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public class IsoDateTimeConverter : JsonConverter<DateTime>
    {
        public override DateTime Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            string? dateString = reader.GetString();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dateString))
                return DateTime.MinValue;

            if (DateTime.TryParse(dateString, null, System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles.RoundtripKind, out var result))
                return result;

            return DateTime.MinValue;
        }

        public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer, DateTime value, JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            writer.WriteStringValue(value.ToString("O"));
        }
    }

    public partial class SupabaseAuthService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
        private string? _jwtToken;

        public SupabaseAuthService()
        {
            _httpClient = new HttpClient();
            // НЕ добавляем Content-Type в DefaultRequestHeaders!
            // Он будет установлен для каждого конкретного запроса (POST/PUT/PATCH)
        }

        public void SetJwtToken(string token)
        {
            _jwtToken = token;
            if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
            {
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
            }
            _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", $"Bearer {token}");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Парсит ID пользователя из Supabase (может быть UUID или int)
        /// </summary>
        private int ParseUserId(string? userId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
                return 0;

            // Пытаемся парсить как int
            if (int.TryParse(userId, out var intId))
                return intId;

            // Если это UUID, используем хеш для получения int
            // Это не идеально, но позволяет использовать существующую структуру UserDto с int Id
            return Math.Abs(userId.GetHashCode());
        }

        private string ParseSupabaseLoginError(string responseJson)
        {
            try
            {
                // Пытаемся разобрать JSON ошибку
                var errorObj = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>(responseJson);
                if (errorObj.TryGetProperty("error_description", out var errorDesc))
                {
                    return errorDesc.GetString() ?? "Ошибка входа";
                }

                if (errorObj.TryGetProperty("msg", out var msg))
                {
                    return msg.GetString() ?? "Ошибка входа";
                }

                if (errorObj.TryGetProperty("message", out var message))
                {
                    return message.GetString() ?? "Ошибка входа";
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                // Игнорируем ошибки парсинга
            }

            // Проверяем распространенные ошибки по тексту
            if (responseJson.Contains("Invalid login credentials") || responseJson.Contains("Invalid email or password") || responseJson.Contains("invalid_credentials") || responseJson.Contains("invalid_grant"))
            {
                return LocalizationService.GetString("InvalidCredentials");
            }

            if (responseJson.Contains("Email not confirmed") || responseJson.Contains("email_not_confirmed"))
            {
                return LocalizationService.GetString("EmailNotConfirmed");
            }

            if (responseJson.Contains("Too many requests") || responseJson.Contains("too_many_requests"))
            {
                return LocalizationService.GetString("TooManyRequests");
            }

            if (responseJson.Contains("User already registered") || responseJson.Contains("user_already_exists"))
            {
                return LocalizationService.GetString("UserAlreadyExists");
            }

            if (responseJson.Contains("signup_disabled"))
            {
                return LocalizationService.GetString("RegistrationDisabled");
            }

            if (responseJson.Contains("weak_password"))
            {
                return LocalizationService.GetString("WeakPassword");
            }

            // Логируем полный ответ для диагностики
            Logger.LogError($"Unexpected Supabase login error: {responseJson}");

            return LocalizationService.GetString("SupabaseError");
        }

        public async Task<bool> IsUserSessionActive(string username, string? token = null)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== CHECKING SESSION FOR USER: {username} ==========");

                // Очищаем все заголовки авторизации
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("apikey");
                }
                
                // Добавляем apikey для доступа к REST API без авторизации
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Added apikey header");
                
                // ВАЖНО: НЕ трогаем Content-Type для GET запросов!
                // Content-Type - это контент-заголовок и не должен быть в DefaultRequestHeaders

                // Проверяем: is_active=true И last_activity не старше 30 минут
                // Если last_activity старше 30 минут - считаем сессию мёртвой (crashed app)
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_sessions?username=eq.{username}&is_active=eq.true&select=id,username,session_id,created_at,last_activity";
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Request URL: {url}");

                var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync(url);
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Response Status: {response.StatusCode}");

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Raw Response JSON: {json}");
                    
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(json) || json == "[]")
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ NO ACTIVE SESSIONS for {username}");
                        return false;
                    }
                    
                    var sessions = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<UserSession>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
                        Converters = { new IsoDateTimeConverter() }
                    });

                    if (sessions != null && sessions.Count > 0)
                    {
                        var session = sessions[0];
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Found active session: ID={session.Id}, LastActivity={session.LastActivity}");
                        
                        // Проверяем, был ли heartbeat за последние 90 секунд
                        var lastActivityTime = session.LastActivity;
                        var timeSinceLastActivity = DateTime.UtcNow - lastActivityTime;
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Time since last activity: {timeSinceLastActivity.TotalSeconds:F0} seconds");
                        
                        if (timeSinceLastActivity.TotalSeconds > 90)
                        {
                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ⚠️  SESSION IS STALE (no heartbeat for {timeSinceLastActivity.TotalSeconds:F0} sec) - treating as inactive");
                            return false; // Сессия мертва - нет heartbeat'а
                        }
                        
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ⚠️  ACTIVE SESSION FOUND - User is online!");
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END SESSION CHECK ==========");
                        return true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ NO ACTIVE SESSIONS for {username}");
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ❌ Session check FAILED - Status: {response.StatusCode}, Content: {errorContent}");
                }

                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END SESSION CHECK (ERROR) ==========");
                return false;
            }
            catch (HttpRequestException ex) when (ex.Message.Contains("No such host is known") || ex.Message.Contains("Name resolution failure") || ex.Message.Contains("host is unknown") || ex.Message.Contains("хост неизвестен") || ex.Message.Contains("не удается найти"))
            {
                Logger.Log("[SupabaseAuthService] No internet connection detected");
                return false; // Нет интернета - считаем что сессия не активна
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] Error checking user session: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> CreateUserSession(string username, string sessionId)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== CREATING SESSION FOR USER: {username} ==========");

                // Очищаем все заголовки авторизации перед установкой новых
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("apikey");
                }

                // Для REST API используем apikey, а НЕ JWT!
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Added apikey header for session creation");

                // СНАЧАЛА удаляем старые активные сессии этого пользователя
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Deleting old active sessions for {username}");
                var deleteUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_sessions?username=eq.{username}&is_active=eq.true";
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] DELETE URL: {deleteUrl}");
                
                var deleteResponse = await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(deleteUrl);
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] DELETE Response Status: {deleteResponse.StatusCode}");
                
                if (!deleteResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var errorContent = await deleteResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ⚠️  Failed to delete old sessions: {errorContent}");
                }

                // Используем snake_case для Supabase REST API
                var sessionData = new
                {
                    username = username,
                    session_id = sessionId,
                    is_active = true,
                    created_at = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    last_activity = DateTime.UtcNow
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(sessionData);
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Session data: {json}");
                
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_sessions";
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] POST URL: {url}");

                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync(url, content);
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Response Status: {response.StatusCode}");

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var responseContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ SESSION CREATED SUCCESSFULLY: {responseContent}");
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END SESSION CREATION ==========");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ❌ SESSION CREATION FAILED - Status: {response.StatusCode}, Content: {errorContent}");
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END SESSION CREATION (ERROR) ==========");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (HttpRequestException ex) when (ex.Message.Contains("No such host is known") || ex.Message.Contains("Name resolution failure") || ex.Message.Contains("host is unknown") || ex.Message.Contains("хост неизвестен") || ex.Message.Contains("не удается найти"))
            {
                Logger.Log("No internet connection detected during session creation");
                return false;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error creating user session: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> EndUserSession(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== ENDING SESSION FOR USER: {username} ==========");

                // Очищаем все заголовки авторизации перед установкой новых
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("apikey");
                }

                // Используем apikey для REST API
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Prefer", "return=representation");
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Accept", "application/json");
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Added apikey header for session end");

                // Быстрый путь: сразу удаляем активные сессии по username (без предварительного GET)
                try
                {
                    var quickDeleteUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_sessions?username=eq.{username}&is_active=eq.true";
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] QUICK DELETE URL: {quickDeleteUrl}");

                    using (var cts = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3)))
                    {
                        var quickResp = await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(quickDeleteUrl, cts.Token);
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] QUICK DELETE Status: {quickResp.StatusCode}");
                        if (quickResp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                        {
                            var quickBody = await quickResp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(quickBody))
                            {
                                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] QUICK DELETE Body: {quickBody}");
                            }
                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ QUICK SESSION DELETE SUCCESS");
                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END SESSION ENDING ==========");
                            return true;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            var quickErrorBody = await quickResp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(quickErrorBody))
                            {
                                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] QUICK DELETE Error Body: {quickErrorBody}");
                            }
                            // Фоллбек: пометить как неактивные, если DELETE недоступен политиками
                            try
                            {
                                var patchUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_sessions?username=eq.{username}&is_active=eq.true";
                                var patchBody = new { is_active = false, ended_at = DateTime.UtcNow };
                                var patchJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(patchBody);
                                var content = new StringContent(patchJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] QUICK PATCH URL: {patchUrl}");
                                var patchResp = await _httpClient.PatchAsync(patchUrl, content, cts.Token);
                                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] QUICK PATCH Status: {patchResp.StatusCode}");
                                if (patchResp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                                {
                                    var patchBodyContent = await patchResp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(patchBodyContent))
                                    {
                                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] QUICK PATCH Body: {patchBodyContent}");
                                    }
                                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ QUICK SESSION PATCH (INACTIVE) SUCCESS");
                                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END SESSION ENDING ==========");
                                    return true;
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    var patchErrorBody = await patchResp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(patchErrorBody))
                                    {
                                        Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] QUICK PATCH Error Body: {patchErrorBody}");
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            catch (Exception patchEx)
                            {
                                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Quick patch path failed: {patchEx.Message}");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception quickEx)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Quick delete path failed: {quickEx.Message}");
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Prefer"))
                        _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Prefer");
                    if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Accept"))
                        _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Accept");
                }

                // Медленный путь: сначала найти активную сессию, затем удалить по id
                // Сначала находим активную сессию пользователя
                var getUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_sessions?username=eq.{username}&is_active=eq.true&select=id";
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] GET URL: {getUrl}");
                var sessionsResponse = await _httpClient.GetAsync(getUrl);
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] GET Response Status: {sessionsResponse.StatusCode}");

                if (sessionsResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await sessionsResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] GET Response JSON: {json}");
                    
                    var sessions = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<UserSession>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
                        Converters = { new IsoDateTimeConverter() }
                    });

                    if (sessions != null && sessions.Any())
                    {
                        var activeSession = sessions.First();
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Found active session with ID: {activeSession.Id}");

                        // УДАЛЯЕМ сессию вместо обновления is_active
                        var deleteUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_sessions?id=eq.{activeSession.Id}";
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] DELETE URL: {deleteUrl}");

                        _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Prefer", "return=representation");
                        _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Accept", "application/json");
                        var response = await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(deleteUrl);
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] DELETE Response Status: {response.StatusCode}");

                        if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                        {
                            var deleteBody = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(deleteBody))
                            {
                                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] DELETE Body: {deleteBody}");
                            }
                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ SESSION DELETED SUCCESSFULLY");
                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END SESSION ENDING ==========");
                            return true;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ❌ SESSION DELETE FAILED - Status: {response.StatusCode}, Content: {errorContent}");

                            // Фоллбек: PATCH is_active=false по id
                            try
                            {
                                var patchUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_sessions?id=eq.{activeSession.Id}";
                                var patchBody = new { is_active = false, ended_at = DateTime.UtcNow };
                                var patchJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(patchBody);
                                var content = new StringContent(patchJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] PATCH URL: {patchUrl}");
                                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Prefer", "return=representation");
                                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Accept", "application/json");
                                var patchResp = await _httpClient.PatchAsync(patchUrl, content);
                                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] PATCH Response Status: {patchResp.StatusCode}");
                                if (patchResp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                                {
                                    var slowPatchBody = await patchResp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(slowPatchBody))
                                    {
                                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] PATCH Body: {slowPatchBody}");
                                    }
                                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ SESSION MARKED INACTIVE SUCCESSFULLY");
                                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END SESSION ENDING ==========");
                                    return true;
                                }
                            }
                            catch (Exception patchEx)
                            {
                                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Patch fallback failed: {patchEx.Message}");
                            }

                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END SESSION ENDING (ERROR) ==========");
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ℹ️  NO ACTIVE SESSION FOUND for {username}");
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END SESSION ENDING (NO SESSION) ==========");
                        return true; // Нет сессии - это не ошибка
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await sessionsResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ❌ GET SESSIONS FAILED - Status: {sessionsResponse.StatusCode}, Content: {errorContent}");
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END SESSION ENDING (GET ERROR) ==========");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error ending user session: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> UpdateSessionHeartbeat(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== HEARTBEAT FOR USER: {username} ==========");

                // Очищаем все заголовки авторизации перед установкой новых
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("apikey");
                }

                // Используем apikey для REST API
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);

                // Находим активную сессию пользователя
                var getUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_sessions?username=eq.{username}&is_active=eq.true&select=id";
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] GET URL: {getUrl}");
                var sessionsResponse = await _httpClient.GetAsync(getUrl);

                if (sessionsResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await sessionsResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] GET Response JSON: {json}");
                    
                    var sessions = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<UserSession>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
                        Converters = { new IsoDateTimeConverter() }
                    });

                    if (sessions != null && sessions.Any())
                    {
                        var activeSession = sessions.First();
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Found session ID: {activeSession.Id}");

                        // Обновляем last_activity на текущее время
                        var updateData = new { last_activity = DateTime.UtcNow };
                        var updateJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(updateData);
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Update data: {updateJson}");
                        
                        var updateContent = new StringContent(updateJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                        var patchUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_sessions?id=eq.{activeSession.Id}";
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] PATCH URL: {patchUrl}");

                        var response = await _httpClient.PatchAsync(patchUrl, updateContent);
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] PATCH Response Status: {response.StatusCode}");

                        if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                        {
                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ HEARTBEAT UPDATED SUCCESSFULLY");
                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ========== END HEARTBEAT ==========");
                            return true;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ❌ HEARTBEAT UPDATE FAILED - Status: {response.StatusCode}, Content: {errorContent}");
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ℹ️  NO ACTIVE SESSION FOUND for {username}");
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await sessionsResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ❌ GET SESSIONS FAILED - Status: {sessionsResponse.StatusCode}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error updating session heartbeat: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// Обновляет статистику пользователя (полная перезапись - использовать только для синхронизации)

        public async Task<bool> UpdateUserStats(string username, int quizzesCreated, int quizzesPassed)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Updating stats for {username}: created={quizzesCreated}, passed={quizzesPassed}");

                // Очищаем заголовки

                {

                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Prefer"))

                }

                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
                
                // ✅ Обновляем статистику (профиль уже должен существовать!)

                var updateJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(updateData);

                    return false;

            }

                Logger.LogError($"Error updating user stats: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Синхронизирует статистику из Supabase (получает актуальное количество викторин из базы)
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> SyncUserStatsFromSupabase(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Syncing stats from Supabase for {username}");
                
                // Получаем количество викторин из Supabase (только с вопросами, как в статистике)
                var quizService = new SupabaseQuizService();
                var allQuizzes = await quizService.GetUserQuizzes(username);
                // Фильтруем только викторины с вопросами (такая же логика, как в StatisticsWindow)
                var validQuizzes = allQuizzes.Where(q => q.Questions != null && q.Questions.Count > 0).ToList();
                int quizzesCreated = validQuizzes.Count;
                
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Found {allQuizzes.Count} total quizzes, {validQuizzes.Count} with questions");
                
                // Получаем текущий профиль для quizzesPassed
                var profile = await GetUserProfile(username);
                int quizzesPassed = profile?.QuizzesPassed ?? 0;
                
                // Обновляем статистику
                var result = await UpdateUserStats(username, quizzesCreated, quizzesPassed);
                if (result)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ Stats synced: created={quizzesCreated}, passed={quizzesPassed}");
                }
                return result;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error syncing stats from Supabase: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> UpdateDisplayName(string username, string displayName)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Updating display name for {username}: {displayName}");

                // Очищаем заголовки
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("apikey");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Prefer"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Prefer");
                }

                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
                
                // ✅ ПРАВИЛЬНЫЙ СПОСОБ: сначала UPDATE, потом INSERT если не обновилось
                // 1️⃣ Пробуем обновить существующую строку
                var updateData = new { display_name = displayName };
                var updateJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(updateData);
                var updateContent = new StringContent(updateJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                // Добавляем заголовок чтобы получить количество обновлённых строк
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Prefer", "return=representation");
                
                var patchUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_profiles?username=eq.{username}";
                var patchResponse = await _httpClient.PatchAsync(patchUrl, updateContent);
                
                // Очищаем Prefer
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Prefer"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Prefer");
                }

                if (patchResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var patchContent = await patchResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] PATCH response: {patchContent}");
                    
                    // Если вернулся пустой массив [] - значит строки не было, создаём
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(patchContent) || patchContent == "[]")
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] No rows updated, creating profile...");
                        
                        // 2️⃣ Создаём новую строку
                        var insertData = new 
                        { 
                            username = username,
                            display_name = displayName,
                            quizzes_created = 0,
                            quizzes_passed = 0
                        };
                        var insertJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(insertData);
                        var insertContent = new StringContent(insertJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                        var postUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_profiles";
                        var postResponse = await _httpClient.PostAsync(postUrl, insertContent);
                        
                        if (postResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                        {
                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ Display name created successfully");
                            return true;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            var errorContent = await postResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ❌ Failed to create: {postResponse.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ Display name updated successfully");
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await patchResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ❌ Failed to update: {patchResponse.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error updating display name: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }
