        /// <summary>
        /// Идемпотентно создать/обновить профиль пользователя в таблице user_profiles.
        /// Использует Postgrest UPSERT (Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates) по UNIQUE-колонке username.
        /// Безопасно вызывать повторно — не создаст дубликат и не затрёт статистику.
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> CreateUserProfile(string username, string displayName)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Upserting user profile for {username}");

                // Очищаем заголовки
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("apikey");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Prefer"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Prefer");
                }

                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
                // resolution=merge-duplicates заставляет PostgREST сделать ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Prefer", "resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal");

                // Для UPSERT передаём только поля, которые хотим создать при вставке.
                // При существующем профиле display_name НЕ затрётся, так как merge_duplicates
                // обновляет только присланные колонки, но мы специально не шлём статистику,
                // чтобы случайно не обнулить её.
                var profileData = new
                {
                    username = username,
                    display_name = displayName
                };
                var profileJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(profileData);
                var profileContent = new StringContent(profileJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                // on_conflict=username — какое ограничение использовать для UPSERT
                var postUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_profiles?on_conflict=username";
                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync(postUrl, profileContent);

                // Чистим Prefer, чтобы не влиять на другие запросы
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Prefer"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Prefer");
                }

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ User profile upserted successfully");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ❌ Failed to upsert user profile: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error upserting user profile: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<UserProfile?> GetUserProfile(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Getting profile for {username}");

                // Очищаем заголовки
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("apikey");
                }

                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);

                // Case-insensitive exact match через ilike с URL-экранированием.
                // Используем именно ilike (без %) — это эквивалентно case-insensitive =,
                // но корректно экранируем спецсимволы в username.
                var encodedUsername = Uri.EscapeDataString(username);
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_profiles?username=ilike.{encodedUsername}&select=*&limit=1";
                var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync(url);

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] Profile JSON: {json}");
                    
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(json) || json == "[]")
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] No profile found for {username}");
                        return null;
                    }
                    
                    var profiles = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<UserProfile>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                    });

                    if (profiles != null && profiles.Count > 0)
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ Profile loaded successfully");
                        return profiles[0];
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ❌ Failed to get profile: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                }

                return null;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error getting user profile: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        private string ParseSupabaseError(string responseJson)
        {
            try
            {
                // Пытаемся разобрать JSON ошибку
                var errorObj = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>(responseJson);
                if (errorObj.TryGetProperty("error_description", out var errorDesc))
                {
                    return errorDesc.GetString() ?? "Ошибка регистрации";
                }

                if (errorObj.TryGetProperty("msg", out var msg))
                {
                    return msg.GetString() ?? "Ошибка регистрации";
                }

                if (errorObj.TryGetProperty("message", out var message))
                {
                    return message.GetString() ?? "Ошибка регистрации";
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                // Игнорируем ошибки парсинга
            }

            // Проверяем распространенные ошибки по тексту
            if (responseJson.Contains("User already registered") || responseJson.Contains("already exists"))
            {
                return "Пользователь с таким логином уже существует";
            }

            if (responseJson.Contains("Password should be at least"))
            {
                return "Пароль должен содержать минимум 6 символов";
            }

            if (responseJson.Contains("Unable to validate email"))
            {
                return "Неверный формат логина";
            }

            if (responseJson.Contains("signup is disabled"))
            {
                return "Регистрация отключена";
            }

            return "Ошибка регистрации в Supabase";
        }

        public async Task<AuthResponse?> RegisterUser(string username, string password, string displayName)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"Supabase: Registering user {username}");
                
                // Убеждаемся что установлены правильные заголовки для auth запроса
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                // apikey нужен для auth endpoints
                if (!_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
                }

                var request = new
                {
                    email = $"{username}@victory.local", // Supabase требует email
                    password = password,
                    user_metadata = new
                    {
                        username = username,
                        display_name = displayName
                    }
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(request);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/auth/v1/signup", content);
                var responseJson = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var authData = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SupabaseAuthResponse>(responseJson);
                    
                    return new AuthResponse
                    {
                        Success = true,
                        Token = authData?.AccessToken,
                        User = new UserDto
                        {
                            Id = ParseUserId(authData?.User?.Id),
                            Username = username,
                            DisplayName = displayName,
                            AvatarPath = null
                        }
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"Supabase registration failed: {responseJson}");

                    // Парсим ошибку для более понятного сообщения
                    string errorMessage = ParseSupabaseError(responseJson);

                    return new AuthResponse
                    {
                        Success = false,
                        Message = errorMessage
                    };
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Supabase registration error", ex);
                return new AuthResponse
                {
                    Success = false,
                    Message = $"Ошибка регистрации: {ex.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<AuthResponse?> LoginUser(string username, string password)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"Supabase: Logging in user {username}");
                
                // Убеждаемся что установлены правильные заголовки для auth запроса
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                // apikey нужен для auth endpoints
                if (!_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
                }

                var request = new
                {
                    email = $"{username}@victory.local",
                    password = password
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(request);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password", content);
                var responseJson = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                
                Logger.Log($"Supabase login response status: {response.StatusCode}");

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var authData = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SupabaseAuthResponse>(responseJson);
                    
                    // Сохраняем токен
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(authData?.AccessToken))
                    {
                        SetJwtToken(authData.AccessToken);
                    }
                    
                    // Получаем оригинальный username и DisplayName из профиля (case-insensitive)
                    string originalUsername = username;
                    string displayName = authData?.User?.UserMetadata?.DisplayName ?? username;
                    string avatarPath = null;
                    
                    try
                    {
                        var profile = await GetUserProfile(username);
                        if (profile != null)
                        {
                            originalUsername = profile.Username ?? username; // Оригинальный регистр
                            displayName = profile.DisplayName ?? username;
                            avatarPath = profile.AvatarPath;
                            Logger.Log($"[LoginUser] Found profile: original username='{originalUsername}', displayName='{displayName}'");
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            Logger.Log($"[LoginUser] No profile found for '{username}', using metadata");
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[LoginUser] Error loading profile: {ex.Message}");
                    }
                    
                    return new AuthResponse
                    {
                        Success = true,
                        Token = authData?.AccessToken,
                        User = new UserDto
                        {
                            Id = ParseUserId(authData?.User?.Id),
                            Username = originalUsername,
                            DisplayName = displayName,
                            AvatarPath = avatarPath
                        }
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"Supabase login failed: {responseJson}");

                    // Парсим ошибку для более понятного сообщения
                    string errorMessage = ParseSupabaseLoginError(responseJson);

                    return new AuthResponse
                    {
                        Success = false,
                        Message = errorMessage
                    };
                }
            }
            catch (HttpRequestException ex) when (ex.Message.Contains("No such host is known") || ex.Message.Contains("Name resolution failure") || ex.Message.Contains("host is unknown") || ex.Message.Contains("хост неизвестен") || ex.Message.Contains("не удается найти"))
            {
                Logger.Log("No internet connection detected during login");
                return new AuthResponse
                {
                    Success = false,
                    Message = "Отсутствует подключение к интернету. Проверьте соединение и попробуйте снова."
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Supabase login error", ex);
                Logger.LogError($"Full exception details: {ex}");
                
                // Проверяем на ошибки сети в общем Exception
                var message = ex.Message.ToLower();
                if (message.Contains("хост неизвестен") || message.Contains("не удается найти") || 
                    message.Contains("no such host") || message.Contains("name resolution failure") ||
                    message.Contains("host is unknown") || message.Contains("unable to resolve") ||
                    message.Contains("network is unreachable") || message.Contains("connection refused") ||
                    message.Contains("timeout") || message.Contains("network error"))
                {
                    return new AuthResponse
                    {
                        Success = false,
                        Message = "Отсутствует подключение к интернету. Проверьте соединение и попробуйте снова."
                    };
                }
                
                return new AuthResponse
                {
                    Success = false,
                    Message = $"Ошибка входа: {ex.Message}"
                };
            }
        }
    }

        /// <summary>
        /// Атомарный инкремент статистики через RPC public.increment_user_stat.
        /// Устраняет race condition при параллельных обновлениях
        /// (например, когда два мультиплеерных матча заканчиваются одновременно).
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<bool> IncrementStatDirect(string username, string columnName, int delta = 1)
        {
            try
            {
                // Очищаем заголовки перед установкой новых
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("apikey");
                }

                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);

                var rpcUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/rpc/increment_user_stat";
                var payload = new { p_username = username, p_column = columnName, p_delta = delta };
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync(rpcUrl, content);
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseAuthService] ✅ Stat '{columnName}' incremented by {delta} (atomic)");
                    return true;
                }

                var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseAuthService] ❌ RPC increment_user_stat failed for '{columnName}': {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                return false;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error in atomic stat increment: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> ChangePassword(string username, string currentPassword, string newPassword)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"Supabase: Changing password for user {username}");
                
                // Сначала проверяем текущий пароль через логин
                var loginResponse = await LoginUser(username, currentPassword);
                if (loginResponse?.Success != true)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("Supabase: Current password is incorrect");
                    return false;
                }

                // После логина получаем новый токен из ответа
                var tokenToUse = loginResponse.Token;
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tokenToUse))
                {
                    Logger.LogError("Supabase: No JWT token received from login response");
                    return false;
                }
                
                // Сохраняем токен для последующих запросов
                SetJwtToken(tokenToUse);
                Logger.Log("Supabase: Token saved after password verification");

                // Очищаем заголовки перед установкой новых
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("apikey");
                }

                // Устанавливаем правильные заголовки для обновления пароля
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", $"Bearer {tokenToUse}");
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);

                var request = new
                {
                    password = newPassword
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(request);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                var response = await _httpClient.PutAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/auth/v1/user", content);
                var responseJson = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log("Supabase: Password changed successfully");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"Supabase: Failed to change password: {response.StatusCode} - {responseJson}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Supabase: Error changing password: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

=== FILE: Services/SupabaseConfig.cs ===

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    public static class SupabaseConfig
    {
        private static string? _supabaseUrl;
        private static string? _supabaseAnonKey;
        
        public static string SupabaseUrl 
        { 
            get 
            {
                if (_supabaseUrl == null)
                {
                    LoadConfig();
                }
                return _supabaseUrl ?? "https://your-project.supabase.co";
            }
        }
        
        public static string SupabaseAnonKey 
        { 
            get 
            {
                if (_supabaseAnonKey == null)
                {
                    LoadConfig();
                }
                return _supabaseAnonKey ?? "your-anon-key";
            }
        }
        
        public static bool IsConfigured =>
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SupabaseUrl) &&
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SupabaseAnonKey) &&
            SupabaseUrl != "https://your-project.supabase.co" &&
            !SupabaseAnonKey.StartsWith("your-");
            
        private static void LoadConfig()
        {
            try
            {
                var assembly = System.Reflection.Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
                
                // 1. Сначала пытаемся загрузить из встроенного ресурса (там реальные данные из репозитория)
                var resourceName = "Victory.server-config.json";
                using (var stream = assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(resourceName))
                {
                    if (stream != null)
                    {
                        using (var reader = new StreamReader(stream))
                        {
                            var json = reader.ReadToEnd();
                            var config = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SupabaseServerConfig>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                            {
                                PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
                                PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
                            });

                            if (config != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.SupabaseUrl) && 
                                config.SupabaseUrl != "https://your-project.supabase.co" &&
                                !config.SupabaseAnonKey?.StartsWith("your-") == true)
                            {
                                _supabaseUrl = config.SupabaseUrl;
                                _supabaseAnonKey = config.SupabaseAnonKey;
                                Logger.Log($"Loaded Supabase config from embedded resource: URL={_supabaseUrl}, IsConfigured={IsConfigured}");
                                return;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // 2. Пытаемся загрузить из файла в корне проекта (для разработки)
                var assemblyLocation = assembly.Location;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(assemblyLocation))
                {
                    var currentDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(assemblyLocation);
                    // Ищем в родительских директориях до корня проекта (максимум 5 уровней вверх)
                    for (int i = 0; i < 5 && currentDir != null; i++)
                    {
                        var configFile = Path.Combine(currentDir, "server-config.json");
                        if (File.Exists(configFile))
                        {
                            var json = File.ReadAllText(configFile);
                            var config = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SupabaseServerConfig>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                            {
                                PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
                                PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
                            });

                            if (config != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.SupabaseUrl) && 
                                config.SupabaseUrl != "https://your-project.supabase.co" &&
                                !config.SupabaseAnonKey?.StartsWith("your-") == true)
                            {
                                _supabaseUrl = config.SupabaseUrl;
                                _supabaseAnonKey = config.SupabaseAnonKey;
                                Logger.Log($"Loaded Supabase config from project root: URL={_supabaseUrl}, IsConfigured={IsConfigured}");
                                return;
                            }
                        }
                        currentDir = Directory.GetParent(currentDir)?.FullName;
                    }
                }

                // 3. Пытаемся загрузить из файла в директории приложения (bin\Debug)
                var configFilePath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "server-config.json");
                if (File.Exists(configFilePath))
                {
                    var json = File.ReadAllText(configFilePath);
                    var config = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SupabaseServerConfig>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
                        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
                    });

                    if (config != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.SupabaseUrl) && 
                        config.SupabaseUrl != "https://your-project.supabase.co" &&
                        !config.SupabaseAnonKey?.StartsWith("your-") == true)
                    {
                        _supabaseUrl = config.SupabaseUrl;
                        _supabaseAnonKey = config.SupabaseAnonKey;
                        Logger.Log($"Loaded Supabase config from app directory: URL={_supabaseUrl}, IsConfigured={IsConfigured}");
                        return;
                    }
                }

                // 4. Если ничего не найдено - используем дефолтные значения (НЕ создаем файл автоматически)
                Logger.LogWarning("Supabase config not found, using default placeholder values");
                _supabaseUrl = "https://your-project.supabase.co";
                _supabaseAnonKey = "your-anon-key";
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error loading Supabase config: {ex.Message}", ex);
                // Используем дефолтные значения при ошибке
                _supabaseUrl = "https://your-project.supabase.co";
                _supabaseAnonKey = "your-anon-key";
            }
        }
    }
    
    public class SupabaseServerConfig
    {
        public bool AutoDiscoverServer { get; set; } = true;
        public bool UseEmbeddedServer { get; set; } = false;
        public bool RequireNetworkServer { get; set; } = false;
        public bool UseSupabase { get; set; } = true;
        public string SupabaseUrl { get; set; } = "https://your-project.supabase.co";
        public string SupabaseAnonKey { get; set; } = "your-anon-key-here";
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Сервис для работы с игровыми комнатами через Supabase REST API
    /// </summary>
    public class SupabaseGameService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;

        public SupabaseGameService()
        {
            _httpClient = new HttpClient();
            _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Создать игровую комнату
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<GameRoom?> CreateGameRoom(string roomName, string hostUsername, string gameType = "quiz", int maxPlayers = 10)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseGameService] Creating game room: {roomName} for {hostUsername}");

                // Генерируем уникальный код комнаты
                var roomCode = GenerateRoomCode();

                var roomData = new
                {
                    room_code = roomCode,
                    room_name = roomName,
                    host_username = hostUsername,
                    game_type = gameType,
                    status = "waiting",
                    max_players = maxPlayers,
                    current_players = 1
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(roomData);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms", content);

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var responseJson = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    var rooms = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<GameRoom>>(responseJson, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                    });

                    if (rooms != null && rooms.Any())
                    {
                        var room = rooms.First();
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseGameService] ✅ Game room created: {room.RoomCode}");

                        // Добавляем хоста в список игроков
                        await AddPlayerToRoom(room.Id, hostUsername, hostUsername);

                        return room;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseGameService] ❌ Failed to create room: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                }

                return null;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error creating game room: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Присоединиться к игровой комнате
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> JoinGameRoom(string roomCode, string username, string displayName)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseGameService] Joining room: {roomCode} as {username}");

                // Находим комнату по коду
                var roomUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?room_code=eq.{roomCode}&select=*";
                var roomResponse = await _httpClient.GetAsync(roomUrl);

                if (!roomResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseGameService] Room not found: {roomCode}");
                    return false;
                }

                var roomJson = await roomResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                var rooms = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<GameRoom>>(roomJson, new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                });

                if (rooms == null || !rooms.Any())
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseGameService] Room not found: {roomCode}");
                    return false;
                }

                var room = rooms.First();

                // Проверяем блок-лист (бан)
                try
                {
                    if (room.Settings != null && room.Settings.TryGetValue("blocked_usernames", out var blockedRaw) && blockedRaw != null)
                    {
                        var blockedJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(blockedRaw);
                        var blocked = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<string>>(blockedJson) ?? new List<string>();
                        if (blocked.Any(b => string.Equals(b, username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                        {
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseGameService] User {username} is banned from room {roomCode}");
                            throw new BannedFromRoomException(room.Id, roomCode, username);
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (BannedFromRoomException)
                {
                    throw; // Пробрасываем исключение бана дальше
                }
                catch (Exception exb)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseGameService] Error checking blocked list: {exb.Message}");
                }

                // Проверяем, не полная ли комната
                if (room.CurrentPlayers >= room.MaxPlayers)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseGameService] Room is full: {roomCode}");
                    return false;
                }

                // Добавляем игрока в комнату
                var success = await AddPlayerToRoom(room.Id, username, displayName);
                if (success)
                {
                    // Обновляем количество игроков в комнате
                    await UpdateRoomPlayerCount(room.Id, room.CurrentPlayers + 1);
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseGameService] ✅ Joined room successfully: {roomCode}");
                }

                return success;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error joining game room: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получить активные игровые комнаты
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<List<GameRoom>> GetActiveGameRooms()
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseGameService] Fetching active game rooms");

                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?status=eq.waiting&select=*,game_room_players(*)&order=created_at.desc";
                var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync(url);

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    var rooms = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<GameRoom>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                    });

                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseGameService] ✅ Loaded {rooms?.Count ?? 0} active rooms");
                    return rooms ?? new List<GameRoom>();
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseGameService] ❌ Failed to fetch rooms: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                    return new List<GameRoom>();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error fetching game rooms: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return new List<GameRoom>();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Добавить игрока в комнату
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<bool> AddPlayerToRoom(int roomId, string username, string displayName)
        {
            try
            {
                var playerData = new
                {
                    room_id = roomId,
                    username = username,
                    display_name = displayName,
                    joined_at = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    is_ready = false,
                    score = 0
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(playerData);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_room_players", content);

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseGameService] ✅ Player added to room: {username}");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseGameService] ❌ Failed to add player: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error adding player to room: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Обновить количество игроков в комнате
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<bool> UpdateRoomPlayerCount(int roomId, int playerCount)
        {
            try
            {
                var updateData = new { current_players = playerCount };
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(updateData);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                var response = await _httpClient.PatchAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?id=eq.{roomId}", content);

                return response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error updating room player count: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Генерировать уникальный код комнаты
        /// </summary>
        private string GenerateRoomCode()
        {
            const string chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789";
            var random = new Random();
            return new string(Enumerable.Repeat(chars, 6)
                .Select(s => s[random.Next(s.Length)]).ToArray());
        }
    }

        // Helpers to safely parse numbers from dynamic/JsonElement values
        private static int SafeToInt(object? value)
        {
            try
            {
                if (value is int i) return i;
                if (value is long l) return (int)l;
                if (value is double d) return Convert.ToInt32(d);
                if (value is float f) return Convert.ToInt32(f);
                if (value is decimal m) return Convert.ToInt32(m);
                if (value is string s && int.TryParse(s, out var si)) return si;
                if (value is System.Text.Json.JsonElement je)
                {
                    if (je.ValueKind == System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.Number)
                    {
                        if (je.TryGetInt32(out var jInt)) return jInt;
                        if (je.TryGetInt64(out var jLong)) return (int)jLong;
                        var jd = je.GetDouble();
                        return Convert.ToInt32(jd);
                    }
                    if (je.ValueKind == System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.String)
                    {
                        var s2 = je.GetString();
                        if (int.TryParse(s2, out var js)) return js;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] SafeToInt error for value '{value}': {ex.Message}");
            }
            return 0;
        }

        private static double SafeToDouble(object? value)
        {
            try
            {
                if (value is double d) return d;
                if (value is float f) return f;
                if (value is decimal m) return (double)m;
                if (value is int i) return i;
                if (value is long l) return l;
                if (value is string s && double.TryParse(s, System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var sd)) return sd;
                if (value is System.Text.Json.JsonElement je)
                {
                    if (je.ValueKind == System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.Number)
                    {
                        if (je.TryGetDouble(out var jDouble)) return jDouble;
                        if (je.TryGetInt32(out var jInt)) return jInt;
                    }
                    if (je.ValueKind == System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.String)
                    {
                        var s2 = je.GetString();
                        if (double.TryParse(s2, System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var jsd)) return jsd;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] SafeToDouble error for value '{value}': {ex.Message}");
            }
            return 0.0;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Проверяет, является ли строка числовым ID (состоит только из цифр)
        /// </summary>
        private static bool IsNumericId(string? value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return false;
            // Проверяем, что строка состоит только из цифр (может быть длинным числом)
            return value.All(char.IsDigit) && value.Length > 0;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Создать игровую комнату с выбором викторины
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<MultiplayerRoom?> CreateMultiplayerRoom(string roomName, string hostUsername, string quizId, int maxPlayers = 10, int timePerQuestion = 30, bool isPrivate = false, string? password = null)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Creating multiplayer room: '{roomName}' for {hostUsername} with quiz {quizId}, max players: {maxPlayers}, private: {isPrivate}");

                // Генерируем уникальный код комнаты
                var roomCode = GenerateRoomCode();
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Generated room code: {roomCode}");

                var roomData = new
                {
                    room_code = roomCode,
                    room_name = roomName,
                    host_username = hostUsername,
                    game_type = "quiz",
                    status = "waiting",
                    max_players = maxPlayers,
                    current_players = 1,
                    quiz_id = quizId,
                    is_private = isPrivate,
                    password = password,
                    settings = new
                    {
                        time_per_question = timePerQuestion,
                        show_results = true,
                        allow_late_answers = false,
                        blocked_usernames = new string[] { }
                    }
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(roomData, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Sending JSON: {json}");

                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Content-Type: {content.Headers.ContentType}");

                var requestUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms";
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Request URL: {requestUrl}");

                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync(requestUrl, content);

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var responseJson = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Raw response: '{responseJson}'");
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Response status: {response.StatusCode}");
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Response headers: {string.Join(", ", response.Headers.Select(h => $"{h.Key}={h.Value.FirstOrDefault()}"))}");

                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(responseJson))
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ⚠️ Empty response from Supabase, trying to get room by code");
                        
                        // Пробуем получить комнату по коду комнаты
                        try
                        {
                            var createdRoom = await GetRoomByCode(roomCode);
                            if (createdRoom != null)
                            {
                                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ✅ Found created room by code: {createdRoom.RoomCode} (ID: {createdRoom.Id})");

                                // Добавляем хоста в список игроков
                                // Получаем DisplayName хоста из профиля
                                string hostDisplayName = hostUsername;
                                try
                                {
                                    var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                                    var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(hostUsername);
                                    hostDisplayName = profile?.DisplayName ?? hostUsername;
                                }
                                catch (Exception ex)
                                {
                                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to load host profile: {ex.Message}");
                                }
                                await AddPlayerToRoom(createdRoom.Id, hostUsername, hostDisplayName);

                                return createdRoom;
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception getRoomEx)
                        {
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ Failed to get room by code: {getRoomEx.Message}");
                        }
                        
                        Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ Empty response from Supabase and room not found by code");
                        return null;
                    }

                    try
                    {
                        // Пробуем десериализовать как массив сначала
                        var rooms = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<MultiplayerRoom>>(responseJson, new JsonSerializerOptions
                        {
                            PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                        });

                        if (rooms != null && rooms.Any())
                        {
                            var room = rooms.First();
                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ✅ Multiplayer room created: {room.RoomCode} (ID: {room.Id})");

                            // Добавляем хоста в список игроков
                            // Получаем DisplayName хоста из профиля
                            string hostDisplayName = hostUsername;
                            try
                            {
                                var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                                var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(hostUsername);
                                hostDisplayName = profile?.DisplayName ?? hostUsername;
                            }
                            catch (Exception ex)
                            {
                                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to load host profile: {ex.Message}");
                            }
                            await AddPlayerToRoom(room.Id, hostUsername, hostDisplayName);

                            return room;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ No room returned in response, but response was not empty");
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Parsed rooms: {rooms?.Count ?? 0}");
                        }
                    }
                    catch (JsonException arrayEx)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            // Если не удалось десериализовать как массив, пробуем как единичный объект
                            var room = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<MultiplayerRoom>(responseJson, new JsonSerializerOptions
                            {
                                PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                            });

                            if (room != null)
                            {
                                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ✅ Multiplayer room created (single object): {room.RoomCode} (ID: {room.Id})");

                                // Добавляем хоста в список игроков
                                // Получаем DisplayName хоста из профиля
                                string hostDisplayName = hostUsername;
                                try
                                {
                                    var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                                    var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(hostUsername);
                                    hostDisplayName = profile?.DisplayName ?? hostUsername;
                                }
                                catch (Exception ex)
                                {
                                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to load host profile: {ex.Message}");
                                }
                                await AddPlayerToRoom(room.Id, hostUsername, hostDisplayName);

                                return room;
                            }
                        }
                        catch (JsonException singleEx)
                        {
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ JSON deserialization error (both array and single object failed)");
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Array error: {arrayEx.Message}");
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Single object error: {singleEx.Message}");
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Response content: '{responseJson}'");
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Response length: {responseJson?.Length ?? 0}");

                            // Пробуем получить комнату по коду комнаты
                            try
                            {
                                var createdRoom = await GetRoomByCode(roomCode);
                                if (createdRoom != null)
                                {
                                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ✅ Found created room by code: {createdRoom.RoomCode} (ID: {createdRoom.Id})");

                                    // Добавляем хоста в список игроков
                                    // Получаем DisplayName хоста из профиля
                                    string hostDisplayName = hostUsername;
                                    try
                                    {
                                        var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                                        var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(hostUsername);
                                        hostDisplayName = profile?.DisplayName ?? hostUsername;
                                    }
                                    catch (Exception ex)
                                    {
                                        Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to load host profile: {ex.Message}");
                                    }
                                    await AddPlayerToRoom(createdRoom.Id, hostUsername, hostDisplayName);

                                    return createdRoom;
                                }
                            }
                            catch (Exception getRoomEx)
                            {
                                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ Failed to get room by code: {getRoomEx.Message}");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ Failed to create room: {response.StatusCode}");
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Error content: '{errorContent}'");
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Error headers: {string.Join(", ", response.Headers.Select(h => $"{h.Key}={h.Value.FirstOrDefault()}"))}");
                }

                return null;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error creating multiplayer room: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Присоединиться к игровой комнате
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> JoinMultiplayerRoom(string roomCode, string username, string displayName)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Joining room: {roomCode} as {username} with displayName: {displayName}");

                // Всегда проверяем и загружаем актуальный DisplayName из профиля, если он пустой, равен username или является числом (ID)
                string finalDisplayName = displayName;
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(finalDisplayName) || 
                    string.Equals(finalDisplayName, username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    IsNumericId(finalDisplayName))
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                        var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(username);
                        finalDisplayName = profile?.DisplayName ?? username;
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Loaded DisplayName from profile for {username}: {finalDisplayName} (was: {displayName})");
                    }
                    catch (Exception exProfile)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to load DisplayName from profile: {exProfile.Message}");
                        finalDisplayName = username;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Using provided DisplayName for {username}: {finalDisplayName}");
                }

                // Находим комнату по коду
                var roomUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?room_code=eq.{roomCode}&select=*";
                var roomResponse = await _httpClient.GetAsync(roomUrl);

                if (!roomResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Room not found: {roomCode}");
                    return false;
                }

                var roomJson = await roomResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                var rooms = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<MultiplayerRoom>>(roomJson, new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                });

                if (rooms == null || !rooms.Any())
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Room not found: {roomCode}");
                    return false;
                }

                var room = rooms.First();

                // Проверяем блок-лист
                try
                {
                    if (room.Settings != null && room.Settings.TryGetValue("blocked_usernames", out var blockedRaw) && blockedRaw != null)
                    {
                        var blockedJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(blockedRaw);
                        var blocked = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<string>>(blockedJson) ?? new List<string>();
                        if (blocked.Any(b => string.Equals(b, username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                        {
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] User is blocked for this room: {username}");
                            throw new BannedFromRoomException(room.Id, roomCode, username);
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (BannedFromRoomException)
                {
                    throw; // Пробрасываем исключение бана дальше
                }
                catch (Exception exb)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] blocked_usernames parse error: {exb.Message}");
                }

                // Проверяем, является ли пользователь хостом комнаты
                if (room.HostUsername == username)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] User {username} is the host of room {roomCode}, no need to join");
                    return true; // Хост уже в комнате
                }

                // Проверяем, не полная ли комната
                if (room.CurrentPlayers >= room.MaxPlayers)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Room is full: {roomCode}");
                    return false;
                }

                // Добавляем игрока в комнату с правильным DisplayName
                var success = await AddPlayerToRoom(room.Id, username, finalDisplayName);
                if (success)
                {
                    // Обновляем количество игроков в комнате
                    await UpdateRoomPlayerCount(room.Id, room.CurrentPlayers + 1);
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ✅ Joined room successfully: {roomCode}");
                }
                else
                {
                    // Проверяем, не является ли это ошибкой дубликата
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ⚠️ Failed to add player, checking if already exists");
                    
                    // Если не удалось добавить, возможно игрок уже в комнате
                    // Проверяем, есть ли игрок в комнате
                    var existingPlayers = await GetRoomPlayers(room.Id);
                    if (existingPlayers.Any(p => p.Username == username))
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ✅ Player already in room: {username}");
                        return true;
                    }
                }

                return success;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error joining multiplayer room: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получить активные игровые комнаты

                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?status=eq.waiting&select=*,game_room_players(*)&order=created_at.desc";

                    {

                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ Failed to fetch rooms: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                    return new List<MultiplayerRoom>();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error fetching multiplayer rooms: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return new List<MultiplayerRoom>();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получить информацию о комнате с игроками
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<MultiplayerRoom?> GetRoomWithPlayers(int roomId)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Getting room with players: {roomId}");

                // Явно указываем settings в select, чтобы он загружался при polling
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?id=eq.{roomId}&select=*,settings,game_room_players(*)";
                var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync(url);

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Room with players JSON: {json}");

                    var rooms = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<MultiplayerRoom>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                    });

                    var room = rooms?.FirstOrDefault();
                    if (room != null)
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Found room with {room.Players?.Count ?? 0} players");
                    }

                    return room;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to get room with players: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                }

                return null;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error getting room with players: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Alias for GetRoomWithPlayers to fix compilation error
        /// </summary>
        public Task<MultiplayerRoom?> GetRoom(int roomId) => GetRoomWithPlayers(roomId);

        /// <summary>
        /// Добавить игрока в комнату
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<bool> AddPlayerToRoom(int roomId, string username, string displayName)
        {
            try
            {
                // Проверяем, не добавлен ли уже игрок
                try
                {
                    var existingPlayers = await GetRoomPlayers(roomId);
                    var existing = existingPlayers.FirstOrDefault(p => string.Equals(p.Username, username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                    if (existing != null)
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Player '{username}' already in room {roomId}, current DisplayName: '{existing.DisplayName}', new: '{displayName}'");
                        // ВСЕГДА обновляем DisplayName, если он неправильный или отличается от правильного
                        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(existing.DisplayName) || 
                            string.Equals(existing.DisplayName, username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                            IsNumericId(existing.DisplayName) ||
                            (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(displayName) && !string.Equals(existing.DisplayName, displayName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                        {
                            await UpdatePlayerDisplayName(roomId, username, displayName);
                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Updated DisplayName for existing player {username}: {displayName}");
                        }
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception exCheck)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Check existing players failed: {exCheck.Message}", exCheck);
                }

                var playerData = new
                {
                    room_id = roomId,
                    username = username,
                    display_name = displayName,
                    joined_at = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    is_ready = false,
                    score = 0
                };

                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(playerData);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_room_players", content);

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ✅ Player added to room: {username}");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ Failed to add player: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error adding player to room: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Проверить, забанен ли игрок в комнате
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<bool> IsPlayerBanned(int roomId, string username)
        {
            try
            {
                var room = await GetRoomWithPlayers(roomId);
                if (room == null) return false;

                if (room.Settings != null && room.Settings.TryGetValue("blocked_usernames", out var blockedRaw) && blockedRaw != null)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var blockedJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(blockedRaw);
                        var blocked = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<string>>(blockedJson) ?? new List<string>();
                        return blocked.Any(b => string.Equals(b, username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Error parsing blocked list: {ex.Message}");
                    }
                }
                return false;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] IsPlayerBanned error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Присоединиться к комнате по roomId (для приглашённого): добавляет игрока и увеличивает счётчик
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> JoinRoomById(int roomId, string username, string displayName)
        {
            try
            {
                // Проверяем, не забанен ли игрок
                var room = await GetRoomWithPlayers(roomId);
                if (room == null) return false;

                if (await IsPlayerBanned(roomId, username))
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] User {username} is banned from room {roomId}");
                    throw new BannedFromRoomException(roomId, room.RoomCode, username);
                }

                // Если уже есть — проверяем и обновляем DisplayName если нужно
                var existing = await GetRoomPlayers(roomId);
                var existingPlayer = existing.FirstOrDefault(p => string.Equals(p.Username, username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                if (existingPlayer != null)
                {
                    // Обновляем DisplayName, если он неправильный
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(existingPlayer.DisplayName) || 
                        string.Equals(existingPlayer.DisplayName, username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        IsNumericId(existingPlayer.DisplayName))
                    {
                        await UpdatePlayerDisplayName(roomId, username, displayName);
                    }
                    return true;
                }

                // Добавляем (включая хоста)
                var ok = await AddPlayerToRoom(roomId, username, displayName);
                if (ok)
                {
                    await UpdateRoomPlayerCount(roomId, Math.Max(room.CurrentPlayers + 1, 1));
                }
                return ok;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"JoinRoomById error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Обновить количество игроков в комнате
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<bool> UpdateRoomPlayerCount(int roomId, int playerCount)

                return response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error updating room player count: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Удалить игрока из комнаты (выход игрока)
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> LeaveRoom(int roomId, string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] 🚪 LEAVING room {roomId} for user {username}");
                
                // Раньше мы блокировали пользователя для повторного входа. 
                // Это мешало вернуться в комнату после обычного выхода. Убираем блокировку.
                
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_room_players?room_id=eq.{roomId}&username=eq.{username}";
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] 🗑️ Deleting player record from database...");
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] DELETE URL: {url}");
                
                var response = await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(url);
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Response Status: {response.StatusCode}");
                
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ✅ Player {username} removed from room {roomId}");
                    
                    // Обновим счётчик игроков
                    try
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] 📊 Updating player count...");
                        var rest = await GetRoomPlayers(roomId);
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Current player count: {rest.Count}");
                        
                        var patch = new { current_players = Math.Max(0, rest.Count) };
                        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(patch);
                        var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                        await _httpClient.PatchAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?id=eq.{roomId}", content);
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ✅ Player count updated");
                    }
                    catch (Exception exCnt)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ Update player count after leave failed: {exCnt.Message}", exCnt);
                    }
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ Failed to leave room: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error leaving room: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Заблокировать пользователя для повторного входа в комнату (после намеренного выхода)
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> BlockUserForRoom(int roomId, string username)
        {
            try
            {
                // Получаем комнату, читаем settings, добавляем username в blocked_usernames и сохраняем
                var room = await GetRoomWithPlayers(roomId);
                var settings = room?.Settings != null
                    ? new Dictionary<string, object>(room.Settings)
                    : new Dictionary<string, object>();

                List<string> blocked;
                if (settings.TryGetValue("blocked_usernames", out var blockedRaw) && blockedRaw != null)
                {
                    var blockedJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(blockedRaw);
                    blocked = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<string>>(blockedJson) ?? new List<string>();
                }
                else
                {
                    blocked = new List<string>();
                }

                if (!blocked.Any(b => string.Equals(b, username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                {
                    blocked.Add(username);
                }

                settings["blocked_usernames"] = blocked;

                var patchObj = new { settings };
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(patchObj);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                var resp = await _httpClient.PatchAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?id=eq.{roomId}", content);
                return resp.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error blocking user: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Хост завершает комнату: помечаем статус finished и фиксируем finished_at.
        /// НИКОГО не удаляем и комнату не удаляем — чтобы показать результаты.
        /// Полную очистку делаем отдельно при явном выходе в меню.
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> FinishRoomByHost(int roomId)
        {
            try
            {
                var patch = new { status = "finished", finished_at = DateTime.UtcNow };
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(patch);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?id=eq.{roomId}";
                var resp = await _httpClient.PatchAsync(url, content);
                if (!resp.IsSuccessStatusCode) return false;
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error finishing room by host: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Полная очистка комнаты ПОСЛЕ показа результатов: удаляем игроков, затем комнату.
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> CleanupRoomAfterResults(int roomId)
        {
            try
            {
                // Удаляем всех игроков
                await _httpClient.DeleteAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_room_players?room_id=eq.{roomId}");
                // Затем удаляем комнату
                return await DeleteRoom(roomId);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error cleanup room after results: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Удалить комнату целиком (используется хостом или при окончании игры)
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> DeleteRoom(int roomId)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] 🗑️ DELETING ROOM: {roomId}");
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] This will CASCADE delete all related data (players, sessions, results, invites)");
                
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?id=eq.{roomId}";
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] DELETE URL: {url}");
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] 📡 Sending DELETE request...");
                
                var response = await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(url);
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Response Status: {response.StatusCode}");
                
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode || response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.NoContent)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ✅ Room {roomId} DELETED successfully from database");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ Failed to delete room {roomId}: {response.StatusCode}");
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Error content: {errorContent}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ❌ EXCEPTION while deleting room {roomId}: {ex.Message}", ex);
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] StackTrace: {ex.StackTrace}");
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Генерировать уникальный код комнаты
        /// </summary>
        private string GenerateRoomCode()
        {
            const string chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789";
            var random = new Random();
            return new string(Enumerable.Repeat(chars, 6)
                .Select(s => s[random.Next(s.Length)]).ToArray());
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Модель игровой комнаты для мультиплеера
    /// </summary>
    public class MultiplayerRoom
    {

    public partial class SupabaseMultiplayerService
