        public async Task<GameSession?> GetOrCreateSession(int roomId)
        {
            try
            {
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_sessions?room_id=eq.{roomId}&select=*";
                var resp = await _httpClient.GetAsync(url);
                if (resp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json) && json.TrimStart().StartsWith("["))
                    {
                        var list = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<GameSession>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true });
                        if (list != null && list.Any()) return list.First();
                    }
                }

                // create
                var create = new { room_id = roomId, question_index = 0, status = "active", answers = new { }, results = new { } };
                var content = new StringContent(JsonSerializer.Serialize(create), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                var post = await _httpClient.PostAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_sessions", content);
                if (post.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await post.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json))
                    {
                        var list = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<GameSession>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true });
                        return list?.FirstOrDefault();
                    }
                    // some PostgREST configs return empty body on insert; fetch again
                    var check = await _httpClient.GetAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_sessions?room_id=eq.{roomId}&select=*");
                    if (check.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                    {
                        var json2 = await check.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                        var list2 = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<GameSession>>(json2, new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true });
                        return list2?.FirstOrDefault();
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"GetOrCreateSession error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
            return null;
        }

        public async Task<GameSession?> GetSession(int roomId)
        {
            try
            {
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_sessions?room_id=eq.{roomId}&select=*";
                var resp = await _httpClient.GetAsync(url);
                if (!resp.IsSuccessStatusCode) return null;
                var json = await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                var list = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<GameSession>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true });
                return list?.FirstOrDefault();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"GetSession error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> SubmitAnswer(int roomId, string username, int questionIndex, double elapsedSeconds, bool correct)
        {
            try
            {
                var session = await GetOrCreateSession(roomId);
                if (session == null) return false;

                // Собираем структуру: answers[username] = [ { q, t, correct } ... ]
                var answersDict = new Dictionary<string, List<Dictionary<string, object>>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                if (session.Answers.HasValue && session.Answers.Value.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Undefined && session.Answers.Value.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Null)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var str = session.Answers.Value.GetRawText();
                        answersDict = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, List<Dictionary<string, object>>>>(str) ?? answersDict;
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to deserialize answers: {ex.Message}");
                    }
                }

                if (!answersDict.TryGetValue(username, out var list))
                {
                    list = new List<Dictionary<string, object>>();
                    answersDict[username] = list;
                }

                // Заменяем запись для текущего вопроса
                var idx = list.FindIndex(e => e.TryGetValue("q", out var q) && SafeToInt(q) == questionIndex);
                var entry = new Dictionary<string, object> { { "q", questionIndex }, { "t", Math.Round(elapsedSeconds, 2) }, { "correct", correct } };
                if (idx >= 0) list[idx] = entry; else list.Add(entry);

                var patchObj = new { answers = answersDict };
                var content = new StringContent(JsonSerializer.Serialize(patchObj), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_sessions?id=eq.{session.Id}";
                var resp = await _httpClient.PatchAsync(url, content);
                return resp.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"SubmitAnswer error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Обновить индекс текущего вопроса в сессии (единый источник истины)
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> UpdateSessionQuestionIndex(int roomId, int questionIndex)
        {
            try
            {
                var session = await GetOrCreateSession(roomId);
                if (session == null) return false;
                var patchObj = new 
                { 
                    question_index = questionIndex,
                    question_start_time = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fffZ")
                };
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(patchObj);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_sessions?id=eq.{session.Id}";
                var resp = await _httpClient.PatchAsync(url, content);
                return resp.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] UpdateSessionQuestionIndex error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public class PlayerStats
        {
            public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;
            public string DisplayName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
            public int Score { get; set; }
            public int CorrectAnswers { get; set; }
            public int TotalQuestions { get; set; }
            public long TotalTimeMs { get; set; }
            public List<double> AnswerTimes { get; set; } = new List<double>();
        }

        public async Task<List<PlayerStats>> GetRoomPlayersWithStats(int roomId)
        {
            var result = new List<PlayerStats>();
            try
            {
                var room = await GetRoomWithPlayers(roomId);
                var players = room?.Players ?? new List<MultiplayerRoomPlayer>();

                var session = await GetSession(roomId);
                var answersDict = new Dictionary<string, List<Dictionary<string, object>>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                if (session?.Answers != null && session.Answers.HasValue)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        answersDict = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, List<Dictionary<string, object>>>>(session.Answers.Value.GetRawText())
                                       ?? answersDict;
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to deserialize answers for stats: {ex.Message}");
                    }
                }

                foreach (var p in players)
                {
                    long totalMs = 0;
                    int totalQ = 0;
                    int correctCount = 0;
                    var times = new List<double>();

                    if (answersDict.TryGetValue(p.Username, out var arr))
                    {
                        foreach (var e in arr)
                        {
                            if (e.TryGetValue("t", out var tObj))
                            {
                                var sec = SafeToDouble(tObj);
                                totalMs += (long)(sec * 1000.0);
                                totalQ += 1;
                                times.Add(sec);
                            }
                            if (e.TryGetValue("correct", out var cObj))
                            {
                                if (cObj is bool b && b) correctCount++;
                                else if (cObj is System.Text.Json.JsonElement je && je.ValueKind == System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.True) correctCount++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Загружаем актуальный DisplayName из профиля для надежности
                    string displayName = p.DisplayName;
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(displayName) || 
                        string.Equals(displayName, p.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        IsNumericId(displayName))
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                            var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(p.Username);
                            displayName = profile?.DisplayName ?? p.Username;
                            Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Loaded DisplayName for {p.Username}: {displayName}");
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to load DisplayName for {p.Username}: {ex.Message}");
                            displayName = p.Username;
                        }
                    }

                    result.Add(new PlayerStats
                    {
                        Username = p.Username,
                        DisplayName = displayName,
                        Score = p.Score,
                        CorrectAnswers = correctCount,
                        TotalQuestions = Math.Max(1, totalQ),
                        TotalTimeMs = totalMs,
                        AnswerTimes = times
                    });
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] GetRoomPlayersWithStats error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
            return result;
        }

        public async Task<bool> ResetRoomForNewGame(int roomId)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Resetting room {roomId} for new game");

                // 0. Получаем информацию о комнате для определения хоста
                var room = await GetRoomWithPlayers(roomId);
                if (room == null)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Room {roomId} not found");
                    return false;
                }

                var hostUsername = room.HostUsername;

                // 1. Сбрасываем статус комнаты
                var updateRoomUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?id=eq.{roomId}";
                var roomData = new
                {
                    status = "waiting",
                    started_at = (string?)null,
                    finished_at = (string?)null
                };
                var roomJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(roomData);
                var roomResponse = await _httpClient.PatchAsync(updateRoomUrl, new StringContent(roomJson, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));

                if (!roomResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to reset room status: {roomResponse.StatusCode}");
                    return false;
                }

                // 2. Удаляем ВСЕХ игроков кроме хоста из game_room_players
                // Игроки должны вручную нажать "Продолжить" и заново присоединиться
                var deletePlayersUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_room_players?room_id=eq.{roomId}&username=neq.{hostUsername}";
                var deleteResponse = await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(deletePlayersUrl);
                
                if (!deleteResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to remove players: {deleteResponse.StatusCode}");
                }

                // 3. Сбрасываем очки и статус готовности ТОЛЬКО у хоста
                var updateHostUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_room_players?room_id=eq.{roomId}&username=eq.{hostUsername}";
                var hostData = new
                {
                    score = 0,
                    is_ready = false
                };
                var hostJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(hostData);
                await _httpClient.PatchAsync(updateHostUrl, new StringContent(hostJson, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));

                // 4. Сбрасываем сессию (вопросы и ответы)
                var session = await GetOrCreateSession(roomId);
                if (session != null)
                {
                    var updateSessionUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_sessions?room_id=eq.{roomId}";
                    var sessionData = new
                    {
                        question_index = 0,
                        answers = new Dictionary<string, object>(),
                        results = new Dictionary<string, object>()
                    };
                    var sessionJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(sessionData);
                    await _httpClient.PatchAsync(updateSessionUrl, new StringContent(sessionJson, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));
                }

                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Room {roomId} reset complete - players removed, must rejoin");
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ResetRoomForNewGame error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Выгнать игрока из комнаты (без блокировки)
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> KickPlayer(int roomId, string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Kicking player {username} from room {roomId}");

                // Удаляем игрока из списка участников комнаты
                var deleteUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_room_players?room_id=eq.{roomId}&username=eq.{username}";
                var deleteResponse = await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(deleteUrl);

                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to remove player from room");
                    return false;
                }

                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Successfully kicked player {username}");
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] KickPlayer error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Забанить игрока (выгнать и добавить в блок-лист)
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> BanPlayer(int roomId, string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Banning player {username} from room {roomId}");

                // 1. Получаем текущие настройки комнаты
                var roomUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?id=eq.{roomId}&select=settings";
                var roomResponse = await _httpClient.GetAsync(roomUrl);

                if (!roomResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Room not found: {roomId}");
                    return false;
                }

                var roomJson = await roomResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                var rooms = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<MultiplayerRoom>>(roomJson, new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                });

                if (rooms == null || !rooms.Any())
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Room not found: {roomId}");
                    return false;
                }

                var room = rooms.First();
                var settings = room.Settings ?? new Dictionary<string, object>();
                
                // 2. Получаем текущий список заблокированных пользователей
                var blockedList = new List<string>();
                if (settings.TryGetValue("blocked_usernames", out var blockedRaw) && blockedRaw != null)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var blockedJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(blockedRaw);
                        blockedList = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<string>>(blockedJson) ?? new List<string>();
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Error parsing blocked list: {ex.Message}");
                    }
                }

                // 3. Добавляем игрока в блок-лист если его там ещё нет
                if (!blockedList.Any(b => string.Equals(b, username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                {
                    blockedList.Add(username);
                    settings["blocked_usernames"] = blockedList;

                    // 4. Обновляем настройки комнаты
                    var updatePayload = new
                    {
                        settings = settings
                    };

                    var updateContent = new StringContent(
                        JsonSerializer.Serialize(updatePayload),
                        Encoding.UTF8,
                        "application/json"
                    );

                    var updateUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?id=eq.{roomId}";
                    var updateResponse = await _httpClient.PatchAsync(updateUrl, updateContent);

                    if (!updateResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to update room settings");
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                // 5. Выгоняем пользователя
                return await KickPlayer(roomId, username);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] BanPlayer error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Обновить настройки комнаты
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> UpdateRoomSettings(int roomId, Dictionary<string, object> gameSettings)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Updating settings for room {roomId}");

                // Получаем текущие настройки комнаты
                var room = await GetRoomWithPlayers(roomId);
                if (room == null)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Room {roomId} not found");
                    return false;
                }

                // Объединяем текущие настройки с новыми game_settings
                var settings = room.Settings != null
                    ? new Dictionary<string, object>(room.Settings)
                    : new Dictionary<string, object>();

                // Добавляем или обновляем game_settings
                settings["game_settings"] = gameSettings;

                // Обновляем в базе
                var patchObj = new { settings };
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(patchObj);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                var updateUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/game_rooms?id=eq.{roomId}";
                var response = await _httpClient.PatchAsync(updateUrl, content);

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] ✅ Settings updated for room {roomId}");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] Failed to update settings: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseMultiplayerService] UpdateRoomSettings error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Сервис для работы с викторинами через Supabase REST API
    /// </summary>
    public class SupabaseQuizService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;

        public SupabaseQuizService()
        {
            _httpClient = new HttpClient();
            _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получить все викторины пользователя
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<List<Quiz>> GetUserQuizzes(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseQuizService] Fetching quizzes for user: {username}");

                // ✅ ВАЖНО! Используем вложенный SELECT для получения викторин С вопросами за 1 запрос!
                var encodedUsername = Uri.EscapeDataString(username);
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/quizzes?username=eq.{encodedUsername}&select=*,questions(*)&order=created_date.desc";
                var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync(url);

                if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"Failed to fetch quizzes: {response.StatusCode}, {error}");
                    return new List<Quiz>();
                }

                var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseQuizService] Raw quizzes JSON: {json}");

                var supabaseQuizzes = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<SupabaseQuizWithQuestions>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                });

                if (supabaseQuizzes == null || !supabaseQuizzes.Any())
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseQuizService] No quizzes found for {username}");
                    return new List<Quiz>();
                }

                // Преобразуем в Quiz с вопросами
                var quizzes = supabaseQuizzes.Select(sq => new Quiz
                {
                    Id = sq.Id,
                    Title = sq.Title,
                    Description = sq.Description ?? string.Empty,
                    Author = sq.Author,
                    CreatedDate = sq.CreatedDate,
                    ModifiedDate = sq.ModifiedDate,
                    TimeLimit = sq.TimeLimit,
                    Questions = sq.Questions?.Select(BuildQuestion).OrderBy(q => q.OrderIndex).ToList() ?? new List<Question>()
                }).ToList();

                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseQuizService] Loaded {quizzes.Count} quizzes");
                return quizzes;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error fetching user quizzes: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return new List<Quiz>();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получить вопросы для викторины
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<List<Question>> GetQuizQuestions(string quizId)
        {
            try
            {
                var encodedQuizId = Uri.EscapeDataString(quizId);
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/questions?quiz_id=eq.{encodedQuizId}&select=*&order=order_index.asc";
                var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync(url);

                if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"Failed to fetch questions for quiz {quizId}");
                    return new List<Question>();
                }

                var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                var supabaseQuestions = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<SupabaseQuestion>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                });

                if (supabaseQuestions == null)
                    return new List<Question>();

                return supabaseQuestions.Select(BuildQuestion).OrderBy(q => q.OrderIndex).ToList();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error fetching questions for quiz {quizId}: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return new List<Question>();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Публичный метод для получения вопросов (для других слоев)
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<List<Question>> GetQuizQuestionsPublic(string quizId)
        {
            return await GetQuizQuestions(quizId);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получить викторину по ID
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<Quiz?> GetQuizAsync(string quizId)
        {
            try
            {
                var encodedQuizId = Uri.EscapeDataString(quizId);
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/quizzes?id=eq.{encodedQuizId}&select=*,questions(*)";
                var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync(url);

                if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                var supabaseQuizzes = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<SupabaseQuizWithQuestions>>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true
                });

                if (supabaseQuizzes == null || !supabaseQuizzes.Any())
                {
                    return null;
                }

                var sq = supabaseQuizzes.First();
                return new Quiz
                {
                    Id = sq.Id,
                    Title = sq.Title,
                    Description = sq.Description ?? string.Empty,
                    Author = sq.Author,
                    CreatedDate = sq.CreatedDate,
                    ModifiedDate = sq.ModifiedDate,
                    TimeLimit = sq.TimeLimit,
                    Questions = sq.Questions?.Select(BuildQuestion).OrderBy(q => q.OrderIndex).ToList() ?? new List<Question>()
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error fetching quiz {quizId}: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Сохранить викторину в Supabase
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> SaveQuiz(Quiz quiz, string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseQuizService] Saving quiz: {quiz.Title} for user: {username}");

                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Prefer");
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Prefer", "resolution=merge-duplicates");

                // 1. Сохраняем викторину
                var supabaseQuiz = new
                {
                    id = quiz.Id,
                    title = quiz.Title,
                    description = quiz.Description,
                    author = quiz.Author,
                    created_date = quiz.CreatedDate,
                    modified_date = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    time_limit = quiz.TimeLimit,
                    username = username
                };

                var quizJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(supabaseQuiz);
                var quizContent = new StringContent(quizJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                // Используем UPSERT (вставка или обновление)
                var quizUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/quizzes";
                var quizResponse = await _httpClient.PostAsync(quizUrl, quizContent);

                if (!quizResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var error = await quizResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"Failed to save quiz: {quizResponse.StatusCode}, {error}");
                    return false;
                }

                // 2. Удаляем старые вопросы
                var encodedQuizId = Uri.EscapeDataString(quiz.Id);
                var deleteUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/questions?quiz_id=eq.{encodedQuizId}";
                var deleteResponse = await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(deleteUrl);

                if (!deleteResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var error = await deleteResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"Failed to delete old questions: {deleteResponse.StatusCode}, {error}");
                    return false;
                }

                // 3. Сохраняем новые вопросы
                var questions = quiz.Questions ?? new List<Question>();
                if (!questions.Any())
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseQuizService] Quiz saved with 0 questions");
                    return true;
                }

                var supabaseQuestions = questions.Select((q, i) => new
                {
                    id = q.Id,
                    quiz_id = quiz.Id,
                    text = q.Text,
                    // legacy JSON-колонка (для обратной совместимости со старым кодом)
                    options = SerializeQuestionOptionsPayload(q),
                    correct_answer_index = q.CorrectAnswerIndex,
                    image_path = q.ImagePath,
                    explanation = q.Explanation,
                    order_index = i,
                    // новые нормализованные колонки
                    question_type = string.Equals(q.QuestionType, "open", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "open" : "closed",
                    open_answer = q.OpenAnswer ?? string.Empty,
                    option_media = q.OptionMediaPaths ?? new List<string>(),
                    media_type = DetectMediaType(q.ImagePath)
                }).ToList();

                var questionJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(supabaseQuestions);
                var questionContent = new StringContent(questionJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                var questionUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/questions";
                var questionResponse = await _httpClient.PostAsync(questionUrl, questionContent);

                if (!questionResponse.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var error = await questionResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"Failed to save questions batch: {questionResponse.StatusCode}, {error}");
                    return false;
                }

                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseQuizService] ✅ Quiz saved successfully");
                
                // Статистика обновляется в QuizEditorService после сохранения
                // (используется SyncUserStatsFromSupabase для точности)
                
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error saving quiz: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Prefer"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Prefer");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Удалить викторину из Supabase
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> DeleteQuiz(string quizId)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseQuizService] Deleting quiz: {quizId}");

                var encodedQuizId = Uri.EscapeDataString(quizId);
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/quizzes?id=eq.{encodedQuizId}";
                var response = await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(url);

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseQuizService] ✅ Quiz deleted successfully");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"Failed to delete quiz: {response.StatusCode}, {error}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error deleting quiz: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Единая точка преобразования вопроса из БД.
        /// Приоритет новым нормализованным колонкам (question_type / open_answer / option_media),
        /// с фоллбэком на legacy JSON-колонку options.
        /// </summary>
        private static Question BuildQuestion(SupabaseQuestion sq)
        {
            var payload = ParseQuestionOptionsPayload(sq.Options);

            // Перекрываем из новых колонок, если они заполнены.
            var questionType = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sq.QuestionType) ? sq.QuestionType! : payload.QuestionType;
            var openAnswer = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sq.OpenAnswer) ? sq.OpenAnswer! : payload.OpenAnswer;

            var optionMedia = (sq.OptionMedia != null && sq.OptionMedia.Count > 0)
                ? sq.OptionMedia
                : payload.OptionMediaPaths;

            // Выравниваем длину медиа-путей под число опций.
            while (optionMedia.Count < payload.Options.Count)
            {
                optionMedia.Add(string.Empty);
            }

            return new Question
            {
                Id = sq.Id,
                Text = sq.Text,
                Options = payload.Options,
                OptionMediaPaths = optionMedia,
                QuestionType = questionType,
                CorrectAnswerIndex = sq.CorrectAnswerIndex,
                OpenAnswer = openAnswer,
                ImagePath = sq.ImagePath ?? string.Empty,
                Explanation = sq.Explanation ?? string.Empty,
                OrderIndex = sq.OrderIndex
            };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Определяет тип медиа по расширению файла: image | gif | video | none.
        /// Согласовано с CHECK constraint в БД.
        /// </summary>
        private static string DetectMediaType(string? path)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) return "none";
            var lower = path.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
            if (lower.EndsWith(".gif")) return "gif";
            if (lower.EndsWith(".mp4") || lower.EndsWith(".webm") || lower.EndsWith(".mov") ||
                lower.EndsWith(".avi") || lower.EndsWith(".mkv")) return "video";
            return "image";
        }

        private static QuestionOptionsPayload ParseQuestionOptionsPayload(string? rawOptions)
        {
            var result = new QuestionOptionsPayload();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawOptions))
            {
                return result;
            }

            try
            {
                using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(rawOptions);
                var root = doc.RootElement;

                if (root.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
                {
                    ParseOptionsArray(root, result);
                }
                else if (root.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
                {
                    if (root.TryGetProperty("questionType", out var questionTypeProp) && questionTypeProp.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
                    {
                        result.QuestionType = questionTypeProp.GetString() ?? "closed";
                    }

                    if (root.TryGetProperty("openAnswer", out var openAnswerProp) && openAnswerProp.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
                    {
                        result.OpenAnswer = openAnswerProp.GetString() ?? string.Empty;
                    }

                    if (root.TryGetProperty("options", out var optionsProp) && optionsProp.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
                    {
                        ParseOptionsArray(optionsProp, result);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                result.Options = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<string>>(rawOptions) ?? new List<string>();
            }

            if (string.Equals(result.QuestionType, "open", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.OpenAnswer) && result.Options.Count == 0))
            {
                result.QuestionType = "open";
            }
            else
            {
                result.QuestionType = "closed";
            }

            while (result.OptionMediaPaths.Count < result.Options.Count)
            {
                result.OptionMediaPaths.Add(string.Empty);
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static void ParseOptionsArray(JsonElement optionsArray, QuestionOptionsPayload payload)
        {
            payload.Options = new List<string>();
            payload.OptionMediaPaths = new List<string>();

            foreach (var item in optionsArray.EnumerateArray())
            {
                if (item.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
                {
                    payload.Options.Add(item.GetString() ?? string.Empty);
                    payload.OptionMediaPaths.Add(string.Empty);
                }
                else if (item.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
                {
                    var text = item.TryGetProperty("text", out var textProp) && textProp.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
                        ? textProp.GetString() ?? string.Empty
                        : string.Empty;

                    var mediaPath = item.TryGetProperty("mediaPath", out var mediaProp) && mediaProp.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
                        ? mediaProp.GetString() ?? string.Empty
                        : string.Empty;

                    payload.Options.Add(text);
                    payload.OptionMediaPaths.Add(mediaPath);
                }
            }
        }

        private static string SerializeQuestionOptionsPayload(Question question)
        {
            var options = question.Options ?? new List<string>();
            var optionMedia = question.OptionMediaPaths ?? new List<string>();
            var questionType = string.Equals(question.QuestionType, "open", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                ? "open"
                : "closed";

            var hasOptionMedia = optionMedia.Any(path => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path));
            var hasExtendedPayload =
                questionType == "open"
                || !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(question.OpenAnswer)
                || hasOptionMedia;

            if (!hasExtendedPayload)
            {
                return JsonSerializer.Serialize(options);
            }

            var optionItems = options.Select((text, index) => new
            {
                text,
                mediaPath = index < optionMedia.Count ? optionMedia[index] : string.Empty
            }).ToList();

            var payload = new
            {
                questionType,
                openAnswer = question.OpenAnswer ?? string.Empty,
                options = optionItems
            };

            return JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload);
        }
    }

using System;

namespace Victory.Services

    public class SupabaseSocialService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _http;
        public SupabaseSocialService()
        {
            _http = new HttpClient();
            // Жёсткий таймаут, чтобы UI не "зависал" при сетевых проблемах
            _http.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8);
            _http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
        }

        public async Task<bool> SendFriendRequest(string fromUsername, string toUsername)
        {
            try
            {
                // Dedupe: block if there's a pending or accepted relation in either direction
                try
                {
                    var checkUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/friend_requests?or=(and(from_username.eq.{fromUsername},to_username.eq.{toUsername}),and(from_username.eq.{toUsername},to_username.eq.{fromUsername}))&select=status";
                    var respChk = await _http.GetAsync(checkUrl);
                    if (respChk.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                    {
                        var js = await respChk.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(string.IsNullOrEmpty(js) ? "[]" : js);
                        foreach (var el in doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
                        {
                            if (el.TryGetProperty("status", out var st) && st.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
                            {
                                var val = st.GetString() ?? "";
                                if (string.Equals(val, "pending", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || string.Equals(val, "accepted", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                    return false; // duplicate or already friends
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch { }

                var payload = new { from_username = fromUsername, to_username = toUsername, status = "pending", created_at = DateTime.UtcNow };
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload);
                var resp = await _http.PostAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/friend_requests", new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));
                return resp.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"SendFriendRequest error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> InviteToRoom(int roomId, string fromUsername, string toUsername)
        {
            try
            {
                // Dedupe: block if invite already sent and pending for this room/recipient
                try
                {
                    var urlCheck = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/room_invites?room_id=eq.{roomId}&to_username=eq.{toUsername}&status=eq.sent&select=id";
                    var chk = await _http.GetAsync(urlCheck);
                    if (chk.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                    {
                        var js = await chk.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(js) && js != "[]") return false;
                    }
                }
                catch { }

                var payload = new { room_id = roomId, from_username = fromUsername, to_username = toUsername, status = "sent", created_at = DateTime.UtcNow };
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload);
                var resp = await _http.PostAsync($"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/room_invites", new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));
                return resp.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"InviteToRoom error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        public async Task<List<string>> GetFriends(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                // Если Supabase не настроен — даём пустой список мгновенно
                if (!SupabaseConfig.IsConfigured || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl))
                    return new List<string>();

                var urlA = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/friend_requests?from_username=eq.{username}&status=eq.accepted&select=to_username";
                var urlB = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/friend_requests?to_username=eq.{username}&status=eq.accepted&select=from_username";
                var aResp = await _http.GetAsync(urlA);
                var bResp = await _http.GetAsync(urlB);
                var friends = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                if (aResp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await aResp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(string.IsNullOrEmpty(json) ? "[]" : json);
                    foreach (var el in doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
                    {
                        if (el.TryGetProperty("to_username", out var u) && u.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
                            friends.Add(u.GetString() ?? string.Empty);
                    }
                }
                if (bResp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await bResp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(string.IsNullOrEmpty(json) ? "[]" : json);
                    foreach (var el in doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
                    {
                        if (el.TryGetProperty("from_username", out var u) && u.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
                            friends.Add(u.GetString() ?? string.Empty);
                    }
                }
                return friends.Where(f => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(f)).ToList();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"GetFriends error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return new List<string>();
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> RemoveFriend(string usernameA, string usernameB)
        {
            try
            {
                var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/friend_requests?or=(and(from_username.eq.{usernameA},to_username.eq.{usernameB},status.eq.accepted),and(from_username.eq.{usernameB},to_username.eq.{usernameA},status.eq.accepted))";
                var resp = await _http.DeleteAsync(url);
                return resp.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"RemoveFriend error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        // Simple online check via user_sessions (active and recent activity)
        public async Task<HashSet<string>> GetOnlineUsers(IEnumerable<string> usernames)
        {
            var online = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            try
            {
                foreach (var u in usernames)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var url = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/rest/v1/user_sessions?username=eq.{u}&is_active=eq.true&select=last_activity";
                        var resp = await _http.GetAsync(url);
                        if (!resp.IsSuccessStatusCode) continue;
                        var json = await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(string.IsNullOrEmpty(json) ? "[]" : json);
                        if (doc.RootElement.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array && doc.RootElement.GetArrayLength() > 0)
                        {
                            online.Add(u);
                        }
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"GetOnlineUsers error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
            return online;
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: Services/SupabaseStorageService.cs ===

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Victory.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Сервис для работы с Supabase Storage (загрузка/скачивание файлов)
    /// </summary>
    public class SupabaseStorageService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
        private const string BUCKET_NAME = "avatars"; // Название bucket в Supabase

        public SupabaseStorageService()
        {
            _httpClient = new HttpClient();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Загрузить аватарку в Supabase Storage
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="username">Имя пользователя</param>
        /// <param name="imagePath">Локальный путь к изображению</param>
        /// <returns>URL загруженного файла или null при ошибке</returns>
        public async Task<string?> UploadAvatar(string username, string imagePath)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseStorage] Uploading avatar for {username}");

                if (!File.Exists(imagePath))
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseStorage] File not found: {imagePath}");
                    return null;
                }

                // Читаем файл как byte[]
                var fileBytes = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(imagePath);
                var fileName = $"{username}_avatar.png";

                // Очищаем заголовки
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("apikey");
                }

                // 🆕 ДЛЯ STORAGE НУЖНЫ ОБА ЗАГОЛОВКА!
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", $"Bearer {SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey}");
                // TODO: Для загрузки файлов нужен JWT токен пользователя, а не anon key
                // Но anon key работает для публичного доступа

                // Создаём multipart/form-data контент
                using var content = new ByteArrayContent(fileBytes);
                content.Headers.Add("Content-Type", "image/png");

                // URL для загрузки: /storage/v1/object/{bucket}/{path}
                var uploadUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/storage/v1/object/{BUCKET_NAME}/{fileName}";

                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseStorage] Upload URL: {uploadUrl}");

                // Загружаем файл (POST для создания, PUT для обновления)
                // Сначала пробуем POST (создание нового файла)
                var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync(uploadUrl, content);

                if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    // Если файл уже существует - обновляем через PUT
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseStorage] File exists, updating with PUT");
                    response = await _httpClient.PutAsync(uploadUrl, content);
                }

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    // Получаем публичный URL
                    var publicUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/storage/v1/object/public/{BUCKET_NAME}/{fileName}";
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseStorage] ✅ Avatar uploaded: {publicUrl}");
                    return publicUrl;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseStorage] ❌ Upload failed: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                    return null;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseStorage] Error uploading avatar: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Скачать аватарку из Supabase Storage
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="avatarUrl">URL аватарки в Supabase</param>
        /// <param name="localPath">Локальный путь для сохранения</param>
        /// <returns>True если успешно скачано</returns>
        public async Task<bool> DownloadAvatar(string avatarUrl, string localPath)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseStorage] Downloading avatar from {avatarUrl}");

                // Создаём директорию если её нет
                var directory = Path.GetDirectoryName(localPath);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory) && !Directory.Exists(directory))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
                }

                // Скачиваем файл
                var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync(avatarUrl);

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var bytes = await response.Content.ReadAsByteArrayAsync();
                    await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(localPath, bytes);
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseStorage] ✅ Avatar downloaded to {localPath}");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseStorage] ❌ Download failed: {response.StatusCode}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseStorage] Error downloading avatar: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Удалить аватарку из Supabase Storage
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="username">Имя пользователя</param>
        /// <returns>True если успешно удалено</returns>
        public async Task<bool> DeleteAvatar(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseStorage] Deleting avatar for {username}");

                var fileName = $"{username}_avatar.png";

                // Очищаем заголовки
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
                }
                if (_httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("apikey"))
                {
                    _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("apikey");
                }

                // ДЛЯ STORAGE НУЖНЫ ОБА ЗАГОЛОВКА!
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apikey", SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey);
                _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", $"Bearer {SupabaseConfig.SupabaseAnonKey}");

                var deleteUrl = $"{SupabaseConfig.SupabaseUrl}/storage/v1/object/{BUCKET_NAME}/{fileName}";
                var response = await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(deleteUrl);

                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseStorage] ✅ Avatar deleted");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseStorage] ❌ Delete failed: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseStorage] Error deleting avatar: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
}

    /// </summary>
    public class SupabaseUserSettingsService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
        private const string SUPABASE_URL = "https://lzqdhoroqvjsmwqimnxe.supabase.co";
        private const string SUPABASE_KEY = "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6Imx6cWRob3JvcXZqc213cWltbnhlIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3MzQxOTM3MDcsImV4cCI6MjA0OTc2OTcwN30.9tZhZCrfOeE7y4i0jz-HWnmnSWRfSGN8hHqMB3Jh5jM";

        public SupabaseUserSettingsService()
        {

            _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", $"Bearer {SUPABASE_KEY}");

        /// <summary>
        /// Загружает настройки пользователя из Supabase
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<UserSettingsData?> LoadSettingsAsync(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseUserSettings] Loading settings for {username}");
                
                var url = $"{SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/user_settings?username=eq.{username}&select=*";
                var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync(url);
                
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    var results = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<UserSettingsData[]>(json);
                    
                    if (results != null && results.Length > 0)
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseUserSettings] ✅ Settings loaded for {username}");
                        return results[0];
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SupabaseUserSettings] No settings found for {username}, will create default");
                        return null;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseUserSettings] Failed to load settings: {response.StatusCode}");
                    return null;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseUserSettings] Error loading settings: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Сохраняет настройки пользователя в Supabase
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> SaveSettingsAsync(string username, UserSettingsData settings)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseUserSettings] Saving settings for {username}");
                
                // Проверяем, существуют ли настройки
                var existing = await LoadSettingsAsync(username);
                
                var settingsObj = new
                {
                    username = username,
                    dark_theme = settings.DarkTheme,
                    selected_language = settings.SelectedLanguage,
                    selected_resolution = settings.SelectedResolution,
                    sound_enabled = settings.SoundEnabled,
                    notifications_enabled = settings.NotificationsEnabled,
                    auto_save = settings.AutoSave
                };
                
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(settingsObj);
                var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                
                HttpResponseMessage response;
                
                if (existing == null)
                {
                    // INSERT - создаём новую запись
                    var url = $"{SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/user_settings";
                    response = await _httpClient.PostAsync(url, content);
                }
                else
                {
                    // UPDATE - обновляем существующую
                    var url = $"{SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/user_settings?username=eq.{username}";
                    var request = new HttpRequestMessage(new HttpMethod("PATCH"), url)
                    {
                        Content = content
                    };
                    response = await _httpClient.SendAsync(request);
                }
                
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseUserSettings] ✅ Settings saved for {username}");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseUserSettings] Failed to save settings: {response.StatusCode}, {errorContent}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseUserSettings] Error saving settings: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Удаляет настройки пользователя из Supabase
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<bool> DeleteSettingsAsync(string username)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[SupabaseUserSettings] Deleting settings for {username}");
                
                var url = $"{SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/user_settings?username=eq.{username}";
                var response = await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(url);
                
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SupabaseUserSettings] ✅ Settings deleted for {username}");
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseUserSettings] Failed to delete settings: {response.StatusCode}");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SupabaseUserSettings] Error deleting settings: {ex.Message}", ex);
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Модель данных настроек пользователя для Supabase
    /// </summary>
    public class UserSettingsData
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }

namespace Victory.Services

    /// <summary>
    /// Exception thrown when user tries to login but is already active in another session
    /// </summary>
    public class UserAlreadyActiveException : Exception
    {
        public string Username { get; }

        public UserAlreadyActiveException(string username) 
            : base($"User {username} is already active")
        {
            Username = username;
        }

        public UserAlreadyActiveException(string username, string message) 
            : base(message)
        {
            Username = username;
        }
    }
