using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Input;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.ViewModels
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Модели для мультиплеера
    /// </summary>
    public class GameRoom
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string RoomCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string RoomName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string HostUsername { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string HostDisplayName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string GameType { get; set; } = "quiz";
        public string Status { get; set; } = "waiting";
        public int MaxPlayers { get; set; } = 10;
        public int CurrentPlayers { get; set; } = 1;
        public string? QuizId { get; set; }
        public Dictionary<string, object>? Settings { get; set; }
        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
        public DateTime? StartedAt { get; set; }
        public DateTime? FinishedAt { get; set; }
        public List<GameRoomPlayer>? Players { get; set; }
        public bool IsPrivate { get; set; }
        public string? Password { get; set; }
        
        // UI свойства
        public string LockIcon => IsPrivate ? "🔒" : "";
        public string HostLabel => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(HostDisplayName) ? HostDisplayName : HostUsername;
    }

    public class GameRoomPlayer
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public int RoomId { get; set; }
        public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string DisplayName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string? AvatarPath { get; set; }
        public DateTime JoinedAt { get; set; }
        public bool IsReady { get; set; }
        public int Score { get; set; }
        public int? Position { get; set; }
        
        // Дополнительные свойства для UI
        public bool IsHost { get; set; }
        public string StatusEmoji => IsReady ? "✓" : "○";
        public string StatusColor => IsReady ? "Green" : "Gray";
        public string DisplayLabel => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DisplayName) ? Username : DisplayName;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// ViewModel для управления игровыми комнатами
    /// </summary>
    public class GameRoomViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
    {
        private readonly SupabaseMultiplayerService _gameService;
        private GameRoom? _currentRoom;
        private GameRoomPlayer? _currentPlayer;
        private System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer? _roomPollTimer;
        private bool _isPolling;
        private bool _navigatedToGame;
        private readonly Dictionary<string, GameRoomPlayer> _lastPlayersByUsername = new Dictionary<string, GameRoomPlayer>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        private System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer? _heartbeatTimer;
        private System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer? _socialPollTimer;
        private readonly SupabaseSocialService _socialService = new SupabaseSocialService();
        private readonly SupabaseQuizService _quizService = new SupabaseQuizService();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _notifiedKeys = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        
        // Кэш профилей: Username -> (DisplayName, AvatarPath, LastFetched)
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, (string DisplayName, string AvatarPath, DateTime LastFetched)> _profileCache = new Dictionary<string, (string DisplayName, string AvatarPath, DateTime LastFetched)>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        private readonly SupabaseAuthService _authService = new SupabaseAuthService();

        public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

        // Коллекции для UI
        public ObservableCollection<GameRoom> AvailableRooms { get; } = new ObservableCollection<GameRoom>();
        public ObservableCollection<GameRoomPlayer> RoomPlayers { get; } = new ObservableCollection<GameRoomPlayer>();
        public ObservableCollection<GameRoomPlayer> VisibleRoomPlayers { get; } = new ObservableCollection<GameRoomPlayer>();
        public ObservableCollection<SpeedStat> SpeedStats { get; } = new ObservableCollection<SpeedStat>();
        public double MaxAvgSeconds { get; private set; }

        private string _notReadySummary = string.Empty;
        public string NotReadySummary
        {
            get => _notReadySummary;
            private set { _notReadySummary = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }
        public string HostDisplayName => RoomPlayers.FirstOrDefault(p => string.Equals(p.Username, CurrentRoom?.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))?.DisplayName ?? (CurrentRoom?.HostUsername ?? string.Empty);

        private string _quizName = "Загрузка...";
        public string QuizName
        {
            get => _quizName;
            set { _quizName = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        // Свойства для создания комнаты
        public string NewRoomName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string NewRoomGameType { get; set; } = "quiz";
        public int NewRoomMaxPlayers { get; set; } = 10;
        public int NewRoomTimePerQuestion { get; set; } = 30;

        // Команды
        public ICommand CreateRoomCommand { get; }
        public ICommand JoinRoomCommand { get; }
        public ICommand RefreshRoomsCommand { get; }
        public ICommand LeaveRoomCommand { get; }
        public ICommand StartGameCommand { get; }
        public ICommand ToggleReadyCommand { get; }

        public GameRoomViewModel()
        {
            _gameService = new SupabaseMultiplayerService();

            CreateRoomCommand = new RelayCommand(async _ => await CreateRoomAsync());
            JoinRoomCommand = new RelayCommand(async (roomCode) => await JoinRoomAsync(roomCode?.ToString() ?? ""));
            RefreshRoomsCommand = new RelayCommand(async _ => await RefreshRoomsAsync());
            LeaveRoomCommand = new RelayCommand(async _ => await LeaveRoomAsync());
            StartGameCommand = new RelayCommand(async _ => await StartGameAsync());
            ToggleReadyCommand = new RelayCommand(async _ => await ToggleReadyAsync());

            // Загружаем данные из RoomDataService если они есть
            if (RoomDataService.CurrentRoom != null)
            {
                CurrentRoom = RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;
                CurrentPlayer = RoomDataService.CurrentPlayer;
                _ = LoadRoomPlayersAsync();
                StartRoomPolling();
                StartHeartbeat();
                StartSocialPolling();
                
                // Уведомляем об изменении
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CurrentRoom));
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CurrentPlayer));
            }

            _ = LoadRoomsAsync();
        }

        public void StartRoomPolling()
        {
            if (_roomPollTimer != null) return;
            _roomPollTimer = new System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer
            {
                Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1) // быстрее обновляем список игроков у хоста
            };
            _roomPollTimer.Tick += async (s, e) => await PollRoomAsync();
            _roomPollTimer.Start();
        }

        private void StartHeartbeat()
        {
            if (_heartbeatTimer != null) return;
            _heartbeatTimer = new System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer
            {
                Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)
            };
            _heartbeatTimer.Tick += async (s, e) =>
            {
                try
                {
                    if (CurrentRoom == null) return;
                    var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                    if (currentUser == null) return;
                    await _gameService.UpdateHeartbeat(CurrentRoom.Id, currentUser.Username);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"Heartbeat error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                }
            };
            _heartbeatTimer.Start();
        }

        private async void StartSocialPolling()
        {
            if (_socialPollTimer != null) return;
            
            // Инициализация: помечаем все существующие accepted как уже показанные
            // ВАЖНО: делаем это ПЕРЕД запуском таймера, чтобы избежать дублирования уведомлений
            await InitializeNotifiedKeysAsync();
            
            _socialPollTimer = new System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer
            {
                Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2)
            };
            _socialPollTimer.Tick += async (s, e) => await PollSocialAsync();
            _socialPollTimer.Start();
        }
        
        private async Task InitializeNotifiedKeysAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null) return;
                
                // Помечаем все существующие accepted friend requests
                var accepted = await _socialService.GetAcceptedFriendRequests(current.Username);
                foreach (var fr in accepted)
                {
                    _notifiedKeys.Add($"friend_request_accepted:{fr.Id}");
                }
                
                // Помечаем все существующие accepted room invites
                var acceptedInv = await _socialService.GetAcceptedRoomInvites(current.Username);
                foreach (var inv in acceptedInv)
                {
                    _notifiedKeys.Add($"room_invite_accepted:{inv.Id}");
                }
                
                Logger.Log($"[GameRoomViewModel] Initialized {_notifiedKeys.Count} existing social notifications as already shown");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"InitializeNotifiedKeysAsync error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получить профиль из кэша или загрузить
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<(string DisplayName, string AvatarPath)> GetCachedProfileAsync(string username)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username)) return (username, null);

            // Если есть в кэше и свежий (менее 5 минут)
            if (_profileCache.TryGetValue(username, out var cache) && (DateTime.Now - cache.LastFetched).TotalMinutes < 5)
            {
                return (cache.DisplayName, cache.AvatarPath);
            }

            try 
            {
                var profile = await _authService.GetUserProfile(username);
                var dn = profile?.DisplayName ?? username;
                var av = profile?.AvatarPath;
                
                // Обновляем кэш
                _profileCache[username] = (dn, av, DateTime.Now);
                return (dn, av);
            }
            catch
            {
                // В случае ошибки возвращаем то что есть (или username)
                return (username, null);
            }
        }

        private async Task PollRoomAsync()
        {
            if (CurrentRoom == null || _isPolling) return;
            _isPolling = true;
            try
            {
                // Объявляем currentUser в начале метода, чтобы он был доступен во всех блоках
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                
                var room = await _gameService.GetRoomWithPlayers(CurrentRoom.Id);
                if (room == null)
                {
                    // Комната удалена — останавливаем ВСЕ таймеры и очищаем состояние
                    StopAllTimers();
                    
                    CurrentRoom = null;
                    CurrentPlayer = null;
                    RoomPlayers.Clear();
                    VisibleRoomPlayers.Clear();
                    _lastPlayersByUsername.Clear();
                    
                    // Очищаем RoomDataService чтобы предотвратить редирект
                    RoomDataService.CurrentRoom = null;
                    RoomDataService.CurrentPlayer = null;
                    return;
                }

                // Обновляем статус/счётчики и настройки
                CurrentRoom.Status = room.Status;
                CurrentRoom.CurrentPlayers = room.CurrentPlayers;
                CurrentRoom.Settings = room.Settings; // Синхронизируем настройки с БД

                // Если комната завершена — НЕ выходим автоматически. Дадим показать результаты в RoomGameView.
                // Поллинг можно остановить, чтобы не перетирало состояние.
                if (string.Equals(room.Status, "finished", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    _roomPollTimer?.Stop();
                    return;
                }

                // Список игроков — берём напрямую из game_room_players (надёжнее, чем вложенная связь)
                {
                    var directPlayers = await _gameService.GetRoomPlayersPublic(room.Id);
                    var effectivePlayers = new List<MultiplayerRoomPlayer>();
                    
                    // Загружаем актуальные DisplayName для каждого игрока
                    if (directPlayers != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var p in directPlayers)
                        {
                            string displayName = p.DisplayName;
                            
                            // Всегда пытаемся получить актуальные данные из кэша/профиля
                            var (cachedDisplayName, cachedAvatar) = await GetCachedProfileAsync(p.Username);
                            
                            // Используем кэшированные данные, если они есть, иначе оставляем то что пришло из базы
                            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cachedDisplayName)) displayName = cachedDisplayName;
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cachedAvatar)) p.AvatarPath = cachedAvatar;
                            
                            effectivePlayers.Add(new MultiplayerRoomPlayer
                            {
                                Id = p.Id,
                                RoomId = p.RoomId,
                                Username = p.Username,
                                DisplayName = displayName,
                                AvatarPath = p.AvatarPath,
                                JoinedAt = p.JoinedAt,
                                IsReady = p.IsReady,
                                Score = p.Score,
                                Position = p.Position
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    // Синхронизируем счётчик игроков по факту
                    CurrentRoom.CurrentPlayers = effectivePlayers.Count;

                    // Вычисляем ушедших игроков для уведомления
                    var newNames = new HashSet<string>(effectivePlayers.Select(p => p.Username), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                    var oldNames = new HashSet<string>(_lastPlayersByUsername.Keys, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                    foreach (var removed in oldNames.Except(newNames))
                    {
                        if (_lastPlayersByUsername.TryGetValue(removed, out var leftP))
                        {
                            var n = new Views.NotificationWindow($"Игрок {leftP.DisplayName} покинул игру", "warning");
                            n.Show();
                        }
                        _lastPlayersByUsername.Remove(removed);
                    }

                    // Проверка: если хост вышел (его нет в списке игроков), и мы не хост — выходим
                    if (currentUser != null && 
                        !string.Equals(CurrentRoom.HostUsername, currentUser.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        var hostExists = effectivePlayers.Any(p => string.Equals(p.Username, CurrentRoom.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                        if (!hostExists)
                        {
                            Logger.Log("[GameRoomViewModel] Host left the room. Disconnecting...");
                            StopAllTimers();
                            new Views.NotificationWindow("Хост покинул комнату", "warning").Show();
                            await LeaveRoomAsync(); // Используем штатный выход
                            return;
                        }
                    }

                    // Проверка: если нас нет в списке игроков, значит нас выгнали
                    if (currentUser != null && 
                        !string.Equals(CurrentRoom.HostUsername, currentUser.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        var meExists = effectivePlayers.Any(p => string.Equals(p.Username, currentUser.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                        
                        // Если нас нет в списке, но комната в статусе waiting - возможно это рестарт игры
                        // В этом случае не выкидываем игрока, даем шанс UI обработать переход
                        bool isRestarting = string.Equals(room.Status, "waiting", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                        
                        if (!meExists && !isRestarting)
                        {
                            Logger.Log("[GameRoomViewModel] I was kicked from the room. Disconnecting...");
                            
                            StopAllTimers();
                            
                            CurrentRoom = null;
                            CurrentPlayer = null;
                            RoomPlayers.Clear();
                            VisibleRoomPlayers.Clear();
                            _lastPlayersByUsername.Clear();
                            RoomDataService.CurrentRoom = null;
                            RoomDataService.CurrentPlayer = null;

                            new Views.NotificationWindow("Вы были исключены из комнаты", "error").Show();
                            NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("MultiplayerMenu");
                            return;
                        }
                    }

                    // Синхронизация RoomPlayers (Add/Remove/Update)
                    SynchronizePlayers(effectivePlayers, currentUser);
                }

                // Хост: обновляем график скорости
                try
                {
                    // Используем уже объявленную переменную currentUser
                    if (currentUser != null && CurrentRoom != null && string.Equals(CurrentRoom.HostUsername, currentUser.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        var stats = await _gameService.GetRoomPlayersWithStats(CurrentRoom.Id);
                        SpeedStats.Clear();
                        double maxAvg = 1.0;
                        foreach (var s in stats)
                        {
                            var totalQ = Math.Max(1, s.TotalQuestions);
                            var avgSec = (s.TotalTimeMs / 1000.0) / totalQ;
                            var item = new SpeedStat { DisplayName = s.DisplayName, AvgSeconds = avgSec };
                            SpeedStats.Add(item);
                            if (avgSec > maxAvg) maxAvg = avgSec;
                        }
                        MaxAvgSeconds = maxAvg;
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(MaxAvgSeconds));
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SpeedStats));
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"Speed chart update error: {ex.Message}", ex);
                }

                // Автонавигация при старте
                if (!_navigatedToGame && (room.Status == "starting" || room.Status == "in_progress"))
                {
                    _navigatedToGame = true;
                    NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("RoomGame");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[GameRoomViewModel] PollRoomAsync error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                _isPolling = false;
            }
        }

        private void StopAllTimers()
        {
            _roomPollTimer?.Stop();
            _roomPollTimer = null;
            _heartbeatTimer?.Stop();
            _heartbeatTimer = null;
            _socialPollTimer?.Stop();
            _socialPollTimer = null;
        }

        private void SynchronizePlayers(List<MultiplayerRoomPlayer> effectivePlayers, Models.User? currentUser)
        {
            var currentPlayersDict = RoomPlayers.ToDictionary(p => p.Username, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var newPlayersDict = effectivePlayers.ToDictionary(p => p.Username, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            // 1. Удаляем тех, кого нет в новом списке
            for (int i = RoomPlayers.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                var p = RoomPlayers[i];
                if (!newPlayersDict.ContainsKey(p.Username))
                {
                    RoomPlayers.RemoveAt(i);
                    _lastPlayersByUsername.Remove(p.Username);
                }
            }

            // 2. Добавляем новых и обновляем существующих
            foreach (var p in effectivePlayers)
            {
                if (currentPlayersDict.TryGetValue(p.Username, out var existingPlayer))
                {
                    // Обновляем свойства
                    if (existingPlayer.IsReady != p.IsReady) existingPlayer.IsReady = p.IsReady;
                    if (existingPlayer.Score != p.Score) existingPlayer.Score = p.Score;
                    if (existingPlayer.Position != p.Position) existingPlayer.Position = p.Position;
                    if (existingPlayer.DisplayName != p.DisplayName) existingPlayer.DisplayName = p.DisplayName;
                    if (existingPlayer.AvatarPath != p.AvatarPath) existingPlayer.AvatarPath = p.AvatarPath;
                    
                    // Обновляем статус в словаре для уведомлений
                    _lastPlayersByUsername[p.Username] = existingPlayer;
                }
                else
                {
                    // Добавляем нового
                    var newPlayer = new GameRoomPlayer
                    {
                        Id = p.Id,
                        RoomId = p.RoomId,
                        Username = p.Username,
                        DisplayName = p.DisplayName,
                        AvatarPath = p.AvatarPath,
                        JoinedAt = p.JoinedAt,
                        IsReady = p.IsReady,
                        Score = p.Score,
                        Position = p.Position,
                        IsHost = string.Equals(p.Username, CurrentRoom?.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                    };
                    RoomPlayers.Add(newPlayer);
                    _lastPlayersByUsername[p.Username] = newPlayer;
                }
            }

            // Синхронизация VisibleRoomPlayers (без хоста)
            var visibleSource = RoomPlayers.Where(p => !string.Equals(p.Username, CurrentRoom?.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
            
            // Удаляем лишних
            for (int i = VisibleRoomPlayers.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (!visibleSource.Any(p => p.Username == VisibleRoomPlayers[i].Username))
                {
                    VisibleRoomPlayers.RemoveAt(i);
                }
            }
            
            // Добавляем недостающих
            foreach (var p in visibleSource)
            {
                if (!VisibleRoomPlayers.Any(vp => vp.Username == p.Username))
                {
                    VisibleRoomPlayers.Add(p);
                }
            }
            
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HostDisplayName));

            // Проверяем готовность всех игроков и логируем, кто не готов (для хоста)
            // Хост не учитывается в готовности
            var notReady = RoomPlayers
                .Where(pp => !pp.IsReady && !string.Equals(pp.Username, CurrentRoom?.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Select(pp => pp.DisplayName)
                .ToList();
            if (notReady.Count > 0)
            {
                // Используем уже объявленную переменную currentUser
                if (currentUser != null && string.Equals(CurrentRoom?.HostUsername, currentUser.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    NotReadySummary = "Не готовы: " + string.Join(", ", notReady);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                NotReadySummary = string.Empty;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Текущая комната
        /// </summary>
        public GameRoom? CurrentRoom
        {
            get => _currentRoom;
            set
            {
                _currentRoom = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsInRoom));
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CanStartGame));
                _ = LoadQuizNameAsync();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Текущий игрок
        /// </summary>
        public GameRoomPlayer? CurrentPlayer
        {
            get => _currentPlayer;
            set
            {
                _currentPlayer = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Находимся ли мы в комнате
        /// </summary>
        public bool IsInRoom => CurrentRoom != null;

        /// <summary>
        /// Можем ли начать игру (только хост)
        /// </summary>
        public bool CanStartGame => CurrentRoom?.HostUsername == UserService.GetCurrentUser()?.Username;

        private bool _isReady;
        public bool IsReady
        {
            get => _isReady;
            set { _isReady = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Создать игровую комнату
        /// </summary>
        private async Task CreateRoomAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser == null)
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Необходимо войти в систему", "error");
                    notification.Show();
                    return;
                }

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(NewRoomName))
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Введите название комнаты", "error");
                    notification.Show();
                    return;
                }

                var room = await _gameService.CreateMultiplayerRoom(NewRoomName, currentUser.Username, "default-quiz-id", NewRoomMaxPlayers, NewRoomTimePerQuestion);
                if (room != null)
                {
                    // Загружаем DisplayName хоста из профиля
                    string hostDisplayName = currentUser.DisplayName ?? currentUser.Username;
                    try
                    {
                        var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                        var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(room.HostUsername);
                        hostDisplayName = profile?.DisplayName ?? currentUser.DisplayName ?? currentUser.Username;
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        // Если не удалось загрузить, используем текущего пользователя
                    }
                    
                    // Конвертируем из сервиса в локальную модель
                    var localRoom = new GameRoom
                    {
                        Id = room.Id,
                        RoomCode = room.RoomCode,
                        RoomName = room.RoomName,
                        HostUsername = room.HostUsername,
                        HostDisplayName = hostDisplayName,
                        GameType = room.GameType,
                        Status = room.Status,
                        MaxPlayers = room.MaxPlayers,
                        CurrentPlayers = room.CurrentPlayers,
                        QuizId = room.QuizId,
                        IsPrivate = room.IsPrivate,
                        Password = room.Password,
                        Settings = room.Settings,
                        CreatedAt = room.CreatedAt,
                        StartedAt = room.StartedAt,
                        FinishedAt = room.FinishedAt,
                        Players = room.Players?.Select(p => new GameRoomPlayer
                        {
                            Id = p.Id,
                            RoomId = p.RoomId,
                            Username = p.Username,
                            DisplayName = p.DisplayName,
                            AvatarPath = p.AvatarPath,
                            JoinedAt = p.JoinedAt,
                            IsReady = p.IsReady,
                            Score = p.Score,
                            Position = p.Position
                        }).ToList()
                    };

                    CurrentRoom = localRoom;
                    await LoadRoomPlayersAsync();
                    StartRoomPolling();
                    
                    // Уведомляем об изменении
                    OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CurrentRoom));
                    OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CurrentPlayer));

                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow($"Комната создана! Код: {room.RoomCode}", "success");
                    notification.Show();

                    // Переходим в комнату
                    NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("RoomHost", this);
                }
                else
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Не удалось создать комнату", "error");
                    notification.Show();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error creating room: {ex.Message}", ex);
                var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow($"Ошибка создания комнаты: {ex.Message}", "error");
                notification.Show();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Присоединиться к комнате
        /// </summary>
        private async Task JoinRoomAsync(string roomCode)
        {
            try
            {
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser == null)
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Необходимо войти в систему", "error");
                    notification.Show();
                    return;
                }

                // Убеждаемся, что DisplayName не пустой
                string displayName = currentUser.DisplayName;
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(displayName))
                {
                    // Пытаемся загрузить из профиля
                    try
                    {
                        var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                        var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(currentUser.Username);
                        displayName = profile?.DisplayName ?? currentUser.Username;
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        displayName = currentUser.Username;
                    }
                }
                
                bool success;
                try
                {
                    success = await _gameService.JoinMultiplayerRoom(roomCode, currentUser.Username, displayName);
                }
                catch (BannedFromRoomException ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[GameRoomViewModel] User is banned from room: {ex.Message}");
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Вы забанены в этой комнате и не можете присоединиться", "error");
                    notification.Show();
                    return;
                }

                if (success)
                {
                    // Загружаем информацию о комнате напрямую по коду, чтобы избежать фильтров
                    var room = await _gameService.GetRoomByCode(roomCode);

                    if (room != null)
                    {
                        // Загружаем DisplayName хоста из профиля
                        string hostDisplayName = room.HostUsername;
                        try
                        {
                            var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                            var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(room.HostUsername);
                            hostDisplayName = profile?.DisplayName ?? room.HostUsername;
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            // Если не удалось загрузить, используем username
                        }
                        
                        // Конвертируем из сервиса в локальную модель
                        var localRoom = new GameRoom
                        {
                            Id = room.Id,
                            RoomCode = room.RoomCode,
                            RoomName = room.RoomName,
                            HostUsername = room.HostUsername,
                            HostDisplayName = hostDisplayName,
                            GameType = room.GameType,
                            Status = room.Status,
                            MaxPlayers = room.MaxPlayers,
                            CurrentPlayers = room.CurrentPlayers,
                            QuizId = room.QuizId,
                            Settings = room.Settings,
                            CreatedAt = room.CreatedAt,
                            StartedAt = room.StartedAt,
                            FinishedAt = room.FinishedAt,
                            Players = room.Players?.Select(p => new GameRoomPlayer
                            {
                                Id = p.Id,
                                RoomId = p.RoomId,
                                Username = p.Username,
                                DisplayName = p.DisplayName,
                                AvatarPath = p.AvatarPath,
                                JoinedAt = p.JoinedAt,
                                IsReady = p.IsReady,
                                Score = p.Score,
                                Position = p.Position
                            }).ToList()
                        };

                        CurrentRoom = localRoom;
                        // Сохраняем для передачи на следующую страницу (там создается новый VM)
                        RoomDataService.CurrentRoom = localRoom;

                        await LoadRoomPlayersAsync();
                        
                        // Сохраняем текущего игрока для последующих экранов
                        var me = RoomPlayers.FirstOrDefault(p => string.Equals(p.Username, currentUser.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                        if (me != null)
                        {
                            CurrentPlayer = me;
                            IsReady = me.IsReady;
                            RoomDataService.CurrentPlayer = me;
                        }
                        
                        // Запускаем все необходимые сервисы для комнаты
                        StartRoomPolling();
                        StartHeartbeat();
                        StartSocialPolling();
                        
                        // Уведомляем об изменении
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CurrentRoom));
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CurrentPlayer));

                        var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow($"Присоединились к комнате: {room.RoomName}", "success");
                        notification.Show();

                        // Явно устанавливаем VM перед навигацией, чтобы он не потерялся
                        NavigationService.Instance.SetCurrentViewModel(this);
                        NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("RoomJoin", this);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Комната уже не существует", "error");
                        notification.Show();
                        
                        // Обновляем список комнат
                        await RefreshRoomsAsync();
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Не удалось присоединиться к комнате", "error");
                    notification.Show();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error joining room: {ex.Message}", ex);
                var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow($"Ошибка присоединения: {ex.Message}", "error");
                notification.Show();
            }
        }

        private bool _isLoadingRooms;

        /// <summary>
        /// Загрузить активные комнаты
        /// </summary>
        private async Task LoadRoomsAsync()
        {
            if (_isLoadingRooms) return;
            _isLoadingRooms = true;
            try
            {
                var rooms = await _gameService.GetActiveMultiplayerRooms();
                // Синхронизация списка комнат (Add/Remove/Update) вместо Clear/Add
                var newRoomsDict = rooms.ToDictionary(r => r.RoomCode, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                
                // 1. Удаляем комнаты, которых больше нет, ИЛИ дубликаты
                var seenCodes = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                for (int i = AvailableRooms.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                {
                    var code = AvailableRooms[i].RoomCode;
                    
                    // Если такой комнаты нет в новом списке - удаляем
                    if (!newRoomsDict.ContainsKey(code))
                    {
                        AvailableRooms.RemoveAt(i);
                        continue;
                    }
                    
                    // Если мы уже видели этот код в этом проходе (значит это дубликат в AvailableRooms) - удаляем
                    if (seenCodes.Contains(code))
                    {
                        AvailableRooms.RemoveAt(i);
                        continue;
                    }
                    
                    seenCodes.Add(code);
                }

                // 2. Добавляем новые и обновляем существующие
                foreach (var room in rooms)
                {
                    var existingRoom = AvailableRooms.FirstOrDefault(r => r.RoomCode == room.RoomCode);
                    
                    // Загружаем DisplayName хоста через кэш
                    var (hostDisplayName, _) = await GetCachedProfileAsync(room.HostUsername);

                    if (existingRoom != null)
                    {
                        // Обновляем существующую комнату
                        if (existingRoom.CurrentPlayers != room.CurrentPlayers) existingRoom.CurrentPlayers = room.CurrentPlayers;
                        if (existingRoom.Status != room.Status) existingRoom.Status = room.Status;
                        if (existingRoom.HostDisplayName != hostDisplayName) existingRoom.HostDisplayName = hostDisplayName;
                        // Другие поля по необходимости
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // Добавляем новую комнату
                        var localRoom = new GameRoom
                        {
                            Id = room.Id,
                            RoomCode = room.RoomCode,
                            RoomName = room.RoomName,
                            HostUsername = room.HostUsername,
                            HostDisplayName = hostDisplayName,
                            GameType = room.GameType,
                            Status = room.Status,
                            MaxPlayers = room.MaxPlayers,
                            CurrentPlayers = room.CurrentPlayers,
                            QuizId = room.QuizId,
                            IsPrivate = room.IsPrivate,
                            Password = room.Password,
                            Settings = room.Settings,
                            CreatedAt = room.CreatedAt,
                            StartedAt = room.StartedAt,
                            FinishedAt = room.FinishedAt,
                            Players = room.Players?.Select(p => new GameRoomPlayer
                            {
                                Id = p.Id,
                                RoomId = p.RoomId,
                                Username = p.Username,
                                DisplayName = p.DisplayName,
                                AvatarPath = p.AvatarPath,
                                JoinedAt = p.JoinedAt,
                                IsReady = p.IsReady,
                                Score = p.Score,
                                Position = p.Position
                            }).ToList()
                        };
                        AvailableRooms.Add(localRoom);
                    }
                }

                Logger.Log($"[GameRoomViewModel] Loaded {rooms.Count} active rooms");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error loading rooms: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                _isLoadingRooms = false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Загрузить игроков в текущей комнате
        /// </summary>
        private async Task LoadRoomPlayersAsync()
        {
            if (CurrentRoom == null) return;

            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[GameRoomViewModel] Loading players for room {CurrentRoom.Id}");
                RoomPlayers.Clear();

                // Загружаем игроков из Supabase
                var roomWithPlayers = await _gameService.GetRoomWithPlayers(CurrentRoom.Id);
                if (roomWithPlayers?.Players != null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[GameRoomViewModel] Found {roomWithPlayers.Players.Count} players in Supabase");
                    foreach (var player in roomWithPlayers.Players)
                    {
                        var localPlayer = new GameRoomPlayer
                        {
                            Id = player.Id,
                            RoomId = player.RoomId,
                            Username = player.Username,
                            DisplayName = player.DisplayName,
                            AvatarPath = player.AvatarPath,
                            JoinedAt = player.JoinedAt,
                            IsReady = player.IsReady,
                            Score = player.Score,
                            Position = player.Position,
                            IsHost = string.Equals(player.Username, CurrentRoom?.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                        };

                        RoomPlayers.Add(localPlayer);

                        // Устанавливаем текущего игрока и переносим реальный is_ready
                        var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                        if (currentUser != null && player.Username == currentUser.Username)
                        {
                            CurrentPlayer = localPlayer;
                            IsReady = localPlayer.IsReady;
                        }
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[GameRoomViewModel] No players found in Supabase, creating fallback");
                    // Fallback: создаем хоста как игрока
                    var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                    if (currentUser != null)
                    {
                        var player = new GameRoomPlayer
                        {
                            Id = 1,
                            RoomId = CurrentRoom.Id,
                            Username = currentUser.Username,
                            DisplayName = currentUser.DisplayName,
                            AvatarPath = currentUser.AvatarPath,
                            JoinedAt = DateTime.Now,
                            IsReady = false,
                            Score = 0,
                            IsHost = string.Equals(currentUser.Username, CurrentRoom?.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                        };

                        RoomPlayers.Add(player);
                        CurrentPlayer = player;
                        Logger.Log($"[GameRoomViewModel] Created fallback player: {player.Username}");
                    }
                }

                Logger.Log($"[GameRoomViewModel] Loaded {RoomPlayers.Count} players total");
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(RoomPlayers));

                // Обновляем видимых игроков (без хоста)
                VisibleRoomPlayers.Clear();
                foreach (var vp in RoomPlayers)
                {
                    if (!string.Equals(vp.Username, CurrentRoom?.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        VisibleRoomPlayers.Add(vp);
                    }
                }
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(VisibleRoomPlayers));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error loading room players: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Обновить активные комнаты
        /// </summary>
        public async Task RefreshRoomsAsync()
        {
            // Сбрасываем залипшее состояние
            _navigatedToGame = false;
            if (!IsInRoom)
            {
                RoomDataService.CurrentRoom = null;
                RoomDataService.CurrentPlayer = null;
            }
            await LoadRoomsAsync();

            // Фильтруем комнаты с status!=waiting
            for (int i = AvailableRooms.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (!string.Equals(AvailableRooms[i].Status, "waiting", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    AvailableRooms.RemoveAt(i);
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Выйти из комнаты
        /// </summary>
        public async Task LeaveRoomAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (CurrentRoom != null && currentUser != null)
                {
                    if (string.Equals(CurrentRoom.HostUsername, currentUser.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        // Хост удаляет комнату полностью - это расформирует комнату для всех игроков
                        await _gameService.DeleteRoom(CurrentRoom.Id);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // Игрок уходит намеренно — блокируем повторный вход и удаляем запись
                        await _gameService.LeaveRoom(CurrentRoom.Id, currentUser.Username);
                    }
                }

                // Останавливаем ВСЕ таймеры чтобы не было редиректа обратно в комнату
                _roomPollTimer?.Stop();
                _roomPollTimer = null;
                _heartbeatTimer?.Stop();
                _heartbeatTimer = null;
                _socialPollTimer?.Stop();
                _socialPollTimer = null;
                
                CurrentRoom = null;
                CurrentPlayer = null;
                RoomPlayers.Clear();
                VisibleRoomPlayers.Clear();
                _lastPlayersByUsername.Clear();
                
                // Очищаем RoomDataService чтобы не восстанавливать комнату при создании нового ViewModel
                RoomDataService.CurrentRoom = null;
                RoomDataService.CurrentPlayer = null;

                var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Вышли из комнаты", "success");
                notification.Show();

                NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("MultiplayerMenu");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error leaving room: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Начать игру
        /// </summary>
        private async Task StartGameAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                if (CurrentRoom == null) return;

                // Только хост может запускать игру
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser == null || !string.Equals(CurrentRoom.HostUsername, currentUser.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Только хост может начать игру", "warning");
                    notification.Show();
                    return;
                }

                // Проверяем количество игроков
                var playersCount = RoomPlayers.Count;
                
                // Получаем настройку участия хоста
                bool hostParticipation = false;
                try
                {
                    if (CurrentRoom.Settings != null && CurrentRoom.Settings.TryGetValue("game_settings", out var gsObj))
                    {
                        var json = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(gsObj);
                        using (var doc = System.Text.Json.JsonDocument.Parse(json))
                        {
                            var root = doc.RootElement;
                            if (root.TryGetProperty("host_participation", out var hp))
                            {
                                hostParticipation = hp.ValueKind == System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.True || 
                                                   (hp.ValueKind == System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.String && hp.GetString()?.ToLower() == "true");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[GameRoomViewModel] Error parsing host_participation setting", ex);
                }

                // Валидация: хост один
                if (playersCount <= 1)
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Невозможно начать игру: нужно минимум 2 игрока", "warning");
                    notification.Show();
                    return;
                }

                // Валидация: есть только 1 участник и хост не участвует
                if (playersCount == 2 && !hostParticipation)
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Невозможно начать игру: включите 'Участие создателя комнаты' или пригласите ещё игроков", "warning");
                    notification.Show();
                    return;
                }

                Logger.Log($"[GameRoomViewModel] Starting game in room: {CurrentRoom.RoomName}");

                // Переводим комнату в статус starting и сразу in_progress
                await _gameService.UpdateRoomStatus(CurrentRoom.Id, "starting");
                await _gameService.StartGame(CurrentRoom.Id);
                NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("RoomGame");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error starting game: {ex.Message}", ex);
                var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow($"Ошибка начала игры: {ex.Message}", "error");
                notification.Show();
            }
        }

        private async Task ToggleReadyAsync()
        {
            if (CurrentRoom == null) return;
            var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
            if (currentUser == null) return;

            var newReady = !IsReady;
            if (await _gameService.SetPlayerReady(CurrentRoom.Id, currentUser.Username, newReady))
            {
                IsReady = newReady;
                await LoadRoomPlayersAsync();
                var note = new Views.NotificationWindow(newReady ? "Вы готовы" : "Вы не готовы", newReady ? "success" : "info");
                note.Show();
            }
        }

        public class SpeedStat
        {
            public string DisplayName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
            public double AvgSeconds { get; set; }
        }

        private async Task PollSocialAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null) return;

                // Приглашения теперь обрабатываются глобальным сервисом SocialNotificationService

                // Принятые заявки в друзья
                var accepted = await _socialService.GetAcceptedFriendRequests(current.Username);
                foreach (var fr in accepted)
                {
                    // Пропускаем аномальные/самонаведенные записи
                    if (string.Equals(fr.To_Username, current.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        continue;

                    var key = $"friend_request_accepted:{fr.Id}";
                    if (_notifiedKeys.Add(key))
                    {
                        var n = new Views.NotificationWindow($"{fr.To_Username} принял(а) вашу заявку в друзья", "success");
                        n.Show();
                    }
                }

                // Новые входящие заявки в друзья (pending)
                var pending = await _socialService.GetPendingFriendRequests(current.Username);
                foreach (var fr in pending)
                {
                    var key = $"friend_request_pending:{fr.Id}";
                    if (_notifiedKeys.Add(key))
                    {
                        var n = new Views.NotificationWindow($"Новая заявка в друзья от {fr.From_Username}", "info");
                        n.Show();
                    }
                }

                // Принятые приглашения в комнату
                var acceptedInv = await _socialService.GetAcceptedRoomInvites(current.Username);
                foreach (var inv in acceptedInv)
                {
                    // Не показываем если по какой-то причине адресат совпадает с текущим
                    if (string.Equals(inv.To_Username, current.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        continue;

                    var key = $"room_invite_accepted:{inv.Id}";
                    if (_notifiedKeys.Add(key))
                    {
                        var n = new Views.NotificationWindow($"{inv.To_Username} принял(а) приглашение в комнату", "success");
                        n.Show();
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"PollSocialAsync error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }


        protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string? propertyName = null)
        {
            PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
        }
        public async Task LoadQuizNameAsync()
        {
            if (CurrentRoom == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(CurrentRoom.QuizId))
            {
                QuizName = "Неизвестно";
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                var quiz = await _quizService.GetQuizAsync(CurrentRoom.QuizId);
                QuizName = quiz?.Title ?? "Неизвестно";
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error loading quiz name: {ex.Message}", ex);
                QuizName = "Ошибка";
            }
        }
    }
}

﻿using Victory.Models;
using Victory.Services;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Windows;

namespace Victory.ViewModels
{
    public class MainViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
    {
        private readonly QuizService quizService;
        private int _selectedAnswerIndex = -1;
        private List<Question> allQuestions = new();
        private Question _currentQuestion = new();
        private int currentQuestionIndex;
        private int score;
        private int _correctAnswersCount = 0;
        private bool _questionAnswered = false;
        private bool _quizFinished = false; // Флаг завершения викторины
        private bool _quizCancelled = false; // Флаг досрочного завершения
        private System.Timers.Timer? _questionTimer;
        private int _timePerQuestion = 0; // 0 = без таймера
        private int _remainingSeconds = 0;
        private bool _deferQuestionTimerStart = false;
        private string _openAnswerInput = string.Empty;
        private int _photoViewSeconds = 5;
        private bool _unlimitedPhotoViewEnabled;
        private bool _allowVideoReplay;

        public event Action<int, int>? QuizFinished;
        public event Action<string>? ShowNotification;
        public event Action<int, bool>? AnswerChecked; // (selectedIndex, isCorrect)
        public event Action? TimerTick;

        public MainViewModel()
        {
            quizService = new QuizService();
            LoadQuestions();
        }

        public bool IsCurrentQuestionOpen => CurrentQuestion?.IsOpenQuestion == true;

        public string OpenAnswerInput
        {
            get => _openAnswerInput;
            set
            {
                _openAnswerInput = value ?? string.Empty;
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(OpenAnswerInput));
                System.Windows.Input.CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
            }
        }

        public void LoadQuestions()
        {
            allQuestions = quizService.GetQuestions();
            currentQuestionIndex = 0;
            // Проверяем, что есть вопросы перед установкой текущего
            if (allQuestions != null && allQuestions.Count > 0)
            {
                CurrentQuestion = allQuestions[currentQuestionIndex];
            }
            else
            {
                CurrentQuestion = new Question(); // Пустой вопрос, если нет вопросов
            }
            Score = 0;
            _quizFinished = false;
            _quizCancelled = false;
        }

        public void LoadQuestionsFrom(List<Question> questions)
        {
            if (questions == null || questions.Count == 0)
            {
                ShowNotification?.Invoke("В выбранной викторине нет вопросов");
                return;
            }

            // Перемешиваем вопросы для уникального опыта каждый раз
            var random = new Random();
            allQuestions = questions.OrderBy(x => random.Next()).ToList();
            
            currentQuestionIndex = 0;
            CurrentQuestion = allQuestions[currentQuestionIndex];
            Score = 0;
            _correctAnswersCount = 0;
            _questionAnswered = false;
            _quizFinished = false;
            _quizCancelled = false;
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CurrentQuestionIndex));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(TotalQuestions));
            
            StartQuestionTimer();
        }

        public void SetTimerSettings(int timePerQuestion)
        {
            _timePerQuestion = timePerQuestion;
            Logger.Log($"[MainViewModel] Timer settings: {_timePerQuestion} seconds per question");
        }

        public void SetMediaPhaseSettings(int photoViewSeconds, bool unlimitedPhotoViewEnabled, bool allowVideoReplay)
        {
            _photoViewSeconds = Math.Max(1, photoViewSeconds);
            _unlimitedPhotoViewEnabled = unlimitedPhotoViewEnabled;
            _allowVideoReplay = allowVideoReplay;

            Logger.Log($"[MainViewModel] Media settings: PhotoViewSeconds={_photoViewSeconds}, UnlimitedPhotoViewEnabled={_unlimitedPhotoViewEnabled}, AllowVideoReplay={_allowVideoReplay}");

            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(PhotoViewSeconds));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(UnlimitedPhotoViewEnabled));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(AllowVideoReplay));
        }

        public int PhotoViewSeconds => _photoViewSeconds;
        public bool UnlimitedPhotoViewEnabled => _unlimitedPhotoViewEnabled;
        public bool AllowVideoReplay => _allowVideoReplay;

        public int RemainingSeconds
        {
            get => _remainingSeconds;
            set
            {
                _remainingSeconds = value;
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(RemainingSeconds));
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasTimer));
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(TimerProgress));
            }
        }

        private RelayCommand _submitOpenAnswerCommand;
        public RelayCommand SubmitOpenAnswerCommand
        {
            get
            {
                return _submitOpenAnswerCommand ??= new RelayCommand(
                    execute: _ => SubmitOpenAnswer(),
                    canExecute: _ => IsCurrentQuestionOpen && !QuestionAnswered && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(OpenAnswerInput)
                );
            }
        }

        public bool HasTimer => _timePerQuestion > 0;

        public bool DeferQuestionTimerStart
        {
            get => _deferQuestionTimerStart;
            set => _deferQuestionTimerStart = value;
        }
        
        public double TimerProgress
        {
            get
            {
                if (_timePerQuestion == 0) return 0;
                return (double)_remainingSeconds / _timePerQuestion * 100;
            }
        }
        
        // Ширина прогресс-бара в пикселях (для упрощения без конвертера)
        public double TimerProgressWidth
        {
            get
            {
                // Возвращаем процент, который будет использоваться с ActualWidth через простую формулу
                return TimerProgress;
            }
        }

        private void StartQuestionTimer()
        {
            StopQuestionTimer();

            if (_quizCancelled)
            {
                Logger.Log("[MainViewModel] Quiz cancelled - timer will not start");
                return;
            }

            if (_timePerQuestion > 0)
            {
                RemainingSeconds = _timePerQuestion;

                if (_deferQuestionTimerStart)
                {
                    Logger.Log("[MainViewModel] Question timer start is deferred by UI phase");
                    return;
                }

                StartQuestionTimerInstance();
                
                Logger.Log($"[MainViewModel] Question timer started: {_timePerQuestion} seconds");
            }
        }

        private void StartQuestionTimerInstance()
        {
            _questionTimer = new System.Timers.Timer(1000); // 1 секунда
            _questionTimer.Elapsed += OnTimerElapsed;
            _questionTimer.AutoReset = true;
            _questionTimer.Start();
        }

        public void StartTimerForCurrentQuestion(bool resetToFullTime = true)
        {
            if (_quizCancelled || _quizFinished || _questionAnswered || _timePerQuestion <= 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            StopQuestionTimer();

            if (resetToFullTime || RemainingSeconds <= 0 || RemainingSeconds > _timePerQuestion)
            {
                RemainingSeconds = _timePerQuestion;
            }

            StartQuestionTimerInstance();
            Logger.Log($"[MainViewModel] Timer started manually for current question: {RemainingSeconds}s");
        }

        public void StopTimerForCurrentQuestion()
        {
            StopQuestionTimer();
            Logger.Log("[MainViewModel] Timer stopped manually for current question");
        }

        private void OnTimerElapsed(object? sender, System.Timers.ElapsedEventArgs e)
        {
            Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                if (_questionAnswered) return;

                RemainingSeconds--;
                TimerTick?.Invoke();

                if (RemainingSeconds <= 0)
                {
                    Logger.Log("[MainViewModel] Time's up! Auto-submitting answer");
                    StopQuestionTimer();
                    
                    // Автоматический ответ (неправильный, если не выбран вариант)
                    if (SelectedAnswerIndex == -1)
                    {
                        SoundService.Instance.PlayErrorSound();
                        ShowNotification?.Invoke("⏰ Время вышло!");
                    }
                    
                    QuestionAnswered = true;
                    AnswerChecked?.Invoke(SelectedAnswerIndex, false);
                    
                    System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(async () =>
                    {
                        await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(1500);
                        Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                        {
                            if (_quizCancelled || _quizFinished) return;
                            
                            SelectedAnswerIndex = -1;
                            QuestionAnswered = false;
                            NextQuestion();
                        });
                    });
                }
            });
        }

        private void SubmitOpenAnswer()
        {
            if (QuestionAnswered || _quizFinished || _quizCancelled || !IsCurrentQuestionOpen)
                return;

            QuestionAnswered = true;
            StopQuestionTimer();

            var expected = (CurrentQuestion.OpenAnswer ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            var submitted = (OpenAnswerInput ?? string.Empty).Trim();
            bool isCorrect = string.Equals(expected, submitted, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            if (isCorrect)
            {
                Score++;
                CorrectAnswersCount++;
                SoundService.Instance.PlaySuccessSound();
            }
            else
            {
                SoundService.Instance.PlayErrorSound();
            }

            AnswerChecked?.Invoke(-1, isCorrect);
            OpenAnswerInput = string.Empty;

            System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(async () =>
            {
                await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(1500);
                Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                {
                    if (_quizFinished || _quizCancelled) return;

                    SelectedAnswerIndex = -1;
                    QuestionAnswered = false;
                    NextQuestion();
                });
            });
        }

        private void StopQuestionTimer()
        {
            if (_questionTimer != null)
            {
                _questionTimer.Stop();
                _questionTimer.Elapsed -= OnTimerElapsed;
                _questionTimer.Dispose();
                _questionTimer = null;
            }
        }

        public int CurrentQuestionIndex => currentQuestionIndex + 1;
        public int TotalQuestions => allQuestions.Count;
        
        public int CorrectAnswersCount
        {
            get => _correctAnswersCount;
            set
            {
                _correctAnswersCount = value;
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CorrectAnswersCount));
            }
        }

        public bool QuestionAnswered
        {
            get => _questionAnswered;
            set
            {
                _questionAnswered = value;
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(QuestionAnswered));
            }
        }


        public Question CurrentQuestion
        {
            get => _currentQuestion; 
            set
            {
                _currentQuestion = value;
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CurrentQuestion));
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsCurrentQuestionOpen));
            }
        }

        private RelayCommand _checkAnswerCommand;
        public RelayCommand CheckAnswerCommand
        {
            get
            {
                return _checkAnswerCommand ??= new RelayCommand(
                    execute: _ => CheckAnswer(),
                    canExecute: _ => SelectedAnswerIndex != -1
                );
            }
        }

        public int SelectedAnswerIndex
        {
            get => _selectedAnswerIndex;
            set
            {
                _selectedAnswerIndex = value;
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedAnswerIndex));
                System.Windows.Input.CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
            }
        }

        public int Score
        {
            get => score;
            set
            {
                score = value;
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(Score));
            }
        }

        private void CheckAnswer()
        {
            // Защита от повторных вызовов после завершения или отмены викторины
            if (QuestionAnswered || _quizFinished || _quizCancelled) return;

            if (IsCurrentQuestionOpen)
            {
                return;
            }

            QuestionAnswered = true;
            StopQuestionTimer(); // Останавливаем таймер при ответе
            
            bool isCorrect = SelectedAnswerIndex == CurrentQuestion.CorrectAnswerIndex;
            
            if (isCorrect)
            {
                Score++;
                CorrectAnswersCount++;
                SoundService.Instance.PlaySuccessSound();
            }
            else
            {
                SoundService.Instance.PlayErrorSound();
            }

            // Уведомляем View для подсветки правильного/неправильного ответа
            AnswerChecked?.Invoke(SelectedAnswerIndex, isCorrect);

            OpenAnswerInput = string.Empty;

            // Проверяем, был ли это последний вопрос
            bool isLastQuestion = currentQuestionIndex + 1 >= allQuestions.Count;

            // Автопереход через короткую паузу
            System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(async () =>
            {
                await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(1500);
                Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                {
                    // Дополнительная проверка на случай, если викторина завершилась во время задержки
                    if (_quizFinished || _quizCancelled) return;
                    
                    SelectedAnswerIndex = -1;
                    QuestionAnswered = false;
                    NextQuestion();
                });
            });
        }

        private void NextQuestion()
        {
            // Защита от повторных вызовов после завершения или отмены викторины
            if (_quizFinished || _quizCancelled || allQuestions == null) return;
            
            if (currentQuestionIndex + 1 < allQuestions.Count)
            {
                currentQuestionIndex++;
                CurrentQuestion = allQuestions[currentQuestionIndex];
                OpenAnswerInput = string.Empty;
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CurrentQuestionIndex));
                StartQuestionTimer(); // Запускаем таймер для нового вопроса
            }
            else
            {
                // Защита от повторного завершения
                if (_quizFinished) return;
                
                StopQuestionTimer(); // Останавливаем таймер при завершении викторины
                _quizFinished = true; // Помечаем викторину как завершённую
                QuestionAnswered = true; // Блокируем дальнейшие ответы
                QuizFinished?.Invoke(CorrectAnswersCount, allQuestions.Count);
            }
        }

        public void Restart()
        {
            if (allQuestions == null || allQuestions.Count == 0) return;
            
            StopQuestionTimer();
            _quizCancelled = false;
            currentQuestionIndex = 0;
            Score = 0;
            CorrectAnswersCount = 0;
            SelectedAnswerIndex = -1;
            OpenAnswerInput = string.Empty;
            QuestionAnswered = false;
            _quizFinished = false;
            CurrentQuestion = allQuestions[currentQuestionIndex];
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CurrentQuestionIndex));
            StartQuestionTimer();
        }

        public void RestartQuiz()
        {
            Restart();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Принудительно останавливает викторину и связанные таймеры
        /// </summary>
        public void AbortQuiz()
        {
            if (_quizCancelled)
            {
                return;
            }

            Logger.Log("[MainViewModel] Quiz aborted manually. Stopping timers and preventing callbacks.");
            _quizCancelled = true;
            StopQuestionTimer();
        }

        public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

        protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
        {
            PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
        }
    }
}
