﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.IO;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows;
using Victory.Models;
using Victory.Services;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Victory.ViewModels
{
    public class PlayerViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
    {
        private readonly QuizService _quizService = new QuizService();
        private readonly QuizEditorService _quizEditorService = new QuizEditorService();
        private readonly QuizUsageTrackingService _usageTrackingService = new QuizUsageTrackingService();

        public ObservableCollection<string> AvailableQuizzes { get; } = new ObservableCollection<string>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, Quiz> _quizzesCache = new Dictionary<string, Quiz>();

        private string _selectedQuiz;
        public string SelectedQuiz
        {
            get => _selectedQuiz;
            set
            {
                _selectedQuiz = value;
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedQuiz));
                CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
            }
        }

        public ICommand PlayCommand { get; }
        public ICommand SelectQuizCommand { get; }

        public PlayerViewModel()
        {
            _ = LoadQuizzesAsync();
            PlayCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => PlaySelectedQuiz(), _ => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SelectedQuiz));
            SelectQuizCommand = new RelayCommand(SelectQuiz);
        }

        private void SelectQuiz(object quizName)
        {
            if (quizName is string quiz)
            {
                SelectedQuiz = quiz;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Публичный метод для перезагрузки викторин (вызывается при открытии страницы)
        /// </summary>
        public async Task RefreshQuizzesAsync()
        {
            await LoadQuizzesAsync();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получить все викторины для диалога выбора
        /// </summary>
        public List<Quiz> GetAllQuizzesForSelection()
        {
            // Также нужно загрузить шаблонную викторину как Quiz объект
            var templateQuizTitle = Application.Current.Resources["QuizTitleTemplate"] as string ?? "Template Quiz";
            var allQuizzes = _quizzesCache.Values.ToList();
            
            // Если шаблонная викторина не в кэше, создаём её
            if (!_quizzesCache.ContainsKey(templateQuizTitle))
            {
                var templateQuestions = _quizService.GetQuestions();
                var templateQuiz = new Quiz
                {
                    Id = "template",
                    Title = templateQuizTitle,
                    Description = "Шаблонная викторина",
                    Questions = templateQuestions.Select((q, idx) => new Question
                    {
                        Id = q.Id,
                        Text = q.Text,
                        Options = q.Options,
                        CorrectAnswerIndex = q.CorrectAnswerIndex,
                        OrderIndex = idx
                    }).ToList()
                };
                allQuizzes.Insert(0, templateQuiz);
            }
            else
            {
                // Шаблонная викторина уже в списке, но нужно убедиться что она первая
                var template = allQuizzes.FirstOrDefault(q => q.Title == templateQuizTitle);
                if (template != null)
                {
                    allQuizzes.Remove(template);
                    allQuizzes.Insert(0, template);
                }
            }
            
            return allQuizzes;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Выбрать викторину из диалога и обновить слайдер
        /// </summary>
        public void SelectQuizFromDialog(Quiz quiz)
        {
            if (quiz != null && _quizzesCache.ContainsKey(quiz.Title))
            {
                SelectedQuiz = quiz.Title;
                // Записываем использование при выборе
                _usageTrackingService.RecordQuizUsage(quiz.Id, quiz.Title);
            }
        }

        private async Task LoadQuizzesAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("[PlayerViewModel] Loading quizzes...");

                // Очищаем перед загрузкой
                AvailableQuizzes.Clear();
                _quizzesCache.Clear();

                // 1) Добавляем шаблонную викторину из QuizService
                var templateQuizTitle = Application.Current.Resources["QuizTitleTemplate"] as string ?? "Template Quiz";
                AvailableQuizzes.Add(templateQuizTitle);
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[PlayerViewModel] Added template quiz: {templateQuizTitle}");

                // 2) Загружаем ВСЕ викторины через QuizEditorService (Supabase + локальные)
                _quizEditorService.ClearCache();
                var quizzes = await _quizEditorService.GetAllQuizzesAsync();
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[PlayerViewModel] Loaded {quizzes.Count} quizzes from QuizEditorService");

                // Фильтруем и сортируем: сначала часто используемые, затем недавно созданные
                var validQuizzes = quizzes.Where(q => q.Questions != null && q.Questions.Count > 0 && q.Title != templateQuizTitle).ToList();
                var sortedQuizzes = _usageTrackingService.SortQuizzesByUsage(validQuizzes);

                // Используем Id вместо Title для проверки дубликатов, чтобы не терять викторины с одинаковыми названиями
                var seenIds = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                foreach (var quiz in sortedQuizzes)
                {
                    // Проверяем по Id, а не по Title, чтобы не терять викторины
                    if (!seenIds.Contains(quiz.Id) && !_quizzesCache.ContainsKey(quiz.Title))
                    {
                        seenIds.Add(quiz.Id);
                        _quizzesCache[quiz.Title] = quiz;
                        AvailableQuizzes.Add(quiz.Title);
                        Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[PlayerViewModel] Added quiz: {quiz.Title} (ID: {quiz.Id}, {quiz.Questions.Count} questions)");
                    }
                    else if (seenIds.Contains(quiz.Id))
                    {
                        Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[PlayerViewModel] Skipped duplicate quiz by ID: {quiz.Title} (ID: {quiz.Id})");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[PlayerViewModel] Skipped duplicate quiz by Title: {quiz.Title} (ID: {quiz.Id})");
                    }
                }

                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[PlayerViewModel] Total available quizzes: {AvailableQuizzes.Count}");
                
                // Уведомляем UI об изменении коллекции
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(AvailableQuizzes));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("[PlayerViewModel] Error loading quizzes", ex);
            }
        }

        private void PlaySelectedQuiz()
        {
            try
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"PlaySelectedQuiz: Starting with SelectedQuiz='{SelectedQuiz}'");
                
                // Записываем использование викторины
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SelectedQuiz))
                {
                    var quiz = _quizzesCache.TryGetValue(SelectedQuiz, out var cachedQuiz) ? cachedQuiz : null;
                    if (quiz != null)
                    {
                        _usageTrackingService.RecordQuizUsage(quiz.Id, quiz.Title);
                    }
                }

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SelectedQuiz))
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log("PlaySelectedQuiz: No quiz selected");
                    MessageBox.Show("Пожалуйста, выберите викторину для прохождения.", "Выберите викторину", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
                    return;
                }

                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("PlaySelectedQuiz: Getting questions");
                var questions = GetQuestionsForSelectedQuiz();
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"PlaySelectedQuiz: Got {questions?.Count ?? 0} questions");
                
                if (questions == null || questions.Count == 0)
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log("PlaySelectedQuiz: No questions found");
                    MessageBox.Show("Вопросы не загружены. Попробуйте выбрать другую викторину.", "Ошибка", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
                    return;
                }

                // Показываем диалог настроек
                var settingsDialog = new Victory.Views.QuizSettingsDialog();
                settingsDialog.Owner = Application.Current.MainWindow;
                
                if (settingsDialog.ShowDialog() != true)
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log("PlaySelectedQuiz: User cancelled settings dialog");
                    return;
                }

                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"PlaySelectedQuiz: Settings - HasTimer={settingsDialog.HasTimer}, TimePerQuestion={settingsDialog.TimePerQuestion}, PhotoViewSeconds={settingsDialog.PhotoViewSeconds}, UnlimitedPhotoViewEnabled={settingsDialog.UnlimitedPhotoViewEnabled}, AllowVideoReplay={settingsDialog.AllowVideoReplay}");

                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("PlaySelectedQuiz: Navigating to Quiz page");
                // Сначала переходим на страницу викторины
                NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Quiz");

                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("PlaySelectedQuiz: Getting MainWindow");
                // Затем загружаем вопросы в MainViewModel
                var mainWindow = Application.Current.MainWindow as Victory.MainWindow;
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"PlaySelectedQuiz: MainWindow is {mainWindow?.GetType().Name ?? "null"}");
                
                if (mainWindow?.DataContext is MainViewModel mainVm)
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log("PlaySelectedQuiz: MainViewModel found, loading questions");
                    mainVm.SetTimerSettings(settingsDialog.TimePerQuestion);
                    mainVm.SetMediaPhaseSettings(settingsDialog.PhotoViewSeconds, settingsDialog.UnlimitedPhotoViewEnabled, settingsDialog.AllowVideoReplay);
                    mainVm.LoadQuestionsFrom(questions);
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log("PlaySelectedQuiz: Questions loaded successfully");
                }
                else
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"PlaySelectedQuiz: MainViewModel not found, DataContext is {mainWindow?.DataContext?.GetType().Name ?? "null"}");
                    MessageBox.Show("Ошибка загрузки викторины. Попробуйте еще раз.", "Ошибка", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("PlaySelectedQuiz failed", ex);
                MessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при запуске викторины: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получить количество вопросов для указанной викторины (по названию)
        /// </summary>
        public int GetQuestionCountForQuiz(string quizTitle)
        {
            try
            {
                // 1) Шаблонная викторина
                var templateQuizTitle = Application.Current.Resources["QuizTitleTemplate"] as string ?? "Template Quiz";
                if (quizTitle == templateQuizTitle)
                {
                    return _quizService.GetQuestions().Count;
                }

                // 2) Из кэша (викторины загруженные через QuizEditorService)
                if (_quizzesCache.TryGetValue(quizTitle, out var cachedQuiz))
                {
                    return cachedQuiz.Questions?.Count ?? 0;
                }

                return 0;
            }
            catch
            {
                return 0;
            }
        }

        private List<Question> GetQuestionsForSelectedQuiz()
        {
            try
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[PlayerViewModel] GetQuestionsForSelectedQuiz: SelectedQuiz='{SelectedQuiz}'");

                // 1) Шаблонная викторина
                var templateQuizTitle = Application.Current.Resources["QuizTitleTemplate"] as string ?? "Template Quiz";
                if (SelectedQuiz == templateQuizTitle)
                {
                    var templateQuestions = _quizService.GetQuestions();
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[PlayerViewModel] Returning template quiz questions: {templateQuestions.Count}");
                    return templateQuestions;
                }

                // 2) Из кэша (викторины загруженные через QuizEditorService)
                if (_quizzesCache.TryGetValue(SelectedQuiz, out var cachedQuiz))
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[PlayerViewModel] Found quiz in cache: {cachedQuiz.Title}, Questions: {cachedQuiz.Questions?.Count ?? 0}");
                    return cachedQuiz.Questions ?? new List<Question>();
                }

                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[PlayerViewModel] Quiz not found in cache: '{SelectedQuiz}'");
                return new List<Question>();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("[PlayerViewModel] Error getting questions", ex);
                return new List<Question>();
            }
        }

        public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;
        private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName) => PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows.Input;
using Victory.Models;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.ViewModels
{
    public class QuizEditorViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
    {
        private readonly QuizEditorService _quizService = new QuizEditorService();

        private Quiz _currentQuiz;
        public Quiz CurrentQuiz
        {
            get => _currentQuiz;
            set
            {
                _currentQuiz = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(QuizTitle));
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(QuizDescription));
            }
        }

        public string QuizTitle
        {
            get => CurrentQuiz?.Title ?? string.Empty;
            set
            {
                if (CurrentQuiz != null)
                {
                    CurrentQuiz.Title = value;
                    OnPropertyChanged();
                }
            }
        }

        public string QuizDescription
        {
            get => CurrentQuiz?.Description ?? string.Empty;
            set
            {
                if (CurrentQuiz != null)
                {
                    CurrentQuiz.Description = value;
                    OnPropertyChanged();
                }
            }
        }

        public ObservableCollection<Quiz> AvailableQuizzes { get; } = new ObservableCollection<Quiz>();
        public ObservableCollection<Question> Questions { get; } = new ObservableCollection<Question>();

        private Quiz _selectedQuiz;
        public Quiz SelectedQuiz
        {
            get => _selectedQuiz;
            set
            {
                _selectedQuiz = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                if (value != null)
                {
                    LoadQuiz(value);
                }
            }
        }

        private Question _selectedQuestion;
        public Question SelectedQuestion
        {
            get => _selectedQuestion;
            set
            {
                _selectedQuestion = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
            }
        }

        public ICommand NewQuizCommand { get; }
        public ICommand SaveQuizCommand { get; }
        public ICommand DeleteQuizCommand { get; }
        public ICommand EditQuizCommand { get; }
        public ICommand LoadQuizCommand { get; }
        public ICommand AddQuestionCommand { get; }
        public ICommand DeleteQuestionCommand { get; }
        public ICommand BackCommand { get; }

        public QuizEditorViewModel()
        {
            CurrentQuiz = _quizService.CreateNewQuiz();
            LoadQuestions();
            
            NewQuizCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => CreateNewQuiz());
            SaveQuizCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => SaveQuiz());
            DeleteQuizCommand = new RelayCommand(async (quiz) => await DeleteQuizAsync(quiz), _ => true);
            EditQuizCommand = new RelayCommand(EditQuiz, _ => SelectedQuiz != null);
            LoadQuizCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => LoadQuiz(SelectedQuiz), _ => SelectedQuiz != null);
            AddQuestionCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => AddQuestion());
            DeleteQuestionCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => DeleteQuestion(), _ => SelectedQuestion != null);
            BackCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => GoBack());

            _ = LoadAvailableQuizzes();
        }

        private async Task LoadAvailableQuizzes()
        {
            var quizzes = await _quizService.GetAllQuizzesAsync();
            AvailableQuizzes.Clear();
            // В редакторе показываем ВСЕ викторины (включая без вопросов), 
            // чтобы пользователь мог их редактировать и добавлять вопросы
            foreach (var quiz in quizzes)
            {
                AvailableQuizzes.Add(quiz);
            }
        }

        private void CreateNewQuiz()
        {
            CurrentQuiz = _quizService.CreateNewQuiz();
            LoadQuestions();
            
            // Add to available quizzes if not already there
            if (!AvailableQuizzes.Contains(CurrentQuiz))
            {
                AvailableQuizzes.Add(CurrentQuiz);
            }
        }

        private async void SaveQuiz()
        {
            if (CurrentQuiz != null)
            {
                var success = await _quizService.SaveQuizAsync(CurrentQuiz);
                if (success)
                {
                    _ = LoadAvailableQuizzes();
                    // Show success message
                }
            }
        }

        private async Task DeleteQuizAsync(object quiz)
        {
            if (quiz is Quiz q)
            {
                try
                {
                    var success = await _quizService.DeleteQuizAsync(q.Id);
                    if (success)
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorViewModel] Quiz deleted successfully: {q.Title}");

                        // Если удаляемая викторина была текущей, создаем новую
                        if (CurrentQuiz?.Id == q.Id)
                        {
                            CreateNewQuiz();
                        }

                        // Убираем из списков и обновляем заново из источника
                        var toRemove = AvailableQuizzes.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == q.Id);
                        if (toRemove != null) AvailableQuizzes.Remove(toRemove);
                        SelectedQuiz = null;
                        await LoadAvailableQuizzes();
                        
                        // Синхронизируем статистику после удаления (если викторина была с вопросами)
                        if (q.Questions != null && q.Questions.Count > 0)
                        {
                            var currentUser = Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                            if (currentUser != null)
                            {
                                var authService = new Services.SupabaseAuthService();
                                await authService.SyncUserStatsFromSupabase(currentUser.Username);
                                Logger.Log($"[QuizEditorViewModel] ✅ Statistics synced after deleting quiz with questions");
                            }
                        }

                        var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Викторина удалена!", "success");
                        notification.Show();
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Не удалось удалить викторину", "error");
                        notification.Show();
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"Error deleting quiz: {ex.Message}", ex);
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow($"Ошибка при удалении: {ex.Message}", "error");
                    notification.Show();
                }
            }
        }

        private void LoadQuiz(Quiz quiz)
        {
            if (quiz != null)
            {
                CurrentQuiz = quiz;
                LoadQuestions();
            }
        }

        private void LoadQuestions()
        {
            Questions.Clear();
            if (CurrentQuiz?.Questions != null)
            {
                foreach (var question in CurrentQuiz.Questions)
                {
                    Questions.Add(question);
                }
            }
        }

        private void AddQuestion()
        {
            var newQuestion = new Question
            {
                Text = "Новый вопрос",
                Options = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string> 
                { 
                    "Вариант 1", "Вариант 2", "Вариант 3", "Вариант 4" 
                },
                CorrectAnswerIndex = 0
            };

            Questions.Add(newQuestion);
            CurrentQuiz?.Questions.Add(newQuestion);
        }

        private void DeleteQuestion()
        {
            if (SelectedQuestion != null)
            {
                Questions.Remove(SelectedQuestion);
                CurrentQuiz?.Questions.Remove(SelectedQuestion);
                SelectedQuestion = null;
            }
        }

        private void EditQuiz(object quiz)
        {
            if (quiz is Quiz q)
            {
                SelectedQuiz = q;
                // Navigate to quiz editor
                Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("QuizEdit");
            }
        }


        private void GoBack()
        {
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Main");
        }

        public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

        protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged([System.Runtime.CompilerServices.CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
        {
            PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: ViewModels/QuizEditViewModel.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Linq;
using Microsoft.Win32;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Input;
using Victory.Models;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.ViewModels
{
    // Вспомогательный класс для передачи параметра удаления опции.
    // ВАЖНО: должен быть DependencyObject с DependencyProperty, иначе XAML-биндинги
    // (например в <Button.CommandParameter>) вылетают с UI-исключением:
    // "Binding можно задать только в параметре DependencyProperty объекта DependencyObject".
    public class RemoveOptionParameter : DependencyObject
    {
        public static readonly DependencyProperty QuestionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
            nameof(Question), typeof(Question), typeof(RemoveOptionParameter), new PropertyMetadata(null));

        public static readonly DependencyProperty OptionTextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
            nameof(OptionText), typeof(string), typeof(RemoveOptionParameter), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty));

        public static readonly DependencyProperty OptionIndexProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
            nameof(OptionIndex), typeof(int), typeof(RemoveOptionParameter), new PropertyMetadata(-1));

        public Question Question
        {
            get => (Question)GetValue(QuestionProperty);
            set => SetValue(QuestionProperty, value);
        }

        public string OptionText
        {
            get => (string)GetValue(OptionTextProperty);
            set => SetValue(OptionTextProperty, value);
        }

        public int OptionIndex
        {
            get => (int)GetValue(OptionIndexProperty);
            set => SetValue(OptionIndexProperty, value);
        }
    }
    public class QuizEditViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
    {
        private readonly QuizEditorService _quizService = new QuizEditorService();

        private Quiz _currentQuiz;
        public Quiz CurrentQuiz
        {
            get => _currentQuiz;
            set
            {
                _currentQuiz = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(QuizTitle));
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(QuizDescription));
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(TimePerQuestion));
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(RandomizeQuestions));
            }
        }

        public string QuizTitle
        {
            get => CurrentQuiz?.Title ?? string.Empty;
            set
            {
                if (CurrentQuiz != null)
                {
                    CurrentQuiz.Title = value;
                    OnPropertyChanged();
                }
            }
        }

        public string QuizDescription
        {
            get => CurrentQuiz?.Description ?? string.Empty;
            set
            {
                if (CurrentQuiz != null)
                {
                    CurrentQuiz.Description = value;
                    OnPropertyChanged();
                }
            }
        }

        public int TimePerQuestion
        {
            get => CurrentQuiz?.TimeLimit ?? 30;
            set
            {
                if (CurrentQuiz != null)
                {
                    CurrentQuiz.TimeLimit = value;
                    OnPropertyChanged();
                }
            }
        }

        public bool RandomizeQuestions
        {
            get => CurrentQuiz?.Questions?.Count > 0; // Simplified for demo
            set
            {
                // Implementation for randomize logic
                OnPropertyChanged();
            }
        }

        public ObservableCollection<Question> Questions { get; } = new ObservableCollection<Question>();

        private Question _selectedQuestion;
        public Question SelectedQuestion
        {
            get => _selectedQuestion;
            set
            {
                _selectedQuestion = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
            }
        }

        public int TotalQuestions => Questions.Count;

        public ICommand AddQuestionCommand { get; }
        public ICommand EditQuestionCommand { get; }
        public ICommand RemoveQuestionCommand { get; }
        public ICommand AddOptionCommand { get; }
        public ICommand RemoveOptionCommand { get; }
        public ICommand SelectQuestionMediaCommand { get; }
        public ICommand ClearQuestionMediaCommand { get; }
        public ICommand SelectOptionMediaCommand { get; }
        public ICommand ClearOptionMediaCommand { get; }
        public ICommand SaveQuizCommand { get; }
        public ICommand PreviewQuizCommand { get; }

        public QuizEditViewModel()
        {
            _currentQuiz = _quizService.CreateNewQuiz();
            CurrentQuiz = _currentQuiz;
            LoadQuestions();
            
            AddQuestionCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => AddQuestion(), _ => Questions.Count < 4);
            EditQuestionCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => EditQuestion(SelectedQuestion), _ => SelectedQuestion != null);
            // Enable delete based on passed parameter (question), not SelectedQuestion
            RemoveQuestionCommand = new RelayCommand(RemoveQuestion, q => q is Question);
            // Enable add option based on passed parameter (question) - максимум 4 варианта
            AddOptionCommand = new RelayCommand(AddOption, question => 
            {
                if (question is Question q)
                {
                    return q.Options != null && q.Options.Count < 4 && !q.IsOpenQuestion;
                }
                return false;
            });
            RemoveOptionCommand = new RelayCommand(RemoveOption, parameter =>
            {
                // Проверяем, можно ли удалить опцию (минимум 2 опции должны остаться)
                if (parameter is RemoveOptionParameter param)
                {
                    if (param.Question?.Options != null)
                    {
                        return param.Question.Options.Count > 2;
                    }
                }
                // Обратная совместимость со старым способом (строка)
                else if (parameter is string optionText)
                {
                    foreach (var question in Questions)
                    {
                        if (question.Options != null && question.Options.Contains(optionText))
                        {
                            return question.Options.Count > 2;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return false;
            });
            SelectQuestionMediaCommand = new RelayCommand(SelectQuestionMedia, q => q is Question);
            ClearQuestionMediaCommand = new RelayCommand(ClearQuestionMedia, q => q is Question);
            SelectOptionMediaCommand = new RelayCommand(SelectOptionMedia, p => p is RemoveOptionParameter);
            ClearOptionMediaCommand = new RelayCommand(ClearOptionMedia, p => p is RemoveOptionParameter);
            SaveQuizCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => SaveQuiz());
            PreviewQuizCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => PreviewQuiz());
        }

        public void LoadQuiz(Quiz quiz)
        {
            try
            {
                if (quiz == null)
                {
                    System.Windows.MessageBox.Show("Ошибка: викторина не найдена", "Ошибка", 
                        System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
                    return;
                }

                CurrentQuiz = quiz;
                LoadQuestions();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Windows.MessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при загрузке викторины: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", 
                    System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadQuestions()
        {
            try
            {
                Questions.Clear();
                if (CurrentQuiz?.Questions != null)
                {
                    foreach (var question in CurrentQuiz.Questions)
                    {
                        NormalizeQuestion(question);
                        Questions.Add(question);
                    }
                }
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(TotalQuestions));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Windows.MessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при загрузке вопросов: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", 
                    System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void AddQuestion()
        {
            // Проверяем максимум 4 вопроса
            if (Questions.Count >= 4)
            {
                var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Максимум 4 вопроса!", "error");
                notification.Show();
                return;
            }

            var newQuestion = new Question
            {
                Text = "Новый вопрос",
                QuestionType = "closed",
                Options = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string> 
                { 
                    "Вариант 1", "Вариант 2", "Вариант 3", "Вариант 4" 
                },
                OptionMediaPaths = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>
                {
                    string.Empty, string.Empty, string.Empty, string.Empty
                },
                CorrectAnswerIndex = 0
            };

            NormalizeQuestion(newQuestion);
            Questions.Add(newQuestion);
            CurrentQuiz?.Questions.Add(newQuestion);
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(TotalQuestions));
            
            // Обновляем команды для обновления состояния кнопки добавления вопроса
            System.Windows.Input.CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
        }

        private void EditQuestion(Question question)
        {
            if (question != null)
            {
                SelectedQuestion = question;
                // Navigate to question editor
                // This would open a detailed question editor
            }
        }

        private void DeleteQuestion()
        {
            if (SelectedQuestion != null)
            {
                Questions.Remove(SelectedQuestion);
                CurrentQuiz?.Questions.Remove(SelectedQuestion);
                SelectedQuestion = null;
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(TotalQuestions));
            }
        }

        private async void SaveQuiz()
        {
            if (CurrentQuiz != null)
            {
                if (CurrentQuiz.Questions != null)
                {
                    foreach (var question in CurrentQuiz.Questions)
                    {
                        NormalizeQuestion(question);
                    }
                }

                var success = await _quizService.SaveQuizAsync(CurrentQuiz);
                if (success)
                {
                    // Show success notification
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Викторина сохранена!", "success");
                    notification.Show();
                }
            }
        }

        private void PreviewQuiz()
        {
            // Navigate to quiz preview
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("QuizPreview");
        }

        private void RemoveQuestion(object question)
        {
            if (question is Question q && Questions.Contains(q))
            {
                Questions.Remove(q);
                CurrentQuiz?.Questions?.Remove(q);
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(TotalQuestions));
            }
        }

        private void AddOption(object question)
        {
            if (question is Question q)
            {
                // Ограничиваем максимум 4 варианта ответа
                if (q.Options == null)
                {
                    q.Options = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
                }
                
                if (q.Options.Count >= 4)
                {
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Максимум 4 варианта ответа!", "error");
                    notification.Show();
                    return;
                }
                
                q.Options.Add("Новый вариант ответа");
                EnsureOptionMediaPaths(q);
                q.OptionMediaPaths.Add(string.Empty);
                
                // Обновляем UI - принудительно обновляем коллекцию вопросов для немедленного отображения изменений
                var index = Questions.IndexOf(q);
                if (index >= 0)
                {
                    // Удаляем и добавляем обратно, чтобы WPF обновил UI
                    Questions.RemoveAt(index);
                    Questions.Insert(index, q);
                    OnPropertyChanged(nameof(Questions));
                }
                
                // Обновляем команды
                System.Windows.Input.CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
            }
        }

        private void RemoveOption(object parameter)
        {
            Question questionToRemoveFrom = null;
            int indexToRemove = -1;

            // Новый способ - через RemoveOptionParameter
            if (parameter is RemoveOptionParameter param)
            {
                questionToRemoveFrom = param.Question;
                if (questionToRemoveFrom?.Options != null)
                {
                    indexToRemove = param.OptionIndex >= 0 && param.OptionIndex < questionToRemoveFrom.Options.Count
                        ? param.OptionIndex
                        : questionToRemoveFrom.Options.IndexOf(param.OptionText);
                }
            }
            // Обратная совместимость со старым способом (строка)
            else if (parameter is string optionText)
            {
                // Ищем вопрос, содержащий этот вариант ответа
                // Проходим по всем вопросам и ищем опцию
                foreach (var question in Questions)
                {
                    if (question.Options != null)
                    {
                        indexToRemove = question.Options.IndexOf(optionText);
                        if (indexToRemove >= 0)
                        {
                            questionToRemoveFrom = question;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (questionToRemoveFrom != null && indexToRemove >= 0)
            {
                RemoveOptionFromQuestion(questionToRemoveFrom, indexToRemove);
            }
        }

        private void RemoveOptionFromQuestion(Question question, int optionIndex)
        {
            if (question == null || question.Options == null || optionIndex < 0 || optionIndex >= question.Options.Count)
                return;
                    
            // Проверяем минимальное количество опций (минимум 2)
            if (question.Options.Count <= 2)
            {
                var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Должно остаться минимум 2 варианта ответа!", "error");
                notification.Show();
                return;
            }

            // Корректируем индекс правильного ответа перед удалением
            if (optionIndex == question.CorrectAnswerIndex)
            {
                // Если удаляем правильный ответ, устанавливаем индекс на 0 (первый оставшийся)
                question.CorrectAnswerIndex = 0;
            }
            else if (optionIndex < question.CorrectAnswerIndex)
            {
                // Если удалили вариант до правильного ответа, уменьшаем индекс
                question.CorrectAnswerIndex--;
            }
            // Если optionIndex > CorrectAnswerIndex, индекс не меняется
            
            // Удаляем опцию
            question.Options.RemoveAt(optionIndex);
            EnsureOptionMediaPaths(question);
            if (optionIndex < question.OptionMediaPaths.Count)
            {
                question.OptionMediaPaths.RemoveAt(optionIndex);
            }
            
            // Убеждаемся, что индекс правильного ответа в допустимых пределах
            if (question.CorrectAnswerIndex >= question.Options.Count)
            {
                question.CorrectAnswerIndex = question.Options.Count - 1;
            }
            
            // Обновляем UI - принудительно обновляем коллекцию вопросов для немедленного отображения изменений
            var questionIndex = Questions.IndexOf(question);
            if (questionIndex >= 0)
            {
                // Удаляем и добавляем обратно, чтобы WPF обновил UI
                Questions.RemoveAt(questionIndex);
                Questions.Insert(questionIndex, question);
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(Questions));
            }
            
            // Обновляем команды - важно обновить для всех опций, чтобы кнопки правильно включались/отключались
            System.Windows.Input.CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
            
            // Дополнительно обновляем команды через Dispatcher, чтобы гарантировать обновление UI
            System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(
                System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Input,
                new Action(() => System.Windows.Input.CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested()));
        }

        private void SelectOptionMedia(object parameter)
        {
            if (parameter is not RemoveOptionParameter param || param.Question == null || param.OptionIndex < 0)
                return;

            var dialog = new OpenFileDialog
            {
                Title = "Выберите файл медиа для варианта",
                Filter = "Медиа файлы|*.png;*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.gif;*.bmp;*.webp;*.mp4;*.webm;*.mov;*.avi;*.mkv|Все файлы|*.*",
                CheckFileExists = true,
                Multiselect = false
            };

            if (dialog.ShowDialog() == true)
            {
                var q = param.Question;
                EnsureOptionMediaPaths(q);
                if (param.OptionIndex < q.OptionMediaPaths.Count)
                {
                    q.OptionMediaPaths[param.OptionIndex] = dialog.FileName;
                    RefreshQuestionInUi(q);
                }
            }
        }

        private void ClearOptionMedia(object parameter)
        {
            if (parameter is not RemoveOptionParameter param || param.Question == null || param.OptionIndex < 0)
                return;

            var q = param.Question;
            EnsureOptionMediaPaths(q);
            if (param.OptionIndex < q.OptionMediaPaths.Count)
            {
                q.OptionMediaPaths[param.OptionIndex] = string.Empty;
                RefreshQuestionInUi(q);
            }
        }

        private void SelectQuestionMedia(object question)
        {
            if (question is not Question q)
                return;

            var dialog = new OpenFileDialog
            {
                Title = "Выберите файл медиа",
                Filter = "Медиа файлы|*.png;*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.gif;*.bmp;*.webp;*.mp4;*.webm;*.mov;*.avi;*.mkv|Все файлы|*.*",
                CheckFileExists = true,
                Multiselect = false
            };

            if (dialog.ShowDialog() == true)
            {
                q.ImagePath = dialog.FileName;
                RefreshQuestionInUi(q);
            }
        }

        private void ClearQuestionMedia(object question)
        {
            if (question is not Question q)
                return;

            q.ImagePath = string.Empty;
            RefreshQuestionInUi(q);
        }

        private static void EnsureOptionMediaPaths(Question question)
        {
            question.OptionMediaPaths ??= new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
            question.Options ??= new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();

            while (question.OptionMediaPaths.Count < question.Options.Count)
            {
                question.OptionMediaPaths.Add(string.Empty);
            }

            if (question.OptionMediaPaths.Count > question.Options.Count)
            {
                question.OptionMediaPaths = question.OptionMediaPaths.Take(question.Options.Count).ToList();
            }
        }

        private static void NormalizeQuestion(Question question)
        {
            if (question == null)
                return;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(question.QuestionType))
            {
                question.QuestionType = "closed";
            }

            question.Options ??= new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
            EnsureOptionMediaPaths(question);

            if (question.IsOpenQuestion)
            {
                question.CorrectAnswerIndex = 0;
                question.OpenAnswer ??= string.Empty;
                return;
            }

            if (question.Options.Count == 0)
            {
                question.Options.AddRange(new[] { "Вариант 1", "Вариант 2" });
            }

            EnsureOptionMediaPaths(question);

            if (question.CorrectAnswerIndex < 0 || question.CorrectAnswerIndex >= question.Options.Count)
            {
                question.CorrectAnswerIndex = 0;
            }
        }

        private void RefreshQuestionInUi(Question question)
        {
            var index = Questions.IndexOf(question);
            if (index >= 0)
            {
                Questions.RemoveAt(index);
                Questions.Insert(index, question);
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(Questions));
            }
        }

        public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

        protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged([System.Runtime.CompilerServices.CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
        {
            PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: ViewModels/RelayCommand.cs ===

﻿using System;
using System.Windows.Input;

namespace Victory.ViewModels
{
    public class RelayCommand : ICommand
    {
        private readonly Action<object?> _execute;
        private readonly Func<object?, bool>? _canExecute;


        public RelayCommand(Action<object?> execute, Func<object?, bool>? canExecute = null)
        {
            _execute = execute ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(execute));
            _canExecute = canExecute;
        }

        public bool CanExecute(object? parameter) => _canExecute == null || _canExecute(parameter);
        public void Execute(object? parameter) => _execute(parameter);

        public event EventHandler? CanExecuteChanged
        {
            add => CommandManager.RequerySuggested += value;
            remove => CommandManager.RequerySuggested -= value;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.Json;
using MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.ViewModels
{
    public class SettingsViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
    {
        private bool _soundEnabled = true;
        private bool _darkTheme = false;
        private bool _notificationsEnabled = true;
        private bool _autoSave = true;

        public bool SoundEnabled
        {
            get => _soundEnabled;
            set
            {
                _soundEnabled = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.SoundEnabled = _soundEnabled;
                SaveSettings();
            }
        }

        public bool DarkTheme
        {
            get => _darkTheme;
            set
            {
                _darkTheme = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                ApplyTheme();
                SaveSettings();
            }
        }


        public bool NotificationsEnabled
        {
            get => _notificationsEnabled;
            set
            {
                _notificationsEnabled = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                
                // Синхронизируем с UserSettingsService
                var userSettings = Victory.Services.UserSettingsService.Instance.GetCurrentSettings();
                userSettings.NotificationsEnabled = value;
                Victory.Services.UserSettingsService.Instance.SaveSettings(userSettings);
                
                SaveSettings();
            }
        }

        public bool AutoSave
        {
            get => _autoSave;
            set
            {
                _autoSave = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                SaveSettings();
            }
        }

        public SettingsViewModel()
        {
            LoadSettings();
            // Apply on startup to keep persisted state
            ApplyTheme();
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.SoundEnabled = _soundEnabled;
            
            // Загружаем настройки из Supabase (асинхронно)
            _ = LoadSettingsFromSupabaseAsync();
        }

        private void LoadSettings()
        {
            try
            {
                var settingsPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "settings.json");
                if (File.Exists(settingsPath))
                {
                    var json = File.ReadAllText(settingsPath);
                    var settings = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SettingsData>(json);
                    if (settings != null)
                    {
                        _soundEnabled = settings.SoundEnabled;
                        _darkTheme = settings.DarkTheme;
                        _notificationsEnabled = settings.NotificationsEnabled;
                        _autoSave = settings.AutoSave;
                        
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SoundEnabled));
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(DarkTheme));
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(NotificationsEnabled));
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(AutoSave));
                    }
                }
                
                // Синхронизируем с UserSettingsService
                var userSettings = Victory.Services.UserSettingsService.Instance.GetCurrentSettings();
                userSettings.NotificationsEnabled = _notificationsEnabled;
                Victory.Services.UserSettingsService.Instance.SaveSettings(userSettings);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // Log error or show notification
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Error loading settings: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private void SaveSettings()
        {
            try
            {
                var settings = new SettingsData
                {
                    SoundEnabled = _soundEnabled,
                    DarkTheme = _darkTheme,
                    NotificationsEnabled = _notificationsEnabled,
                    AutoSave = _autoSave
                };

                // Сохраняем локально
                var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });
                var settingsPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "settings.json");
                File.WriteAllText(settingsPath, json);
                
                // Сохраняем в Supabase (асинхронно)
                _ = SaveSettingsToSupabaseAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // Log error or show notification
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Error saving settings: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private async Task LoadSettingsFromSupabaseAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                var currentUser = Victory.Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser != null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SettingsViewModel] Loading settings from Supabase for {currentUser.Username}");
                    
                    var supabaseService = new Victory.Services.SupabaseUserSettingsService();
                    var settings = await supabaseService.LoadSettingsAsync(currentUser.Username);
                    
                    if (settings != null)
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SettingsViewModel] ✅ Settings loaded from Supabase");
                        
                        // Обновляем настройки из БД
                        _soundEnabled = settings.SoundEnabled;
                        _darkTheme = settings.DarkTheme;
                        _notificationsEnabled = settings.NotificationsEnabled;
                        _autoSave = settings.AutoSave;
                        
                        // Уведомляем UI об изменениях
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SoundEnabled));
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(DarkTheme));
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(NotificationsEnabled));
                        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(AutoSave));
                        
                        // Применяем настройки
                        ApplyTheme();
                        Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.SoundEnabled = _soundEnabled;
                        
                        // Синхронизируем с UserSettingsService
                        var userSettings = Victory.Services.UserSettingsService.Instance.GetCurrentSettings();
                        userSettings.NotificationsEnabled = _notificationsEnabled;
                        Victory.Services.UserSettingsService.Instance.SaveSettings(userSettings);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SettingsViewModel] No settings in Supabase, will create on first save");
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SettingsViewModel] Failed to load settings from Supabase: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        private async Task SaveSettingsToSupabaseAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                var currentUser = Victory.Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser != null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[SettingsViewModel] Saving settings to Supabase for {currentUser.Username}");
                    
                    var supabaseService = new Victory.Services.SupabaseUserSettingsService();
                    var settings = new Victory.Services.UserSettingsData
                    {
                        DarkTheme = _darkTheme,
                        SoundEnabled = _soundEnabled,
                        NotificationsEnabled = _notificationsEnabled,
                        AutoSave = _autoSave
                    };
                    
                    var success = await supabaseService.SaveSettingsAsync(currentUser.Username, settings);
                    
                    if (success)
                    {
                        Logger.Log($"[SettingsViewModel] ✅ Settings saved to Supabase");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[SettingsViewModel] ❌ Failed to save settings to Supabase");
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[SettingsViewModel] Error saving settings to Supabase: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        private void ApplyTheme()
        {
            try
            {
                // Align with startup logic: swap MD Light/Dark dictionaries
                var dicts = Application.Current.Resources.MergedDictionaries;
                for (int i = dicts.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                {
                    var src = dicts[i].Source?.OriginalString ?? string.Empty;
                    if (src.Contains("MaterialDesignTheme.Dark.xaml") || src.Contains("MaterialDesignTheme.Light.xaml"))
                        dicts.RemoveAt(i);
                }
                var themeUri = new Uri(_darkTheme
                    ? "pack://application:,,,/MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf;component/Themes/MaterialDesignTheme.Dark.xaml"
                    : "pack://application:,,,/MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf;component/Themes/MaterialDesignTheme.Light.xaml");
                dicts.Add(new ResourceDictionary { Source = themeUri });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"ApplyTheme error: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }


        public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

        protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
        {
            PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
        }
    }

    public class SettingsData
    {
        public bool SoundEnabled { get; set; } = true;
        public bool DarkTheme { get; set; } = false;
        public bool NotificationsEnabled { get; set; } = true;
        public bool AutoSave { get; set; } = true;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class AchievementNotificationWindow : Window
    {
        public AchievementNotificationWindow(Achievement achievement)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            DataContext = achievement;
            
            // Позиционируем окно в правом верхнем углу
            Loaded += (s, e) =>
            {
                var screen = SystemParameters.WorkArea;
                Left = screen.Width - Width - 20;
                Top = 20;
            };

            // Автоматически закрываем через 5 секунд
            var timer = new System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer
            {
                Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)
            };
            timer.Tick += (s, e) =>
            {
                timer.Stop();
                Close();
            };
            timer.Start();

            // Анимация появления
            Loaded += (s, e) =>
            {
                var fadeIn = new DoubleAnimation(0, 1, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(0.5));
                BeginAnimation(OpacityProperty, fadeIn);
            };
        }

        private void CloseButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Close();
        }
    }
}

<Page x:Class="Victory.Views.AiChatView"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
