=== FILE: Views/CropAvatarWindow.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using System.Windows.Input;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class CropAvatarWindow : Window
    {
        private readonly string _sourcePath;
        public BitmapSource? CroppedBitmap { get; private set; }
        private Point _lastDragPoint;
        private bool _isDragging;

        public CropAvatarWindow(string sourcePath)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _sourcePath = sourcePath;
            Loaded += CropAvatarWindow_Loaded;
            ZoomSlider.ValueChanged += ZoomSlider_ValueChanged;

            // Pan/zoom interactions
            SourceImage.MouseLeftButtonDown += SourceImage_MouseLeftButtonDown;
            SourceImage.MouseLeftButtonUp += SourceImage_MouseLeftButtonUp;
            SourceImage.MouseMove += SourceImage_MouseMove;
            SourceImage.MouseWheel += SourceImage_MouseWheel;
        }

        private void CropAvatarWindow_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                var bitmap = new BitmapImage();
                bitmap.BeginInit();
                bitmap.UriSource = new Uri(_sourcePath, UriKind.Absolute);
                bitmap.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
                bitmap.CreateOptions = BitmapCreateOptions.IgnoreImageCache;
                bitmap.EndInit();
                SourceImage.Source = bitmap;
                
                // Ждём загрузки изображения и устанавливаем начальный масштаб
                bitmap.DownloadCompleted += (s, args) =>
                {
                    Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                    {
                        // Вычисляем начальный масштаб для LayoutTransform
                        // Stretch="Uniform" уже масштабирует изображение, поэтому нужно учесть это
                        var circleSize = 440.0; // размер круга обрезки
                        var availableWidth = Scroll.ActualWidth > 0 ? Scroll.ActualWidth : 400;
                        var availableHeight = Scroll.ActualHeight > 0 ? Scroll.ActualHeight : 400;
                        
                        if (bitmap.PixelWidth > 0 && bitmap.PixelHeight > 0)
                        {
                            // Вычисляем масштаб Stretch="Uniform"
                            var stretchScaleX = availableWidth / bitmap.PixelWidth;
                            var stretchScaleY = availableHeight / bitmap.PixelHeight;
                            var uniformScale = Math.Min(stretchScaleX, stretchScaleY);
                            
                            // Размер изображения после Stretch="Uniform"
                            var imageWidthAfterStretch = bitmap.PixelWidth * uniformScale;
                            var imageHeightAfterStretch = bitmap.PixelHeight * uniformScale;
                            
                            // Вычисляем дополнительный масштаб для LayoutTransform, чтобы изображение помещалось
                            // с учетом круга обрезки
                            var extraScaleX = (availableWidth - circleSize) / imageWidthAfterStretch;
                            var extraScaleY = (availableHeight - circleSize) / imageHeightAfterStretch;
                            var initialScale = Math.Min(extraScaleX, extraScaleY);
                            
                            // Устанавливаем начальный масштаб (минимум 0.1, чтобы изображение было видно)
                            ZoomSlider.Value = Math.Max(ZoomSlider.Minimum, Math.Min(initialScale, 1.0));
                        }
                    });
                };
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                DialogResult = false;
                Close();
            }
        }

        private void SourceImage_MouseWheel(object sender, MouseWheelEventArgs e)
        {
            // Zoom around mouse position
            double oldScale = (SourceImage.LayoutTransform as ScaleTransform)?.ScaleX ?? 1.0;
            double delta = e.Delta > 0 ? 0.1 : -0.1;
            double newScale = Math.Clamp(oldScale + delta, ZoomSlider.Minimum, ZoomSlider.Maximum);

            // Compute relative mouse position in content
            var mousePos = e.GetPosition(SourceImage);
            ZoomSlider.Value = newScale;

            // Adjust scroll to keep mouse point stable
            var unitsToPixelsX = (SourceImage.Source as BitmapSource)!.PixelWidth / Math.Max(1.0, SourceImage.ActualWidth);
            var unitsToPixelsY = (SourceImage.Source as BitmapSource)!.PixelHeight / Math.Max(1.0, SourceImage.ActualHeight);

            // Convert to ScrollViewer units
            double contentX = (mousePos.X * newScale);
            double contentY = (mousePos.Y * newScale);
            Scroll.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(Math.Max(0, contentX - (Scroll.ViewportWidth / 2)));
            Scroll.ScrollToVerticalOffset(Math.Max(0, contentY - (Scroll.ViewportHeight / 2)));
        }

        private void SourceImage_MouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_isDragging && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
            {
                var currentPos = e.GetPosition(Scroll);
                var delta = currentPos - _lastDragPoint;
                _lastDragPoint = currentPos;
                Scroll.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(Scroll.HorizontalOffset - delta.X);
                Scroll.ScrollToVerticalOffset(Scroll.VerticalOffset - delta.Y);
            }
        }

        private void SourceImage_MouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            _isDragging = false;
            SourceImage.ReleaseMouseCapture();
        }

        private void SourceImage_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            _isDragging = true;
            _lastDragPoint = e.GetPosition(Scroll);
            SourceImage.CaptureMouse();
        }

        private void ZoomSlider_ValueChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double> e)
        {
            var scale = e.NewValue;
            SourceImage.LayoutTransform = new ScaleTransform(scale, scale);
        }

        private void Cancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DialogResult = false;
            Close();
        }

        private void Crop_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                if (SourceImage.Source is not BitmapSource src)
                {
                    DialogResult = false;
                    Close();
                    return;
                }

                // Размер круга обрезки в пикселях UI (должен совпадать с XAML)
                var circleSize = 440.0;

                // Размер изображения в исходных пикселях
                var imageSourceWidth = src.PixelWidth;
                var imageSourceHeight = src.PixelHeight;
                
                // Центр viewport (центр видимой области ScrollViewer) - это центр круга
                // Круг находится в центре видимой области, НЕ в центре контента
                var viewportCenterX = Scroll.ViewportWidth / 2.0;
                var viewportCenterY = Scroll.ViewportHeight / 2.0;

                // Получаем позицию изображения относительно ScrollViewer
                // Используем TransformToVisual для точного преобразования координат
                var transform = SourceImage.TransformToVisual(Scroll);
                var imageTopLeft = transform.Transform(new Point(0, 0));
                var imageBottomRight = transform.Transform(new Point(SourceImage.ActualWidth, SourceImage.ActualHeight));
                
                // Размер изображения в координатах ScrollViewer (с учетом всех преобразований)
                var imageWidthInScroll = imageBottomRight.X - imageTopLeft.X;
                var imageHeightInScroll = imageBottomRight.Y - imageTopLeft.Y;

                // Центр круга находится в центре viewport (видимой области)
                // Это точка (viewportCenterX, viewportCenterY) в координатах ScrollViewer
                // НЕ нужно добавлять HorizontalOffset/VerticalOffset, так как viewport - это видимая область
                var circleCenterXInScroll = viewportCenterX;
                var circleCenterYInScroll = viewportCenterY;

                // Координаты центра круга относительно левого верхнего угла изображения (в координатах ScrollViewer)
                var circleCenterXRelativeToImage = circleCenterXInScroll - imageTopLeft.X;
                var circleCenterYRelativeToImage = circleCenterYInScroll - imageTopLeft.Y;

                // Преобразуем координаты из координат ScrollViewer в пиксели исходного изображения
                // Коэффициент преобразования: пиксели изображения / единицы ScrollViewer
                double pixelsPerScrollUnitX = imageSourceWidth / Math.Max(1.0, imageWidthInScroll);
                double pixelsPerScrollUnitY = imageSourceHeight / Math.Max(1.0, imageHeightInScroll);

                // Размер круга в пикселях исходного изображения
                // circleSize - размер в пикселях UI (viewport), нужно преобразовать в пиксели изображения
                // Используем средний коэффициент для сохранения пропорций (квадрат)
                var pixelsPerScrollUnit = Math.Min(pixelsPerScrollUnitX, pixelsPerScrollUnitY);
                var circleSizeInPixels = circleSize * pixelsPerScrollUnit;

                // Центр круга в пикселях исходного изображения
                var circleCenterXInPixels = circleCenterXRelativeToImage * pixelsPerScrollUnitX;
                var circleCenterYInPixels = circleCenterYRelativeToImage * pixelsPerScrollUnitY;

                // Левый верхний угол квадрата обрезки в пикселях
                int x = (int)Math.Round(circleCenterXInPixels - circleSizeInPixels / 2.0);
                int y = (int)Math.Round(circleCenterYInPixels - circleSizeInPixels / 2.0);
                int size = (int)Math.Round(circleSizeInPixels);

                // Clamp within image bounds
                if (size <= 0) size = Math.Min(src.PixelWidth, src.PixelHeight);
                if (x < 0) x = 0;
                if (y < 0) y = 0;
                if (x + size > src.PixelWidth) size = src.PixelWidth - x;
                if (y + size > src.PixelHeight) size = src.PixelHeight - y;

                var cropped = new CroppedBitmap(src, new Int32Rect(x, y, size, size));

                // Re-encode to PNG 512x512
                var resized = new TransformedBitmap(cropped, new ScaleTransform(512.0 / size, 512.0 / size));

                CroppedBitmap = new FormatConvertedBitmap(resized, PixelFormats.Pbgra32, null, 0);
                DialogResult = true;
                Close();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Crop error: {ex.Message}");
                DialogResult = false;
                Close();
            }
        }
    }
}

        <!-- Back Button -->
        <Button x:Name="BackButton" 
                HorizontalAlignment="Left" 
                VerticalAlignment="Top"
                Width="56" Height="56" 
                Margin="24,24,0,0"
                Style="{StaticResource MaterialDesignFloatingActionButton}"
                Click="Back_Click"
                ToolTip="Назад"
                Panel.ZIndex="1000">
            <Button.Effect>

=== FILE: Views/EditorView.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Victory.Models;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class EditorView : Page
    {
        private int _currentQuizIndex = 0;
        private List<Quiz> _quizzes = new List<Quiz>();

        public EditorView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        private void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Main");
        }

        private async void LogoutButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is System.Windows.Controls.Button button)
            {
                button.IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем кнопку сразу
            }
            
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            // Показываем loading overlay и блокируем взаимодействие
            try
            {
                LogoutLoadingOverlay.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем всё взаимодействие
            }
            catch { }
            
            await Victory.Services.UserService.Logout();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Login");
        }

        private void Save_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DataContext is ViewModels.QuizEditorViewModel vm)
            {
                vm.SaveQuizCommand.Execute(null);
                // Show success notification
                var notification = new NotificationWindow("Викторина сохранена!", "success");
                notification.Show();
            }
        }

        private void Statistics_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            try
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("Statistics_Click: Opening statistics window");
                
                // Показываем затемнение фона
                var mainWindow = Application.Current.MainWindow as MainWindow;
                mainWindow?.ShowOverlay();
                
                var statsWindow = new StatisticsWindow();
                statsWindow.ShowDialog();
                
                // Скрываем затемнение после закрытия окна статистики
                mainWindow?.HideOverlay();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("Statistics_Click failed", ex);
                
                // Скрываем затемнение в случае ошибки
                var mainWindow = Application.Current.MainWindow as MainWindow;
                mainWindow?.HideOverlay();
                
                var errorWindow = new Views.NotificationWindow("Ошибка при загрузке статистики", "error");
                errorWindow.Show();
            }
        }

        private void AiHelper_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("AiChat");
        }

        private void NewQuiz_Click(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            // Создаём новую пустую викторину для редактирования
            var newQuiz = new Models.Quiz
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                Title = "Новая викторина",
                Description = "Описание викторины",
                Author = Victory.Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser()?.Username ?? "Неизвестен",
                Questions = new System.Collections.Generic.List<Models.Question>()
            };
            
            // Сохраняем для редактирования
            QuizEditView.SelectedQuizForEditing = newQuiz;
            
            // Переходим в редактор
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("QuizEdit");
        }

        private void EditorView_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DataContext is ViewModels.QuizEditorViewModel vm)
            {
                // Подписываемся на изменения коллекции викторин
                vm.AvailableQuizzes.CollectionChanged += (s, args) =>
                {
                    Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new System.Action(() => UpdateQuizzesList()), 
                        System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
                };
                
                // Обновляем список викторин после загрузки
                Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new System.Action(() => UpdateQuizzesList()), 
                    System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateQuizzesList()
        {
            if (DataContext is ViewModels.QuizEditorViewModel vm && vm.AvailableQuizzes != null)
            {
                _quizzes = vm.AvailableQuizzes.ToList();
                _currentQuizIndex = 0;
                UpdateCarousel();
            }
        }

        private void PrevQuiz_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            if (_quizzes.Count == 0) return;
            
            _currentQuizIndex--;
            if (_currentQuizIndex < 0)
                _currentQuizIndex = _quizzes.Count - 1;
            
            UpdateCarousel();
        }

        private void NextQuiz_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            if (_quizzes.Count == 0) return;
            
            _currentQuizIndex++;
            if (_currentQuizIndex >= _quizzes.Count)
                _currentQuizIndex = 0;
            
            UpdateCarousel();
        }

        private void UpdateCarousel()
        {
            if (_quizzes.Count == 0)
            {
                CurrentQuizTitle.Text = "Нет викторин";
                CurrentQuizQuestionCount.Text = "0 вопросов";
                QuizCountText.Text = "0 / 0";
                if (CurrentQuizDescription != null)
                    CurrentQuizDescription.Text = "Создайте викторину, используя кнопки выше";
                PrevQuizButton.IsEnabled = false;
                NextQuizButton.IsEnabled = false;
                if (DeleteQuizButton != null)
                    DeleteQuizButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                return;
            }

            var quiz = _quizzes[_currentQuizIndex];
            CurrentQuizTitle.Text = quiz.Title ?? "Без названия";
            
            if (CurrentQuizDescription != null)
            {
                CurrentQuizDescription.Text = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(quiz.Description) 
                    ? "" 
                    : quiz.Description;
            }
            
            var questionCount = quiz.Questions?.Count ?? 0;
            CurrentQuizQuestionCount.Text = $"{questionCount} {GetQuestionWord(questionCount)}";
            QuizCountText.Text = $"{_currentQuizIndex + 1} / {_quizzes.Count}";
            
            // Показываем кнопку удаления
            if (DeleteQuizButton != null)
            {
                DeleteQuizButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }

            PrevQuizButton.IsEnabled = _quizzes.Count > 1;
            NextQuizButton.IsEnabled = _quizzes.Count > 1;
        }
        
        private string GetQuestionWord(int count)
        {
            if (count % 10 == 1 && count % 100 != 11) return "вопрос";
            if (count % 10 >= 2 && count % 10 <= 4 && (count % 100 < 10 || count % 100 >= 20)) return "вопроса";
            return "вопросов";
        }

        private void QuizCard_Click(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            // Проверяем, что клик был не по кнопке удаления
            if (e.OriginalSource is Button button && button.Content?.ToString() == "🗑️")
            {
                return;
            }

            if (_quizzes.Count == 0) return;
            
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            var quiz = _quizzes[_currentQuizIndex];
            try
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"QuizCard_Click: Starting edit for quiz '{quiz.Title}'");

                // Store the quiz in a static property for access from QuizEditView
                QuizEditView.SelectedQuizForEditing = quiz;
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"QuizCard_Click: Quiz stored in static property");

                // Navigate to quiz editor
                Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("QuizEdit");
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"QuizCard_Click: Navigation completed");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("QuizCard_Click failed", ex);
                var notification = new NotificationWindow($"Ошибка при открытии редактора: {ex.Message}", "error");
                notification.Show();
            }
        }

        private void DeleteQuizButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Предотвращаем всплытие события на родительский элемент
            e.Handled = true;
            
            if (_quizzes.Count == 0 || _currentQuizIndex < 0 || _currentQuizIndex >= _quizzes.Count)
                return;
            
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            var quiz = _quizzes[_currentQuizIndex];
            
            // Подтверждение удаления
            var confirmDialog = new ConfirmationDialog(
                "Подтверждение удаления",
                $"Вы уверены, что хотите удалить викторину \"{quiz.Title}\"?");
            confirmDialog.Owner = Window.GetWindow(this);
            
            if (confirmDialog.ShowDialog() == true && confirmDialog.Confirmed)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (DataContext is ViewModels.QuizEditorViewModel vm)
                    {
                        var deletedIndex = _currentQuizIndex;
                        vm.DeleteQuizCommand.Execute(quiz);
                        
                        // Обновляем список после удаления
                        UpdateQuizzesList();
                        
                        // Корректируем индекс если нужно
                        if (_quizzes.Count > 0)
                        {
                            if (deletedIndex >= _quizzes.Count)
                                _currentQuizIndex = _quizzes.Count - 1;
                            else
                                _currentQuizIndex = deletedIndex;
                            
                            UpdateCarousel();
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("DeleteQuizButton_Click failed", ex);
                    var notification = new NotificationWindow($"Ошибка при удалении викторины: {ex.Message}", "error");
                    notification.Show();
                }
            }
        }
    }

=== FILE: Views/FriendsView.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Media;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class FriendsView : Page
    {
        public FriendsView()
        {
            try
            {
                InitializeComponent();
                Loaded += FriendsView_Loaded;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("FriendsView constructor error", ex);
                throw;
            }
        }

        private async void FriendsView_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null) return;
                var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
                var friends = await social.GetFriends(current.Username);
                var online = await social.GetOnlineUsers(friends);
                FriendsListBox.ItemsSource = friends.Select(f => new { Username = f, IsOnline = online.Contains(f) }).ToList();

                var pending = await social.GetPendingFriendRequests(current.Username);
                Logger.Log($"FriendsView: Получено {pending.Count} заявок в друзья");
                foreach (var req in pending)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"  - Заявка от: {req.From_Username}, ID: {req.Id}, Status: {req.Status}");
                }
                
                var requestsList = pending.Select(p => new { FromUser = p.From_Username, RequestId = p.Id }).ToList();
                FriendRequestsListBox.ItemsSource = requestsList;
                Logger.Log($"FriendsView: Установлено {requestsList.Count} заявок в ItemsSource");
                
                // Show/hide empty state
                EmptyRequestsText.Visibility = requestsList.Count == 0 ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                
                FriendsCountText.Text = $"{friends.Count}/128";
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("FriendsView load error", ex);
            }
        }

        private void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Main");
        }

        private async void AddFriend_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            try
            {
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null) return;
                var to = (SearchUserBox.Text ?? "").Trim().TrimStart('@');
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(to))
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Введите имя пользователя", "warning").Show();
                    return;
                }
                if (string.Equals(to, current.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Нельзя добавить себя", "warning").Show();
                    return;
                }
                // Проверяем, существует ли пользователь
                var auth = new SupabaseAuthService();
                var profile = await auth.GetUserProfile(to);
                if (profile == null)
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Пользователь не найден", "error").Show();
                    return;
                }
                var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
                var ok = await social.SendFriendRequest(current.Username, to);
                new NotificationWindow(ok ? "Заявка отправлена" : "Не удалось отправить заявку", ok ? "success" : "error").Show();
                await RefreshAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("AddFriend_Click error", ex);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task RefreshAsync()
        {
            var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
            if (current == null) return;
            var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
            var friends = await social.GetFriends(current.Username);
            var online = await social.GetOnlineUsers(friends);
            FriendsListBox.ItemsSource = friends.Select(f => new { Username = f, IsOnline = online.Contains(f) }).ToList();
            
            var pending = await social.GetPendingFriendRequests(current.Username);
            Logger.Log($"RefreshAsync: Получено {pending.Count} заявок в друзья");
            var requestsList = pending.Select(p => new { FromUser = p.From_Username, RequestId = p.Id }).ToList();
            FriendRequestsListBox.ItemsSource = requestsList;
            Logger.Log($"RefreshAsync: Установлено {requestsList.Count} заявок в ItemsSource");
            
            // Show/hide empty state
            EmptyRequestsText.Visibility = requestsList.Count == 0 ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
            
            FriendsCountText.Text = $"{friends.Count}/128";
        }

        private async void RefreshFriends_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            await RefreshAsync();
        }

        private async void AcceptRequest_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            try
            {
                var button = sender as Button;
                var fromUser = button?.Tag as string;
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fromUser)) return;
                
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null) return;
                
                var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
                var pending = await social.GetPendingFriendRequests(current.Username);
                var request = pending.FirstOrDefault(r => r.From_Username == fromUser);
                if (request == null) return;
                
                var ok = await social.AcceptFriendRequest(request.Id);
                new NotificationWindow(ok ? "Заявка принята" : "Не удалось принять заявку", ok ? "success" : "error").Show();
                await RefreshAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("AcceptRequest_Click error", ex);
            }
        }

        private async void DeclineRequest_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            try
            {
                var button = sender as Button;
                var fromUser = button?.Tag as string;
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fromUser)) return;
                
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null) return;
                
                var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
                var pending = await social.GetPendingFriendRequests(current.Username);
                var request = pending.FirstOrDefault(r => r.From_Username == fromUser);
                if (request == null) return;
                
                var ok = await social.DeclineFriendRequest(request.Id);
                new NotificationWindow(ok ? "Заявка отклонена" : "Не удалось отклонить заявку", ok ? "success" : "error").Show();
                await RefreshAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("DeclineRequest_Click error", ex);
            }
        }


        private async void RemoveFriend_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            try
            {
                var button = sender as Button;
                var friend = button?.Tag as string;
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(friend)) return;
                
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null) return;
                var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
                var ok = await social.RemoveFriend(current.Username, friend);
                new NotificationWindow(ok ? "Друг удалён" : "Не удалось удалить друга", ok ? "success" : "error").Show();
                await RefreshAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("RemoveFriend_Click error", ex);
            }
        }
    }

    // Конвертер для цвета статуса
    public class BoolToOnlineColorConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is bool isOnline)
            {
                return new SolidColorBrush(isOnline ? Color.FromRgb(76, 175, 80) : Color.FromRgb(158, 158, 158));
            }
            return new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(158, 158, 158));
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }

    // Конвертер для текста статуса
    public class BoolToOnlineTextConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is bool isOnline)
            {
                return isOnline ? "В сети" : "Не в сети";
            }
            return "Не в сети";
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }

    // Конвертер для первой буквы имени
    public class FirstLetterConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is string str && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(str))
            {
                return str.Substring(0, 1).ToUpper();
            }
            return "?";
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/GameRoomsView.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Victory.Services;
using Victory.ViewModels;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Логика взаимодействия для GameRoomsView.xaml
    /// </summary>
    public partial class GameRoomsView : Page
    {
        private readonly GameRoomViewModel _viewModel;

        public GameRoomsView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _viewModel = (GameRoomViewModel)DataContext;

            // Подписываемся на изменения в ViewModel
            _viewModel.PropertyChanged += ViewModel_PropertyChanged;
            
            Loaded += GameRoomsView_Loaded;
        }
        
        private void GameRoomsView_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Обновляем список комнат
            _ = _viewModel.RefreshRoomsAsync();
        }

        private void ViewModel_PropertyChanged(object sender, System.ComponentModel.PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.PropertyName == nameof(GameRoomViewModel.CurrentRoom))
            {
                UpdateCurrentRoomDisplay();
            }
        }

        private void UpdateCurrentRoomDisplay()
        {
            if (_viewModel.CurrentRoom != null)
            {
                CurrentRoomPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                NoRoomPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

                RoomNameText.Text = _viewModel.CurrentRoom.RoomName;
                RoomCodeText.Text = $"Код: {_viewModel.CurrentRoom.RoomCode}";
                RoomPlayersText.Text = $"{_viewModel.CurrentRoom.CurrentPlayers}/{_viewModel.CurrentRoom.MaxPlayers} игроков";
            }
            else
            {
                CurrentRoomPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                NoRoomPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
        }

        private void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("MultiplayerMenu");
        }

        private void CreateRoom_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            // Переходим на новый экран создания комнаты (с выбором викторины и валидацией)
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("CreateMultiplayerRoom");
        }

        private void RefreshRooms_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            _ = _viewModel.RefreshRoomsAsync();
        }

        private void StartGame_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            // Команда StartGameCommand выполнится через Binding
        }

        private void LeaveRoom_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            // Команда LeaveRoomCommand выполнится через Binding
        }

        private void JoinRoom_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();

            try
            {
                if (sender is not Button button || button.Tag is not ViewModels.GameRoom room)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[GameRoomsView] Invalid sender or Tag for JoinRoom_Click");
                    return;
                }

                Logger.Log($"[GameRoomsView] Attempting to join room: {room.RoomName} (IsPrivate: {room.IsPrivate})");

                // Если комната закрытая, показываем диалог ввода пароля
                if (room.IsPrivate)
                {
                    var passwordDialog = new RoomPasswordDialog
                    {
                        Owner = Window.GetWindow(this)
                    };

                    if (passwordDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
                    {
                        // Проверяем пароль
                        if (passwordDialog.EnteredPassword != room.Password)
                        {
                            Logger.Log("[GameRoomsView] Incorrect password");
                            var notification = new NotificationWindow("Неверный пароль", "error");
                            notification.Show();
                            return;
                        }

                        Logger.Log("[GameRoomsView] Password correct, joining room");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Logger.Log("[GameRoomsView] User cancelled password dialog");
                        return;
                    }
                }

                // Присоединяемся к комнате
                if (_viewModel.JoinRoomCommand.CanExecute(room.RoomCode))
                {
                    _viewModel.JoinRoomCommand.Execute(room.RoomCode);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GameRoomsView] JoinRoom_Click error", ex);
                var notification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при присоединении к комнате", "error");
                notification.Show();
            }
        }
        private void JoinByCode_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            try
            {
                string code = RoomCodeInput.Text?.Trim();
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(code))
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Введите код комнаты", "warning").Show();
                    return;
                }

                Logger.Log($"[GameRoomsView] Attempting to join by code: {code}");

                if (_viewModel.JoinRoomCommand.CanExecute(code))
                {
                    _viewModel.JoinRoomCommand.Execute(code);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[GameRoomsView] JoinByCode_Click error", ex);
                new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при присоединении", "error").Show();
            }
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/InviteFriendsDialog.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class InviteFriendsDialog : Window
    {
        public string[] SelectedUsernames { get; private set; } = Array.Empty<string>();
        private readonly string[] _friends;

        public InviteFriendsDialog(string[] friends)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            try
            {
                _friends = friends ?? Array.Empty<string>();
                Logger.Log($"[InviteFriendsDialog] ctor. friends={_friends.Length}");
                Title = "Выбор друзей";
                // Инициализация пустыми списками — фактическая раскладка выполняется асинхронно после Loaded
                OnlineList.ItemsSource = new List<string>();
                OfflineList.ItemsSource = _friends.Select(u => "@" + u).Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();
                Loaded += InviteFriendsDialog_Loaded;
            }
            catch
            {
                _friends = friends ?? Array.Empty<string>();
                var list = _friends.Select(u => "@" + u).ToList();
                OnlineList.ItemsSource = list;
                OfflineList.ItemsSource = new List<string>();
                Logger.Log("[InviteFriendsDialog] fallback single-list mode");
            }
        }

        private async void InviteFriendsDialog_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
                var task = social.GetOnlineUsers(_friends);
                var completed = await Task.WhenAny(task, Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8)));
                var onlineSet = completed == task ? await task : new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

                var online = new List<string>();
                var offline = new List<string>();
                foreach (var f in _friends.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    if (onlineSet.Contains(f)) online.Add("@" + f); else offline.Add("@" + f);
                }

                OnlineList.ItemsSource = online;
                OfflineList.ItemsSource = offline;
                Logger.Log($"[InviteFriendsDialog] prepared lists (async): online={online.Count}, offline={offline.Count}");
                if (online.Count == 0) Title = "Нет друзей в сети — можно выбрать любого";
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[InviteFriendsDialog] async prepare error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        private void Cancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DialogResult = false;
            Close();
        }

        private void Invite_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            var s1 = OnlineList.SelectedItems.Cast<string>().Select(s => s.TrimStart('@'));
            var s2 = OfflineList.SelectedItems.Cast<string>().Select(s => s.TrimStart('@'));
            SelectedUsernames = s1.Concat(s2).Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToArray();
            Logger.Log($"[InviteFriendsDialog] Invite_Click: selected={SelectedUsernames.Length}");
            DialogResult = true;
            Close();
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/LoadingView.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class LoadingView : Page
    {
        private readonly List<string> _loadingMessages = new List<string>();

        private int _currentMessageIndex = 0;
        private DispatcherTimer? _messageTimer;
        private DispatcherTimer? _progressTimer;
        private double _progress = 0;

        public LoadingView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            InitializeLoadingMessages();
            StartLoadingAnimation();
        }

        private void InitializeLoadingMessages()
        {
            _loadingMessages.Clear();
            _loadingMessages.Add(Application.Current.Resources["LoadingInit"] as string ?? "Initializing application...");
            _loadingMessages.Add(Application.Current.Resources["LoadingConfig"] as string ?? "Setting up quizzes...");
            _loadingMessages.Add(Application.Current.Resources["AppearanceTitle"] as string ?? "🎨 Applying styles...");
            _loadingMessages.Add(Application.Current.Resources["AudioTitle"] as string ?? "🔊 Setting up audio...");
            _loadingMessages.Add(Application.Current.Resources["SettingsTitle"] as string ?? "⚙️ Loading settings...");
            _loadingMessages.Add("✨ " + (Application.Current.Resources["LoadingInit"] as string ?? "Almost ready..."));
            _loadingMessages.Add(Application.Current.Resources["LoadingStart"] as string ?? "Starting Victory!");
        }

        private void StartLoadingAnimation()
        {
            // Character jumping animation
            var jumpAnimation = new DoubleAnimation
            {
                From = 0,
                To = -20,
                Duration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500),
                AutoReverse = true,
                RepeatBehavior = RepeatBehavior.Forever,
                EasingFunction = new CubicEase { EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut }
            };

            CharacterTranslate.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.YProperty, jumpAnimation);

            // Squash and stretch animation
            // Squash (ScaleY < 1, ScaleX > 1) when on ground
            // Stretch (ScaleY > 1, ScaleX < 1) when jumping
            
            var scaleYAnimation = new DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames
            {
                RepeatBehavior = RepeatBehavior.Forever,
                Duration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1000)
            };

            // 0ms: Start (Ground) - Normal or slight squash
            scaleYAnimation.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(0.9, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(0))));
            
            // 100ms: Launch (Stretch)
            scaleYAnimation.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(1.1, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100))));
            
            // 500ms: Peak (Normal/Slight Stretch)
            scaleYAnimation.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(1.0, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500))));
            
            // 900ms: Landing (Stretch)
            scaleYAnimation.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(1.1, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(900))));
            
            // 1000ms: Ground (Squash)
            scaleYAnimation.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(0.9, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1000))));

            CharacterScale.BeginAnimation(ScaleTransform.ScaleYProperty, scaleYAnimation);

            // Inverse scale for X to maintain volume
            var scaleXAnimation = new DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames
            {
                RepeatBehavior = RepeatBehavior.Forever,
                Duration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1000)
            };

            scaleXAnimation.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(1.1, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(0))));
            scaleXAnimation.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(0.9, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100))));
            scaleXAnimation.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(1.0, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500))));
            scaleXAnimation.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(0.9, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(900))));
            scaleXAnimation.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(1.1, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1000))));

            CharacterScale.BeginAnimation(ScaleTransform.ScaleXProperty, scaleXAnimation);

            // Progress bar animation: fill green from left to right
            var progressAnimation = new DoubleAnimation
            {
                From = 0,
                To = 1,
                Duration = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3.5),
                EasingFunction = new CubicEase { EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut }
            };
            ProgressTransform.BeginAnimation(ScaleTransform.ScaleXProperty, progressAnimation);

            // Message rotation
            _messageTimer = new DispatcherTimer
            {
                Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500)
            };
            _messageTimer.Tick += MessageTimer_Tick;
            _messageTimer.Start();

            // Progress simulation
            _progressTimer = new DispatcherTimer
            {
                Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(50)
            };
            _progressTimer.Tick += ProgressTimer_Tick;
            _progressTimer.Start();
        }

        private void MessageTimer_Tick(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (_currentMessageIndex < _loadingMessages.Count)
            {
                StatusText.Text = _loadingMessages[_currentMessageIndex];
                _currentMessageIndex++;
            }
            else
            {
                _messageTimer.Stop();
                _progressTimer.Stop();
                
                // Navigate to login after loading is complete
                var timer = new DispatcherTimer
                {
                    Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500)
                };
                timer.Tick += async (s, args) =>
                {
                    timer.Stop();
                    // Check if user is already logged in
                    try
                    {
                        var currentUser = Victory.Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                        if (currentUser != null)
                        {
                            // User is logged in, preload data then go to main page
                            await PreloadUserDataAsync();
                            
                            // Запускаем глобальный сервис социальных уведомлений
                            Victory.Services.SocialNotificationService.Instance.Start();
                            
                            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Main");
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            // User is not logged in, go to login page
                            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Login");
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        // If there's any error, go to login page
                        Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Login");
                    }
                };
                timer.Start();
            }
        }

        private void ProgressTimer_Tick(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            _progress += 0.5;
            if (_progress > 100)
            {
                _progress = 100;
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task PreloadUserDataAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("[LoadingView] Preloading user data...");
                
                // Загружаем викторины в фоне
                var quizService = new Victory.Services.QuizEditorService();
                var quizzes = await quizService.GetAllQuizzesAsync();
                
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[LoadingView] Preloaded {quizzes.Count} quizzes");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError($"[LoadingView] Error preloading user data: {ex.Message}", ex);
                // Не показываем ошибку пользователю - это не критично
            }
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/LoginView.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Victory.Services;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class LoginView : Page
    {
        private bool _isLoginTab = true;

        public LoginView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        private void LoginTab_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            _isLoginTab = true;
            UpdateTabAppearance();
            LoginContent.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            RegisterContent.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        }

        private void RegisterTab_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            _isLoginTab = false;
            UpdateTabAppearance();
            LoginContent.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            RegisterContent.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        }

        private void UpdateTabAppearance()
        {
            if (_isLoginTab)
            {
                LoginTabButton.Style = (Style)FindResource("MaterialDesignRaisedButton");
                LoginTabButton.Background = (System.Windows.Media.Brush)FindResource("PrimaryHueMidBrush");
                LoginTabButton.Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White;
                
                RegisterTabButton.Style = (Style)FindResource("MaterialDesignOutlinedButton");
                RegisterTabButton.Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
                RegisterTabButton.Foreground = (System.Windows.Media.Brush)FindResource("MaterialDesignBody");
            }
            else
            {
                RegisterTabButton.Style = (Style)FindResource("MaterialDesignRaisedButton");
                RegisterTabButton.Background = (System.Windows.Media.Brush)FindResource("PrimaryHueMidBrush");
                RegisterTabButton.Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White;
                
                LoginTabButton.Style = (Style)FindResource("MaterialDesignOutlinedButton");
                LoginTabButton.Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
                LoginTabButton.Foreground = (System.Windows.Media.Brush)FindResource("MaterialDesignBody");
            }
        }

        private async void LoginButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            string login = LoginBox.Text;
            // Получаем пароль из правильного поля в зависимости от видимости
            string password = PasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible 
                ? PasswordBox.Password 
                : PasswordBoxVisible.Text;

            try
            {
                var user = await UserService.Login(login, password);
                Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlaySuccessSound();
                
                // Предзагружаем викторины сразу после логина
                await PreloadUserDataAsync();
                
                ShowWelcomeNotification($"Добро пожаловать, {user.Username}!");
                // Навигация теперь происходит в ShowWelcomeNotification
            }
            catch (UserAlreadyActiveException ex)
            {
                // Специальная обработка для "Пользователь уже активен"
                Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayErrorSound();
                var message = string.Format(LocalizationService.GetString("UserAlreadyActiveMessage"), ex.Username);
                ShowErrorNotification(message);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayErrorSound();
                // Доп. локализация типичных английских сообщений, если вдруг просочились
                var msg = ex.Message;
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(msg))
                {
                    if (msg.Contains("Invalid login credentials", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        msg.Contains("invalid_credentials", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        msg.Contains("Invalid email or password", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        msg = "Неверный логин или пароль";
                    }
                }
                ShowErrorNotification(msg);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task PreloadUserDataAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log("[LoginView] Preloading user data after login...");
                
                // Загружаем викторины в фоне
                var quizService = new QuizEditorService();
                var quizzes = await quizService.GetAllQuizzesAsync();
                
                Logger.Log($"[LoginView] Preloaded {quizzes.Count} quizzes");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[LoginView] Error preloading user data: {ex.Message}", ex);
                // Не показываем ошибку пользователю - это не критично
            }
        }

        private async void RegisterButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            string login = RegisterLoginBox.Text;
            // Получаем пароли из правильных полей в зависимости от видимости
            string password = RegisterPasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible 
                ? RegisterPasswordBox.Password 
                : RegisterPasswordBoxVisible.Text;
            string confirmPassword = ConfirmPasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible 
                ? ConfirmPasswordBox.Password 
                : ConfirmPasswordBoxVisible.Text;

            // Manual validation before calling service
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(login))
            {
                Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayErrorSound();
                ShowErrorNotification("Логин не может быть пустым.");
                return;
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password) || password.Length < 6)
            {
                Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayErrorSound();
                ShowErrorNotification("Пароль должен быть не менее 6 символов.");
                return;
            }
            if (password != confirmPassword)
            {
                Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayErrorSound();
                ShowErrorNotification("Пароли не совпадают.");
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                var user = await UserService.Register(login, password);
                Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlaySuccessSound();
                ShowSuccessNotification("Регистрация успешна! Теперь вы можете войти.");
                // Clear fields after successful registration
                RegisterLoginBox.Clear();
                RegisterPasswordBox.Clear();
                ConfirmPasswordBox.Clear();
                // Switch to login tab
                LoginTab_Click(sender, e);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayErrorSound();
                ShowErrorNotification(ex.Message);
            }
        }

        private void PasswordBox_PasswordChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (RegisterPasswordBox.Password.Length < 6 && RegisterPasswordBox.Password.Length > 0)
            {
                PasswordErrorText.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
            else
            {
                PasswordErrorText.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }
            ValidateConfirmPassword();
        }

        private void ConfirmPasswordBox_PasswordChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            ValidateConfirmPassword();
        }

        private void ValidateConfirmPassword()
        {
            if (ConfirmPasswordBox.Password != RegisterPasswordBox.Password && ConfirmPasswordBox.Password.Length > 0)
            {
                ConfirmPasswordErrorText.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
            else
            {
                ConfirmPasswordErrorText.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }
        }

        private void ShowWelcomeNotification(string message)
        {
            // Запускаем глобальный сервис социальных уведомлений
            Victory.Services.SocialNotificationService.Instance.Start();
            
            // Быстрый переход без задержки
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Main");
            
            // Показываем уведомление в фоне
            var notification = new NotificationWindow(message, "success");
            notification.Show();
        }

        private void ShowSuccessNotification(string message)
        {
            var notification = new NotificationWindow(message, "success");
            notification.Show();
        }

        private void ShowErrorNotification(string message)
        {
            var notification = new NotificationWindow(message, "error");
            notification.Show();
        }

        private void SettingsButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Settings");
        }

        // Обработка Enter для входа
        private void LoginBox_KeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == System.Windows.Input.Key.Enter)
            {
                PasswordBox.Focus();
            }
        }

        private void PasswordBox_KeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == System.Windows.Input.Key.Enter)
            {
                e.Handled = true;
                LoginButton_Click(sender, e);
            }
        }

        // Обработка Enter для регистрации
        private void RegisterLoginBox_KeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == System.Windows.Input.Key.Enter)
            {
                if (RegisterPasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
                {
                    RegisterPasswordBox.Focus();
                }
                else
                {
                    RegisterPasswordBoxVisible.Focus();
                }
            }
        }

        private void RegisterPasswordBox_KeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == System.Windows.Input.Key.Enter)
            {
                e.Handled = true;
                // Переходим на следующее поле или регистрируемся
                if (ConfirmPasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
                {
                    ConfirmPasswordBox.Focus();
                }
                else if (ConfirmPasswordBoxVisible.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
                {
                    ConfirmPasswordBoxVisible.Focus();
                }
                else
                {
                    RegisterButton_Click(sender, e);
                }
            }
        }

        private void ConfirmPasswordBox_KeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == System.Windows.Input.Key.Enter)
            {
                e.Handled = true;
                RegisterButton_Click(sender, e);
            }
        }

        // Переключение видимости пароля для входа
        private void PasswordToggleButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (PasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
            {
                PasswordBoxVisible.Text = PasswordBox.Password;
                PasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                PasswordBoxVisible.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                PasswordToggleIcon.Kind = MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf.PackIconKind.EyeOff;
            }
            else
            {
                PasswordBox.Password = PasswordBoxVisible.Text;
                PasswordBoxVisible.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                PasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                PasswordToggleIcon.Kind = MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf.PackIconKind.Eye;
            }
        }

        // Переключение видимости пароля для регистрации
        private void RegisterPasswordToggleButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (RegisterPasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
            {
                RegisterPasswordBoxVisible.Text = RegisterPasswordBox.Password;
                RegisterPasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                RegisterPasswordBoxVisible.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                RegisterPasswordToggleIcon.Kind = MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf.PackIconKind.EyeOff;
            }
            else
            {
                RegisterPasswordBox.Password = RegisterPasswordBoxVisible.Text;
                RegisterPasswordBoxVisible.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                RegisterPasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                RegisterPasswordToggleIcon.Kind = MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf.PackIconKind.Eye;
            }
        }

        // Переключение видимости подтверждения пароля
        private void ConfirmPasswordToggleButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (ConfirmPasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
            {
                ConfirmPasswordBoxVisible.Text = ConfirmPasswordBox.Password;
                ConfirmPasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                ConfirmPasswordBoxVisible.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                ConfirmPasswordToggleIcon.Kind = MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf.PackIconKind.EyeOff;
            }
            else
            {
                ConfirmPasswordBox.Password = ConfirmPasswordBoxVisible.Text;
                ConfirmPasswordBoxVisible.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                ConfirmPasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                ConfirmPasswordToggleIcon.Kind = MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf.PackIconKind.Eye;
            }
        }

        // Синхронизация TextBox с PasswordBox для регистрации
        private void RegisterPasswordBoxVisible_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (RegisterPasswordBoxVisible.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
            {
                RegisterPasswordBox.Password = RegisterPasswordBoxVisible.Text;
            }
        }

        // Синхронизация TextBox с PasswordBox для подтверждения
        private void ConfirmPasswordBoxVisible_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (ConfirmPasswordBoxVisible.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
            {
                ConfirmPasswordBox.Password = ConfirmPasswordBoxVisible.Text;
            }
        }
    }

=== FILE: Views/MainView.xaml.cs ===

using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class MainView : Page
    {

        public MainView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            Loaded += MainView_Loaded;
        }

        private void CreateQuiz_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Editor");
        }

        private void PlayQuiz_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayQuizStartSound();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Player");
        }

        private void Settings_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Settings");
        }

        private void Multiplayer_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("MultiplayerMenu");
        }

        private void Friends_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Friends");
        }

        private void ProfileButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Profile");
        }

        private void MainView_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Инициализация бейджа друзей от нового сервиса
            try
            {
                UpdateFriendsBadge(Victory.Services.SocialNotificationService.Instance.PendingFriendRequestsCount);
                Victory.Services.SocialNotificationService.Instance.PendingFriendRequestsChanged += (s, args) =>
                {
                    UpdateFriendsBadge(Victory.Services.SocialNotificationService.Instance.PendingFriendRequestsCount);
                };
            }
            catch { }
        }

        private void UpdateFriendsBadge(int pendingFriends)
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                var badge = (System.Windows.Controls.Border)FindName("FriendsBadge");
                var text = (System.Windows.Controls.TextBlock)FindName("FriendsBadgeText");
                if (badge == null || text == null) return;
                if (pendingFriends > 0)
                {
                    text.Text = pendingFriends > 9 ? "9+" : pendingFriends.ToString();
                    badge.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                }
                else
                {
                    badge.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }
            });
        }

        private async void LogoutButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is System.Windows.Controls.Button button)
            {
                button.IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем кнопку сразу
            }
            
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            // Показываем loading overlay и блокируем взаимодействие
            try
            {
                LogoutLoadingOverlay.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем всё взаимодействие
            }
            catch { }
            
            // Останавливаем сервис социальных уведомлений
            Victory.Services.SocialNotificationService.Instance.Stop();
            
            // Если пользователь в комнате — корректно выходим
            try
            {
                var currentRoom = Victory.Services.RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;
                var cu = Victory.Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentRoom != null && cu != null)
                {
                    var svc = new Victory.Services.SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                    _ = svc.LeaveRoom(currentRoom.Id, cu.Username); // Не ждём завершения
                }
            }
            catch { }

            await Victory.Services.UserService.Logout();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Login");
        }
    }
}

using System.Windows;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class MiniProfileDialog : Window
    {
        public MiniProfileDialog(string displayName, string username, string stats, string? avatarPath = null)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            DisplayNameText.Text = displayName;
            UsernameText.Text = "@" + username;
            StatsText.Text = stats;
            
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(avatarPath))
            {
                try
                {
                    var bitmap = new System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapImage();
                    bitmap.BeginInit();
                    
                    // Handle relative paths (assuming they are in Supabase Storage or local resources)
                    // For now, assuming full URL or local file path. If it's a relative path from Supabase, we might need to prepend the base URL.
                    // But usually AvatarPath in this app seems to be a full URL or a local resource path?
                    // Let's try to use it as is.
                    
                    bitmap.UriSource = new System.Uri(avatarPath, System.UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
                    bitmap.CacheOption = System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
                    bitmap.EndInit();
                    
                    AvatarEllipse.Fill = new System.Windows.Media.ImageBrush(bitmap) 
                    { 
                        Stretch = System.Windows.Media.Stretch.UniformToFill 
                    };
                }
                catch (System.Exception ex)
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.LogError($"[MiniProfileDialog] Error loading avatar: {ex.Message}");
                }
            }

            Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[MiniProfileDialog] opened for @{username} ({displayName})");
        }

        private void Close_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DialogResult = true;
            Close();
        }

        private async void AddFriend_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                var current = Victory.Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null)
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Требуется вход", "error").Show();
                    return;
                }
                var toUsername = UsernameText.Text.TrimStart('@');
                var social = new Victory.Services.SupabaseSocialService();
                var ok = await social.SendFriendRequest(current.Username, toUsername);
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[MiniProfileDialog] AddFriend_Click: from={current.Username} to={toUsername} ok={ok}");
                new NotificationWindow(ok ? "Заявка в друзья отправлена" : "Не удалось отправить заявку", ok ? "success" : "error").Show();
            }
            catch (System.Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("AddFriend_Click error", ex);
                new NotificationWindow("Ошибка отправки заявки", "error").Show();
            }
        }

        private async void Invite_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                var current = Victory.Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null)
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Требуется вход", "error").Show();
                    return;
                }
                var room = Victory.Services.RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;
                if (room == null)
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Комната не найдена", "error").Show();
                    return;
                }
                var toUsername = UsernameText.Text.TrimStart('@');
                // Block invite if already in room
                try
                {
                    var svc = new Victory.Services.SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                    var players = await svc.GetRoomPlayersPublic(room.Id);
                    if (players.Any(p => string.Equals(p.Username, toUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                    {
                        new NotificationWindow("Пользователь уже в комнате", "warning").Show();
                        return;
                    }
                }
                catch { }
                var social = new Victory.Services.SupabaseSocialService();
                var ok = await social.InviteToRoom(room.Id, current.Username, toUsername);
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"[MiniProfileDialog] Invite_Click: from={current.Username} to={toUsername} room={room.Id} ok={ok}");
                new NotificationWindow(ok ? "Приглашение отправлено" : "Не удалось отправить приглашение", ok ? "success" : "error").Show();
            }
            catch (System.Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("Invite_Click error", ex);
                new NotificationWindow("Ошибка отправки приглашения", "error").Show();
            }
        }
    }
}
