=== FILE: Views/MiniProfileTooltip.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Victory.Services;
using GameRoomPlayer = Victory.ViewModels.GameRoomPlayer;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class MiniProfileTooltip : UserControl, INotifyPropertyChanged
    {
        // Кэш для загруженных профилей (чтобы не загружать повторно)
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, CachedProfile> _profileCache = new Dictionary<string, CachedProfile>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        
        private string? _displayName;
        private string? _username;
        private string? _avatarPath;
        private int _score;
        private bool _isReady;
        private bool _isLoading = false;
        private bool _hasLoaded = false;

        public string? DisplayName
        {
            get => _displayName;
            set { _displayName = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        public string? Username
        {
            get => _username;
            set { _username = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        public string? AvatarPath
        {
            get => _avatarPath;
            set { _avatarPath = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        public int Score
        {
            get => _score;
            set { _score = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        public bool IsReady
        {
            get => _isReady;
            set { _isReady = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

        public MiniProfileTooltip()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            DataContextChanged += MiniProfileTooltip_DataContextChanged;
        }

        private string? _lastUsername = null;

        private void MiniProfileTooltip_DataContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.NewValue is GameRoomPlayer player)
            {
                // Всегда обновляем динамические данные (Score, IsReady) при каждом изменении
                Score = player.Score;
                IsReady = player.IsReady;

                // Обновляем статические данные только если это другой игрок
                bool isNewPlayer = _lastUsername != player.Username;
                if (isNewPlayer)
                {
                    Username = player.Username;
                    DisplayName = player.DisplayName;
                    AvatarPath = player.AvatarPath;
                    _lastUsername = player.Username;
                    _hasLoaded = false; // Сбрасываем флаг загрузки для нового игрока
                }

                // Загружаем полные данные профиля один раз для каждого игрока (если еще не загружены)
                if (isNewPlayer && !_isLoading)
                {
                    _ = LoadProfileDataAsync(player.Username);
                }
            }
            else if (e.NewValue == null)
            {
                // Очищаем данные при удалении DataContext
                _lastUsername = null;
                _hasLoaded = false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Обновить статус готовности (вызывается при изменении статуса игрока)
        /// </summary>
        public void UpdateReadyStatus(bool isReady)
        {
            IsReady = isReady;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Обновить счет (вызывается при изменении счета игрока)
        /// </summary>
        public void UpdateScore(int score)
        {
            Score = score;
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadProfileDataAsync(string username)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username) || _isLoading || _hasLoaded)
                return;

            _isLoading = true;

            try
            {
                // Проверяем кэш
                if (_profileCache.TryGetValue(username, out var cached))
                {
                    // Используем кэшированные данные
                    DisplayName = cached.DisplayName;
                    AvatarPath = cached.AvatarPath;
                    _hasLoaded = true;
                    Logger.Log($"[MiniProfileTooltip] Using cached profile for {username}");
                    return;
                }

                // Загружаем профиль из Supabase
                var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(username);

                if (profile != null)
                {
                    // Обновляем данные
                    DisplayName = profile.DisplayName;
                    
                    // Обрабатываем AvatarPath (может быть URL или локальный путь)
                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile.AvatarPath))
                    {
                        if (profile.AvatarPath.StartsWith("http://") || profile.AvatarPath.StartsWith("https://"))
                        {
                            AvatarPath = profile.AvatarPath;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            // Локальный путь
                            var localAvatarPath = System.IO.Path.Combine(
                                AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory,
                                "Data", "Avatars", $"{username}_avatar.png"
                            );
                            if (System.IO.File.Exists(localAvatarPath))
                            {
                                AvatarPath = localAvatarPath;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                AvatarPath = profile.AvatarPath;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Кэшируем данные
                    _profileCache[username] = new CachedProfile
                    {
                        DisplayName = profile.DisplayName,
                        AvatarPath = AvatarPath
                    };

                    _hasLoaded = true;
                    Logger.Log($"[MiniProfileTooltip] Loaded profile for {username}: {DisplayName}");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[MiniProfileTooltip] Error loading profile for {username}: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                _isLoading = false;
            }
        }

        protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string? propertyName = null)
        {
            PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
        }

        private class CachedProfile
        {
            public string DisplayName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
            public string? AvatarPath { get; set; }
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/MultiplayerQuizView.xaml.cs ===

using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class MultiplayerQuizView : Page
    {
        private int _correctIndex = -1;
        private string? _buzzedPlayer;

        public MultiplayerQuizView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            LoadQuestion();
            RefreshScores();
            this.Focusable = true;
            this.Loaded += (_, __) => this.Focus();
            this.PreviewKeyDown += OnPreviewKeyDown;
        }

        private void LoadQuestion()
        {
            var q = MultiplayerService.GetCurrentQuestion();
            if (q == null)
            {
                // Show winners
                // Show winner window, then back to main
                var win = new WinnerWindow { Owner = Window.GetWindow(this) };
                win.ShowDialog();
                Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Main");
                return;
            }
            QuestionText.Text = q.Text;
            _correctIndex = q.CorrectAnswerIndex;
            OptionsList.ItemsSource = q.Options.ToList();
        }

        private void RefreshScores()
        {
            ScoresList.ItemsSource = null;
            ScoresList.ItemsSource = MultiplayerService.Players.ToList();
        }

        private void Option_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is Button b && b.Content is string chosen)
            {
                // Real-time: if someone buzzed first, use that player; otherwise ask
                string? player = _buzzedPlayer;
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(player))
                {
                    var picker = new WinnerPickerWindow();
                    if (picker.ShowDialog() == true && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(picker.SelectedPlayer))
                    {
                        player = picker.SelectedPlayer;
                    }
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(player))
                {
                    var q = MultiplayerService.GetCurrentQuestion();
                    int chosenIndex = OptionsList.Items.IndexOf(chosen);
                    if (q != null && chosenIndex == _correctIndex)
                    {
                        MultiplayerService.AwardPoint(player);
                        RefreshScores();
                        SoundService.Instance.PlaySuccessSound();
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        SoundService.Instance.PlayErrorSound();
                    }
                    ClearBuzz();
                }
            }
        }

        private void Next_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!MultiplayerService.NextQuestion())
            {
                var win = new WinnerWindow { Owner = Window.GetWindow(this) };
                win.ShowDialog();
                Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Main");
            }
            else
            {
                LoadQuestion();
            }
        }

        private void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("MultiplayerSetup");
        }

        private void ResetBuzz_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            ClearBuzz();
        }

        private void OnPreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            // Map 1..9 to Players list index 0..8
            int idx = e.Key switch
            {
                Key.D1 or Key.NumPad1 => 0,
                Key.D2 or Key.NumPad2 => 1,
                Key.D3 or Key.NumPad3 => 2,
                Key.D4 or Key.NumPad4 => 3,
                Key.D5 or Key.NumPad5 => 4,
                Key.D6 or Key.NumPad6 => 5,
                Key.D7 or Key.NumPad7 => 6,
                Key.D8 or Key.NumPad8 => 7,
                Key.D9 or Key.NumPad9 => 8,
                _ => -1
            };
            if (idx < 0) return;
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_buzzedPlayer)) return; // already buzzed
            if (idx >= MultiplayerService.Players.Count) return;

            _buzzedPlayer = MultiplayerService.Players[idx].Name;
            HighlightBuzz(idx);
            SoundService.Instance.PlayNotificationSound();
        }

        private void HighlightBuzz(int playerIndex)
        {
            // visually highlight selected player panel
            // simplistic: refresh list so styles can be applied later; currently just notify via hint text
            BuzzHint.Text = $"Ход: {_buzzedPlayer}";
        }

        private void ClearBuzz()
        {
            _buzzedPlayer = null;
            BuzzHint.Text = "Нажмите 1–9 чтобы нажать кнопку";
        }
    }
}

using System.Linq;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class MultiplayerSetupView : Page
    {
        public MultiplayerSetupView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            RefreshPlayers();
        }

        private void RefreshPlayers()
        {
            PlayersList.ItemsSource = null;
            PlayersList.ItemsSource = MultiplayerService.Players.ToList();
        }

        private void AddPlayer_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            MultiplayerService.AddPlayer(PlayerNameBox.Text);
            PlayerNameBox.Text = string.Empty;
            RefreshPlayers();
        }

        private void RemovePlayer_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is Button btn && btn.Tag is string name)
            {
                MultiplayerService.RemovePlayer(name);
                RefreshPlayers();
            }
        }

        private void Start_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Load questions from QuizService
            var qs = new QuizService().GetQuestions();
            MultiplayerService.StartNewQuiz(qs);
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("MultiplayerQuiz");
        }

        private void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Main");
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Victory.Models;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class NetworkRoomHostView : Page
    {
        private string _roomCode = string.Empty;
        private bool _isConnected = false;

        public NetworkRoomHostView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            GenerateRoomCode();
            SetupNetworkEvents();
        }

        private void GenerateRoomCode()
        {
            var random = new Random();
            _roomCode = random.Next(100000, 999999).ToString();
            RoomCodeText.Text = _roomCode;
        }

        private void SetupNetworkEvents()
        {
            NetworkService.Instance.RoomCreated += OnRoomCreated;
            NetworkService.Instance.PlayerJoined += OnPlayerJoined;
            NetworkService.Instance.PlayerLeft += OnPlayerLeft;
            NetworkService.Instance.GameStarted += OnGameStarted;
            NetworkService.Instance.HostDisconnected += OnHostDisconnected;
        }

        private void OnRoomCreated(string roomCode)
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                ConnectionStatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Green;
                ConnectionStatusText.Text = "Подключено";
                if (StatusIndicator != null) StatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Green;
                if (StatusText != null) StatusText.Text = "Подключено";
                _isConnected = true;
            });
        }

        private void OnPlayerJoined(string playerName, int count)
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                PlayersList.ItemsSource = NetworkService.Instance.Players;
                PlayersCountText.Text = $"{count} игроков";
            });
        }

        private void OnPlayerLeft(string playerName)
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                PlayersList.ItemsSource = NetworkService.Instance.Players;
                PlayersCountText.Text = $"{NetworkService.Instance.Players.Count} игроков";
            });
        }

        private void OnGameStarted()
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                // Navigate to game view
                Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("NetworkRoomGame");
            });
        }

        private void OnHostDisconnected()
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                ConnectionStatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red;
                ConnectionStatusText.Text = "Хост отключился";
                if (StatusIndicator != null) StatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red;
                if (StatusText != null) StatusText.Text = "Отключено";
                _isConnected = false;
            });
        }

        private async void Connect_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            try
            {
                var hostName = HostNameTextBox.Text.Trim();
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(hostName))
                {
                    hostName = "Ведущий";
                }

                // Start embedded server automatically
                ConnectionStatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Yellow;
                ConnectionStatusText.Text = "Запуск сервера...";
                if (StatusIndicator != null) StatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Yellow;
                if (StatusText != null) StatusText.Text = "Запуск сервера...";

                var serverStarted = await Server.EmbeddedServerHost.StartAsync();
                if (!serverStarted)
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Не удалось запустить сервер", "error").Show();
                    ConnectionStatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red;
                    ConnectionStatusText.Text = "Отключено";
                    if (StatusIndicator != null) StatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red;
                    if (StatusText != null) StatusText.Text = "Отключено";
                    return;
                }

                // Give server time to initialize
                await Task.Delay(300);

                // Connect to embedded server
                var success = await NetworkService.Instance.ConnectToServer("http://localhost:5000/gamehub");
                
                if (success)
                {
                    // Create room
                    var quizData = "{}"; // TODO: Get actual quiz data
                    await NetworkService.Instance.CreateRoom(_roomCode, hostName, quizData);
                    
                    ConnectionStatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Yellow;
                    ConnectionStatusText.Text = "Подключение...";
                    if (StatusIndicator != null) StatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Yellow;
                    if (StatusText != null) StatusText.Text = "Подключение...";
                }
                else
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Не удалось подключиться к серверу", "error").Show();
                    ConnectionStatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red;
                    ConnectionStatusText.Text = "Отключено";
                    if (StatusIndicator != null) StatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red;
                    if (StatusText != null) StatusText.Text = "Отключено";
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to start server or connect", ex);
                new NotificationWindow("Ошибка запуска сервера", "error").Show();
                ConnectionStatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red;
                ConnectionStatusText.Text = "Отключено";
                if (StatusIndicator != null) StatusIndicator.Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red;
                if (StatusText != null) StatusText.Text = "Отключено";
            }
        }

        private void CopyCode_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            try
            {
                System.Windows.Clipboard.SetText(_roomCode);
                new NotificationWindow("Код скопирован в буфер обмена", "success").Show();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to copy room code", ex);
                new NotificationWindow("Ошибка копирования кода", "error").Show();
            }
        }

        private async void StartGame_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            if (_isConnected && NetworkService.Instance.Players.Count > 0)
            {
                await NetworkService.Instance.StartGame();
            }
            else
            {
                new NotificationWindow("Добавьте игроков для начала игры", "warning").Show();
            }
        }

        private async void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            await NetworkService.Instance.Disconnect();
            await Server.EmbeddedServerHost.StopAsync();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("MultiplayerMenu");
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class NetworkRoomJoinView : Page
    {
        public NetworkRoomJoinView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            RoomCodeTextBox.Focus();
            SetupNetworkEvents();
        }

        private void SetupNetworkEvents()
        {
            NetworkService.Instance.JoinSuccess += OnJoinSuccess;
            NetworkService.Instance.JoinFailed += OnJoinFailed;
            NetworkService.Instance.GameStarted += OnGameStarted;
        }

        private void OnJoinSuccess(string roomCode)
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                ShowStatus("Успешно присоединились к комнате!", false);
                // Navigate to waiting room or game
                Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("NetworkRoomWaiting");
            });
        }

        private void OnJoinFailed(string message)
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                ShowStatus(message, true);
            });
        }

        private void OnGameStarted()
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                // Navigate to game
                Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("NetworkRoomGame");
            });
        }

        private void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("MultiplayerMenu");
        }

        private async void JoinRoom_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            var roomCode = RoomCodeTextBox.Text.Trim();
            var playerName = PlayerNameTextBox.Text.Trim();

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(roomCode))
            {
                ShowStatus("Введите код комнаты", true);
                return;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(playerName))
            {
                ShowStatus("Введите ваше имя", true);
                return;
            }

            if (roomCode.Length != 6)
            {
                ShowStatus("Код комнаты должен содержать 6 цифр", true);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                // Автообнаружение сервера в локальной сети
                ShowStatus("Поиск сервера...", false);
                var discoveredHubUrl = await DiscoveryService.DiscoverServerHubUrlAsync();
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(discoveredHubUrl))
                {
                    ShowStatus("Сервер не найден. Попросите хоста открыть комнату.", true);
                    return;
                }

                var connected = await NetworkService.Instance.ConnectToServer(discoveredHubUrl);
                if (!connected)
                {
                    ShowStatus("Не удалось подключиться к серверу.", true);
                    return;
                }

                // Join room
                await NetworkService.Instance.JoinRoom(roomCode, playerName);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Failed to join room", ex);
                ShowStatus("Ошибка присоединения к комнате", true);
            }
        }

        private void ShowStatus(string message, bool isError)
        {
            StatusText.Text = message;
            StatusText.Foreground = isError ? 
                System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red : 
                System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Green;
            StatusText.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Windows;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class NoInternetWindow : Window
    {
        public bool ShouldRetry { get; private set; } = false;
        
        public NoInternetWindow()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        private void Retry_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            ShouldRetry = true;
            DialogResult = true;
            Close();
        }

        private void Close_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            ShouldRetry = false;
            DialogResult = false;
            Close();
        }
    }

=== FILE: Views/NotificationWindow.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class NotificationWindow : Window
    {
        public NotificationWindow()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            Loaded += NotificationWindow_Loaded;
        }

        public NotificationWindow(string message, string type = "success") : this()
        {
            MessageText.Text = message;
            
            // Set colors and icon based on type
            var border = (Border)Content;
            var grid = (Grid)border.Child;
            var iconText = (TextBlock)grid.Children[0];
            
            switch (type.ToLower())
            {
                case "success":
                    border.Background = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#4CAF50"));
                    iconText.Text = "✓";
                    break;
                case "error":
                    border.Background = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#F44336"));
                    iconText.Text = "✕";
                    break;
                case "warning":
                    border.Background = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#FF9800"));
                    iconText.Text = "⚠";
                    break;
                case "info":
                    border.Background = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#2196F3"));
                    iconText.Text = "ℹ";
                    break;
            }
        }

        private void NotificationWindow_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Position at top center of screen
            var screenWidth = SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenWidth;
            var screenHeight = SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenHeight;
            
            Left = (screenWidth - ActualWidth) / 2;
            Top = 50; // 50 pixels from top of screen
            
            // Auto-close: короткие сообщения - 2 секунды, длинные - 4 секунды
            double duration = MessageText.Text.Length > 100 ? 4.0 : 2.0;
            
            var timer = new System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer();
            timer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(duration);
            timer.Tick += (s, args) =>
            {
                timer.Stop();
                CloseWithAnimation();
            };
            timer.Start();
        }

        private void CloseButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            CloseWithAnimation();
        }

        private void CloseWithAnimation()
        {
            var fadeOut = new DoubleAnimation(1, 0, new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(300)));
            fadeOut.Completed += (s, args) => Close();
            BeginAnimation(OpacityProperty, fadeOut);
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/PasswordChangeWindow.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Windows;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class PasswordChangeWindow : Window
    {
        public string CurrentPassword => CurrentPasswordBox.Password;
        public string NewPassword => NewPasswordBox.Password;

        public PasswordChangeWindow()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            Loaded += PasswordChangeWindow_Loaded;
        }

        private void PasswordChangeWindow_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Make window fullscreen to cover owner window, but content stays centered
            if (Owner != null)
            {
                Left = Owner.Left;
                Top = Owner.Top;
                Width = Owner.Width;
                Height = Owner.Height;
            }
            else
            {
                // If no owner, center on screen
                var screenWidth = SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenWidth;
                var screenHeight = SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenHeight;
                Left = (screenWidth - 520) / 2;
                Top = (screenHeight - 600) / 2;
                Width = 520;
                Height = 600;
            }
            
            // Ensure window is properly sized and centered
            SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Manual;
        }

        private void Overlay_MouseDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            // Prevent closing when clicking overlay - only close button should work
            e.Handled = true;
        }

        private void Cancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DialogResult = false;
            Close();
        }

        private void Change_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                var currentPassword = CurrentPasswordBox.Password;
                var newPassword = NewPasswordBox.Password;
                var confirmPassword = ConfirmPasswordBox.Password;
                
                // Validation
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentPassword))
                {
                    var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Введите текущий пароль!", "error");
                    errorNotification.Show();
                    return;
                }
                
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(newPassword))
                {
                    var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Введите новый пароль!", "error");
                    errorNotification.Show();
                    return;
                }
                
                if (newPassword.Length < 6)
                {
                    var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Новый пароль должен содержать минимум 6 символов!", "error");
                    errorNotification.Show();
                    return;
                }
                
                if (newPassword != confirmPassword)
                {
                    var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Пароли не совпадают!", "error");
                    errorNotification.Show();
                    return;
                }
                
                // Verify current password
                var user = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (user == null)
                {
                    var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Пользователь не найден!", "error");
                    errorNotification.Show();
                    return;
                }
                
                // TODO: Verify current password with database
                // For now, just proceed with password change
                
                // Update password in database
                // TODO: Hash and save new password
                
                DialogResult = true;
                Close();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("Change password failed", ex);
                var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при смене пароля!", "error");
                errorNotification.Show();
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Victory.Models;
using Victory.Services;
using Victory.ViewModels;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class PlayerView : Page
    {
        private int _currentQuizIndex = 0;
        private List<string> _quizzes = new List<string>();

        public PlayerView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            DataContextChanged += PlayerView_DataContextChanged;
            Loaded += PlayerView_Loaded;
        }

        private async void PlayerView_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DataContext is PlayerViewModel vm)
            {
                vm.PropertyChanged += ViewModel_PropertyChanged;
                
                // ✅ КРИТИЧЕСКИ ВАЖНО! Обновляем викторины при каждом открытии страницы
                await vm.RefreshQuizzesAsync();
                
                UpdateQuizzesList();
            }
        }

        private void ViewModel_PropertyChanged(object sender, System.ComponentModel.PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.PropertyName == nameof(PlayerViewModel.AvailableQuizzes))
            {
                UpdateQuizzesList();
            }
        }

        private void PlayerView_DataContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DataContext is PlayerViewModel vm)
            {
                vm.PropertyChanged += ViewModel_PropertyChanged;
                UpdateQuizzesList();
            }
        }

        private void UpdateQuizzesList()
        {
            if (DataContext is PlayerViewModel vm && vm.AvailableQuizzes != null)
            {
                _quizzes = vm.AvailableQuizzes.ToList();
                _currentQuizIndex = 0;
                UpdateCarousel();
            }
        }

        private void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Main");
        }

        private void Settings_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Settings");
        }

        private async void LogoutButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is System.Windows.Controls.Button button)
            {
                button.IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем кнопку сразу
            }
            
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            // Показываем loading overlay и блокируем взаимодействие
            try
            {
                LogoutLoadingOverlay.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем всё взаимодействие
            }
            catch { }
            
            // Останавливаем сервис социальных уведомлений
            Victory.Services.SocialNotificationService.Instance.Stop();
            
            // Если пользователь в комнате — корректно выходим
            try
            {
                var currentRoom = Victory.Services.RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;
                var cu = Victory.Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentRoom != null && cu != null)
                {
                    var svc = new Victory.Services.SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                    await svc.LeaveRoom(currentRoom.Id, cu.Username);
                }
            }
            catch { }

            await Victory.Services.UserService.Logout();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Login");
        }

        private void PrevQuiz_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            if (_quizzes.Count == 0) return;
            
            _currentQuizIndex--;
            if (_currentQuizIndex < 0)
                _currentQuizIndex = _quizzes.Count - 1;
            
            UpdateCarousel();
        }

        private void NextQuiz_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            if (_quizzes.Count == 0) return;
            
            _currentQuizIndex++;
            if (_currentQuizIndex >= _quizzes.Count)
                _currentQuizIndex = 0;
            
            UpdateCarousel();
        }

        private void UpdateCarousel()
        {
            if (_quizzes.Count == 0)
            {
                CurrentQuizTitle.Text = "Нет доступных викторин";
                CurrentQuizQuestionCount.Text = "0 вопросов";
                QuizCountText.Text = "0 / 0";
                PrevQuizButton.IsEnabled = false;
                NextQuizButton.IsEnabled = false;
                return;
            }

            CurrentQuizTitle.Text = _quizzes[_currentQuizIndex];
            QuizCountText.Text = $"{_currentQuizIndex + 1} / {_quizzes.Count}";
            
            // Update ViewModel and get question count
            if (DataContext is PlayerViewModel vm)
            {
                vm.SelectedQuiz = _quizzes[_currentQuizIndex];
                
                // Get question count from the selected quiz
                var questionCount = vm.GetQuestionCountForQuiz(_quizzes[_currentQuizIndex]);
                CurrentQuizQuestionCount.Text = $"{questionCount} {GetQuestionWord(questionCount)}";
            }

            PrevQuizButton.IsEnabled = _quizzes.Count > 1;
            NextQuizButton.IsEnabled = _quizzes.Count > 1;
        }
        
        private string GetQuestionWord(int count)
        {
            if (count % 10 == 1 && count % 100 != 11) return "вопрос";
            if (count % 10 >= 2 && count % 10 <= 4 && (count % 100 < 10 || count % 100 >= 20)) return "вопроса";
            return "вопросов";
        }

        private void QuizItem_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            // Card click - just visual feedback, quiz already selected
        }

        private void ShowAllQuizzesButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            if (DataContext is PlayerViewModel vm)
            {
                // Получаем все викторины для диалога
                var allQuizzes = vm.GetAllQuizzesForSelection();
                
                if (allQuizzes.Count == 0)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Нет доступных викторин.", "Информация", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
                    return;
                }

                // Открываем диалог выбора викторин
                var dialog = new QuizSelectionDialog(allQuizzes)
                {
                    Owner = Application.Current.MainWindow
                };

                if (dialog.ShowDialog() == true && dialog.SelectedQuiz != null)
                {
                    // Выбираем викторину из диалога и обновляем слайдер
                    vm.SelectQuizFromDialog(dialog.SelectedQuiz);
                    
                    // Обновляем карусель чтобы показать выбранную викторину
                    UpdateQuizzesList();
                    
                    // Находим индекс выбранной викторины в списке
                    var selectedIndex = _quizzes.IndexOf(dialog.SelectedQuiz.Title);
                    if (selectedIndex >= 0)
                    {
                        _currentQuizIndex = selectedIndex;
                        UpdateCarousel();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

    }
}

using System.Windows;
using HelixToolkit.Wpf.SharpDX;
using HelixToolkit.SharpDX.Core.Assimp;
using SharpDX;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class Podium3DWindow : Window
    {
        public Podium3DWindow()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            LoadModel();
        }

        private async void LoadModel()
        {
            try
            {
                var importer = new Importer();
                var scene = await importer.LoadAsync("Assets/Podium2.fbx");
                if (scene != null)
                {
                    SceneRoot.Items.Add(scene.Root);
                    View3D.ZoomExtents();
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                // Fallback silently if model fails
            }
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/PodiumWindow.xaml.cs ===

using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class PodiumWindow : Window
    {
        public PodiumWindow(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<(string name, int score)> results)
        {
            InitializeComponent();

            var top = results.OrderByDescending(r => r.score).Take(3).ToList();
            if (top.Count > 0)
            {
                FirstName.Text = top[0].name;
                FirstScore.Text = $"{top[0].score}";
            }
            if (top.Count > 1)
            {
                SecondName.Text = top[1].name;
                SecondScore.Text = $"{top[1].score}";
            }
            if (top.Count > 2)
            {
                ThirdName.Text = top[2].name;
                ThirdScore.Text = $"{top[2].score}";
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class ProfileView : Page
    {
        private readonly AchievementService _achievementService;
        private AchievementCollection? _currentAchievements;
        private string _currentCategory = "all";
        private readonly ObservableCollection<Achievement> _displayedAchievements = new ObservableCollection<Achievement>();

        public ProfileView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            Loaded += ProfileView_Loaded;
            _achievementService = new AchievementService();
            if (AchievementsItemsControl != null)
            {
                AchievementsItemsControl.ItemsSource = _displayedAchievements;
            }
            UpdateCategoryButtons();
        }

        private void ProfileView_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            _ = LoadUserProfile(); // Fire-and-forget
            LoadAchievements();
        }

        private async void LoadAchievements()
        {
            try
            {
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser == null) return;

                // Загружаем достижения
                _currentAchievements = await _achievementService.GetUserAchievements(currentUser.Username);

                // Обновляем статистику пользователя и проверяем достижения
                await UpdateUserStatsAndCheckAchievements(currentUser);

                // Обновляем UI
                UpdateAchievementsDisplay();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("LoadAchievements failed", ex);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task UpdateUserStatsAndCheckAchievements(Victory.Models.User user)
        {
            try
            {
                var authService = new SupabaseAuthService();
                var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(user.Username);
                
                if (profile == null) return;

                var quizService = new QuizEditorService();
                var allQuizzes = await quizService.GetAllQuizzesAsync();
                var userQuizzes = allQuizzes.Where(q => q.Author == user.Username).ToList();
                var aiQuizzes = userQuizzes.Count; // Упрощённо

                var socialService = new SupabaseSocialService();
                var friends = await socialService.GetFriends(user.Username);

                // Получаем правильные значения для PerfectQuizzes и CurrentPerfectStreak
                var perfectStreak = await _achievementService.GetPerfectStreak(user.Username);
                var totalPerfectQuizzes = await _achievementService.GetTotalPerfectQuizzes(user.Username);
                
                var stats = new UserStats
                {
                    QuizzesPassed = profile.QuizzesPassed,
                    QuizzesCreated = profile.QuizzesCreated,
                    AiQuizzesCreated = profile.AiQuizzesCreated,
                    FriendsCount = friends?.Count ?? 0,
                    MultiplayerGamesPlayed = profile.MultiplayerGamesPlayed,
                    MultiplayerGamesWon = profile.MultiplayerGamesWon,
                    PerfectQuizzes = totalPerfectQuizzes,
                    CurrentPerfectStreak = perfectStreak
                };

                await _achievementService.CheckAndUpdateAchievements(user.Username, stats);
                _currentAchievements = await _achievementService.GetUserAchievements(user.Username);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("UpdateUserStatsAndCheckAchievements failed", ex);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateAchievementsDisplay()
        {
            if (_currentAchievements == null) return;

            // Обновляем прогресс
            var unlocked = _currentAchievements.UnlockedAchievements;
            var total = _currentAchievements.TotalAchievements;
            var percentage = _currentAchievements.CompletionPercentage;

            if (AchievementsProgressText != null)
            {
                AchievementsProgressText.Text = $"{unlocked} из {total} достижений разблокировано";
            }

            if (AchievementsProgressBar != null)
            {
                AchievementsProgressBar.Value = percentage;
            }

            if (AchievementsPercentageText != null)
            {
                AchievementsPercentageText.Text = $"{percentage:F0}%";
            }

            // Фильтруем достижения по категории
            FilterAchievements(_currentCategory);
        }

        private void FilterAchievements(string category)
        {
            _currentCategory = category;
            _displayedAchievements.Clear();

            if (_currentAchievements == null) return;

            var filtered = category == "all"
                ? _currentAchievements.Achievements
                : _currentAchievements.Achievements.Where(a => a.Category == category);

            foreach (var achievement in filtered.OrderBy(a => a.IsUnlocked ? 0 : 1).ThenBy(a => a.Rarity))
            {
                _displayedAchievements.Add(achievement);
            }

            // Обновляем стиль активной кнопки
            UpdateCategoryButtons();
        }

        private void UpdateCategoryButtons()
        {
            if (AllCategoryButton == null) return;

            var buttons = new[] { 
                (AllCategoryButton, "all"), 
                (QuizzesCategoryButton, "quizzes"), 
                (CreatorCategoryButton, "creator"), 
                (StreaksCategoryButton, "streaks"), 
                (SocialCategoryButton, "social") 
            };

            var activeBackground = new BrushConverter().ConvertFromString("#684bff") is Brush ab ? ab : Brushes.Transparent;
            var inactiveText = new BrushConverter().ConvertFromString("#5c5c5c") is Brush it ? it : Brushes.Gray;
            var inactiveBorder = new BrushConverter().ConvertFromString("#c7bcff") is Brush ib ? ib : Brushes.LightGray;
            var inactiveBackground = new BrushConverter().ConvertFromString("#f7f3ff") is Brush ibg ? ibg : Brushes.White;

            foreach (var (button, category) in buttons)
            {
                if (button == null) continue;

                var isActive = string.Equals(_currentCategory, category, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

                button.Padding = new Thickness(18, 6, 18, 6);
                button.Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 10, 0);
                button.MinHeight = 36;
                button.HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center;
                button.VerticalContentAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
                button.FontSize = 14;

                if (isActive)
                {
                    button.Style = (Style)Application.Current.FindResource("MaterialDesignRaisedButton");
                    button.Background = activeBackground;
                    button.Foreground = Brushes.White;
                    button.BorderBrush = Brushes.Transparent;
                    button.BorderThickness = new Thickness(0);
                    button.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold;
                }
                else
                {
                    button.Style = (Style)Application.Current.FindResource("MaterialDesignOutlinedButton");
                    button.Background = inactiveBackground;
                    button.Foreground = inactiveText;
                    button.BorderBrush = inactiveBorder;
                    button.BorderThickness = new Thickness(1.5);
                    button.FontWeight = FontWeights.Normal;
                }
            }
        }

        private void CategoryButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            if (sender is Button button && button.Tag is string category)
            {
                FilterAchievements(category);
            }
        }

        private void ProgressBarFill_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is Border fillBorder && fillBorder.DataContext is Achievement achievement)
            {
                var container = fillBorder.Parent as Border;
                if (container == null || achievement.RequiredValue <= 0)
                    return;

                void UpdateWidth()
                {
                    if (container.ActualWidth > 0)
                    {
                        var percentage = Math.Min((double)achievement.CurrentValue / achievement.RequiredValue * 100, 100.0);
                        fillBorder.Width = (container.ActualWidth * percentage) / 100.0;
                    }
                }

                UpdateWidth();
                container.SizeChanged += (s, args) => UpdateWidth();
            }
        }

        private async Task LoadUserProfile()
        {
            try
            {
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser != null)
                {
                    UsernameText.Text = currentUser.Username;
                    DisplayNameText.Text = currentUser.DisplayName;
                    DisplayNameTextBox.Text = currentUser.DisplayName;
                    
                    // Set member since date (using creation date or current date)
                    MemberSinceText.Text = DateTime.Now.ToString("MMMM yyyy");
                    LastLoginText.Text = DateTime.Now.ToString("dd MMMM yyyy, HH:mm");
                    
                    // Load avatar - сначала проверяем локальный файл
                    var localAvatarDir = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "Data", "Avatars");
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(localAvatarDir);
                    var localAvatarPath = Path.Combine(localAvatarDir, $"{currentUser.Username}_avatar.png");
                    
                    // ✅ ПРИОРИТЕТ: если локальный файл существует, используем его сразу
                    if (File.Exists(localAvatarPath))
                    {
                        UpdateAvatarDisplay(localAvatarPath);
                        Logger.Log($"[ProfileView] ✅ Avatar loaded from local file: {localAvatarPath}");
                    }
                    // Если это URL из Supabase - скачиваем/обновляем
                    else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUser.AvatarPath) &&
                             (currentUser.AvatarPath.StartsWith("http://") || currentUser.AvatarPath.StartsWith("https://")))
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            // Скачиваем свежую версию из Supabase
                            Logger.Log($"[ProfileView] Downloading/updating avatar from {currentUser.AvatarPath}");
                            var storageService = new SupabaseStorageService();
                            await storageService.DownloadAvatar(currentUser.AvatarPath, localAvatarPath);

                            if (File.Exists(localAvatarPath))
                            {
                                UpdateAvatarDisplay(localAvatarPath);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                Logger.LogError($"[ProfileView] Failed to download avatar to {localAvatarPath}");
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            Logger.LogError($"Error downloading avatar: {ex.Message}", ex);
                        }
                    }
                    // Иначе это локальный путь
                    else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUser.AvatarPath) && File.Exists(currentUser.AvatarPath))
                    {
                        UpdateAvatarDisplay(currentUser.AvatarPath);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("LoadUserProfile failed", ex);
            }
        }

        private void ViewStatistics_Click(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            try
            {
                Logger.Log("ViewStatistics_Click: Opening statistics window");
                
                // Показываем затемнение фона
                var mainWindow = Application.Current.MainWindow as MainWindow;
                mainWindow?.ShowOverlay();
                
                var statsWindow = new StatisticsWindow();
                statsWindow.ShowDialog();
                
                // Скрываем затемнение после закрытия окна статистики
                mainWindow?.HideOverlay();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("ViewStatistics_Click failed", ex);
                
                // Скрываем затемнение в случае ошибки
                var mainWindow = Application.Current.MainWindow as MainWindow;
                mainWindow?.HideOverlay();
                
                var errorWindow = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при загрузке статистики", "error");
                errorWindow.Show();
            }
        }

        private void BackButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)

        private async void LogoutButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is System.Windows.Controls.Button button)
            {
                button.IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем кнопку сразу
            }
            
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            // Показываем loading overlay и блокируем взаимодействие
            try
            {
                LogoutLoadingOverlay.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем всё взаимодействие
            }
            catch { }
            
            // Останавливаем сервис социальных уведомлений
            Victory.Services.SocialNotificationService.Instance.Stop();
            
            // Если пользователь в комнате — корректно выходим
            try
            {
                var currentRoom = Victory.Services.RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;
                var cu = Victory.Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentRoom != null && cu != null)
                {
                    var svc = new Victory.Services.SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                    await svc.LeaveRoom(currentRoom.Id, cu.Username);
                }
            }
            catch { }

            await UserService.Logout();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Login");
        }

        private async void ChangeAvatar_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
                Logger.Log("ChangeAvatar_Click: Button clicked");
                
                var openFileDialog = new OpenFileDialog
                {
                    Title = "Выберите изображение для аватара",
                    Filter = "Изображения|*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.png;*.bmp;*.gif|Все файлы|*.*",
                    FilterIndex = 1
                };
                
                if (openFileDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        // Let user crop first
                        var cropWindow = new CropAvatarWindow(openFileDialog.FileName)
                        {
                            Owner = Window.GetWindow(this)
                        };
                        var croppedOk = cropWindow.ShowDialog() == true && cropWindow.CroppedBitmap != null;
                        if (!croppedOk)
                        {
                            return;
                        }
                        
                        // Сохраняем обрезанное изображение во временный файл
                        var tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "Victory", "Avatars");
                        Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);
                        
                        var user = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                        if (user == null)
                        {
                            var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка: пользователь не найден", "error");
                            errorNotification.Show();
                            return;
                        }
                        var avatarFileName = $"{user.Username}_avatar.png";
                        var tempAvatarPath = Path.Combine(tempDir, avatarFileName);
                        
                        // Save cropped bitmap as PNG
                        using (var file = File.Create(tempAvatarPath))
                        {
                            var encoder = new PngBitmapEncoder();
                            encoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(cropWindow.CroppedBitmap));
                            encoder.Save(file);
                        }
                        
                        Logger.Log($"[ProfileView] Avatar saved to temp: {tempAvatarPath}");

                        // ✅ СОХРАНЯЕМ ЛОКАЛЬНО СРАЗУ для немедленного отображения
                        var avatarDir = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "Data", "Avatars");
                        Directory.CreateDirectory(avatarDir);
                        var avatarLocalPath = Path.Combine(avatarDir, avatarFileName);
                        
                        // Копируем временный файл в локальную директорию
                        File.Copy(tempAvatarPath, avatarLocalPath, overwrite: true);
                        Logger.Log($"[ProfileView] ✅ Avatar saved locally: {avatarLocalPath}");

                        // ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ UI ЛОКАЛЬНО СРАЗУ (до загрузки на сервер)
                        Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                        {
                            UpdateAvatarDisplay(avatarLocalPath);
                            // Принудительно обновляем все элементы
                            AvatarImage.InvalidateVisual();
                            AvatarImage.UpdateLayout();
                            InvalidateVisual();
                            UpdateLayout();
                        });
                        
                        Logger.Log($"[ProfileView] ✅ Avatar UI updated locally immediately");

                        // 🆕 ЗАГРУЖАЕМ В SUPABASE STORAGE АСИНХРОННО В ФОНЕ
                        try
                        {
                            if (SupabaseConfig.IsConfigured)
                            {
                                var storageService = new SupabaseStorageService();
                                var avatarUrl = await storageService.UploadAvatar(user.Username, tempAvatarPath);
                                
                                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(avatarUrl))
                                {
                                    // ✅ УДАЛЯЕМ СТАРУЮ АВАТАРКУ ИЗ STORAGE, ЕСЛИ ОНА БЫЛА
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(user.AvatarPath) &&
                                        (user.AvatarPath.StartsWith("http://") || user.AvatarPath.StartsWith("https://")))
                                    {
                                        try
                                        {
                                            await storageService.DeleteAvatar(user.AvatarPath);
                                            Logger.Log($"[ProfileView] ✅ Old avatar deleted from storage");
                                        }
                                        catch (Exception ex)
                                        {
                                            Logger.LogError($"[ProfileView] Error deleting old avatar: {ex.Message}", ex);
                                        }
                                    }

                                    // ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ АВАТАР В ТЕКУЩЕМ СЕАНСЕ ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛЯ
                                    var currentUserSession = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                                    if (currentUserSession != null && currentUserSession.Username == user.Username)
                                    {
                                        currentUserSession.AvatarPath = avatarUrl;
                                        Logger.Log($"[ProfileView] ✅ Avatar updated in current user session: {avatarUrl}");
                                    }

                                    // ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ ПРОФИЛЬ В БАЗЕ ДАННЫХ АСИНХРОННО В ФОНЕ (не блокируя UI)
                                    _ = System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(async () =>
                                    {
                                        try
                                        {
                                            var supabaseAuth = new Victory.Services.SupabaseAuthService();
                                            // Устанавливаем JWT токен для авторизации
                                            if (currentUserSession != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUserSession.JwtToken))
                                            {
                                                supabaseAuth.SetJwtToken(currentUserSession.JwtToken);
                                            }
                                            
                                            var updateSuccess = await supabaseAuth.UpdateAvatarPath(user.Username, avatarUrl);
                                            if (updateSuccess)
                                            {
                                                Logger.Log($"[ProfileView] ✅ Avatar path updated in database (background)");
                                            }
                                            else
                                            {
                                                Logger.LogError($"[ProfileView] ❌ Failed to update avatar path in database (background)");
                                            }
                                        }
                                        catch (Exception ex)
                                        {
                                            Logger.LogError($"[ProfileView] Error updating avatar path in DB (background): {ex.Message}", ex);
                                        }
                                    });
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    Logger.LogError("[ProfileView] Failed to upload avatar to Supabase");
                                    var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка загрузки аватара на сервер!", "error");
                                    errorNotification.Show();
                                    return;
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                // Если Supabase не настроен - сохраняем локально
                                var localAvatarDir = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "Data", "Avatars");
                                Directory.CreateDirectory(localAvatarDir);
                                var localAvatarPath = Path.Combine(localAvatarDir, avatarFileName);
                                File.Copy(tempAvatarPath, localAvatarPath, true);
                                
                                user.AvatarPath = Path.Combine("Data", "Avatars", avatarFileName);
                                UpdateAvatarDisplay(localAvatarPath);
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception storageEx)
                        {
                            Logger.LogError("Error uploading avatar to Supabase Storage", storageEx);
                            var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка загрузки аватара на сервер!", "error");
                            errorNotification.Show();
                            return;
                        }
                        
                        var successNotification = new NotificationWindow("Аватар успешно изменен!", "success");
                        successNotification.Show();
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("ChangeAvatar failed", ex);
                        var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при загрузке аватара!", "error");
                        errorNotification.Show();
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("ChangeAvatar failed", ex);
                var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при выборе аватара!", "error");
                errorNotification.Show();
            }
        }

        private void UpdateAvatarDisplay(string avatarPath)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"UpdateAvatarDisplay: Trying to load avatar from {avatarPath}");
                
                // Resolve to absolute path if needed
                var resolvedPath = avatarPath;
                if (!Path.IsPathRooted(resolvedPath))
                {
                    resolvedPath = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, resolvedPath));
                }

                if (File.Exists(resolvedPath))
                {
                    Logger.Log("UpdateAvatarDisplay: File exists, loading image");
                    
                    // Очищаем старое изображение для принудительного обновления
                    AvatarImage.Source = null;
                    AvatarImage.UpdateLayout();
                    
                    // Небольшая задержка для гарантированного освобождения ресурсов
                    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(50);
                    
                    // Загружаем изображение через MemoryStream для обхода кэша
                    byte[] imageData = File.ReadAllBytes(resolvedPath);
                    var bitmap = new System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapImage();
                    using (var stream = new System.IO.MemoryStream(imageData))
                    {
                        bitmap.BeginInit();
                        bitmap.StreamSource = stream;
                        bitmap.CacheOption = System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
                        bitmap.CreateOptions = System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapCreateOptions.None;
                        bitmap.EndInit();
                        bitmap.Freeze(); // Замораживаем для использования в UI потоке
                    }
                    
                    // Устанавливаем изображение
                    AvatarImage.Source = bitmap;
                    AvatarImage.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    AvatarIcon.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                    
                    // Принудительно обновляем UI
                    AvatarImage.InvalidateVisual();
                    AvatarImage.UpdateLayout();
                    InvalidateVisual();
                    UpdateLayout();
                    
                    Logger.Log("UpdateAvatarDisplay: Avatar image loaded and displayed successfully");
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.Log("UpdateAvatarDisplay: File does not exist, showing default icon");
                    // Show default icon if no avatar
                    AvatarImage.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                    AvatarIcon.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("UpdateAvatarDisplay failed", ex);
                // Fallback to default icon
                AvatarImage.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                AvatarIcon.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
        }

        private void SaveDisplayName_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
                var newDisplayName = DisplayNameTextBox.Text.Trim();
                
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(newDisplayName))
                {
                    var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Имя не может быть пустым!", "error");
                    errorNotification.Show();
                    return;
                }
                
                // Update display name in current user and on server
                var user = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (user != null)
                {
                    user.DisplayName = newDisplayName;
                    DisplayNameText.Text = newDisplayName;

                    // 🆕 ЛОКАЛЬНОЕ СОХРАНЕНИЕ (мгновенное!)
                    Logger.Log($"[ProfileView] DisplayName updated locally: {newDisplayName}");

                    // Обновление на сервере происходит при выходе из системы
                    var successNotification = new NotificationWindow("Имя успешно изменено!", "success");
                    successNotification.Show();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("SaveDisplayName failed", ex);
                var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при сохранении имени!", "error");
                errorNotification.Show();
            }
        }

        private async void ChangePassword_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();

                // Create password change dialog
                var passwordDialog = new PasswordChangeWindow
                {
                    Owner = Window.GetWindow(this)
                };
                if (passwordDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var success = await UserService.ChangePassword(passwordDialog.CurrentPassword, passwordDialog.NewPassword);
                        if (success)
                        {
                            var successNotification = new NotificationWindow("Пароль успешно изменен!", "success");
                            successNotification.Show();
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при смене пароля на сервере!", "error");
                            errorNotification.Show();
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception serverEx)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("Error changing password on server", serverEx);
                        var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при смене пароля на сервере!", "error");
                        errorNotification.Show();
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("ChangePassword failed", ex);
                var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при смене пароля!", "error");
                errorNotification.Show();
            }
        }

        private void ExportData_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
                
                var saveFileDialog = new SaveFileDialog
                {
                    Title = "Экспорт данных профиля",
                    Filter = "JSON файлы|*.json|Все файлы|*.*",
                    FileName = $"victory_profile_export_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd}.json"
                };
                
                if (saveFileDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
                {
                    var user = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                    if (user == null)
                    {
                        var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка: пользователь не найден", "error");
                        errorNotification.Show();
                        return;
                    }
                    var exportData = new
                    {
                        Username = user.Username,
                        DisplayName = user.DisplayName,
                        ExportDate = DateTime.Now
                    };
                    
                    var json = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(exportData, new System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });
                    File.WriteAllText(saveFileDialog.FileName, json);
                    
                    var successNotification = new NotificationWindow("Данные успешно экспортированы!", "success");
                    successNotification.Show();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("ExportData failed", ex);
                var errorNotification = new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при экспорте данных!", "error");
                errorNotification.Show();
            }
        }
    }
}
