using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class QuizEditView : Page
    {
        public static Quiz SelectedQuizForEditing { get; set; }

        public QuizEditView()
        {
            try
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("QuizEditView: Constructor started");
                InitializeComponent();
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("QuizEditView: InitializeComponent completed");
                
                // Load the quiz if one was selected for editing
                if (SelectedQuizForEditing != null)
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"QuizEditView: SelectedQuizForEditing found: {SelectedQuizForEditing.Title}");
                    
                    // Simple approach - load immediately after DataContext is set
                    this.Loaded += (s, e) =>
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            Victory.Services.Logger.Log("QuizEditView: Loaded event fired");
                            if (DataContext is ViewModels.QuizEditViewModel vm)
                            {
                                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("QuizEditView: DataContext is QuizEditViewModel");
                                vm.LoadQuiz(SelectedQuizForEditing);
                                SelectedQuizForEditing = null; // Clear after loading
                                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("QuizEditView: Quiz loaded successfully");
                                
                                // Update UI fields
                                QuizTitleTextBox.Text = vm.QuizTitle;
                                QuizDescriptionTextBox.Text = vm.QuizDescription;
                                UpdateQuestionsDisplay();
                                
                                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("QuizEditView: UI updated with quiz data");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"QuizEditView: DataContext is not QuizEditViewModel, it's: {DataContext?.GetType().Name}");
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("QuizEditView: Loaded event failed", ex);
                        }
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log("QuizEditView: No SelectedQuizForEditing, creating new quiz");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("QuizEditView: Constructor failed", ex);
                throw;
            }
        }

        private void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Editor");
        }

        private async void LogoutButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is System.Windows.Controls.Button button)
            {
                button.IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем кнопку сразу
            }
            
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            // Показываем loading overlay и блокируем взаимодействие
            try
            {
                LogoutLoadingOverlay.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем всё взаимодействие
            }
            catch { }
            
            await Victory.Services.UserService.Logout();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Login");
        }

        private void Save_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("Save_Click: Starting");
                if (DataContext is ViewModels.QuizEditViewModel vm)
                {
                    // Update quiz title and description from UI
                    vm.QuizTitle = QuizTitleTextBox.Text;
                    vm.QuizDescription = QuizDescriptionTextBox.Text;
                    
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"Save_Click: Updated title to '{vm.QuizTitle}', description to '{vm.QuizDescription}'");
                    
                    vm.SaveQuizCommand.Execute(null);
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log("Save_Click: Save command executed");
                    
                    // Show success notification
                    var notification = new Views.NotificationWindow("Викторина сохранена!", "success");
                    notification.Show();
                }
                else
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"Save_Click: DataContext is not QuizEditViewModel, it's: {DataContext?.GetType().Name}");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("Save_Click failed", ex);
            }
        }

        private void Preview_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DataContext is ViewModels.QuizEditViewModel vm)
            {
                vm.PreviewQuizCommand.Execute(null);
            }
        }

        // Метод AddQuestion_Click больше не нужен, так как используется Command в XAML
        // Оставлен для обратной совместимости, если потребуется
        private void AddQuestion_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Теперь используется Command="{Binding AddQuestionCommand}" в XAML
            // Этот метод можно оставить пустым или удалить
        }

        private void UpdateQuestionsDisplay()
        {
            try
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("UpdateQuestionsDisplay: Starting");
                if (DataContext is ViewModels.QuizEditViewModel vm)
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"UpdateQuestionsDisplay: Found {vm.Questions.Count} questions");
                    // ItemsControl will automatically update through binding
                    // No need to manually manipulate children
                }
                else
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.Log("UpdateQuestionsDisplay: DataContext is not QuizEditViewModel");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("UpdateQuestionsDisplay failed", ex);
            }
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/QuizFinishedWindow.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Windows;
using Victory.Services;
using Victory;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class QuizFinishedWindow : Window
    {
        public bool RestartQuiz { get; private set; } = false;
        private readonly int _score;
        private readonly int _totalQuestions;
        
        public QuizFinishedWindow(int score, int totalQuestions)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"QuizFinishedWindow: Creating window with score {score}/{totalQuestions}");
                _score = score;
                _totalQuestions = totalQuestions;
                InitializeComponent();
                Loaded += QuizFinishedWindow_Loaded;
                Closed += QuizFinishedWindow_Closed;
                UpdateUI();
                Logger.Log("QuizFinishedWindow: Window created successfully");
            }
            catch (System.Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("QuizFinishedWindow: Failed to create window", ex);
                // Don't show MessageBox here - let QuizPage handle the fallback
                // Just set default values
                RestartQuiz = false;
                DialogResult = false;
            }
        }
        
        private void QuizFinishedWindow_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                // Make window fullscreen to cover owner window, but content stays centered
                if (Owner != null)
                {
                    Left = Owner.Left;
                    Top = Owner.Top;
                    Width = Owner.Width;
                    Height = Owner.Height;
                    Logger.Log($"QuizFinishedWindow: Positioned relative to owner - L:{Left}, T:{Top}, W:{Width}, H:{Height}");
                }
                else
                {
                    // If no owner, make fullscreen on primary screen
                    var screenWidth = SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenWidth;
                    var screenHeight = SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenHeight;
                    Left = 0;
                    Top = 0;
                    Width = screenWidth;
                    Height = screenHeight;
                    Logger.Log($"QuizFinishedWindow: No owner, using fullscreen - W:{Width}, H:{Height}");
                }
                
                // Ensure window is properly sized and content is centered
                SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Manual;
                
                // Force update layout to ensure content is centered
                UpdateLayout();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("QuizFinishedWindow_Loaded: Error positioning window", ex);
                // Fallback to center of screen
                try
                {
                    var screenWidth = SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenWidth;
                    var screenHeight = SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenHeight;
                    Left = 0;
                    Top = 0;
                    Width = screenWidth;
                    Height = screenHeight;
                }
                catch { }
            }
        }
        
        private void UpdateUI()
        {
            try
            {
                // Update score text
                ScoreTextBlock.Text = $"{_score} / {_totalQuestions}";
                
                // Calculate percentage
                var percentage = _totalQuestions > 0 ? (double)_score / _totalQuestions * 100 : 0;
                PercentageTextBlock.Text = $"{percentage:F0}% правильных ответов";
                
                // Set emoji and message based on score
                if (percentage >= 100)
                {
                    ResultEmoji.Text = "🏆";
                    MessageTextBlock.Text = "Идеальный результат! Вы ответили на все вопросы правильно!";
                }
                else if (percentage >= 80)
                {
                    ResultEmoji.Text = "⭐";
                    MessageTextBlock.Text = "Отличный результат! Вы показали высокий уровень знаний!";
                }
                else if (percentage >= 60)
                {
                    ResultEmoji.Text = "👍";
                    MessageTextBlock.Text = "Хороший результат! Продолжайте в том же духе!";
                }
                else if (percentage >= 40)
                {
                    ResultEmoji.Text = "📚";
                    MessageTextBlock.Text = "Неплохо! Есть над чем поработать, но вы на правильном пути!";
                }
                else
                {
                    ResultEmoji.Text = "💪";
                    MessageTextBlock.Text = "Не сдавайтесь! Повторите материал и попробуйте снова!";
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("UpdateUI failed", ex);
            }
        }
        
        private void QuizFinishedWindow_Closed(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // Hide overlay when window closes
            try
            {
                var mainWindow = Application.Current.MainWindow as MainWindow;
                mainWindow?.HideOverlay();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("QuizFinishedWindow_Closed: Error hiding overlay", ex);
            }
        }
        
        private void Overlay_MouseDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            // Prevent closing when clicking overlay - only close button should work
            e.Handled = true;
        }
        
        private void ExitButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log("QuizFinishedWindow: Exit button clicked");
                RestartQuiz = false;
                DialogResult = true;
                Close();
            }
            catch (System.Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("QuizFinishedWindow: Exit button error", ex);
                DialogResult = false;
                Close();
            }
        }
        
        private void RestartButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log("QuizFinishedWindow: Restart button clicked");
                RestartQuiz = true;
                DialogResult = true;
                Close();
            }
            catch (System.Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("QuizFinishedWindow: Restart button error", ex);
                DialogResult = false;
                Close();
            }
        }
    }
}

        public QuizPage()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            Loaded += QuizPage_Loaded;
            Unloaded += QuizPage_Unloaded;
        }

        private void QuizPage_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DataContext is MainViewModel vm)
            {
                if (_boundViewModel != null)
                {
                    _boundViewModel.ShowNotification -= Vm_ShowNotification;
                    _boundViewModel.QuizFinished -= Vm_QuizFinished;
                    _boundViewModel.AnswerChecked -= Vm_AnswerChecked;
                    _boundViewModel.PropertyChanged -= Vm_PropertyChanged;
                }

                _boundViewModel = vm;

                // Сбрасываем флаг при загрузке страницы
                _quizFinishedHandled = false;
                _isQuizContextCleaned = false;
                
                vm.ShowNotification -= Vm_ShowNotification;
                vm.ShowNotification += Vm_ShowNotification;
                vm.QuizFinished -= Vm_QuizFinished;
                vm.QuizFinished += Vm_QuizFinished;
                vm.AnswerChecked -= Vm_AnswerChecked;
                vm.AnswerChecked += Vm_AnswerChecked;
                vm.PropertyChanged -= Vm_PropertyChanged;
                vm.PropertyChanged += Vm_PropertyChanged;

                InitializeQuestionPhase(vm.CurrentQuestion);
            }
        }

        private void Vm_PropertyChanged(object? sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs args)
        {
            if (_isQuizContextCleaned || sender is not MainViewModel vm)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (args.PropertyName == nameof(MainViewModel.TimerProgress))
            {
                UpdateTimerProgressWidth();
            }
            else if (args.PropertyName == nameof(MainViewModel.CurrentQuestion))
            {
                InitializeQuestionPhase(vm.CurrentQuestion);
            }
        }
        
        private void TimerProgressGrid_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            UpdateTimerProgressWidth(animate: false);
        }
        
        private void UpdateTimerProgressWidth(bool animate = true)
        {
            if (TimerProgressGrid != null && TimerProgressBar != null && DataContext is MainViewModel vm)
            {
                var containerWidth = TimerProgressGrid.ActualWidth;
                if (containerWidth > 0 && vm.TimerProgress >= 0)
                {
                    var targetWidth = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(containerWidth, (vm.TimerProgress / 100.0) * containerWidth));

                    if (!animate || !IsLoaded || targetWidth <= 0.1 || vm.TimerProgress >= 99.9)
                    {
                        TimerProgressBar.BeginAnimation(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, null);
                        TimerProgressBar.Width = targetWidth;
                        return;
                    }

                    var currentWidth = TimerProgressBar.ActualWidth;
                    if (double.IsNaN(currentWidth) || currentWidth < 0)
                    {
                        currentWidth = TimerProgressBar.Width;
                    }

                    if (double.IsNaN(currentWidth) || currentWidth < 0)
                    {
                        currentWidth = targetWidth;
                    }

                    currentWidth = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(containerWidth, currentWidth));

                    if (Math.Abs(currentWidth - targetWidth) < 0.5)
                    {
                        TimerProgressBar.BeginAnimation(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, null);
                        TimerProgressBar.Width = targetWidth;
                        return;
                    }

                    var animation = new DoubleAnimation
                    {
                        From = currentWidth,
                        To = targetWidth,
                        Duration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(920),
                        FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop
                    };

                    animation.Completed += (_, _) =>
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            TimerProgressBar.BeginAnimation(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, null);
                            TimerProgressBar.Width = targetWidth;
                        }
                        catch { }
                    };

                    TimerProgressBar.BeginAnimation(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, animation, HandoffBehavior.SnapshotAndReplace);
                }
                else
                {
                    TimerProgressBar.BeginAnimation(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, null);
                    TimerProgressBar.Width = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        private void QuizPage_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            CleanupQuizContext();
        }

        private void Answer_Click(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is Border clickedBorder)
            {
                var vm = DataContext as MainViewModel;
                if (vm == null || vm.QuestionAnswered) return;
                
                // Блокируем клики после завершения викторины
                if (vm.CorrectAnswersCount >= vm.TotalQuestions && vm.CurrentQuestionIndex >= vm.TotalQuestions) return;

                // Найдём индекс выбранного ответа
                var optionsContainer = FindName("OptionsContainer") as ItemsControl;
                if (optionsContainer == null) return;

                int selectedIndex = -1;
                for (int i = 0; i < optionsContainer.Items.Count; i++)
                {
                    var container = optionsContainer.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) as ContentPresenter;
                    if (container != null)
                    {
                        var border = FindVisualChild<Border>(container);
                        if (border == clickedBorder)
                        {
                            selectedIndex = i;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (selectedIndex >= 0)
                {
                    vm.SelectedAnswerIndex = selectedIndex;
                    ApplySelectedAnswerStyle(selectedIndex);
                    PlayAnswerCardStoryboard(selectedIndex, "AnswerCardPressStoryboard");
                    if (vm.CheckAnswerCommand.CanExecute(null))
                    {
                        vm.CheckAnswerCommand.Execute(null);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private void Vm_AnswerChecked(int selectedIndex, bool isCorrect)
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                try
                {
                    var optionsContainer = FindName("OptionsContainer") as ItemsControl;
                    if (optionsContainer == null) return;

                    var vm = DataContext as MainViewModel;
                    if (vm?.CurrentQuestion == null) return;

                    // Проходим по всем вариантам ответа
                    for (int i = 0; i < optionsContainer.Items.Count; i++)
                    {
                        var container = optionsContainer.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) as ContentPresenter;
                        if (container == null) continue;

                        var border = FindVisualChild<Border>(container);
                        if (border == null) continue;

                        SetAnswerCardVisualState(
                            border,
                            Color.FromRgb(255, 255, 255),
                            Color.FromRgb(206, 203, 246),
                            Color.FromRgb(228, 226, 251),
                            Color.FromRgb(83, 74, 183),
                            Color.FromRgb(32, 27, 72));

                        // Подсвечиваем правильный ответ
                        if (i == vm.CurrentQuestion.CorrectAnswerIndex)
                        {
                            AnimateAnswerCardColor(border, Color.FromRgb(234, 243, 222), Color.FromRgb(99, 153, 34));
                            SetAnswerCardVisualState(
                                border,
                                Color.FromRgb(234, 243, 222),
                                Color.FromRgb(99, 153, 34),
                                Color.FromRgb(99, 153, 34),
                                Colors.White,
                                Color.FromRgb(32, 27, 72));
                            PlayAnswerCardStoryboard(i, "AnswerCardCorrectPulseStoryboard");
                        }
                        // Подсвечиваем неправильный выбранный ответ
                        else if (i == selectedIndex && !isCorrect)
                        {
                            AnimateAnswerCardColor(border, Color.FromRgb(252, 235, 235), Color.FromRgb(163, 45, 45));
                            SetAnswerCardVisualState(
                                border,
                                Color.FromRgb(252, 235, 235),
                                Color.FromRgb(163, 45, 45),
                                Color.FromRgb(163, 45, 45),
                                Colors.White,
                                Color.FromRgb(32, 27, 72));
                            PlayAnswerCardStoryboard(i, "AnswerCardWrongShakeStoryboard");
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("Vm_AnswerChecked error", ex);
                }
            });
        }

        private T FindVisualChild<T>(DependencyObject parent) where T : DependencyObject
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(parent); i++)
            {
                var child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, i);
                if (child is T typedChild)
                {
                    return typedChild;
                }
                var childOfChild = FindVisualChild<T>(child);
                if (childOfChild != null)
                {
                    return childOfChild;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        private async void LogoutButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is System.Windows.Controls.Button button)
            {
                button.IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем кнопку сразу
            }
            
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            CleanupQuizContext();
            
            // Показываем loading overlay и блокируем взаимодействие
            try
            {
                LogoutLoadingOverlay.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                IsEnabled = false; // Блокируем всё взаимодействие
            }
            catch { }
            
            await Victory.Services.UserService.Logout();
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Login");
        }

        private void Vm_ShowNotification(string message)

        private async void Vm_QuizFinished(int score, int total)
        {
            if (_isQuizContextCleaned || !IsLoaded)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log("Vm_QuizFinished: Ignored because quiz page is no longer active");
                return;
            }

            // Защита от повторных вызовов
            if (_quizFinishedHandled)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"Vm_QuizFinished: Already handled, ignoring duplicate call");
                return;
            }
            
            _quizFinishedHandled = true;
            
            try
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"Vm_QuizFinished: Quiz finished with score {score}/{total}");
                
                // Обновляем достижения
                var currentUser = Victory.Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser != null)
                {
                    var achievementService = new Victory.Services.AchievementService();
                    var authService = new Victory.Services.SupabaseAuthService();
                    
                    // Записываем игру для серии
                    await achievementService.RecordGamePlayed(currentUser.Username);
                    
                    // Получаем актуальный профиль
                    var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(currentUser.Username);
                    
                    if (profile != null)
                    {
                        // Используем инкремент вместо пересчета (безопаснее)
                        await authService.IncrementQuizzesPassed(currentUser.Username);
                        
                        // Обновляем профиль после обновления статистики
                        profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(currentUser.Username);
                        
                        if (profile != null)
                        {
                            var socialService = new Victory.Services.SupabaseSocialService();
                            var friends = await socialService.GetFriends(currentUser.Username);
                            
                            // Если викторина идеальная - записываем для серии
                            if (score == total)
                            {
                                await achievementService.RecordPerfectQuiz(currentUser.Username);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                // Сбрасываем серию идеальных результатов
                                await achievementService.ResetPerfectStreak(currentUser.Username);
                            }
                            
                            var perfectStreak = await achievementService.GetPerfectStreak(currentUser.Username);
                            var totalPerfectQuizzes = await achievementService.GetTotalPerfectQuizzes(currentUser.Username);
                            
                            var stats = new Victory.Services.UserStats
                            {
                                QuizzesPassed = profile.QuizzesPassed, // Используем обновлённое значение
                                QuizzesCreated = profile.QuizzesCreated,
                                AiQuizzesCreated = profile.AiQuizzesCreated,
                                FriendsCount = friends?.Count ?? 0,
                                MultiplayerGamesPlayed = profile.MultiplayerGamesPlayed,
                                MultiplayerGamesWon = profile.MultiplayerGamesWon,
                                PerfectQuizzes = totalPerfectQuizzes,
                                CurrentPerfectStreak = perfectStreak
                            };
                            
                            Victory.Services.Logger.Log($"Checking achievements with stats: QuizzesPassed={stats.QuizzesPassed}, QuizzesCreated={stats.QuizzesCreated}");
                            await achievementService.CheckAndUpdateAchievements(currentUser.Username, stats);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("Error updating achievements", ex);
            }
            
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                try
                {
                    // Показываем затемнение фона
                    var mainWindow = Application.Current.MainWindow as MainWindow;
                    mainWindow?.ShowOverlay();
                    
                    var finishedWindow = new QuizFinishedWindow(score, total);
                    
                    // Check if window was created successfully
                    if (finishedWindow.DialogResult == false)
                    {
                        // Window creation failed, show fallback
                        Victory.Services.Logger.Log("Vm_QuizFinished: Window creation failed, showing fallback");
                        // Скрываем затемнение при ошибке создания окна
                        mainWindow?.HideOverlay();
                        
                        var result = MessageBox.Show($"Викторина завершена!\nВаш результат: {score} из {total}\n\nПовторить викторину?", 
                                                  "Викторина завершена", 
                                                  MessageBoxButton.YesNo, 
                                                  MessageBoxImage.Question);
                        if (result == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
                        {
                            if (DataContext is MainViewModel vm)
                            {
                                vm.RestartQuiz();
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Player");
                        }
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    finishedWindow.Owner = Window.GetWindow(this);
                    var result2 = finishedWindow.ShowDialog();
                    
                    // Скрываем затемнение после закрытия окна (на случай если оно не было скрыто в Closed)
                    mainWindow?.HideOverlay();
                    
                    if (result2 == true && finishedWindow.RestartQuiz)
                    {
                        // Restart quiz
                        Victory.Services.Logger.Log("Vm_QuizFinished: Restarting quiz");
                        if (DataContext is MainViewModel vm)
                        {
                            vm.RestartQuiz();
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // Exit to player view
                        Victory.Services.Logger.Log("Vm_QuizFinished: Exiting to player view");
                        Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Player");
                    }
                }
                catch (System.Exception ex)
                {
                    Victory.Services.Logger.LogError("Vm_QuizFinished: Error showing finished window", ex);
                    
                    // Скрываем затемнение в случае ошибки
                    var mainWindowError = Application.Current.MainWindow as MainWindow;
                    mainWindowError?.HideOverlay();
                    
                    // Fallback: show simple message box
                    var result = MessageBox.Show($"Викторина завершена!\nВаш результат: {score} из {total}\n\nПовторить викторину?", 
                                              "Викторина завершена", 
                                              MessageBoxButton.YesNo, 
                                              MessageBoxImage.Question);
                    if (result == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
                    {
                        if (DataContext is MainViewModel vm)
                        {
                            vm.RestartQuiz();
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Player");
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        private void CleanupQuizContext()
        {
            if (_isQuizContextCleaned) return;
            _isQuizContextCleaned = true;

            StopPhaseOneCountdown();
            _isTransitioningToPhaseTwo = false;
            if (_boundViewModel != null)
            {
                _boundViewModel.ShowNotification -= Vm_ShowNotification;
                _boundViewModel.QuizFinished -= Vm_QuizFinished;
                _boundViewModel.AnswerChecked -= Vm_AnswerChecked;
                _boundViewModel.PropertyChanged -= Vm_PropertyChanged;
                _boundViewModel.DeferQuestionTimerStart = false;
                _boundViewModel.AbortQuiz();
                _boundViewModel = null;
            }

            try
            {
                if (TimerProgressBar != null)
                {
                    TimerProgressBar.BeginAnimation(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, null);
                }

                if (QuestionVideo != null)
                {
                    QuestionVideo.Stop();
                    QuestionVideo.Source = null;
                }
            }
            catch { }
        }

        private void OptionsContainer_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DataContext is MainViewModel vm)
            {
                ApplyOptionBadges();
                RenderOptionMedia(vm.CurrentQuestion);
            }
        }

        private void PhaseOneNextButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            EnterPhaseTwoWithTransition(true);
        }

        // ======================================================================
        //  Медиа-вопросы (картинки/гиф/видео)
        // ======================================================================

        private void RefreshQuestionMedia(Question question)
        {
            if (question == null) return;
            
            LoadQuestionMedia(question);
            LoadQuestionMiniMedia(question);
            
            // Медиа для опций (ждём обновления UI)
            Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
            {
                ApplyOptionBadges();
                RenderOptionMedia(question);
                ResetAnswerCardsToDefault();
            }), System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
        }

        private void LoadQuestionMedia(Question question)
        {
            try
            {
                if (QuestionMediaPanel != null) QuestionMediaPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                if (QuestionImage != null)
                {
                    WpfAnimatedGif.ImageBehavior.SetAnimatedSource(QuestionImage, null);
                    QuestionImage.Source = null;
                    QuestionImage.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }
                if (QuestionVideo != null)
                {
                    try { QuestionVideo.Stop(); } catch { }
                    QuestionVideo.Source = null;
                    QuestionVideo.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }

                if (question == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(question.ImagePath)) return;

                var uri = TryCreateMediaUri(question.ImagePath);
                if (uri == null) return;

                var kind = DetectMediaKind(question.ImagePath);
                bool mediaRendered = false;

                if (kind == "video")
                {
                    mediaRendered = TryStartVideoPlayback(uri);
                }
                else if (QuestionImage != null)
                {
                    var bitmap = LoadBitmap(uri);
                    if (bitmap != null)
                    {
                        QuestionImage.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                        if (kind == "gif")
                        {
                            WpfAnimatedGif.ImageBehavior.SetAnimatedSource(QuestionImage, bitmap);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            QuestionImage.Source = bitmap;
                        }

                        mediaRendered = true;
                    }
                    else if (IsHttpOrHttpsUri(uri))
                    {
                        mediaRendered = TryStartVideoPlayback(uri);
                    }
                }

                if (QuestionMediaPanel != null)
                {
                    QuestionMediaPanel.Visibility = mediaRendered ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"LoadQuestionMedia error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        private bool TryStartVideoPlayback(Uri uri)
        {
            if (QuestionVideo == null)
            {
                return false;
            }

            try
            {
                QuestionVideo.Stop();
                QuestionVideo.Position = TimeSpan.Zero;
                QuestionVideo.Source = null;
                QuestionVideo.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                QuestionVideo.Source = uri;

                Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
                {
                    try
                    {
                        if (QuestionVideo.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
                        {
                            QuestionVideo.Play();
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("QuestionVideo.Play deferred error", ex);
                    }
                }), DispatcherPriority.Background);

                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"TryStartVideoPlayback error for '{uri}'", ex);
                try
                {
                    QuestionVideo.Source = null;
                    QuestionVideo.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }
                catch { }
                return false;
            }
        }

        private void LoadQuestionMiniMedia(Question question)
        {
            try
            {
                if (QuestionMiniMediaPanel != null)
                {
                    QuestionMiniMediaPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                    QuestionMiniMediaPanel.Opacity = 0;
                }

                if (QuestionMiniImage != null)
                {
                    WpfAnimatedGif.ImageBehavior.SetAnimatedSource(QuestionMiniImage, null);
                    QuestionMiniImage.Source = null;
                    QuestionMiniImage.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }

                if (QuestionMiniVideoGlyph != null)
                {
                    QuestionMiniVideoGlyph.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }

                if (question == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(question.ImagePath)) return;

                if (QuestionMiniMediaPanel == null) return;

                var kind = DetectMediaKind(question.ImagePath);
                if (kind == "video")
                {
                    if (QuestionMiniVideoGlyph != null)
                    {
                        QuestionMiniVideoGlyph.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    }
                    QuestionMiniMediaPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    return;
                }

                var uri = TryCreateMediaUri(question.ImagePath);
                if (uri == null || QuestionMiniImage == null) return;

                var bitmap = LoadBitmap(uri);
                if (bitmap == null) return;

                if (kind == "gif")
                {
                    WpfAnimatedGif.ImageBehavior.SetAnimatedSource(QuestionMiniImage, bitmap);
                }
                else
                {
                    QuestionMiniImage.Source = bitmap;
                }

                QuestionMiniImage.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                QuestionMiniMediaPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"LoadQuestionMiniMedia error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        private void RenderOptionMedia(Question question)
        {
            try
            {
                if (OptionsContainer == null || question == null) return;
                if (question.Options == null) return;

                for (int i = 0; i < question.Options.Count; i++)
                {
                    var container = OptionsContainer.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) as ContentPresenter;
                    if (container == null) continue;

                    var image = FindVisualChildByName<Image>(container, "OptionMedia");
                    if (image == null) continue;

                    WpfAnimatedGif.ImageBehavior.SetAnimatedSource(image, null);
                    image.Source = null;
                    image.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }

                var paths = question.OptionMediaPaths;
                if (paths == null || paths.Count == 0) return;

                int count = Math.Min(question.Options.Count, paths.Count);
                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                {
                    var path = paths[i];
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) continue;

                    var container = OptionsContainer.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) as ContentPresenter;
                    if (container == null) continue;

                    var image = FindVisualChildByName<Image>(container, "OptionMedia");
                    if (image == null) continue;

                    var uri = TryCreateMediaUri(path);
                    if (uri == null) continue;

                    var kind = DetectMediaKind(path);
                    if (kind == "video") continue; // Видео не рендерим в кнопках

                    var bitmap = LoadBitmap(uri);
                    if (bitmap == null) continue;

                    if (kind == "gif")
                    {
                        WpfAnimatedGif.ImageBehavior.SetAnimatedSource(image, bitmap);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        image.Source = bitmap;
                    }
                    image.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                }

                AnimateAnswerCardsAppearance();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"RenderOptionMedia error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        private void InitializeQuestionPhase(Question question)
        {
            if (_isQuizContextCleaned || question == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            _questionPhaseVersion++;
            ResetPhaseAnimationState();
            _isTransitioningToPhaseTwo = false;

            RefreshQuestionMedia(question);
            ResetAnswerCardsToDefault();
            ApplyOptionBadges();

            bool hasMedia = QuestionHasMedia(question);
            _currentQuestionHasVideo = hasMedia
                && string.Equals(DetectMediaKind(question.ImagePath), "video", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            _currentQuestionHasPhoto = hasMedia && !_currentQuestionHasVideo;

            if (_boundViewModel != null)
            {
                _configuredPhotoViewSeconds = Math.Max(1, _boundViewModel.PhotoViewSeconds);
                _unlimitedPhotoViewEnabled = _boundViewModel.UnlimitedPhotoViewEnabled;
                _allowVideoReplay = _boundViewModel.AllowVideoReplay;
                _boundViewModel.DeferQuestionTimerStart = hasMedia;

                if (hasMedia)
                {
                    _boundViewModel.StopTimerForCurrentQuestion();
                }
            }
            else
            {
                _configuredPhotoViewSeconds = DefaultPhaseOneSeconds;
                _unlimitedPhotoViewEnabled = false;
                _allowVideoReplay = false;
            }

            if (hasMedia)
            {
                StartPhaseOne();
                return;
            }

            StopPhaseOneCountdown();
            ShowPhaseTwo();

            if (_boundViewModel != null)
            {
                _boundViewModel.DeferQuestionTimerStart = false;
                _boundViewModel.StartTimerForCurrentQuestion();
            }

            UpdateTimerProgressWidth();
            AnimateAnswerCardsAppearance();
        }

        private static bool QuestionHasMedia(Question? question)
        {
            if (question == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(question.ImagePath))
            {
                return false;
            }

            return TryCreateMediaUri(question.ImagePath) != null;
        }

        private void StartPhaseOne()
        {
            ResetPhaseAnimationState();

            bool shouldAutoAdvance = true;

            if (_currentQuestionHasVideo)
            {
                if (_allowVideoReplay)
                {
                    shouldAutoAdvance = false;
                    _phaseOneSecondsLeft = 0;
                    PhaseOneCountdownText.Text = "∞";
                }
                else
                {
                    _phaseOneSecondsLeft = VideoFallbackPhaseOneSeconds;
                    PhaseOneCountdownText.Text = _phaseOneSecondsLeft.ToString();
                }
            }
            else if (_currentQuestionHasPhoto)
            {
                if (_unlimitedPhotoViewEnabled)
                {
                    shouldAutoAdvance = false;
                    _phaseOneSecondsLeft = 0;
                    PhaseOneCountdownText.Text = "∞";
                }
                else
                {
                    _phaseOneSecondsLeft = Math.Max(1, _configuredPhotoViewSeconds);
                    PhaseOneCountdownText.Text = _phaseOneSecondsLeft.ToString();
                }
            }
            else
            {
                _phaseOneSecondsLeft = DefaultPhaseOneSeconds;
                PhaseOneCountdownText.Text = _phaseOneSecondsLeft.ToString();
            }

            PhaseTwoRoot.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            PhaseTwoRoot.Opacity = 0;

            PhaseOneRoot.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            PhaseOneRoot.Opacity = 1;

            PhaseOneCountdownScale.ScaleX = 1;
            PhaseOneCountdownScale.ScaleY = 1;

            QuestionMediaPanel.Opacity = 0;
            PhaseOneQuestionText.Opacity = 0;

            QuestionMediaPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;

            if (shouldAutoAdvance)
            {
                StartPhaseOneCountdown(_phaseOneSecondsLeft);
            }
            else
            {
                StopPhaseOneCountdown();
            }
            try
            {
                bool mediaAnimationStarted = false;
                bool textAnimationStarted = false;

                // Запускаем анимации без использования TargetName, чтобы избежать проблем с Namescope
                if (Resources["PhaseOneMediaEntranceStoryboard"] is Storyboard mediaSb)
                {
                    var clone = mediaSb.Clone();
                    clone.Begin(PhaseOneRoot, true);
                    mediaAnimationStarted = true;
                }

                if (Resources["PhaseOneTextEntranceStoryboard"] is Storyboard textSb)
                {
                    var clone = textSb.Clone();
                    clone.Begin(PhaseOneRoot, true);
                    textAnimationStarted = true;
                }

                if (!mediaAnimationStarted)
                {
                    QuestionMediaPanel.Opacity = 1;
                }

                if (!textAnimationStarted)
                {
                    PhaseOneQuestionText.Opacity = 1;
                }

                Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
                {
                    if (PhaseOneRoot.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
                    {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (QuestionMediaPanel.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && QuestionMediaPanel.Opacity < 0.05)
                    {
                        QuestionMediaPanel.Opacity = 1;
                    }

                    if (PhaseOneQuestionText.Opacity < 0.05)
                    {
                        PhaseOneQuestionText.Opacity = 1;
                    }
                }), DispatcherPriority.Render);

            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Phase1 animation error: {ex.Message}");
                QuestionMediaPanel.Opacity = 1;
                PhaseOneQuestionText.Opacity = 1;
            }
        }

        private void ResetPhaseAnimationState()
        {
            try { PhaseOneRoot.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null); } catch { }
            try { PhaseTwoRoot.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null); } catch { }
            try { QuestionMediaPanel.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null); } catch { }
            try { PhaseOneQuestionText.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null); } catch { }
            try { PhaseOneMediaScale.BeginAnimation(System.Windows.Media.ScaleTransform.ScaleXProperty, null); } catch { }
            try { PhaseOneMediaScale.BeginAnimation(System.Windows.Media.ScaleTransform.ScaleYProperty, null); } catch { }

            PhaseOneRoot.Opacity = 1;
            PhaseTwoRoot.Opacity = 1;
            if (QuestionMediaPanel != null) QuestionMediaPanel.Opacity = 1;
            if (PhaseOneQuestionText != null) PhaseOneQuestionText.Opacity = 1;
            if (PhaseOneMediaScale != null)
            {
                PhaseOneMediaScale.ScaleX = 1;
                PhaseOneMediaScale.ScaleY = 1;
            }
        }

        private void StartPhaseOneProgressAnimation()
        {
            if (_phaseOneCountdownStoryboard != null)
            {
                try { _phaseOneCountdownStoryboard.Stop(PhaseOneRoot); } catch { }
                _phaseOneCountdownStoryboard = null;
            }

            if (Resources["PhaseOneCountdownProgressStoryboard"] is not Storyboard countdownStoryboard)
            {
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                _phaseOneCountdownStoryboard = countdownStoryboard.Clone();

                var duration = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Max(1, _phaseOneSecondsLeft));
                foreach (var animation in _phaseOneCountdownStoryboard.Children.OfType<DoubleAnimation>())
                {
                    animation.Duration = new Duration(duration);
                }

                _phaseOneCountdownStoryboard.Begin(PhaseOneRoot, true);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Countdown animation error: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private void StartPhaseOneCountdown(int seconds)
        {
            StopPhaseOneCountdown();

            _phaseOneSecondsLeft = Math.Max(1, seconds);
            PhaseOneCountdownText.Text = _phaseOneSecondsLeft.ToString();
            StartPhaseOneProgressAnimation();

            _phaseOneCountdownTimer = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1) };
            _phaseOneCountdownTimer.Tick += (_, _) =>
            {
                _phaseOneSecondsLeft = Math.Max(0, _phaseOneSecondsLeft - 1);
                PhaseOneCountdownText.Text = _phaseOneSecondsLeft.ToString();

                if (_phaseOneSecondsLeft <= 0)
                {
                    EnterPhaseTwoWithTransition(true);
                }
            };
            _phaseOneCountdownTimer.Start();
        }

        private void StopPhaseOneCountdown()
        {
            if (_phaseOneCountdownTimer != null)
            {
                _phaseOneCountdownTimer.Stop();
                _phaseOneCountdownTimer = null;
            }

            if (_phaseOneCountdownStoryboard != null)
            {
                try { _phaseOneCountdownStoryboard.Stop(PhaseOneRoot); } catch { }
                _phaseOneCountdownStoryboard = null;
            }
        }

        private void EnterPhaseTwoWithTransition(bool resetQuestionTimer)
        {
            if (_isTransitioningToPhaseTwo || _isQuizContextCleaned) return;
            int transitionVersion = _questionPhaseVersion;
            _isTransitioningToPhaseTwo = true;
            StopPhaseOneCountdown();
            StopQuestionVideoPlayback();

            void StartTimerAndAnimations()
            {
                if (_isQuizContextCleaned || transitionVersion != _questionPhaseVersion)
                {
                    return;
                }

                if (_boundViewModel != null)
                {
                    _boundViewModel.DeferQuestionTimerStart = false;
                    _boundViewModel.StartTimerForCurrentQuestion(resetQuestionTimer);
                }
                UpdateTimerProgressWidth();
                AnimateAnswerCardsAppearance();
                try { BeginStoryboardFromResources("PhaseTwoMiniMediaInStoryboard", PhaseTwoRoot); }
                catch { }
            }

            if (PhaseOneRoot.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
            {
                if (_isQuizContextCleaned || transitionVersion != _questionPhaseVersion)
                {
                    _isTransitioningToPhaseTwo = false;
                    return;
                }

                ShowPhaseTwo();
                StartTimerAndAnimations();
                _isTransitioningToPhaseTwo = false;
                return;
            }

            if (Resources["PhaseFadeOutStoryboard"] is Storyboard fadeOut)
            {
                var outClone = fadeOut.Clone();
                outClone.Completed += (_, _) =>
                {
                    if (_isQuizContextCleaned || transitionVersion != _questionPhaseVersion)
                    {
                        _isTransitioningToPhaseTwo = false;
                        return;
                    }

                    PhaseOneRoot.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                    ShowPhaseTwo();

                    if (Resources["PhaseFadeInStoryboard"] is Storyboard fadeIn)
                    {
                        var inClone = fadeIn.Clone();
                        inClone.Completed += (_, _) => _isTransitioningToPhaseTwo = false;
                        inClone.Begin(PhaseTwoRoot);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        PhaseTwoRoot.Opacity = 1;
                        _isTransitioningToPhaseTwo = false;
                    }

                    StartTimerAndAnimations();
                };
                outClone.Begin(PhaseOneRoot);
            }
            else
            {
                if (_isQuizContextCleaned || transitionVersion != _questionPhaseVersion)
                {
                    _isTransitioningToPhaseTwo = false;
                    return;
                }

                PhaseOneRoot.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                ShowPhaseTwo();
                StartTimerAndAnimations();
                _isTransitioningToPhaseTwo = false;
            }
        }

        private void StopQuestionVideoPlayback()
        {
            if (QuestionVideo == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            try { QuestionVideo.Stop(); } catch { }
            try { QuestionVideo.Position = TimeSpan.Zero; } catch { }
        }

        private void ShowPhaseTwo()
        {
            PhaseOneRoot.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            PhaseTwoRoot.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            if (PhaseTwoRoot.Opacity <= 0)
            {
                PhaseTwoRoot.Opacity = 1;
            }
        }

        private void AnimateAnswerCardsAppearance()
        {
            if (OptionsContainer == null || DataContext is not MainViewModel vm || vm.IsCurrentQuestionOpen) return;

            int attempts = 0;
            int[] delays = { 0, 70, 140, 210 };
            var retryTimer = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(80) };
            retryTimer.Tick += (_, _) =>
            {
                attempts++;
                bool anyFound = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < OptionsContainer.Items.Count; i++)
                {
                    var border = GetAnswerBorderByIndex(i);
                    if (border == null) continue;
                    anyFound = true;
                    if (Resources["AnswerCardAppearStoryboard"] is Storyboard sb)
                    {
                        var clone = sb.Clone();
                        clone.BeginTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(i < delays.Length ? delays[i] : 210);
                        clone.Begin(border);
                    }
                }
                if (anyFound || attempts >= 10) retryTimer.Stop();
            };
            retryTimer.Start();
        }

        private void ApplyOptionBadges()
        {
            if (OptionsContainer == null) return;

            for (int i = 0; i < OptionsContainer.Items.Count; i++)
            {
                var container = OptionsContainer.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) as ContentPresenter;
                if (container == null) continue;

                var badgeText = FindVisualChildByName<TextBlock>(container, "OptionBadgeText");
                if (badgeText == null) continue;

                badgeText.Text = GetOptionLabelByIndex(i);
            }
        }

        private static string GetOptionLabelByIndex(int index)
        {
            const string labels = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";
            if (index >= 0 && index < labels.Length)
            {
                return labels[index].ToString();
            }
            return (index + 1).ToString();
        }

        private Border? GetAnswerBorderByIndex(int index)
        {
            if (OptionsContainer == null) return null;
            var container = OptionsContainer.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(index) as ContentPresenter;
            return container == null ? null : FindVisualChildByName<Border>(container, "AnswerBorder");
        }

        private void ResetAnswerCardsToDefault()
        {
            if (OptionsContainer == null) return;

            for (int i = 0; i < OptionsContainer.Items.Count; i++)
            {
                var border = GetAnswerBorderByIndex(i);
                if (border == null) continue;

                SetAnswerCardVisualState(
                    border,
                    Color.FromRgb(255, 255, 255),
                    Color.FromRgb(206, 203, 246),
                    Color.FromRgb(228, 226, 251),
                    Color.FromRgb(83, 74, 183),
                    Color.FromRgb(32, 27, 72));
            }
        }

        private void ApplySelectedAnswerStyle(int selectedIndex)
        {
            ResetAnswerCardsToDefault();

            var border = GetAnswerBorderByIndex(selectedIndex);
            if (border == null) return;

            AnimateAnswerCardColor(border, Color.FromRgb(238, 237, 254), Color.FromRgb(83, 74, 183));
            SetAnswerCardVisualState(
                border,
                Color.FromRgb(238, 237, 254),
                Color.FromRgb(83, 74, 183),
                Color.FromRgb(83, 74, 183),
                Colors.White,
                Color.FromRgb(32, 27, 72));
        }

        private void SetAnswerCardVisualState(Border border, Color cardColor, Color borderColor, Color badgeColor, Color badgeTextColor, Color textColor)
        {
            border.Background = new SolidColorBrush(cardColor);
            border.BorderBrush = new SolidColorBrush(borderColor);
            border.BorderThickness = new Thickness(1.5);

            var badge = FindVisualChildByName<Border>(border, "OptionBadge");
            if (badge != null)
            {
                badge.Background = new SolidColorBrush(badgeColor);
            }

            var badgeText = FindVisualChildByName<TextBlock>(border, "OptionBadgeText");
            if (badgeText != null)
            {
                badgeText.Foreground = new SolidColorBrush(badgeTextColor);
            }

            var optionText = FindVisualChildByName<TextBlock>(border, "OptionText");
            if (optionText != null)
            {
                optionText.Foreground = new SolidColorBrush(textColor);
                optionText.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold;
            }
        }

        private void AnimateAnswerCardColor(Border border, Color targetCardColor, Color targetBorderColor)
        {
            if (border.Background is not SolidColorBrush backgroundBrush)
            {
                backgroundBrush = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.White);
                border.Background = backgroundBrush;
            }

            if (border.BorderBrush is not SolidColorBrush borderBrush)
            {
                borderBrush = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(206, 203, 246));
                border.BorderBrush = borderBrush;
            }

            backgroundBrush.BeginAnimation(SolidColorBrush.ColorProperty, new ColorAnimation(targetCardColor, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(120)));
            borderBrush.BeginAnimation(SolidColorBrush.ColorProperty, new ColorAnimation(targetBorderColor, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(120)));
        }

        private void PlayAnswerCardStoryboard(int optionIndex, string storyboardKey)
        {
            var border = GetAnswerBorderByIndex(optionIndex);
            if (border == null) return;

            BeginStoryboardFromResources(storyboardKey, border);
        }

        private void BeginStoryboardFromResources(string key, FrameworkElement target)
        {
            if (Resources[key] is not Storyboard storyboard) return;
            var clone = storyboard.Clone();
            clone.Begin(target);
        }

        private static BitmapImage LoadBitmap(Uri uri)
        {
            try
            {
                var bmp = new BitmapImage();
                bmp.BeginInit();
                bmp.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
                bmp.CreateOptions = BitmapCreateOptions.IgnoreImageCache;
                bmp.UriSource = uri;
                bmp.EndInit();
                bmp.Freeze();
                return bmp;
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static Uri TryCreateMediaUri(string path)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) return null;
            try
            {
                var candidate = path.Trim();

                if (candidate.StartsWith("www.", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    candidate = "https://" + candidate;
                }

                if (Uri.TryCreate(candidate, UriKind.Absolute, out var absolute))
                {
                    if (absolute.IsFile)
                    {
                        var localPath = absolute.LocalPath;
                        if (File.Exists(localPath))
                        {
                            return absolute;
                        }
                    }
                    else if (IsHttpOrHttpsUri(absolute))
                    {
                        return absolute;
                    }
                }

                if (candidate.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                    || candidate.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    var normalizedHttp = candidate.Replace(" ", "%20", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                    if (Uri.TryCreate(normalizedHttp, UriKind.Absolute, out var normalizedAbsolute) && IsHttpOrHttpsUri(normalizedAbsolute))
                    {
                        return normalizedAbsolute;
                    }
                }

                if (File.Exists(candidate))
                {
                    return new Uri(Path.GetFullPath(candidate), UriKind.Absolute);
                }

                return null;
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string DetectMediaKind(string path)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) return "none";

            string candidate = path.Trim();
            if (Uri.TryCreate(candidate, UriKind.Absolute, out var absoluteUri))
            {
                candidate = absoluteUri.AbsolutePath;
            }
            else
            {
                int queryIndex = candidate.IndexOf('?');
                if (queryIndex >= 0)
                {
                    candidate = candidate[..queryIndex];
                }
            }

            var extension = Path.GetExtension(candidate).ToLowerInvariant();
            if (extension == ".gif") return "gif";
            if (Array.Exists(VideoExtensions, ext => string.Equals(ext, extension, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))) return "video";
            if (Array.Exists(ImageExtensions, ext => string.Equals(ext, extension, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))) return "image";

            if (Uri.TryCreate(path.Trim(), UriKind.Absolute, out var uri) && IsHttpOrHttpsUri(uri))
            {
                return "video";
            }

            return "image";
        }

        private static bool IsHttpOrHttpsUri(Uri uri)
        {
            return uri.Scheme.Equals(Uri.UriSchemeHttp, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || uri.Scheme.Equals(Uri.UriSchemeHttps, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }

        private static T FindVisualChildByName<T>(DependencyObject parent, string name) where T : FrameworkElement
        {
            if (parent == null) return null;
            int count = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(parent);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                var child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, i);
                if (child is T t && t.Name == name) return t;
                var result = FindVisualChildByName<T>(child, name);
                if (result != null) return result;
            }
            return null;
        }

        private void QuestionVideo_MediaEnded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                if (QuestionVideo == null || _isQuizContextCleaned)
                {
                    return;
                }

                if (_allowVideoReplay && PhaseOneRoot.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && !_isTransitioningToPhaseTwo)
                {
                    StopPhaseOneCountdown();
                    PhaseOneCountdownText.Text = "∞";

                    try
                    {
                        QuestionVideo.Position = TimeSpan.Zero;
                        QuestionVideo.Play();
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("QuestionVideo replay failed", ex);
                    }

                    return;
                }

                if (PhaseOneRoot.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && !_isTransitioningToPhaseTwo)
                {
                    EnterPhaseTwoWithTransition(true);
                }
            }
            catch { }
        }

        private void QuestionVideo_MediaOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                if (!_currentQuestionHasVideo || _isQuizContextCleaned || _isTransitioningToPhaseTwo)
                {
                    return;
                }

                if (_allowVideoReplay)
                {
                    StopPhaseOneCountdown();
                    PhaseOneCountdownText.Text = "∞";
                    return;
                }

                if (QuestionVideo?.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan != true)
                {
                    return;
                }

                var durationSeconds = (int)Math.Ceiling(QuestionVideo.NaturalDuration.TimeSpan.TotalSeconds);
                durationSeconds = Math.Max(DefaultPhaseOneSeconds, Math.Min(300, durationSeconds));

                if (PhaseOneRoot.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
                {
                    StartPhaseOneCountdown(durationSeconds);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("QuestionVideo_MediaOpened error", ex);
            }
        }

        private void QuestionVideo_MediaFailed(object sender, ExceptionRoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.LogError("QuestionVideo_MediaFailed", e.ErrorException);

                if (PhaseOneRoot.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && !_isTransitioningToPhaseTwo)
                {
                    EnterPhaseTwoWithTransition(true);
                }
            }
            catch { }
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/QuizSelectionDialog.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class QuizSelectionDialog : Window
    {
        public Quiz? SelectedQuiz { get; private set; }
        private List<Quiz> _allQuizzes;
        private List<Quiz> _filteredQuizzes;
        private int _currentPage = 0;
        private const int QuizzesPerPage = 4;

        public QuizSelectionDialog(List<Quiz> quizzes)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _allQuizzes = quizzes ?? new List<Quiz>();
            _filteredQuizzes = new List<Quiz>(_allQuizzes);
            
            // Показываем затемнение фона при открытии
            var mainWindow = Application.Current.MainWindow as MainWindow;
            mainWindow?.ShowOverlay();

            // Если главное окно пытается закрыться, автоматически закрываем диалог
            if (mainWindow != null)
            {
                mainWindow.Closing += MainWindow_Closing;
                this.Closed += (s, e) => { try { mainWindow.Closing -= MainWindow_Closing; } catch { } };
            }
            
            // Скрываем затемнение при закрытии окна любым способом
            Closed += (s, e) =>
            {
                mainWindow?.HideOverlay();
            };
            
            // Позиционируем окно чуть ниже центра экрана, чтобы не залезало на фиолетовый блок сверху
            Loaded += (s, e) =>
            {
                var screen = SystemParameters.WorkArea;
                Left = (screen.Width - Width) / 2;
                Top = (screen.Height - Height) / 2 + 60; // Опускаем на 60 пикселей ниже центра
            };
            
            LoadQuizzes();
        }

        private void MainWindow_Closing(object? sender, System.ComponentModel.CancelEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                // Закрываем модальный диалог, чтобы не блокировать завершение приложения
                if (IsVisible)
                {
                    DialogResult = false;
                    Close();
                }
            }
            catch { }
        }

        private void LoadQuizzes()
        {
            _currentPage = 0;
            UpdatePage();
            StatusText.Text = $"Найдено викторин: {_filteredQuizzes.Count}";
        }

        private void UpdatePage()
        {
            var totalPages = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)_filteredQuizzes.Count / QuizzesPerPage);
            if (totalPages == 0) totalPages = 1;
            
            var startIndex = _currentPage * QuizzesPerPage;
            var pageQuizzes = _filteredQuizzes.Skip(startIndex).Take(QuizzesPerPage).ToList();
            
            // Ensure selected quiz is still selected if it's on current page
            if (SelectedQuiz != null)
            {
                foreach (var q in _filteredQuizzes)
                {
                    q.IsSelected = (q.Id == SelectedQuiz.Id);
                }
            }
            
            QuizzesItemsControl.ItemsSource = null;
            QuizzesItemsControl.ItemsSource = pageQuizzes;
            
            // Update pagination buttons
            PrevPageButton.IsEnabled = _currentPage > 0;
            NextPageButton.IsEnabled = _currentPage < totalPages - 1;
            
            // Update page info
            PageInfoText.Text = $"{_currentPage + 1} / {totalPages}";
            
            // Update status
            if (SelectedQuiz != null)
            {
                StatusText.Text = $"Выбрано: {SelectedQuiz.Title} ({SelectedQuiz.Questions?.Count ?? 0} вопросов)";
            }
            else
            {
                StatusText.Text = $"Найдено викторин: {_filteredQuizzes.Count}";
            }
        }

        private void PrevPageButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_currentPage > 0)
            {
                _currentPage--;
                UpdatePage();
            }
        }

        private void NextPageButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            var totalPages = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)_filteredQuizzes.Count / QuizzesPerPage);
            if (_currentPage < totalPages - 1)
            {
                _currentPage++;
                UpdatePage();
            }
        }

        private void SearchTextBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            var searchText = SearchTextBox.Text?.ToLower() ?? string.Empty;
            
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchText))
            {
                _filteredQuizzes = new List<Quiz>(_allQuizzes);
            }
            else
            {
                _filteredQuizzes = _allQuizzes.Where(q => 
                    q.Title.ToLower().Contains(searchText) ||
                    (q.Description?.ToLower().Contains(searchText) ?? false)
                ).ToList();
            }

            _currentPage = 0;
            UpdatePage();
        }

        private void QuizItem_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is Border border && border.DataContext is Quiz quiz)
            {
                // Deselect all quizzes
                foreach (var q in _filteredQuizzes)
                {
                    q.IsSelected = false;
                }
                
                // Select current quiz
                quiz.IsSelected = true;
                SelectedQuiz = quiz;
                SelectButton.IsEnabled = true;
                StatusText.Text = $"Выбрано: {quiz.Title} ({quiz.Questions?.Count ?? 0} вопросов)";
                
                // Refresh display to show selection
                UpdatePage();
            }
        }

        private void SelectButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (SelectedQuiz != null)
            {
                DialogResult = true;
                Close();
            }
            else
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Пожалуйста, выберите викторину из списка.", "Выбор викторины", 
                    MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
            }
        }

        private void CloseButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DialogResult = false;
            Close();
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/QuizSettingsDialog.xaml.cs ===

using System.Windows;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class QuizSettingsDialog : Window
    {
        public int TimePerQuestion { get; private set; } = 30;
        public bool HasTimer { get; private set; } = true;
        public int PhotoViewSeconds { get; private set; } = 5;
        public bool UnlimitedPhotoViewEnabled { get; private set; }
        public bool AllowVideoReplay { get; private set; }

        public QuizSettingsDialog()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        private void Start_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Исправлена логика: если NoTimerToggle.IsChecked == true, то таймер отключен
            HasTimer = !(NoTimerToggle.IsChecked ?? false);
            if (HasTimer)
            {
                TimePerQuestion = (int)TimeSlider.Value;
            }
            else
            {
                TimePerQuestion = 0; // 0 означает без таймера
            }

            PhotoViewSeconds = (int)PhotoTimeSlider.Value;
            UnlimitedPhotoViewEnabled = LimitPhotoTimeToggle.IsChecked ?? false;
            AllowVideoReplay = AllowVideoReplayToggle.IsChecked ?? false;

            DialogResult = true;
            Close();
        }

        private void Cancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DialogResult = false;
            Close();
        }
    }
}
