        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task CleanupRoomAfterResults()
        {
            try
            {
                var vmRoom = RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;
                if (vmRoom != null)
                {
                    await _multiplayerService.DeleteRoom(vmRoom.Id);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("CleanupRoomAfterResults error", ex);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LeaveRoom()
        {
            try
            {
                var vmRoom = RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (vmRoom != null && currentUser != null)
                {
                    await _multiplayerService.LeaveRoom(vmRoom.Id, currentUser.Username);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("LeaveRoom error", ex);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task TryFinishQuestionEarlyAsync()
        {
            if (!_waitForAll) return;

            try
            {
                var vmRoom = RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;
                if (vmRoom == null) return;

                var session = await _multiplayerService.GetSession(vmRoom.Id);
                if (session == null) return;

                // Получаем количество игроков
                var players = await _multiplayerService.GetRoomPlayersPublic(vmRoom.Id);
                int playerCount = players.Count;
                if (playerCount == 0) return;

                // Считаем ответы
                int answersCount = 0;
                if (session.Answers.HasValue)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var answersDict = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, List<Dictionary<string, object>>>>(session.Answers.Value.GetRawText());
                        if (answersDict != null)
                        {
                            foreach (var kvp in answersDict)
                            {
                                if (kvp.Value.Any(a => a.TryGetValue("q", out var qObj) && SafeToInt(qObj) == _currentQuestionIndex))
                                {
                                    answersCount++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("TryFinishQuestionEarlyAsync parsing error", ex);
                    }
                }

                if (answersCount >= playerCount)
                {
                    // Все ответили
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("TryFinishQuestionEarlyAsync error", ex);
            }
        }

        private int SafeToInt(object? value)
        {
            if (value is int i) return i;
            if (value is System.Text.Json.JsonElement je && je.ValueKind == System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.Number && je.TryGetInt32(out var jInt)) return jInt;
            return 0;
        }


        private async void GoToMenu_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                // Очищаем комнату при выходе в меню
                var currentRoom = RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                
                if (currentRoom != null && currentUser != null)
                {
                    var gameService = new SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                    
                    if (string.Equals(currentRoom.HostUsername, currentUser.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        // После показа результатов — полностью удаляем игроков и комнату
                        await gameService.CleanupRoomAfterResults(currentRoom.Id);
                        Logger.Log($"Host {currentUser.Username} cleaned up room {currentRoom.Id} on menu exit");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // Гость покидает комнату
                        await gameService.LeaveRoom(currentRoom.Id, currentUser.Username);
                        Logger.Log($"Guest {currentUser.Username} left room {currentRoom.Id} on menu exit");
                    }
                    
                    // Очищаем локальные данные
                    RoomDataService.CurrentRoom = null;
                    RoomDataService.CurrentPlayer = null;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"Error cleaning up room on menu exit: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
            
            Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("MultiplayerMenu");
        }

        private async void UpdateSpectatorDashboard()
        {
            if (SpectatorPlayersList == null) return;

            try
            {
                var vmRoom = RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;
                if (vmRoom == null) return;

                // Get player stats
                var stats = await _multiplayerService.GetRoomPlayersWithStats(vmRoom.Id);
                if (stats == null || stats.Count == 0) return;

                // Get session to check answer counts
                var session = await _multiplayerService.GetSession(vmRoom.Id);
                Dictionary<string, List<Dictionary<string, object>>> answersDict = null;

                if (session?.Answers != null && session.Answers.HasValue)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        answersDict = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, List<Dictionary<string, object>>>>(session.Answers.Value.GetRawText());
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("UpdateSpectatorDashboard parsing error", ex);
                    }
                }

                int totalQuestions = _currentRoom?.Quiz?.Questions?.Count ?? 0;
                var spectatorList = new List<SpectatorPlayerInfo>();

                foreach (var s in stats)
                {
                    // Skip host if not participating
                    if (string.Equals(s.Username, vmRoom.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        continue;

                    int currentQuestion = s.TotalQuestions;
                    int correctCount = s.CorrectAnswers;
                    int wrongCount = Math.Max(0, s.TotalQuestions - s.CorrectAnswers);

                    string statusText = "";
                    if (currentQuestion >= totalQuestions)
                    {
                        statusText = "Завершил";
                    }
                    else if (currentQuestion > 0)
                    {
                        statusText = "В процессе";
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        statusText = "Ожидает";
                    }

                    spectatorList.Add(new SpectatorPlayerInfo
                    {
                        Username = s.Username,
                        DisplayName = s.DisplayName,
                        QuestionProgress = $"{currentQuestion}/{totalQuestions}",
                        CorrectCount = correctCount,
                        WrongCount = wrongCount,
                        StatusText = statusText
                    });
                }

                // Sort by progress (descending)
                spectatorList = spectatorList.OrderByDescending(p => p.CorrectCount).ThenBy(p => p.WrongCount).ToList();

                SpectatorPlayersList.ItemsSource = spectatorList;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("UpdateSpectatorDashboard error", ex);
            }
        }

        // ======================================================================
        //  Phase C: медиа-вопросы (картинки/гиф/видео) и открытые вопросы
        // ======================================================================

        /// <summary>
        /// Загрузить медиа основного вопроса: Image для картинок и гифок (анимация через WpfAnimatedGif),
        /// MediaElement для видео. Пустой ImagePath скрывает панель.
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadQuestionMedia(Question question)
        {
            try
            {
                // Сброс предыдущего состояния
                if (QuestionMediaPanel != null) QuestionMediaPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                if (QuestionImage != null)
                {
                    WpfAnimatedGif.ImageBehavior.SetAnimatedSource(QuestionImage, null);
                    QuestionImage.Source = null;
                    QuestionImage.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }
                if (QuestionVideo != null)
                {
                    try { QuestionVideo.Stop(); } catch { }
                    QuestionVideo.Source = null;
                    QuestionVideo.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }

                if (question == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(question.ImagePath)) return;

                var uri = TryCreateMediaUri(question.ImagePath);
                if (uri == null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[RoomGameView] Skipping question media: cannot resolve '{question.ImagePath}'");
                    return;
                }

                var kind = DetectMediaKind(question.ImagePath);

                if (kind == "video")
                {
                    if (QuestionVideo != null)
                    {
                        QuestionVideo.Source = uri;
                        QuestionVideo.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                        QuestionVideo.Play();
                    }
                }
                else if (QuestionImage != null)
                {
                    QuestionImage.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    var bitmap = LoadBitmap(uri);
                    if (bitmap != null)
                    {
                        if (kind == "gif")
                        {
                            WpfAnimatedGif.ImageBehavior.SetAnimatedSource(QuestionImage, bitmap);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            QuestionImage.Source = bitmap;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (QuestionMediaPanel != null) QuestionMediaPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"LoadQuestionMedia error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Пробегает по контейнерам ItemsControl и выставляет Source у Image "OptionMedia"
        /// согласно question.OptionMediaPaths[index]. Вызывается после того, как
        /// ItemsSource проставлен и контейнеры сгенерированы (через Dispatcher.BeginInvoke).
        /// </summary>
        private void RenderOptionMedia(Question question)
        {
            try
            {
                if (OptionsContainer == null || question == null) return;
                var paths = question.OptionMediaPaths;
                if (paths == null || paths.Count == 0) return;
                if (question.Options == null) return;

                int count = Math.Min(question.Options.Count, paths.Count);
                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                {
                    var path = paths[i];
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) continue;

                    var container = OptionsContainer.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) as ContentPresenter;
                    if (container == null) continue;

                    var image = FindVisualChildByName<Image>(container, "OptionMedia");
                    if (image == null) continue;

                    var uri = TryCreateMediaUri(path);
                    if (uri == null) continue;

                    var kind = DetectMediaKind(path);
                    if (kind == "video")
                    {
                        // В вариантах ответа видео не рендерим (неудобно UI), оставляем опцию без превью.
                        continue;
                    }

                    var bitmap = LoadBitmap(uri);
                    if (bitmap == null) continue;

                    if (kind == "gif")
                    {
                        WpfAnimatedGif.ImageBehavior.SetAnimatedSource(image, bitmap);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        image.Source = bitmap;
                    }
                    image.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"RenderOptionMedia error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        private static BitmapImage? LoadBitmap(Uri uri)
        {
            try
            {
                var bmp = new BitmapImage();
                bmp.BeginInit();
                bmp.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
                bmp.CreateOptions = BitmapCreateOptions.IgnoreImageCache;
                bmp.UriSource = uri;
                bmp.EndInit();
                bmp.Freeze();
                return bmp;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"LoadBitmap error for {uri}: {ex.Message}");
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static Uri? TryCreateMediaUri(string path)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) return null;
            try
            {
                if (Uri.TryCreate(path, UriKind.Absolute, out var absolute)) return absolute;
                if (File.Exists(path)) return new Uri(path, UriKind.Absolute);
                return null;
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string DetectMediaKind(string path)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) return "none";
            var lower = path.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
            if (lower.EndsWith(".gif")) return "gif";
            if (lower.EndsWith(".mp4") || lower.EndsWith(".webm") || lower.EndsWith(".mov") ||
                lower.EndsWith(".avi") || lower.EndsWith(".mkv")) return "video";
            return "image";
        }

        private static T? FindVisualChildByName<T>(DependencyObject parent, string name) where T : FrameworkElement
        {
            if (parent == null) return null;
            int count = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(parent);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                var child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, i);
                if (child is T t && t.Name == name) return t;
                var result = FindVisualChildByName<T>(child, name);
                if (result != null) return result;
            }
            return null;
        }

        // Зацикливаем видео, пока игрок не ответил.
        private void QuestionVideo_MediaEnded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {

                QuestionVideo.Position = TimeSpan.Zero;
                QuestionVideo.Play();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("QuestionVideo_MediaEnded error", ex);
            }
        }

            }
        }

        private void SubmitOpenAnswer_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_questionAnswered) return;
            var question = _currentRoom?.Quiz?.Questions?.ElementAtOrDefault(_currentQuestionIndex);
            if (question == null) return;

            var input = OpenAnswerInput?.Text ?? string.Empty;
            var expected = question.OpenAnswer ?? string.Empty;
            bool isCorrect = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) &&
                             string.Equals(input.Trim(), expected.Trim(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            _questionAnswered = true;
            if (OpenAnswerInput != null) OpenAnswerInput.IsEnabled = false;
            if (SubmitOpenAnswerBtn != null) SubmitOpenAnswerBtn.IsEnabled = false;

            ProcessAnswerResult(isCorrect);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Общая логика обработки ответа (скоринг, sync, автопереход).
        /// Используется для закрытых (из Answer_Click) и открытых вопросов.
        /// </summary>
        private async void ProcessAnswerResult(bool isCorrect)
        {
            var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
            var room = RoomDataService.CurrentRoom;

            // Вычисляем время ответа (с учетом синхронизации)
            double elapsedSec;
            if (_waitForAll && _serverQuestionStartTime.HasValue)
            {
                elapsedSec = (DateTime.UtcNow - _serverQuestionStartTime.Value).TotalSeconds;
            }
            else
            {
                elapsedSec = _questionTimer.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;
            }
            // Ограничиваем временем вопроса
            elapsedSec = Math.Min(elapsedSec, _questionTimeSeconds);
            if (elapsedSec < 0) elapsedSec = 0;

            if (isCorrect)
            {
                var me = FindPlayerScore(currentUser?.Username, currentUser?.DisplayName);
                if (me != null)
                {
                    var remaining = Math.Max(0, _questionTimeSeconds - elapsedSec);
                    var factor = _questionTimeSeconds > 0 ? remaining / _questionTimeSeconds : 1.0;
                    var points = (int)Math.Max(200, 1000 * factor);
                    me.Score += points;
                }
                UpdateLeaderboard();
                SoundService.Instance.PlaySuccessSound();
                var shownPoints = _questionTimeSeconds > 0
                    ? (int)Math.Max(200, 1000 * Math.Max(0, (_questionTimeSeconds - elapsedSec)) / _questionTimeSeconds)
                    : 1000;
                ShowResultBanner($"Верно! +{shownPoints}", true);
                _numCorrect++;
                if (MyScoreText != null) MyScoreText.Text = _numCorrect.ToString();
            }
            else
            {
                SoundService.Instance.PlayErrorSound();
                ShowResultBanner("Неверно", false);
            }

            // Отправляем в сессию с ожиданием, чтобы данные точно попали в БД до конца игры
            if (room != null)
            {
                await _multiplayerService.SubmitAnswer(room.Id, currentUser?.Username ?? "", _currentQuestionIndex,
                    elapsedSec, isCorrect);
            }

            // Локальная статистика
            _answerTimesSeconds.Add(elapsedSec);
            _totalTimeSeconds += elapsedSec;
            _numAnswered++;

            _ = TryFinishQuestionEarlyAsync();

            // Синхронизируем мой счёт на сервер для лидерборда у других
            try
            {
                var meSync = FindPlayerScore(currentUser?.Username, currentUser?.DisplayName);
                if (meSync != null && room != null && currentUser != null)
                {
                    await _multiplayerService.SetPlayerScore(room.Id, currentUser.Username, meSync.Score);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("ProcessAnswerResult SetPlayerScore error", ex);
            }

            // Автопереход
            if (_currentRoom?.Quiz?.Questions == null || room == null) return;

            // Ждём визуальную паузу для показа правильного ответа
            await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(1200);

            if (!_waitForAll)
            {
                _currentQuestionIndex++;
                _questionAnswered = false;
                LoadQuestion();
                return;
            }

            if (_isHost)
            {
                if (_currentQuestionIndex >= _currentRoom.Quiz.Questions.Count - 1)
                {
                    await _multiplayerService.FinishRoomByHost(room.Id);
                    ShowGameFinished();
                }
                else
                {
                    await _multiplayerService.UpdateSessionQuestionIndex(room.Id, _currentQuestionIndex + 1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Data class for spectator player info
    public class SpectatorPlayerInfo
    {
        public string Username { get; set; }
        public string DisplayName { get; set; }
        public string QuestionProgress { get; set; }
        public int CorrectCount { get; set; }
        public int WrongCount { get; set; }
        public string StatusText { get; set; }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/RoomHostView.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using Victory.Services;
using Victory.ViewModels;
using Victory.Models;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class RoomHostView : Page
    {
        private GameRoomViewModel? _viewModel;
        private DispatcherTimer? _pollTimer;

        public RoomHostView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            Logger.Log("[RoomHostView] Constructor called");
            Loaded += RoomHostView_Loaded;
            Unloaded += RoomHostView_Unloaded;
            
            // Добавляем обработчики для RadioButtons
            NoTimerRadio.Checked += TimerMode_Changed;
            GlobalTimerRadio.Checked += TimerMode_Changed;
            PerQuestionTimerRadio.Checked += TimerMode_Changed;
            
            // Добавляем обработчики для синхронизации настроек
            NoTimerRadio.Checked += Settings_Changed;
            GlobalTimerRadio.Checked += Settings_Changed;
            PerQuestionTimerRadio.Checked += Settings_Changed;
            GlobalTimerTextBox.TextChanged += Settings_TextChanged;
            PerQuestionTimerTextBox.TextChanged += Settings_TextChanged;
            WaitForAllToggle.Checked += Settings_Changed;
            WaitForAllToggle.Unchecked += Settings_Changed;
            ShuffleQuestionsToggle.Checked += Settings_Changed;
            ShuffleQuestionsToggle.Unchecked += Settings_Changed;
            HostParticipationToggle.Checked += Settings_Changed;
            HostParticipationToggle.Unchecked += Settings_Changed;
            RejoinAllowedCheckBox.Checked += Settings_Changed;
            RejoinAllowedCheckBox.Unchecked += Settings_Changed;
        }

        private void RoomHostView_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Logger.Log("[RoomHostView] Loaded event fired");
            _viewModel = DataContext as GameRoomViewModel;
            
            if (_viewModel != null)
            {
                Logger.Log($"[RoomHostView] DataContext is GameRoomViewModel");
                _viewModel.PropertyChanged += ViewModel_PropertyChanged;
                UpdateRoomInfo();
            }
            else
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[RoomHostView] DataContext is not GameRoomViewModel: {DataContext?.GetType().Name ?? "null"}");
            }


            // Polling уже есть в GameRoomViewModel через PollRoomAsync
            // Просто обновляем UI каждые 2 секунды
            _pollTimer = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2) };
            _pollTimer.Tick += (s, args) =>
            {
                try
                {
                    UpdateRoomInfo();
                    UpdatePlayersList();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[RoomHostView] Poll error", ex);
                }
            };
            _pollTimer.Start();
        }

        private void RoomHostView_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            _pollTimer?.Stop();
            if (_viewModel != null)
            {
                _viewModel.PropertyChanged -= ViewModel_PropertyChanged;
            }
        }

        private void ViewModel_PropertyChanged(object? sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            Logger.Log($"[RoomHostView] PropertyChanged: {e.PropertyName}");
            if (e.PropertyName == nameof(GameRoomViewModel.CurrentRoom) || 
                e.PropertyName == nameof(GameRoomViewModel.RoomPlayers))
            {
                UpdateRoomInfo();
                UpdatePlayersList();
            }
        }

        private bool _isPasswordVisible = false;

        private void UpdateRoomInfo()
        {
            if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom != null)
            {
                RoomCodeText.Text = _viewModel.CurrentRoom.RoomCode;
                RoomNameText.Text = _viewModel.CurrentRoom.RoomName;
                QuizNameText.Text = _viewModel.QuizName; // Bind to ViewModel's QuizName
                
                // Подсчитываем всех игроков (включая хоста)
                var playerCount = _viewModel.RoomPlayers?.Count ?? 0;
                // Если хоста нет в списке, добавляем его
                if (playerCount == 0 || !_viewModel.RoomPlayers.Any(p => p.IsHost))
                {
                    var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                    if (currentUser != null && string.Equals(currentUser.Username, _viewModel.CurrentRoom.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        playerCount = Math.Max(playerCount, 1); // Хоста засчитываем как игрока
                    }
                }
                var maxPlayers = _viewModel.CurrentRoom.MaxPlayers;
                PlayersCountText.Text = $"{playerCount} / {maxPlayers}";
                
                // Проверяем готовность всех игроков (кроме хоста)
                var guests = _viewModel.RoomPlayers?.Where(p => !p.IsHost).ToList();
                var allGuestsReady = guests == null || guests.Count == 0 || guests.All(p => p.IsReady);
                
                // Можно начинать если хотя бы 1 игрок И все гости готовы
                StartGameButton.IsEnabled = playerCount >= 1 && allGuestsReady;
                
                // Показываем блок с паролем только для приватных комнат
                if (_viewModel.CurrentRoom.IsPrivate && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Password))
                {
                    PasswordPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    if (!_isPasswordVisible)
                    {
                        RoomPasswordText.Text = new string('●', _viewModel.CurrentRoom.Password?.Length ?? 0);
                        ShowPasswordButton.Content = "Показать";
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        RoomPasswordText.Text = _viewModel.CurrentRoom.Password ?? string.Empty;
                        ShowPasswordButton.Content = "Скрыть";
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    PasswordPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }
                
                // Загружаем настройки комнаты (только один раз)
                if (!_initialSettingsLoaded)
                {
                    LoadRoomSettings();
                }
            }
        }

        private bool _initialSettingsLoaded = false;

        private void UpdatePlayersList()
        {
            if (_viewModel?.RoomPlayers != null && _viewModel.CurrentRoom != null)
            {
                // Фильтруем хоста из списка игроков (он будет показан отдельно)
                var guests = _viewModel.RoomPlayers
                    .Where(p => !p.IsHost)
                    .OrderBy(p => p.DisplayLabel, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                    .ToList();

                // PlayersList.ItemsSource is bound to VisibleRoomPlayers in XAML
                // Do not set it manually here
                
                // Показываем хоста отдельно
                var host = _viewModel.RoomPlayers.FirstOrDefault(p => p.IsHost);
                if (host != null)
                {
                    HostCard.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    HostNameText.Text = host.DisplayLabel;
                }
                else
                {
                    // Если хоста нет в списке, создаём его из CurrentRoom
                    var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                    if (currentUser != null && string.Equals(currentUser.Username, _viewModel.CurrentRoom.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        HostCard.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                        HostNameText.Text = currentUser.DisplayName ?? currentUser.Username;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        HostCard.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                    }
                }
                
                if (guests.Count == 0)
                {
                    WaitingText.Text = "Ожидание других игроков...";
                }
                else
                {
                    var readyCount = guests.Count(p => p.IsReady);
                    WaitingText.Text = $"{readyCount} из {guests.Count} игроков готовы";
                }
            }
        }

        private async void KickPlayer_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom == null) return;
                if (sender is not Button btn || btn.Tag is not string username || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username)) return;

                SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();

                var dialog = new ConfirmationDialog("Выгнать игрока?", $"Вы действительно хотите выгнать игрока '{username}' из комнаты?");
                dialog.Owner = Application.Current.MainWindow;
                if (dialog.ShowDialog() != true) return;

                var svc = new SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                var ok = await svc.KickPlayer(_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Id, username);
                if (ok)
                {
                    new NotificationWindow($"Игрок '{username}' выгнан из комнаты", "success").Show();
                }
                else
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Не удалось выгнать игрока", "error").Show();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[RoomHostView] KickPlayer_Click error", ex);
                new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при выгоне игрока", "error").Show();
            }
        }

        private async void BanPlayer_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom == null) return;
                if (sender is not Button btn || btn.Tag is not string username || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username)) return;

                SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();

                var dialog = new ConfirmationDialog("Забанить игрока?", $"Вы действительно хотите забанить игрока '{username}'? Он не сможет вернуться в эту комнату.");
                dialog.Owner = Application.Current.MainWindow;
                if (dialog.ShowDialog() != true) return;

                var svc = new SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                var ok = await svc.BanPlayer(_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Id, username);
                if (ok)
                {
                    new NotificationWindow($"Игрок '{username}' забанен и выгнан из комнаты", "success").Show();
                }
                else
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Не удалось забанить игрока", "error").Show();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[RoomHostView] BanPlayer_Click error", ex);
                new NotificationWindow("Ошибка при бане игрока", "error").Show();
            }
        }

        private void ShowPassword_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom == null) return;
                
                _isPasswordVisible = !_isPasswordVisible;
                
                if (_isPasswordVisible)
                {
                    // Показываем пароль
                    RoomPasswordText.Text = _viewModel.CurrentRoom.Password ?? string.Empty;
                    ShowPasswordButton.Content = "Скрыть";
                }
                else
                {
                    // Скрываем пароль
                    RoomPasswordText.Text = new string('●', _viewModel.CurrentRoom.Password?.Length ?? 0);
                    ShowPasswordButton.Content = "Показать";
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[RoomHostView] ShowPassword_Click error", ex);
            }
        }

        private void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Logger.Log("[RoomHostView] Back button clicked");
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            if (_viewModel != null)
            {
                _viewModel.LeaveRoomCommand?.Execute(null);
            }
            else
            {
                Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("GameRooms");
            }
        }

        private async void StartGame_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Logger.Log("[RoomHostView] Start Game button clicked");
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            if (_viewModel != null)
            {
                // Проверка синхронизации настроек перед запуском
                if (!await VerifySettingsSynchronized())
                {
                    return;
                }

                _viewModel.StartGameCommand?.Execute(null);
            }
        }

        private async Task<bool> VerifySettingsSynchronized()
        {
            try
            {
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom == null) return false;

                var uiSettings = GetCurrentSettingsFromUI();
                var dbSettings = new Dictionary<string, object>();

                if (_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Settings != null && 
                    _viewModel.CurrentRoom.Settings.TryGetValue("game_settings", out var gameSettingsRaw))
                {
                     var gameSettingsJson = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(gameSettingsRaw);
                     dbSettings = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, object>>(gameSettingsJson) ?? new Dictionary<string, object>();
                }

                // Сравниваем ключевые настройки
                bool synchronized = true;
                foreach (var kvp in uiSettings)
                {
                    if (!dbSettings.TryGetValue(kvp.Key, out var dbValue))
                    {
                        synchronized = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    
                    // Приводим к строке для сравнения, чтобы избежать проблем с типами (int vs long)
                    if (!string.Equals(kvp.Value.ToString(), dbValue.ToString(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        synchronized = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!synchronized)
                {
                    Logger.LogWarning("[RoomHostView] Settings not synchronized. Retrying save...");
                    new NotificationWindow("Настройки синхронизируются...", "info").Show();
                    
                    // Принудительно сохраняем
                    await SaveRoomSettingsAsync();
                    
                    // Даем время на прохождение запроса и обновление polling (хотя polling нам тут не поможет мгновенно)
                    // Но SaveRoomSettingsAsync ждет ответа от сервера, так что данные там уже должны быть.
                    // Мы не можем ждать polling, так как он раз в секунду.
                    // Поэтому мы просто возвращаем false и просим пользователя нажать еще раз (или можно было бы рекурсивно вызвать, но лучше явно)
                    
                    new NotificationWindow("Настройки обновлены. Нажмите 'Начать игру' ещё раз.", "warning").Show();
                    return false;
                }

                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[RoomHostView] VerifySettingsSynchronized error", ex);
                return true; // В случае ошибки разрешаем запуск, чтобы не блокировать
            }
        }

        private void CopyCode_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom != null)
                {
                    Clipboard.SetText(_viewModel.CurrentRoom.RoomCode);
                    new NotificationWindow("Код скопирован!", "success").Show();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[RoomHostView] CopyCode error", ex);
            }
        }

        private async void InviteFriends_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Logger.Log("[RoomHostView] InviteFriends button clicked");
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();

            // Отключаем кнопку чтобы не было повторных нажатий
            InviteFriendsButton.IsEnabled = false;
            var originalContent = InviteFriendsButton.Content;
            InviteFriendsButton.Content = "⏳ Загрузка...";

            try
            {
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null)
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Требуется вход", "error").Show();
                    return;
                }

                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom == null)
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Комната не найдена", "error").Show();
                    return;
                }

                var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
                // Получение друзей с таймаутом и безопасным fallback, чтобы не блокировать UI
                var friendsTask = social.GetFriends(current.Username);
                var completed = await Task.WhenAny(friendsTask, Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8)));
                var friends = completed == friendsTask ? (await friendsTask) : new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();

                // Получаем список игроков, уже находящихся в комнате
                var svc = new SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                var playersTask = svc.GetRoomPlayersPublic(_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Id);
                completed = await Task.WhenAny(playersTask, Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8)));
                var playersInRoom = completed == playersTask ? (await playersTask) : new System.Collections.Generic.List<Victory.Services.MultiplayerRoomPlayer>();

                // Фильтруем:
                // 1. Хоста комнаты - хост не может быть приглашён в свою же комнату
                // 2. Игроков, которые уже находятся в комнате
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom != null)
                {
                    friends = friends.Where(f => 
                        // Не хост
                        !string.Equals(f, _viewModel.CurrentRoom.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                        // Не находится уже в комнате
                        !playersInRoom.Any(p => string.Equals(p.Username, f, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || 
                                               string.Equals(p.DisplayName, f, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    ).ToList();
                }

                // Возвращаем кнопку перед показом диалога
                InviteFriendsButton.Content = originalContent;
                InviteFriendsButton.IsEnabled = true;

                var dlg = new InviteFriendsDialog(friends.ToArray());
                dlg.Owner = Application.Current.MainWindow;
                // Показываем диалог без блокировки UI — через Dispatcher.BeginInvoke
                bool? result = null;
                await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { result = dlg.ShowDialog(); }, DispatcherPriority.Background);

                if (result == true && dlg.SelectedUsernames.Length > 0)
                {
                    // Снова отключаем на время отправки
                    InviteFriendsButton.IsEnabled = false;
                    InviteFriendsButton.Content = "📤 Отправка...";

                    int invited = 0;
                    // Игроки уже отфильтрованы ранее, просто отправляем приглашения
                    foreach (var toUsername in dlg.SelectedUsernames)
                    {
                        // Отправка инвайта с таймаутом
                        var inviteTask = social.InviteToRoom(_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Id, current.Username, toUsername);
                        completed = await Task.WhenAny(inviteTask, Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8)));
                        var ok = completed == inviteTask && await inviteTask;
                        if (ok) invited++;
                    }
                    new NotificationWindow(invited > 0 ? $"Отправлено приглашений: {invited}" : "Некого приглашать", invited > 0 ? "success" : "info").Show();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[RoomHostView] InviteFriends error", ex);
                new NotificationWindow("Ошибка отправки приглашений", "error").Show();
            }
            finally
            {
                // Всегда возвращаем кнопку в нормальное состояние
                InviteFriendsButton.Content = originalContent;
                InviteFriendsButton.IsEnabled = true;
            }
        }

        // Обработчик изменения режима таймера
        private void TimerMode_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Включаем/выключаем TextBox в зависимости от выбранного режима
            GlobalTimerTextBox.IsEnabled = GlobalTimerRadio.IsChecked == true;
            PerQuestionTimerTextBox.IsEnabled = PerQuestionTimerRadio.IsChecked == true;
            
            // "Ждать пока все ответят" доступен только при "Таймер на каждый вопрос"
            WaitForAllToggle.IsEnabled = PerQuestionTimerRadio.IsChecked == true;
            
            // Если выключили "Таймер на каждый вопрос", то сбрасываем "Ждать пока все ответят"
            if (PerQuestionTimerRadio.IsChecked != true)
            {
                WaitForAllToggle.IsChecked = false;
            }
        }

        // Обработчик изменения настроек (для синхронизации)
        private void Settings_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            _ = SaveRoomSettingsAsync();
        }

        // Обработчик изменения текста в TextBox (с задержкой)
        private System.Threading.Timer? _settingsSaveTimer;
        private void Settings_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Используем таймер с задержкой чтобы не сохранять после каждого символа
            _settingsSaveTimer?.Dispose();
            _settingsSaveTimer = new System.Threading.Timer(_ =>
            {
                Dispatcher.Invoke(() => _ = SaveRoomSettingsAsync());
            }, null, 1000, System.Threading.Timeout.Infinite); // Сохраняем через 1 секунду после последнего изменения
        }

        // Загрузить настройки комнаты из Supabase
        private void LoadRoomSettings()
        {
            try
            {
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom?.Settings == null) return;

                // Проверяем наличие game_settings
                if (_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Settings.TryGetValue("game_settings", out var gameSettingsRaw))
                {
                    var gameSettingsJson = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(gameSettingsRaw);
                    var gameSettings = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, object>>(gameSettingsJson);

                    if (gameSettings != null)
                    {
                        // Отключаем обработчики на время загрузки чтобы не вызывать сохранение
                        NoTimerRadio.Checked -= Settings_Changed;
                        GlobalTimerRadio.Checked -= Settings_Changed;
                        PerQuestionTimerRadio.Checked -= Settings_Changed;
                        GlobalTimerTextBox.TextChanged -= Settings_TextChanged;
                        PerQuestionTimerTextBox.TextChanged -= Settings_TextChanged;
                        WaitForAllToggle.Checked -= Settings_Changed;
                        WaitForAllToggle.Unchecked -= Settings_Changed;
                        ShuffleQuestionsToggle.Checked -= Settings_Changed;
                        ShuffleQuestionsToggle.Unchecked -= Settings_Changed;
                        HostParticipationToggle.Checked -= Settings_Changed;
                        HostParticipationToggle.Unchecked -= Settings_Changed;
                        RejoinAllowedCheckBox.Checked -= Settings_Changed;
                        RejoinAllowedCheckBox.Unchecked -= Settings_Changed;

                        // Timer Mode
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("timer_mode", out var timerMode))
                        {
                            var mode = timerMode.ToString();
                            NoTimerRadio.IsChecked = mode == "none";
                            GlobalTimerRadio.IsChecked = mode == "global";
                            PerQuestionTimerRadio.IsChecked = mode == "per_question";
                        }

                        // Timer values
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("global_timer_seconds", out var globalTimer))
                        {
                            GlobalTimerTextBox.Text = globalTimer.ToString();
                        }
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("per_question_timer_seconds", out var perQuestionTimer))
                        {
                            PerQuestionTimerTextBox.Text = perQuestionTimer.ToString();
                        }

                        // Toggles and checkbox
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("wait_for_all", out var waitForAll))
                        {
                            WaitForAllToggle.IsChecked = waitForAll.ToString().ToLower() == "true";
                        }
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("shuffle_questions", out var shuffle))
                        {
                            ShuffleQuestionsToggle.IsChecked = shuffle.ToString().ToLower() == "true";
                        }
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("host_participation", out var hostPart))
                        {
                            HostParticipationToggle.IsChecked = hostPart.ToString().ToLower() == "true";
                        }
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("rejoin_allowed", out var rejoin))
                        {
                            RejoinAllowedCheckBox.IsChecked = rejoin.ToString().ToLower() == "true";
                        }

                        // Включаем обработчики обратно
                        NoTimerRadio.Checked += Settings_Changed;
                        GlobalTimerRadio.Checked += Settings_Changed;
                        PerQuestionTimerRadio.Checked += Settings_Changed;
                        GlobalTimerTextBox.TextChanged += Settings_TextChanged;
                        PerQuestionTimerTextBox.TextChanged += Settings_TextChanged;
                        WaitForAllToggle.Checked += Settings_Changed;
                        WaitForAllToggle.Unchecked += Settings_Changed;
                        ShuffleQuestionsToggle.Checked += Settings_Changed;
                        ShuffleQuestionsToggle.Unchecked += Settings_Changed;
                        HostParticipationToggle.Checked += Settings_Changed;
                        HostParticipationToggle.Unchecked += Settings_Changed;
                        RejoinAllowedCheckBox.Checked += Settings_Changed;
                        RejoinAllowedCheckBox.Unchecked += Settings_Changed;

                        Logger.Log("[RoomHostView] Settings loaded from Supabase");
                        _initialSettingsLoaded = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[RoomHostView] Error loading settings: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        private Dictionary<string, object> GetCurrentSettingsFromUI()
        {
            // Parse and validate timer values
            int globalTimer = int.TryParse(GlobalTimerTextBox.Text, out int gt) ? gt : GameSettings.DefaultGlobalTimerSeconds;
            int perQuestionTimer = int.TryParse(PerQuestionTimerTextBox.Text, out int pqt) ? pqt : GameSettings.DefaultPerQuestionTimerSeconds;
            
            // Validate timer values
            globalTimer = GameSettings.ValidateTimerSeconds(globalTimer, isGlobal: true);
            perQuestionTimer = GameSettings.ValidateTimerSeconds(perQuestionTimer, isGlobal: false);
            
            // Determine timer mode
            string timerMode = NoTimerRadio.IsChecked == true ? GameSettings.TimerModeNone :
                              GlobalTimerRadio.IsChecked == true ? GameSettings.TimerModeGlobal : 
                              GameSettings.TimerModePerQuestion;
            
            return new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                [GameSettings.TimerMode] = timerMode,
                [GameSettings.GlobalTimerSeconds] = globalTimer,
                [GameSettings.PerQuestionTimerSeconds] = perQuestionTimer,
                [GameSettings.WaitForAll] = WaitForAllToggle.IsChecked == true,
                [GameSettings.ShuffleQuestions] = ShuffleQuestionsToggle.IsChecked == true,
                [GameSettings.HostParticipation] = HostParticipationToggle.IsChecked == true,
                [GameSettings.RejoinAllowed] = RejoinAllowedCheckBox.IsChecked == true
            };
        }

        // Сохранить настройки комнаты в Supabase
        private async Task SaveRoomSettingsAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom == null) return;

                var gameSettings = GetCurrentSettingsFromUI();

                var service = new SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                await service.UpdateRoomSettings(_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Id, gameSettings);
                Logger.Log("[RoomHostView] Settings saved to Supabase");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[RoomHostView] Error saving settings: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        // Removed unused RoomPasswordText_TextChanged handler
    }
}

using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class RoomInviteNotificationWindow : Window
    {
        private readonly int _inviteId;
        private readonly int _roomId;
        private readonly string _fromUsername;
        private readonly DispatcherTimer _timer;
        private int _secondsLeft = 10;

        public RoomInviteNotificationWindow(int inviteId, int roomId, string fromUsername)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _inviteId = inviteId;
            _roomId = roomId;
            _fromUsername = fromUsername;

            MessageText.Text = $"@{fromUsername} приглашает вас в комнату";
            CountdownText.Text = $"Закроется через {_secondsLeft} сек";

            Loaded += (s, e) =>
            {
                Left = (SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenWidth - ActualWidth) / 2;
                Top = 60;
            };

            _timer = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1) };
            _timer.Tick += (s, e) =>
            {
                _secondsLeft--;
                if (_secondsLeft <= 0)
                {
                    _timer.Stop();
                    CloseWithAnimation();
                }
                else
                {
                    CountdownText.Text = $"Закроется через {_secondsLeft} сек";
                }
            };
            _timer.Start();
        }

        private async void AcceptButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] Accept button clicked, inviteId={_inviteId}, roomId={_roomId}");
                AcceptButton.IsEnabled = false;
                DeclineButton.IsEnabled = false;

                var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
                await social.AcceptRoomInvite(_inviteId);
                Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] Invite accepted in DB");

                // Авто-присоединение к комнате и переход на экран ожидания
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current != null)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] Current user: {current.Username}, joining room {_roomId}");
                    var svc = new SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                    
                    // Проверяем, не является ли пользователь хостом этой комнаты
                    var roomInfo = await svc.GetRoomWithPlayers(_roomId);
                    if (roomInfo != null && string.Equals(roomInfo.HostUsername, current.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] User {current.Username} is the host of room {_roomId}, cannot join as regular player!");
                        new NotificationWindow("Вы не можете присоединиться к своей собственной комнате", "error").Show();
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    // Добавляем игрока в комнату по Id
                    bool ok;
                    try
                    {
                        ok = await svc.JoinRoomById(_roomId, current.Username, current.DisplayName);
                    }
                    catch (BannedFromRoomException ex)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] User is banned from room: {ex.Message}");
                        new NotificationWindow("Вы забанены в этой комнате и не можете присоединиться", "error").Show();
                        Close();
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] JoinRoomById result: {ok}");
                    
                    if (ok)
                    {
                        var r = await svc.GetRoomWithPlayers(_roomId);
                        if (r != null)
                        {
                            Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] Room fetched: {r.RoomName}, players: {r.Players?.Count ?? 0}");
                            
                            // Маппинг в локальную модель и сохранение для VM
                            var localRoom = new Victory.ViewModels.GameRoom
                            {
                                Id = r.Id,
                                RoomCode = r.RoomCode,
                                RoomName = r.RoomName,
                                HostUsername = r.HostUsername,
                                GameType = r.GameType,
                                Status = r.Status,
                                MaxPlayers = r.MaxPlayers,
                                CurrentPlayers = r.CurrentPlayers,
                                QuizId = r.QuizId,
                                Settings = r.Settings,
                                CreatedAt = r.CreatedAt,
                                StartedAt = r.StartedAt,
                                FinishedAt = r.FinishedAt,
                                Players = r.Players?.Select(p => new Victory.ViewModels.GameRoomPlayer
                                {
                                    Id = p.Id,
                                    RoomId = p.RoomId,
                                    Username = p.Username,
                                    DisplayName = p.DisplayName,
                                    AvatarPath = p.AvatarPath,
                                    JoinedAt = p.JoinedAt,
                                    IsReady = p.IsReady,
                                    Score = p.Score,
                                    Position = p.Position
                                }).ToList()
                            };

                            RoomDataService.CurrentRoom = localRoom;
                            Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] ✅ RoomDataService.CurrentRoom set: ID={localRoom.Id}, Name={localRoom.RoomName}, Host={localRoom.HostUsername}");
                            
                            // Установим текущего игрока для корректного отображения в лобби
                            Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] 🔍 Searching for player '{current.Username}' in room players list (total: {localRoom.Players?.Count ?? 0})");
                            var mePlayer = localRoom.Players?.FirstOrDefault(pp =>
                                string.Equals(pp.Username, current.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                            if (mePlayer != null)
                            {
                                RoomDataService.CurrentPlayer = mePlayer;
                                Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] ✅ CurrentPlayer set: {mePlayer.Username}, IsReady={mePlayer.IsReady}");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                Logger.LogError($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] ❌ CurrentPlayer NOT FOUND for {current.Username}! This will cause issues!");
                                Logger.LogError($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] Available players: {string.Join(", ", localRoom.Players?.Select(p => p.Username) ?? new List<string>())}");
                            }

                            // Навигация с новой VM (она подхватит RoomDataService.CurrentRoom)
                            Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] 🚀 Starting navigation to RoomJoin view on UI thread...");
                            System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] 🔨 Creating new GameRoomViewModel...");
                                    var vm = new Victory.ViewModels.GameRoomViewModel();
                                    Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] ✅ GameRoomViewModel created successfully");
                                    
                                    Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] 🧭 Setting current ViewModel...");
                                    NavigationService.Instance.SetCurrentViewModel(vm);
                                    Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] ✅ ViewModel set");
                                    
                                    Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] 🧭 Navigating to RoomJoin...");
                                    NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("RoomJoin", vm);
                                    Logger.Log($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] ✅ Navigation to RoomJoin completed successfully!");
                                }
                                catch (Exception navEx)
                                {
                                    Logger.LogError($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] ❌ NAVIGATION FAILED: {navEx.Message}", navEx);
                                    Logger.LogError($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] StackTrace: {navEx.StackTrace}");
                                    if (navEx.InnerException != null)
                                    {
                                        Logger.LogError($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] Inner Exception: {navEx.InnerException.Message}");
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            Logger.LogError($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] Room {_roomId} not found after join");
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Logger.LogError($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] Failed to join room {_roomId}");
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.LogError($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] Current user is null");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[RoomInviteNotificationWindow] Accept error: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                CloseWithAnimation();
            }
        }

        private async void DeclineButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                AcceptButton.IsEnabled = false;
                DeclineButton.IsEnabled = false;
                var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
                await social.DeclineRoomInvite(_inviteId);
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                CloseWithAnimation();
            }
        }

        private void CloseWithAnimation()
        {
            var fadeOut = new DoubleAnimation(1, 0, new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(200)));
            fadeOut.Completed += (s, e) => Close();
            BeginAnimation(OpacityProperty, fadeOut);
        }
    }
}
