=== FILE: Views/RoomJoinView.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using Victory.Services;
using Victory.ViewModels;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class RoomJoinView : Page
    {
        private GameRoomViewModel? _viewModel;
        private DispatcherTimer? _pollTimer;
        private bool _isPasswordVisible = false;

        public RoomJoinView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            Logger.Log("[RoomJoinView] Constructor called");
            Loaded += RoomJoinView_Loaded;
            Unloaded += RoomJoinView_Unloaded;
        }

        private void RoomJoinView_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Logger.Log("[RoomJoinView] Loaded event fired");
            _viewModel = DataContext as GameRoomViewModel;

            if (_viewModel != null)
            {
                Logger.Log($"[RoomJoinView] DataContext is GameRoomViewModel");
                _viewModel.PropertyChanged += ViewModel_PropertyChanged;
                UpdateRoomInfo();
                UpdateReadyButton(); // Обновляем кнопку при загрузке
            }
            else
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[RoomJoinView] DataContext is not GameRoomViewModel: {DataContext?.GetType().Name ?? "null"}");
            }

            // Polling уже есть в GameRoomViewModel через PollRoomAsync
            // Просто обновляем UI каждые 2 секунды
            _pollTimer = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2) };
            _pollTimer.Tick += (s, args) =>
            {
                try
                {
                    UpdateRoomInfo();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[RoomJoinView] Poll error", ex);
                }
            };
            _pollTimer.Start();
        }

        private void RoomJoinView_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            _pollTimer?.Stop();
            if (_viewModel != null)
            {
                _viewModel.PropertyChanged -= ViewModel_PropertyChanged;
            }
        }

        private void ViewModel_PropertyChanged(object? sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            Logger.Log($"[RoomJoinView] PropertyChanged: {e.PropertyName}");
            if (e.PropertyName == nameof(GameRoomViewModel.CurrentRoom) || 
                e.PropertyName == nameof(GameRoomViewModel.RoomPlayers))
            {
                UpdateRoomInfo();
            }
            
            // Обновляем кнопку "Готов" при изменении IsReady в ViewModel
            if (e.PropertyName == nameof(GameRoomViewModel.IsReady) && _viewModel != null)
            {
                UpdateReadyButton();
            }
        }
        
        private void UpdateReadyButton()
        {
            if (_viewModel == null || ReadyButton == null) return;
            
            var isReady = _viewModel.IsReady;
            ReadyButton.Content = isReady ? "✓ Готов" : "○ Не готов";
            ReadyButton.Background = new System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                isReady 
                    ? System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(76, 175, 80)  // Green
                    : System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(158, 158, 158) // Gray
            );
        }

        private void UpdateRoomInfo()
        {
            if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom != null)
            {
                var allPlayers = _viewModel.RoomPlayers?.ToList() ?? new System.Collections.Generic.List<Victory.ViewModels.GameRoomPlayer>();
                var host = allPlayers.FirstOrDefault(p => p.IsHost);

                // ItemsSource is bound in XAML to VisibleRoomPlayers
                
                
                // Обновляем информацию о хосте
                if (host != null)
                {
                    HostNameText.Text = host.DisplayLabel;
                    // HostStatusText removed from XAML
                }
                
                var playerCount = allPlayers.Count;
                var guestCount = host == null ? playerCount : Math.Max(0, playerCount - 1);
                WaitingText.Text = playerCount < 2 
                    ? "Ожидание других игроков..." 
                    : $"{guestCount + 1} игроков в комнате";
                
                // Показываем блок с паролем только для приватных комнат
                if (_viewModel.CurrentRoom.IsPrivate && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Password))
                {
                    PasswordPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    if (!_isPasswordVisible)
                    {
                        RoomPasswordText.Text = new string('●', _viewModel.CurrentRoom.Password?.Length ?? 0);
                        ShowPasswordButton.Content = "Показать";
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        RoomPasswordText.Text = _viewModel.CurrentRoom.Password ?? string.Empty;
                        ShowPasswordButton.Content = "Скрыть";
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    PasswordPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }
                
                // Загружаем настройки комнаты
                LoadRoomSettings();
            }
        }

        private void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Logger.Log("[RoomJoinView] Back button clicked");
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();

            if (_viewModel != null)
            {
                _viewModel.LeaveRoomCommand?.Execute(null);
            }
            else
            {
                Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("GameRooms");
            }
        }

        private void CopyCode_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom != null)
                {
                    Clipboard.SetText(_viewModel.CurrentRoom.RoomCode);
                    new NotificationWindow("Код скопирован!", "success").Show();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[RoomJoinView] CopyCode error", ex);
            }
        }

        private void ShowPassword_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom == null) return;
                
                _isPasswordVisible = !_isPasswordVisible;
                
                if (_isPasswordVisible)
                {
                    // Показываем пароль
                    RoomPasswordText.Text = _viewModel.CurrentRoom.Password ?? string.Empty;
                    ShowPasswordButton.Content = "Скрыть";
                }
                else
                {
                    // Скрываем пароль
                    RoomPasswordText.Text = new string('●', _viewModel.CurrentRoom.Password?.Length ?? 0);
                    ShowPasswordButton.Content = "Показать";
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[RoomJoinView] ShowPassword_Click error", ex);
            }
        }

        private async void InviteFriends_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Logger.Log("[RoomJoinView] InviteFriends button clicked");
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();

            // Отключаем кнопку чтобы не было повторных нажатий
            InviteFriendsButton.IsEnabled = false;
            var originalContent = InviteFriendsButton.Content;
            InviteFriendsButton.Content = "⏳ Загрузка...";

            try
            {
                var current = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (current == null)
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Требуется вход", "error").Show();
                    return;
                }

                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom == null)
                {
                    new NotificationWindow("Комната не найдена", "error").Show();
                    return;
                }

                var social = new SupabaseSocialService();
                // Получение друзей с таймаутом и безопасным fallback, чтобы не блокировать UI
                var friendsTask = social.GetFriends(current.Username);
                var completed = await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.WhenAny(friendsTask, System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8)));
                var friends = completed == friendsTask ? (await friendsTask) : new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();

                // Получаем список игроков, уже находящихся в комнате
                var svc = new SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                var playersTask = svc.GetRoomPlayersPublic(_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Id);
                completed = await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.WhenAny(playersTask, System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8)));
                var playersInRoom = completed == playersTask ? (await playersTask) : new System.Collections.Generic.List<Victory.Services.MultiplayerRoomPlayer>();

                // Фильтруем:
                // 1. Хоста комнаты - хост не может быть приглашён в свою же комнату
                // 2. Игроков, которые уже находятся в комнате
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom != null)
                {
                    friends = friends.Where(f => 
                        // Не хост
                        !string.Equals(f, _viewModel.CurrentRoom.HostUsername, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                        // Не находится уже в комнате
                        !playersInRoom.Any(p => string.Equals(p.Username, f, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || 
                                               string.Equals(p.DisplayName, f, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    ).ToList();
                }

                // Возвращаем кнопку перед показом диалога
                InviteFriendsButton.Content = originalContent;
                InviteFriendsButton.IsEnabled = true;

                var dlg = new InviteFriendsDialog(friends.ToArray());
                dlg.Owner = Application.Current.MainWindow;
                // Показываем диалог без блокировки UI — через Dispatcher.BeginInvoke
                bool? result = null;
                await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { result = dlg.ShowDialog(); }, DispatcherPriority.Background);

                if (result == true && dlg.SelectedUsernames.Length > 0)
                {
                    // Снова отключаем на время отправки
                    InviteFriendsButton.IsEnabled = false;
                    InviteFriendsButton.Content = "📤 Отправка...";

                    int invited = 0;
                    // Игроки уже отфильтрованы ранее, просто отправляем приглашения
                    foreach (var toUsername in dlg.SelectedUsernames)
                    {
                        // Отправка инвайта с таймаутом
                        var inviteTask = social.InviteToRoom(_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Id, current.Username, toUsername);
                        completed = await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.WhenAny(inviteTask, System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8)));
                        var ok = completed == inviteTask && await inviteTask;
                        if (ok) invited++;
                    }
                    new NotificationWindow(invited > 0 ? $"Отправлено приглашений: {invited}" : "Некого приглашать", invited > 0 ? "success" : "info").Show();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[RoomJoinView] InviteFriends error", ex);
                new NotificationWindow("Ошибка отправки приглашений", "error").Show();
            }
            finally
            {
                // Всегда возвращаем кнопку в нормальное состояние
                InviteFriendsButton.Content = originalContent;
                InviteFriendsButton.IsEnabled = true;
            }
        }

        private async void ReadyButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Logger.Log("[RoomJoinView] Ready button clicked");
            SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();

            try
            {
                var currentUser = UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser == null || _viewModel?.CurrentRoom == null)
                {
                    return;
                }

                // Переключаем статус готовности
                var currentPlayer = _viewModel.RoomPlayers?.FirstOrDefault(p => 
                    string.Equals(p.Username, currentUser.Username, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                
                bool newReadyStatus = !(currentPlayer?.IsReady ?? false);

                // Optimistic UI Update
                var originalContent = ReadyButton.Content;
                var originalBackground = ReadyButton.Background;
                
                ReadyButton.Content = newReadyStatus ? "✓ Готов" : "○ Не готов";
                ReadyButton.Background = new System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                    newReadyStatus 
                        ? System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(76, 175, 80)  // Green
                        : System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(158, 158, 158) // Gray
                );
                
                // Prevent multiple clicks but keep the new look
                ReadyButton.IsEnabled = false; 

                var gameService = new SupabaseMultiplayerService();
                var success = await gameService.UpdatePlayerReadyStatus(
                    _viewModel.CurrentRoom.Id, 
                    currentUser.Username, 
                    newReadyStatus
                );

                if (success)
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[RoomJoinView] Ready status updated to: {newReadyStatus}");
                    
                    // Обновляем IsReady в ViewModel для синхронизации UI
                    // Сеттер IsReady уже вызывает OnPropertyChanged автоматически
                    if (_viewModel != null)
                    {
                        _viewModel.IsReady = newReadyStatus;
                        
                        // Также обновляем CurrentPlayer если он есть
                        if (_viewModel.CurrentPlayer != null)
                        {
                            _viewModel.CurrentPlayer.IsReady = newReadyStatus;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Trigger list update
                    await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(200);
                    UpdateRoomInfo();
                }
                else
                {
                    // Revert on failure
                    ReadyButton.Content = originalContent;
                    ReadyButton.Background = originalBackground;
                    new NotificationWindow("Не удалось обновить статус", "error").Show();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError("[RoomJoinView] ReadyButton_Click error", ex);
                new NotificationWindow("Ошибка обновления статуса", "error").Show();
            }
            finally
            {
                ReadyButton.IsEnabled = true;
            }
        }

        private void PlayerCard_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            var button = sender as FrameworkElement;
            var player = button?.DataContext as Victory.ViewModels.GameRoomPlayer;

            if (player != null)
            {
                Logger.Log($"[RoomJoinView] PlayerCard clicked: {player.Username}");
                SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();

                try
                {
                    var dialog = new MiniProfileDialog(
                        player.DisplayName ?? player.Username,
                        player.Username,
                        $"Игрок в комнате",
                        player.AvatarPath
                    );
                    dialog.Owner = Application.Current.MainWindow;
                    dialog.ShowDialog();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Logger.LogError("[RoomJoinView] PlayerCard_Click error", ex);
                }
            }
        }

        // Загрузить настройки комнаты из Supabase
        private void LoadRoomSettings()
        {
            try
            {
                if (_viewModel?.CurrentRoom?.Settings == null)
                {
                    Logger.Log("[RoomJoinView] No settings to load (CurrentRoom or Settings is null)");
                    return;
                }

                // Проверяем наличие game_settings
                if (_viewModel.CurrentRoom.Settings.TryGetValue("game_settings", out var gameSettingsRaw))
                {
                    Logger.Log($"[RoomJoinView] game_settings raw type: {gameSettingsRaw?.GetType().Name ?? "null"}");
                    
                    var gameSettingsJson = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(gameSettingsRaw);
                    Logger.Log($"[RoomJoinView] game_settings JSON: {gameSettingsJson}");
                    
                    var gameSettings = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, object>>(gameSettingsJson);

                    if (gameSettings != null)
                    {
                        // Timer Mode
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("timer_mode", out var timerMode))
                        {
                            var mode = timerMode.ToString();
                            NoTimerRadio.IsChecked = mode == "none";
                            GlobalTimerRadio.IsChecked = mode == "global";
                            PerQuestionTimerRadio.IsChecked = mode == "per_question";
                        }

                        // Timer values
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("global_timer_seconds", out var globalTimer))
                        {
                            GlobalTimerTextBox.Text = globalTimer.ToString();
                        }
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("per_question_timer_seconds", out var perQuestionTimer))
                        {
                            PerQuestionTimerTextBox.Text = perQuestionTimer.ToString();
                        }

                        // Toggles and checkbox
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("wait_for_all", out var waitForAll))
                        {
                            WaitForAllToggle.IsChecked = waitForAll.ToString().ToLower() == "true";
                        }
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("shuffle_questions", out var shuffle))
                        {
                            ShuffleQuestionsToggle.IsChecked = shuffle.ToString().ToLower() == "true";
                        }
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("host_participation", out var hostPart))
                        {
                            HostParticipationToggle.IsChecked = hostPart.ToString().ToLower() == "true";
                        }
                        if (gameSettings.TryGetValue("rejoin_allowed", out var rejoin))
                        {
                            RejoinAllowedCheckBox.IsChecked = rejoin.ToString().ToLower() == "true";
                        }

                        Logger.Log("[RoomJoinView] Settings loaded from Supabase");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Logger.Log("[RoomJoinView] Failed to deserialize game_settings");
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger.Log("[RoomJoinView] No game_settings found in CurrentRoom.Settings");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError($"[RoomJoinView] Error loading settings: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }
    }
}

using System.Windows;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class RoomPasswordDialog : Window
    {
        public string? EnteredPassword { get; private set; }

        public RoomPasswordDialog()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            PasswordBox.Focus();
        }

        private void Ok_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            EnteredPassword = PasswordBox.Password;
            DialogResult = true;
            Close();
        }

        private void Cancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            EnteredPassword = null;
            DialogResult = false;
            Close();
        }
    }

using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class SettingsView : Page
    {
        public SettingsView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        private void Back_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Victory.Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            
            // Check if user is logged in
            var currentUser = Victory.Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
            if (currentUser != null)
            {
                // User is logged in, go to main menu
                Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Main");
            }
            else
            {
                // User is not logged in, go to login
                Victory.Services.NavigationService.Instance.NavigateTo("Login");
            }
        }

        private void SaveSettings_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Show success notification
            var notification = new NotificationWindow("Настройки сохранены!", "success");
            notification.Show();
        }

        private void ResetSettings_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            var confirmDialog = new ConfirmationDialog(
                "Сброс настроек",
                "Вы уверены, что хотите сбросить все настройки на значения по умолчанию?"
            );
            confirmDialog.Owner = Window.GetWindow(this);
            
            if (confirmDialog.ShowDialog() == true && confirmDialog.Confirmed)
            {
                // Reset to default values
                if (DataContext is ViewModels.SettingsViewModel vm)
                {
                    vm.SoundEnabled = true;
                    vm.DarkTheme = false;
                    vm.NotificationsEnabled = true;
                    vm.AutoSave = true;
                }
                
                var notification = new NotificationWindow("Все настройки успешно сброшены на значения по умолчанию.", "success");
                notification.Show();
            }
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: Views/StatisticsWindow.xaml.cs ===

using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class StatisticsWindow : Window
    {
        public StatisticsWindow()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            
            // Позиционируем окно чуть ниже центра экрана
            Loaded += (s, e) =>
            {
                var screen = SystemParameters.WorkArea;
                Left = (screen.Width - Width) / 2;
                Top = (screen.Height - Height) / 2 + 40; // Опускаем на 40 пикселей ниже центра
            };
            
            _ = LoadStatisticsAsync();
        }

        private async Task LoadStatisticsAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                var currentUser = Services.UserService.GetCurrentUser();
                if (currentUser == null)
                {
                    Services.Logger.Log("[StatisticsWindow] No current user found");
                    return;
                }

                Services.Logger.Log($"[StatisticsWindow] Loading statistics for user: {currentUser.Username}");

                // Получаем профиль пользователя
                var authService = new Services.SupabaseAuthService();
                var profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(currentUser.Username);

                if (profile == null)
                {
                    Services.Logger.LogError("[StatisticsWindow] Failed to load user profile");
                    return;
                }

                // Получаем викторины пользователя
                var quizService = new Services.QuizEditorService();
                var quizzes = await quizService.GetAllQuizzesAsync();
                
                // Фильтруем викторины пользователя с вопросами (такая же логика, как при выборе викторин)
                var userQuizzes = quizzes.Where(q => 
                    q.Author == currentUser.Username && 
                    q.Questions != null && 
                    q.Questions.Count > 0
                ).ToList();

                Services.Logger.Log($"[StatisticsWindow] Found {userQuizzes.Count} valid quizzes for user (with questions)");

                // Синхронизируем счетчик в профиле с реальным количеством викторин
                if (userQuizzes.Count != profile.QuizzesCreated)
                {
                    Services.Logger.Log($"[StatisticsWindow] Syncing stats: actual={userQuizzes.Count}, profile={profile.QuizzesCreated}");
                    await authService.UpdateUserStats(currentUser.Username, userQuizzes.Count, profile.QuizzesPassed);
                    // Обновляем профиль после синхронизации
                    profile = await authService.GetUserProfile(currentUser.Username);
                }

                // Обновляем UI
                Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                {
                    // Основные метрики - используем реальное количество викторин с вопросами
                    int validQuizzesCount = userQuizzes.Count;
                    TotalQuizzesText.Text = validQuizzesCount.ToString();
                    
                    int totalQuestions = userQuizzes.Sum(q => q.Questions?.Count ?? 0);
                    TotalQuestionsText.Text = totalQuestions.ToString();
                    
                    double averageQuestions = validQuizzesCount > 0 
                        ? (double)totalQuestions / validQuizzesCount 
                        : 0;
                    AverageQuestionsText.Text = averageQuestions.ToString("F1");

                    // Дополнительная статистика - используем синхронизированное значение
                    QuizzesCreatedText.Text = (profile?.QuizzesCreated ?? validQuizzesCount).ToString();
                    QuizzesPassedText.Text = (profile?.QuizzesPassed ?? 0).ToString();
                    AiQuizzesText.Text = (profile?.AiQuizzesCreated ?? 0).ToString();
                    MultiplayerGamesText.Text = (profile?.MultiplayerGamesPlayed ?? 0).ToString();
                });

                Services.Logger.Log("[StatisticsWindow] Statistics loaded successfully");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Services.Logger.LogError("[StatisticsWindow] Error loading statistics", ex);
            }
        }

        private void Close_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Services.SoundService.Instance.PlayClickSound();
            Close();
        }
    }
}

using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class WinnerPickerWindow : Window
    {
        public string? SelectedPlayer { get; private set; }

        public WinnerPickerWindow()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            PlayersBox.ItemsSource = MultiplayerService.Players.Select(p => p.Name).ToList();
        }

        private void Cancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DialogResult = false;
            Close();
        }

        private void Ok_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (PlayersBox.SelectedItem is string name)
            {
                SelectedPlayer = name;
                DialogResult = true;
                Close();
            }
        }
    }
}

using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;
using Victory.Services;

namespace Victory.Views
{
    public partial class WinnerWindow : Window
    {
        public WinnerWindow()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            var winners = MultiplayerService.GetWinners();
            if (winners.Count == 0)
            {
                WinnerText.Text = "Ничья";
            }
            else if (winners.Count == 1)
            {
                WinnerText.Text = winners.First().Name;
            }
            else
            {
                WinnerText.Text = string.Join(", ", winners.Select(w => w.Name));
            }

            // Simple animation
            var fade = new DoubleAnimation(0, 1, new Duration(System.TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(400)));
            this.BeginAnimation(OpacityProperty, fade);

            SoundService.Instance.PlayQuizCompleteSound();
        }

        private void Ok_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DialogResult = true;
            Close();
        }
    }
}
